Zeynep was a most welcoming and generous host, with a gorgeous, comfortable flat - as advertised! The flat is light and spacious, kitchen well-equipped, bed comfortable (both beds actually), and bathroom clean, with great shower pressure. Zeynep prepared a note with key information about the flat, which was great to have for reference. I especially appreciated the ground coffee and coffee maker. The fact that there was a desk in the house made my stay all the more comfortable - I had a proper place to sit down at my computer.

It's clear that Zeynep has put a lot of care into making her flat a home - it's an awesome flat! 

Zeynep lives a five min walk to the sea, with a great park along the water front. There are plenty of hip cafes and coffee shops in the neighborhood (Moda), all a short walk from the flat. And it's only a 15 mins walk to the Kadikoy ferry, which offers easy access to the rest of Istanbul.

This place and the service has a lot of potential but certainly has not reached its prime yet. Ahmet was very quick to respond and approve my reservation which is great. He was also very responsive to additional questions. The residence service at the counter was also good and the blokes were helpful. The apartment is clean and spacious, although it could do with a couple of extra basic necessities particularly in the kitchen. 

However, two main things made this experience rather average instead of great.
- I reserved a flat with TWO bedrooms and only got one. I complained and they relocated me to a bigger apartment with two separate beds, but still ONE bedroom.  Upon booking make sure to confirm its two bedrooms you sign up to.

- Saturday seemed to be national construction day which meant 8am rise and shine. sunday there was activity too although less loud. Normally not a problem but not great when you experienced some of the Istanbul night life the night before. A notice about this at least would have been great.

reviews[2].comments: Впервые попробовал снять квартиру вместо гостиницы. Выбрал квартиру Османа - очень понравилось. По деталям, очень близко от метро Таксим - минут пять пешком. До Истикляль можно дойти минут за 6-8. Если пойти вниз от квартиры мимо больницы немецкого посольства, то до трамвая всего минут 15 ходьбы. В доме 6 этажей, лифт имеется. Подъезд закрывается на ключ и в маленькой коморке в подвальчике обязательно кто-то дежурит из людей Османа. Рядом с домом есть супермаркет CARREFOUR, что очень хорошо. Пару раз дергал Османа просьбами - он всегда помогал. В квартире 2 кондиционера ,  посуда, вайфай, тв, чайник и тд. рекомендую!
reviews[3].comments: My family enjoyed staying in Osman's flat. Osman is very helpful, kind and communicative person. Although the flat is smaller than what you see in the pictures but it was clean and tidy and comfortable enough to stay.
reviews[4].comments: Apartment is in very good location in Taksim area! It is located in calm small street, but not far from Istacle street and the square, where airport shuttle buses are arriving. There is also supermarket just around the corner. So very convenient! We had everything we needed in the apartment, but don't expect 5star hotel :) It is cosy home atmosphere. There are some problem in shower as water is passing by and getting on floor, but otherwise all is good :) Thank's for Osman and his team! Osman was very responsive, when I had some doubts due to not calm situation in Taksim square. Luckily all was good :) I can for sure recommend Osman and his apartments as home out of home :)
reviews[5].comments: There was 4 of us staying in this luxury apartment in Istanbul. We were there during the end of the protesting but we felt so safe the whole time. Our host and landlord Osman cannot be faulted. He was there for any of out needs and questions and was continuously welcoming and friendly during out stay. I will be returning in the future and could not imagine a better place to stay. The area of the apartment was perfect. A stone throw away from the main street and taxsim square and a 5 minute walk to kabatas. I couldn't think of a better place to stay if your a family or a young group like we were. I cannot recommend this more. THANK YOU OSMAN
reviews[6].comments: Very nice and simple apartment in a great location about 5 mins walk from Taksim Square. Everything was great and Osman was helpful! Only issue was the wifi in the apartment which was poor.
reviews[7].comments:
Our stay in stay in Istanbul at Osmans place was very nice, the apartment was very clean and looked as described.

The location is very good, very central and you can reach the public transport easily too.

Besides that Osman is a very kind and helpful guy.
reviews[8].comments: Стамбул произвёл на нас отличное впечатление и квартирка Османа не стала исключением. Её расположение позволило нам очень быстро добраться от площади Таксим,но она находится немножко вглубине, поэтому шум улиц нас совсем не беспокоил. Единственным неудобством было то, что вход в душевую проходит через одну из комнат.
reviews[9].comments: Thank you Osman, your apartments are lovely and in a great location.  Easy walking to Taxim square (10 min) and downhill and across the bridge to the Old city (35 min).  Apartments are clean and well furnished.  \r\nOsman took great care of us.  Because the person before us had not checked out from our room when we arrived, Osman placed us in a different room, then moved us to a top floor penthouse for our second night. The view from the roof top suite the second night was fantastic. Osman was very responsive and easy to work with.  I highly recommend staying in his apartments when in Istanbul.
reviews[10].comments: Osman was a great host! My friends and I arrived early and we did wait a few minutes but Osman and his friend Rejup were really helpful. The location is perfect - close enough to taxsim, but not too close and loud. \r\n\r\nWould stay here again if i'm in istanbul
reviews[11].comments: Osman's place was great! I enjoyed the stay very much.
reviews[12].comments:
Osman est une personne très agréable et serviable. Il a fait son maximum pour que nous nous sentions bien dans son appartement.
L'immeuble où il a les appartements est bien situé dans Taksim. Il y a cependant un bar à proximité et on entendait souvent du bruit la nuit (pour les personnes dormant dans le salon). La chambre était calme. L'appartement était propre.
En revanche, lorsque j'avais réservé (pour 5), je ne pensais pas que nous dormirerions sur des matelas pneumatiques. Nous en avons parlé à Osman qui a arrangé la situation et nous a donné deux appartements. Nous avons eu à changer 3 fois de chambre et c'est un peu dommage ! 
Mais ça reste une bonne expérience. Appartement à recommander plutôt pour 2 ou 3 personnes !
reviews[13].comments: We were stying 5 girls in this apartment. We enjoyed our stay so much. Osman was very friendly. the kitchen and bathroom were small for 5 of us. Anyway we didnt need to cook since there are lot of opportunities to eat outside. Sleeping was comfortable for each of us, Osman provided us after request with extra blanket so that we didnt have to sleep under one for couples. The apartment provided also free Wifi which was working great and there was also hair dryer which we apreciated a lot. We would definitely recommend this appartment to our friends.
reviews[14].comments:
We really loved staying at Osman's place! It was hidden from d main road but yet steps away from Taksim Square. Super quiet at nite n thts what we wanted, a peaceful sleep. 

Its a really clean apartment. No problem wth getting food, near to the subway n bus terminals. 

Osman was very helpful esp with our luggages n easy going host. Next trip to Istanbul, we will definetly be staying there again.
reviews[15].comments: I love staying at Osman's place. It was close to the Taksim area where exciting events are going on! He was kind and nice to us. I wish I could stay in Istanbul longer and definitely go to Osman's place when I visit Istanbul! Moreover, the shuttle service from airport was cheaper than I expected. It costs me $35 US dollar from his place to the Ataturk airport! \r\n\r\nThanks for great memory Osman
reviews[16].comments: Greatly enjoyed our stay in Istanbul and this place was the ideal base for is. Around the corner of Taksim square and near all the nice cafes. Would definitely recommend it!
reviews[17].comments: It was a great time in Istambul, the flat was clean and correct, the location is perfect. Osman is a very good host, it is highly recommended flat.
reviews[18].comments: Osman is a great host! Always available and supportive! The flat is simply perfect, both in terms of position and itself! Great experience!
reviews[19].comments: Overall our stay was very nice... everything was clean. However, there is an elevator going through the flat, which is not awful, however makes inconvenient noise... further was the shower lacking water, making it complicated to shower after one another, as you were constantly standing on a wet ground.\r\n\r\nwe could live and work with everything, though. overall a very nice stay
reviews[20].comments: Very well located, the welcoming was very nice. \r\n\r\nThe flat is clean and it looks exaclty like the pictures.
reviews[21].comments: Osman was a great host, helpful and kind. Appartment is really convinient for three to four persons, 5 minutes walk from Taxim square (excellent location), very clean. People seem to look for appartments in Sultanahmet were tourist attractions are, but to us there is absolutely no need for that - you go there once or twice and thats it. Taxim is real center, and you can easily walk to some other great parts of Istanbul  from there (Dolmabahce palace, Istanbul Moderna, Istiklal street...) or take cab that is really cheap. Plus, as I said appartment is cozy and clean, and Osman is like the good host, there for most of the times (which is not always the case). Recomendation for sure!\r\n
reviews[22].comments: Thank you Osman for the accommodation!the appartment is lovely, the location is great and Osman really helpful with everything!
reviews[23].comments: We had wonderful long weekend (holiday) stay in Istanbul. Apartment was clean and nice (as in pictures), equipped with all necessary things (kettle, tv, beds, linens, fridge etc). Located in quiet side street but still only approx 10min walk away from Taksim square. I was not able to meet host Osman, but people who were taking care of the apartment during our stay were nice and friendly. I can warmly recommend!
reviews[24].comments: I thoroughly recommend this accommodation to everyone. first of all it is very clean and neat. Osman and his friends are very polite and helpful. the building has about 5 or six apartments each one including a living room, a bedroom and bathroom. there is s nice real bed in the bedroom and although 2 sofabeds in the living room. There is although a small kitchen with cooking stuff with help you to reduce your eating costs so much. the place of the residence is also very good.Just about 3 to 4 minutes far from Taksim square. When we got the apartment in the early morning, actually 3 hours before the check-in time, Osman was so kind to give us another apartment until our apartment gets ready. In the same way, because we were about to leave Istanbul some hours after the check out time, Osman helped us to leave our staff in his office and enjoy our last hours in the city. and the photos are exactly the same as the apartment. I highly recommend the apartment.
reviews[25].comments: Notre séjour a été parfait, Osman est un hôte très sympathique et l'appartement que nous avions était très confortable, impeccablement propre, parfaitement bien situé. \r\n\r\nJe recommande vivement !
reviews[26].comments:
Nous avons été très satisfaits par l'accueil et la disponibilité d'Osman ainsi que de son personnel. 
Outre ses fonctions de propriétaire, Osman a pu nous réserver un taxi pour notre arrivée à l'aéroport et pour le retour aussi, il a su même très bien réagir pour le retour (trop long à expliquer ici mais c'est un professionnel très fiable).
L'appartement correspond très bien à la réalité. TB entretenu et à proximité de tout dans l'Istanbul moderne et du tramway pour rejoindre le vieil Istanbul (10 min. en descente, provilégier le funiculaire pour la remontée !...).
En conclusion, c'est une TB adresse avec des professionnels sérieux et très accueillants.
reviews[27].comments: Osman was very friendly and helpful, apartment is   Centrally located on Taxim near amenities and many bars and cafes. Definitely recommended!
reviews[28].comments: Osman was very helpfull and organised our airport transfer so a driver was already waiting for us. The appartment is very well situated, shops for food and restaurants are just arround the corner...there is nothing more pleasant than to fetch warm bread in the mornings. The appartment is nice and tidy and  there is allways somebody in the house to get information and help if needed. The only disadvantage is the small bathroom but Osman is already thinking about a solution. I can only recommand the place and it also works very well for families.
reviews[29].comments: Fist of all , the location of the place is perfect and close to Taksim area by 5 minutes walk. Inside the apartment is very clean and everything looks good. Osman is a open guy and you can give your comments to him and he accept them.
reviews[30].comments: Nice and quiet appartment near Taksim Square, where you can take metro or bus to anywhere in or out Istanbul. Osman, the host, was very helpful with us. So we can only recommend to everybody.
reviews[31].comments: Osman was very friendly and helpful. The flat was clean practical for 4 persons. The neighborhood is good, with many bars and restaurants, and very central (near Taksim). We enjoyed our stay very much.
reviews[32].comments:
Osman was a great host.
The location was perfect and very close to all the great restaurants.
Had a great time and Osman was very accommodating even when we had two extra guests show up!
Thank you and will definitely stay there next time I come to Istanbul.
reviews[33].comments:
Amazing flat in a good location (Taksim).  We were 4 and we felt very comfortable sleeping in a large bed in a separate room and 2 comfortable sofa-beds for 1 person each (could also be 2 and 1).  Although the kitchen is a bit small we managed to cook most of the meals there (there is a Carrefour grocery store 30m away).  There is also a lot of very good restaurants nearby.

The flat is very safe as Osman or one of his friends is always on site to control who enters the building.

The flat is about 30 minutes from the airport (Ataturk) by taxi.

Thank you Osman for a perfect stay in the wonderful Istanbul!
reviews[34].comments: My family stayed at Osman's place for two nights and we really loved the place. It is close to all tourist attractions and transportation is easily accessible. We arrived at 6 in the morning but Osman was able to help us leave our luggage in his office. We would stay at Osman's place again !
reviews[35].comments: Good location, a little bit dangerous, everything is clean, but no hot water
reviews[36].comments: Appartement propre et très bien situé. Bon accueil d'Osman qui a été présent pour toute info nécessaire!
reviews[37].comments: We so enjoyed our stay. Osman was extremely helpful and welcoming. The flat was clean and very comfortable. It was good value and its location was excellent. Nothing was too much trouble and Osman organised all of our taxi travel etc.
reviews[38].comments:
Overall we had a very pleasant experience with Osman and his apartment. 

The apartment itself was very clean and exactly what we expected based on the listing. The location was very convenient since it was close to many restaurants and bars and also near public transportation.

Getting to the apartment from the airport was simple and worry-free thanks to Osman arranging a car to have us picked up. Getting to the airport at the end of our trip was simple as well by walking to Taksim Square and taking a shuttle bus.
reviews[39].comments: Value for money choice. The room is at excellent location, near Taxim square where you can go anywhere in the city. Clean, tidy and newly renovated.
reviews[40].comments: We had a very nice stay in Osman appartement. Osman was very helpfull and the appartement is exactly as describe. Furthermore it's well located in a quiet Street close of Taksim place and public transportation.
reviews[41].comments: Ottima posizione, appartamento pulito e nuovo.
reviews[42].comments: Die Unterkunft ist wie auf den Bildern zu sehen und liegt genial in der Nähe des Taksim Platzes, alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu erreichen.  Allein das Bad ist etwas klein, für den Aufenthalt ist es jedoch auf jeden Fall ausreichend. \r\nOsman kümmert sich um alles und hilft bei Fragen gerne weiter. Auch der Shuttle Service vom und zum Flughafen hat einwandfrei geklappt!\r\nWir würden wieder kommen!
reviews[43].comments: L'appartement est très sympa, propre, il correspond bien à la description. Osman est charmant et discret. Avec son bureau dans l'immeuble la remise des clefs est très simple. L'appartement est idéalement situé près des endroits qui bougent mais reste très calme. Je recommande !
reviews[44].comments: My friends and I stayed a week at Osman's apartment . It was a good experience. We were pleased to have had such a nice place to stay with comfortable beds, modern interior, neat and with perfect location. We thank Osman a lot for being a good host. Our best wishes to you! Çok teşekkürler! ;)
reviews[45].comments: The place was great, it was just as pictured and perfect for two people.  The portable stove did not work but we improvised with cooking by using the grill.  The building is also known as "Sunflower Apartments" and has an apartment for each floor that the owners seem to rent out.  The location is great, I'd recommend staying here.
reviews[46].comments: A very good flat and location! I would come back again. Thank you Osman)
reviews[47].comments: This apartment in Taksim was very neat and in a great location - lots of lovely cafes and bars nearby and an easy trip to any of the major sites. Osman provided clear instructions to get there and was waiting for us upon our arrival. The other people who man the desk in this building don't really speak English, but they could always call Osman for help which they did. He was helpful with other questions we had too. There was a problem with the plumbing in the bathroom, some leaking around the base of the toilet - which made the small bathroom quite wet. Osman offered to have it fixed while we were there to be fair, but we didn't want a tradesman through during our stay. It will hopefully be repaired when you stay here. The electric stove top did not seem to work, but all other appliances did. All in all, we really enjoyed our stay.
reviews[48].comments: Osman was very friendly during the whole stay and also helped with the airport transfer. Thanks again!\r\nThe apartment was clean and has everything you would need for a short stay. We really enjoyed the location near Taksim place with all the little restaurants/bars and cafés. this also means that it can get loud during the night.\r\nWe can recommend this apartment and would definitely come again!
reviews[49].comments: The flat is really nice, exactly like in the pictures and really well located in Istanbul. Osmane was very nice with us and explain everything. I recommend it !
reviews[50].comments:
A lovely home, close to Taksim, an important place for Istanbul. Besides, you only need five minutes to catch the train or a bus. 

The apartment is nice, with wifi, and nice bedroom. And for the other apartments of the building, you have a private lift! The only problem that we had is a leak in the bathroom. The floor was always wet.

So it is not so expensive for the neighborhood and if they fix the leak in the bathroom, it is a lovely place to stay !
reviews[51].comments: Die Wohnung entspricht genau den Bildern auf airbnb. Die Lage ist super zentral und man hat gleich um die Ecke Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Osman ist super nett und jeder Zeit erreichbar, wenn er nicht selbst in seinem Büro ist, das sich in dem selben Haus befindet wie die Wohnung. Er hilft gerne weiter und ist auch bereit den Transfer vom und zu Flughafen zu organisieren. Die Sauberkeit ist in Ordnung. Das Bad ist klein und zweckmäßig. Die Nachbarn sind etwas laut zu hören, das ist aber das Einzige, was zu bemängeln ist. Wir würden jeder Zeit wieder dort einchecken.\r\n
reviews[52].comments: Osman was a great host (always available if needed), and the flat is exactly as described! No problem with the heating (heavy snowstorms and cold weather during our stay).\r\nThe location is perfect, you can find nearby everything you need during a vacation (restaurants, cafes, shops, bakeries, etc.), and you can reach easily the historical old town either with public transport or by walk. Even one of the main ports (Kabatas) is located close to the flat, so you can walk there in 10 min.\r\nDefinitely, I recommend it to everybody who need a pleasant and affordable apartment in Istanbul!
reviews[53].comments:
The apartment matched the description and was as centrally located as told. Supermarkets, excellent cafés and local restaurants within a short distance. 

Although we didn't meet Osman himself during our stay (3 guys), he made sure we got safely to the apartment from the airport and had another guy giving us the keys and taking our luggage upstairs. Very kind service all in all.

Would definitely recommend for a price/quality sensitive traveler who is looking to minimize all the fuss related to living and wants to focus exploring the city.
reviews[54].comments: unfortunately Osman wasn't there but a colleague of his showed us the flat. all was according to the description and very comfortable! we liked the flat and the surrounding neighborhood a lot... especially that you are so close to all the main hot spots is a big plus. definitely recommendable :-) we would stay here again any time.
reviews[55].comments: Osman's place was a really good choice. It is very well situated, walking distance to Taksim and in the heart of the Cihangir neighbourhood next to cozy cafes and restaurants. Very clean, well heated and fully equipped. Osman was a very helpful host, when we arrived he helped us find the way to the appartment and was very eager to answer all questions we had about the city and about places to eat or hang around. It was an overall very good experience, we would definitely revisit.\r\n\r\n
reviews[56].comments: Osman provided an excellent experience from start to finish. Upon our arrival, he had organized a car to take us directly from the airport to the apartment. We also got upgraded to a different apartment with an amazing view of the Bosphorus and Sultanahmet. The apartment's neighborhood is also an excellent starting point for sightseeing or going out. I will definitely keep Osman in mind the next time I am in Istanbul.
reviews[57].comments: Osman is a fantastic host! We stayed at his place for 4 nights – the apartment was very clean and cosy. Osman provided us with interesting information and helpful tips for our sightseeing tour in Istanbul. We had everything we needed in our apartment and felt very welcomed. The location was great – very close to Taksim square with many sights in foot-walking distance.\n\nMany thanks  Osman for a very pleasant stay!
reviews[58].comments: This apartment was very comfortable and well located in a trendy area (Cihangir neighbourhood in Beyoglu district), close to lots of great restaurants and cafés and a Carrefour supermarket. The apartment was clean and exactly as the photo shows. Osman organised a private  airport pick-up for us which is easier than finding a taxi and not much more expensive.\r\nThe only issue was that the lift (elevator) is actually inside the apartment. Each apartment has its own key which only allows you to access that floor......but somehow there was a problem with the key of another apartment and they came to our floor by mistake and arrived in our apartment! Quite a shock to find them in our kitchen, but luckily they were just friendly and confused tourists. The whole building seems to be just 4-5 apartments rented only to tourists. Anyway, this is a security issue and needs to be fixed.
reviews[59].comments: We had a good time at the appartment, Osman was very nice and welcoming and the pictures confirming the reality. The location is near Taksim but pretty difficult to access by taxi (lot of stairs and slopes before getting to Taksim). \r\nDie Wohnung befindet sich im Stadtzentrum, so dass man eigentlich alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten zu fuß erreichen kann. Die Schlüsselübergabe hat einwandfrei funktioniert, wir wurden direkt von Osmans Freund abgeholt und zur Wohnung geführt. Die Wohnung ist zwar sehr klein, aber genau wie auf den Fotos zu sehen. Ein Plus ist die schöne Dachterrasse, auf der man wunderbar frühstücken kann.
reviews[60].comments: Osman was really helpful throughout the whole stay , although I didn't manage to see him a lot , my stay was hassle free and I really enjoyed my time over there .A definite place I will return to when I come back to Istanbul
reviews[61].comments: Osman is very accommodating and friendly. His apartment is well located, very clean and comfortable. We really enjoy our stay there. We would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul (excepting the early birds who will find it noisy, especially at the end of the week, due to its proximity with a club-concert stage). çok teşekkür ederim, Osman!
reviews[62].comments: The location of apartment is very nice, only 300 meters to taksim square, the traffic is very convenient. The apartment is also good, clean and comfortable. Osman is a very helpful host, he can try his best to help u when u ask for any help.
reviews[63].comments: Very good. The flat  is perfectly  located  and Osman is à very helpful and convenient  host
reviews[64].comments:
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Istanbul!
Die Unterkunft liegt sehr gut. Es gibt unzählige nette Bars und Restaurants in der Nähe, man kann von dort aus gut zu Fuss los oder die Metro nutzen. Obwohl wir abends erst sehr spät ankamen hatte man uns ein Taxi organisiert, welches uns direkt zur Wohnung brachte. Auch als wir so spät noch auf die Suche nach den nächsten Kneipen gingen bekamen wir Hilfe.
Insgesamt war es überhaupt kein Problem nach irgendetwas zu fragen, Osman war immer hilfsbereit und freundlich!
Auch mit der Wohnungsausstattung waren wir zufrieden. Die Wohnung ist nicht besonders gross, war aber auch für 4 Leute absolut ausreichend und an Sauberkeit fehlte es auch nicht.
reviews[65].comments:
Очень понравилось. Всё соответствует заявленному. Присутствует всё необходимое. Очень удобное местоположение, рядом есть различные магазины, 5-10 минут до Истикляль, площади Таксим. Хозяева доброжелательны и приветливы.

Ещё из плюсов - трансфер из аэропорта, встретят в любое время и с комфортом довезут до апартаментов.

Из минусов - чистота, там не так чисто как можно подумать по отзывам. Пыльный ковёр, мебель, недостаточно чистые полотенца и душевая.
reviews[66].comments: Osman is a very friendly, helpful host, and he gave us good information about how to get from the airport to the apartment. The place is clean & it has nice interior, just about enough space for 4 people.\r\nThe location is in the lively neighborhood of Beyoglu. If you like an authentic atmosphere, good bars, restaurants, antique shops, ... it's the place to be! Nighttime can be quite noisy because of cheering football fans or people drinking in the streets in weekends. Walking distance to Taksim square, where you have all public transport. If you are in good shape, it's nice to explore the neighborhood by foot.
reviews[67].comments: The host canceled this reservation 50 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[68].comments: What an amazing apartment!! In the coolest little neighbourhood, close to shopping, eating, sightseeing, and a wonderful place to come back to at the end of the day. Extremely clean, looks just like the pictures, and Osman is a really helpful host, always replying to my questions quickly. Perfect size for 5 people, would definitely recommend to anyone travelling to istanbul.
reviews[69].comments: Osman deliver nice manner by telling me and my family about the different tourist location.\r\n\r\nOsman's apartment locate quite close to the metro station where it is convenient for going to the tourists' locations in Istanbul. The apartment is quite a cozy and neat apartment and we had a nice experience.
reviews[70].comments: Sunny and very clean apartment, conveniently located, just a short walk from Taxim square where we could get bus to the airport and metro to Sultanahmed. \n\nOsman was very accommodating and responsive. We loved our stay there!
reviews[71].comments: This apartment is really nice. Modern and comfortable. Suits 5 or 6 people perfectly. Its 5 minutes away from Taksim Square.  Osman very kindly received us for a late check in.
reviews[72].comments: The apartment is great few minutes walk from taksim square! Osman was responsive and helped us arranged a car pick made it easier to reach the place. Great experience!
reviews[73].comments: Really nice apartment with perfect location near to Taksim square. Really quiet, clean and friendly flat. Osman was nice and friendly and answered all our questions. We enjoyed our stay here.
reviews[74].comments:
Great location 
Great apartment 
Highly recommend 
Would love to come back
reviews[75].comments: L'appartement est très bien situé à deux pas de la place Taksim et de tous les autres lieux touristiques. Nous avons passé un bon séjour, néanmoins, nous avons été déçu par la propreté de l'appartement. Le ménage lors de notre entrée dans les lieux n'avait pas été fait et après multiples explications, ils ont fait le ménage 2 jours plus tard. La salle de bain est trop exègue et surtout elle est vétuste, la robinetterie qui bouge, les WC qui fuit, et la douche qui donne de l'eau chaude et froide d'une façon aléatoire. C'est dommage que notre hôte n'ai pas réagit quand nous avons demandé. 'Nous voulions quitter les lieux pour aller ailleurs mais pas facile avec des enfants en bas âge. Globalement, nous ne recommandons pas cet appartement dans son état actuel de Salle de bain,
reviews[76].comments: Apartamento en muy buena condición y excelente localización a sólo 300 metros de Taksim e Istikal. No tiene vista pero es claro. Tiene aire acondicionado y buena conexión de internet. Lo encontramos en buen estado de limpieza.  Está en una calle trasera pero la sensación es segura. Buen precio y buena atención (hay una oficina en el edificio, donde recibieron el equipaje antes de la hora de chequeo y después de la salida, por lo cual quedamos muy agradecidos). Estuvimos muy cómodos (familia de 4 personas).
reviews[77].comments: L'appartement est agréable, dans un immeuble typiquement stamboliote, situé dans un quartier central de la rive européenne d'Istanbul. A cinq minutes de Taxim, l'endroit est pourtant très calme. L'intérieur est soigné et très propre. Osman est hôte disponible et \r\nsympathique.
reviews[78].comments: Osman is a very nice host,the apartment makes us feel like home,really love the decorations.And the Tram stop is very close,about five-minute walk.

(great walking distance for all the events), Easily accessible to subway, tram, ferries. The neighbourhood is friendly and diverse. It is only 3 minutes by walk to the Galatasaray Square which is located approximately at the center of the Istiklal Avenue. Istiklal Avenue is located in the historic Beyoğlu (Pera) district, it is an elegant pedestrian street, 1.4 kilometers long, which houses boutiques, music stores, bookstores, art galleries, cinemas, theatres, libraries, cafés, pubs, night clubs with live music, historical patisseries, chocolateries and restaurants.  You should definately walk through the local bazaar on Sunday right beside the apartment. You can find anything you need with cheap prices; fruits, vegetables, nuts, fish, meat, dairy products! Local bazaars will be very helpful to understand the culture of Turkish people as well. There are couple of restaurants close by where yo
notes: From/To Airports: There are several ways to get from the airport to the apartment, but the most convenient manner is to take “HAVATAŞ" shuttle to Taksim Square departing every 30 minutes from the airport (from both airports- Atatürk and Sabiha Gökçen). As you may be unfamiliar with the area, I am happy to come and pick you up in front of Galatasaray Highschool (on Istiklal Street) which is 10 minutes walk from Taksim Square where you will get off. I can always advise you cheaper public transport options if you ask for. Useful information: You can rent the apartment/room for (a) day(s), week, month or longer periods of time.  There is various supermarkets conveniently situated a block away from the apartment on the way to Istiklal street, also a small kiosk right next to the apartment and a laundry in 100 meters distance.
transit: Getting around by Walk, Subway, Bus, Tram, Ferry, Tunnel: You can take one of the world's oldest tram on Istiklal street by 3 minutes walk from the apartment on Istiklal street. By tram you can end up in Istanbul’s Tunnel (Tünel) which is the world’s shortest and third-oldest passenger terminal. This one-stop funicular climbs the steeply uphill for 500 meters from Karaköy to Tünel and the other way around. Karaköy is today a major transport hub for intercity and also a house of unique cafes and galleries. We can count Karaköy for the city's recent hip?? district. The Galata Bridge connects Karaköy with the Old City, on which the fast tram line Zeytinburnu-Kabataş runs with. This tram line goes to Atatürk Airport within 1 hour. Ferry boats run every 10 to 20 minutes from the ferry terminal on a pontoon to Haydarpaşa train terminal and Kadıköy across the Asian shore of Bosphorus. In the living room there is a TV, a wooden dining table with four chairs and a corner sofa bed (for two people). In the kitchen there are dishes, glasses, pans, cutlery, fridge, kettle, microwave, coffee machine and a teapot. Coffee and tea will be avaliable for you. There is a bathroom with shower, towels, shampoo, soap, toilet paper, hair dryer and of course hot water:) Iron and ironing board, a washing machine and an air-conditioner avaliable. There is a balcony where you can smoke (please not in the apartment). Wifi and clean bed linen will be ready for you.

Квартира полностью соответствует описанию, представленному на сайте. Находится в самом центре Стамбула. До улицы Истикляль 5 минут неспешной ходьбы. 
	Айбике прекрасная хозяйка – в доме есть все необходимое. Все детали обстановки подобраны в оригинальном жанре. 
	Отец Айбике встретил нас очень радушно, несмотря на то, что было уже 3 часа ночи. Айбике быстро выходит на связь и всегда готова прийти на помощь.
	Из минусов, хочу заметить наличие сигаретного дыма, распространяющегося с нижнего этажа дома. А также высокий шум с улицы, который не прекращается даже ночью. Шум, преимущественно, исходит от лежачего полицейского, который устроен в виде больших граблей, расположенных таким образом, чтобы машины могли ехать только в одном направлении. Улица, на которую выходят окна квартиры, с односторонним движением и грабли срабатывают с изящным скрежетом каждый раз, когда на лежачий полицейский наезжают колеса автотранспорта. 
	В остальном хозяйка сделала все возможное для нашего комфортного проживания. Большое спасибо Айбике!

reviews[21].comments: 这个住宿离Taksim广场和独立大街很近,需要走一小段路就到了｡住址在一片住宅区的三楼,楼下是一个慈善组织为那些流浪汉准备一些吃的东西｡周围的配套也很方便,有超市,小卖部和卖水果的地方,土耳其的水果很便宜,如果到了就多买一点｡住宿是一个两室一厅一卫一厨的套房,这个房间是主卧,然后还有一个小卧室｡Nihat是在附近酒店上班的,他把两间房间都出租出去,如果都住满的话,他就睡在沙发里｡房东英文沟通没问题,和Nihat聊了很多土耳其大选的事情,也很热情,用厨房也OK｡如果你有带地图,并且英文没问题的话,他会介绍你一些旅游的地方｡我们一共住了四晚,对了从IST机场到这里就直接坐地铁到Taksim,如果从亚洲机场的话,也可以坐大巴到Taksim,到了之后,按照 (Hidden by Airbnb) maps走过来就好了｡其实土耳其的住宿很多,酒店非常多,但个人觉得酒店都是千篇一律,高档或是不高档,Airbnb提供的是不那么一次性的旅游体验,酒店没啥温度｡伊斯坦布尔也挺好,建议大家来之前,多看一些当地的历史,拜占庭或者奥斯曼土耳其的书,这样的话,逛到那些教堂和清真寺大概知道咋会事｡购物的话,我推荐个商场,挺大的,当时我们正值里拉贬值和开斋节活动,所以购物还挺便宜的(Istinye Park Shopping Center)｡好像食住行游购娱都说的差不多了｡祝你们土耳其旅游愉快!

Michael Schmitt

reviews[7].comments: This is the most beautiful place I've stayed on AirBnb. It's set back in a quiet part of the island, a short walk from the water and parks, and has a beautiful garden with fruit trees and a wide porch on the ground floor. A perfect spot to just relax and listen to the birds and complete privacy from the street. The view of the sea from the living room on the top floor is amazing. The house is well-kept and has a lot of character and space. Sanem was also an amazing host, extremely gracious is welcoming us in person, and then available throughout our stay by text for any questions. Five-start experience all around. Thank you and we'll definitely be back.
reviews[8].comments: I have used Airbnb in four different countries, and Sanem´s place was my best experience ever. The spatial arrangement of the house, which I speculate would have been built in the 50s or 60s, is great: two bedrooms are in the first floor, luminous but protected from direct exposure to sunlight, excellent for peaceful sleep. A spacious and nicely decorated living room upstairs boasts a commanding view of the garden, the sea, and the neighboring island (Heybeliada). The living room connects to a kitchen and a balcony overlooking the garden where we enjoyed our meals. The garden was my favorite spot. It is not for those who love neatly arranged, engineered, and regularly maintained gardens. Sanem´s is an essentially picturesque garden with wild plants that look like being there for ages. There are regularized pockets where Sanem has planted tomatoes, cucumbers, and green peppers. I loved watering them. She graciously let us taste mulberries and plums. Four different plum trees, two different mulberry trees, a cherry tree, a sour cherry tree, fig tree, vines, roses, loquat, and of course the sublime pine tree partly covered by a delightful bougainvillea... Yes, this is still considered to be Istanbul. The notorious phaeton noises and manure smells of Büyükada stay away from this house. We only smelt flowers and post-rain soil, and heard beautiful seagulls whose concert sabotaged occasionally by gangs of crows plotting to take plums and mulberries away... Despite all its peacefulness, the house is not completely isolated: there are two small groceries and a restaurant just about fifty meters down the street. Sanem is a lovely person. She met us at the check-in, made sure we had a pleasant stay, and encouraged us to contact her anytime should there be any inconvenience, which never happened. Great house, dream garden.

reviews[2].comments: Nice and simple room. Good central location in Sultanahmad. Just a short walk to the blue mosque and Hajia Sofia through a nice bazar. The rooms facing the street side are a bit noisy from the street traffic, so if you want a quite room, get the ones facing the garden. There is a washer and a small kitchen upstairs that you can use, and it connects to a terrace. Kamuran welcomed us when we got there and showed us our room. She's usually in the travel agency office downstairs so you can reach her easily if you need anything and get some recommendations on what to do or where to go. Word of advice, don't use their airport transfer car because it's more expensive then just getting a taxi from the airport (taxis run about 50 TL to Sultanahmed and their car transfer is 20$ which is about 72 TL ). We also had to wait 30 minutes outside the airport for the driver to pick us up.

We have walked all over from here, the metro stop is also close. There is a small kitchen and laundry place on the roof, which was great. Also the view is beautiful. ONE small inconvenience would be the morning noises from the street, but that didn't keep us from having a great stay here. I recommend it, and would certainly stay here again if I ever visit Istanbul again!
reviews[6].comments: We had an amazing time at one of the rooms rented by Kamuran , when we saw the place for the first time we were surprise by the view on the blue mosque and the sea from the roof terrace ,we were having our breakfasts here and enjoying a beer/ wine in the night. During our stay it was very hot in Istanbul so air-conditioning was a life saviour. For all the questions we had about where to go and how to get we got the most detailed explanation,me and my boyfriend couldn't imagine best host then that. All the problems you might possibly have with the room will be solved in a blink of an eye! reviews[0].comments: Ilknur was a great host. We were the first to stay in this room, and so she invited any feedback about it. We had trouble with internet at first, and right away Ilknur adjusted and made sure we had a strong signal. We then had a bit of trouble with the refridgerator in the room, and Ilknur arranged for us to switch rooms. All very minor issues and the host responded right away and very generously took care of us to make sure we had everything we needed. It is a great location, just a short walk from Istiklal, and you have cafes and bakery across the street. It is clean and comfortable. I highly recommend!
reviews[1].comments: What a fantastic find!  The studio is a cozy basement apartment with new furnishings and housewares. We had everything we needed for our 4 day stay. The location was fantastic! It is right down the street from a huge shopping and cafe district with tons of nightlife, but the studio is located just far enough not to pick up any of the noise or chaos.  Our first day (a Sunday) the was a lovely neighborhood market with tons of produce. There is a bakery and grocery store right across the street.  Ilknur was a wonderful hostess! She left us kitchen essentials, even helped us find a scale so we could weigh our baggage for the flight, and was extremely friendly and willing to help us out with anything we needed!  The previous person mentioned problems with the Internet and fridge, but these were resolved by the time we arrived. This is one of the best deals in Istanbul!
reviews[2].comments: I stayed in Ilknur's apartment building in late June/early July, and I would highly recommend staying here!  First, the location - this building is located in a non-touristy neighborhood but is only about a three minute walk to Istiklal Cad, a great pedestrian shopping district with all sorts of restaurants (both delicious Turkish food and more international options).  The walk to Istiklal is a bit steep, but it is so convenient to the apartment.  I was travelling alone and felt safe in this neighborhood (though I didn't go out late at night).  From Istiklal, you can easily take the Tunel and then the tramvay to get to the big tourist sites in Sultanahmet.  \r\nWhen I arrived, Ilknur upgraded me to another room on the first floor, so I cannot comment on studyo 7 specifically.  However, all the rooms look pretty similar - the building has been recently renovated, so all of the furniture, kitchen, bathroom, etc. is brand new, and everything was extremely clean.  The room was exactly what I wanted when on a trip - small (a studio apartment with combined bed, sitting, and kitchen area), affordable, and everything worked and was clean and comfortable.  The bathroom worked well, and the shower was substantially larger than what you normally find in a Turkish hotel!  The kitchen was stocked with basic cookware and dishes.  On Sunday there was a huge street market around the corner from the apartment, where you can buy delicious produce for very inexpensive prices.  The wireless internet worked well.  There is no air conditioning in the apartment, but Ilknur provided a fan for me when I asked for it, and I was very comfortable with the fan.\r\nIlknur was very nice and gave good advice about the area.  She really wants her guests to be comfortable and takes their suggestions into account.  I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment and would definitely recommend it to anyone I know travelling to Istanbul!

reviews[46].comments: A great place to stay in Istanbul! The place is nice and clean and in a great location and Ilknur is so amazingly helpful with anything you need. reviews[47].comments: Le logement est dans un quartier bien placé, pas très loin de la place Taksim et de la bouillonnante rue Iskedal. Ilknur nous ne l'avons pas vue, tout s'est fait par mail, texto, c'est toujours plus sympathique quand on voit les personnes mais bon nous avons bien récupéré les clés et Ilknur nous avait envoyé par mail quelques infos sur le quartier : supermarchés à proximité, hammam, marché de légumes etc. \r\nConcernant le logement quelques bemols : il se situait sous le niveau de la rue, donc autant dire que les fenêtres offrent un paysage plutôt bouché et sur le palier une machine à laver collective (et un sèche-linge) utilisés la nuit peut perturber le sommeil le temps de l'essorage. reviews[48].comments: The host was very helpful over the phone when we needed help. The neighborhood is great with lots of food and restaurants at reasonable prices.Mir is close to taksim square. We enjoyed the accommodation.
reviews[49].comments: Ilknur was a great host. She was very helpful and gave us her number if we needed anything while we were there. We asked to leave our bag and she was very kind and allowed us to have a late check out which was very helpful as we were taking a night bus!! \r\n  The apartment was small, but had everything that we needed to enjoy our stay, wifi, kitchen, hot water, comfy bed, and a fan. It is in a good location close to everything and pretty easy to find. We would stay with her again in this apartment if we visit Istanbul in the future!
reviews[50].comments: Very good experience! The flat is very nice, location easy to find though very close to tarlabaç, which can get a little gloomy at night. Otherwise, I would recommand it!
reviews[51].comments: The apartment is in a great location and very comfortable and cosy. It was perfect for our stay in Istanbul. Ilknur also sent us some excellent information and tips on what to do with our visit which was useful. Thanks for a great stay!
reviews[52].comments: Good location, very convenient. Small but comfortable apartment.\nIlknur was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay!
reviews[53].comments: We had a wonderful time in Istanbul! Ilknur was extremely easy to communicate with, provided us with various recommendations for things to do (and we second her recommendations of the Ciya restaurant in Kadikoy and the Bizim restaurant just down the street -- both were delicious!), and offered us any help that we could possibly need. reviews[54].comments: The description was very accurate. Ilknur allowed us to check in early and check out late, which was very helpful! She was very fast to respond anytime we asked a question.\r\nThe location was just as advertised.\r\nThank you for the great stay!
reviews[55].comments: Small but very functional apartment in a great location. İlknur was the most helpful host I have ever come across on airbnb! Although we never met in-person, she provided lots of invaluable tips about the surrounding area. The apartment itself has everything you need and has been carefully thought out with travellers in mind. It's also very tidy, the wireless internet is fast, the bed is comfy. The only thing stopping this apartment from being perfect was the lack of air-conditioning, but there was a fan provided which helped.
reviews[56].comments: The studio is very well located, close to the center everything is at hand. The neighborhood is safe. Apart from the fact that the studio is really small and in the basement , everything is clean.\r\nAs for the host even if we didn't get to meet them, they were very helpful and always responding by mail when we had a question. \r\n
reviews[57].comments: This flat is small,but really comfortable. It's like a nest for a couple)We did like it's price and  it's location-it's in the centre of the city.Thanks a lot for maps,good explanations how to go to main sightseeings,an umbrella,late check-out and tasty cakes)
reviews[58].comments: Nice cozy little place on a great location. The hosts were super friendly and helpful. Istanbul is one of the best places in the world to visit and i kindly recommend staying here.
reviews[59].comments: The woman who hosted us on Ilknur's behalf was very lovely. The place is quite small and a bit run down. It should be made more clear that it's a basement apartment as well. We only stayed for one of the two nights we reserved because we wanted a bigger and nicer place for our last two nights in the city. It's right for the price and if you're looking to crash and not spend much time in the place, it's perfectly fine.
reviews[60].comments: We were happy to stay in İlknur&Bülent's flat.  It is small (as expected), but had everything we needed: a comfortable double bed,  a small kitchen area with a fridge, an internet access, a toilet and a shower.  It was clean, it is conveniently located with food shops nearby, but it is bit far from the major tourist center (Blue Mosque, St Sophie church etc.). On Sundays, there is a local market selling variety of goods from food to clothes.  İlknur was very helpful, he sent us the detailed description on how to find the flat and gave us tips about local places and restaurants.  The only downside we could see is that the flat was very warm, but it is a compromise we were prepared to have in the relations to the cost of renting.
reviews[61].comments:
IIknur was a wonderful host. We didn't meet her but she arranged everything perfectly & gave us lots of great ideas on what to see & do in Istanbul. 

The flat is just how the photos show, small but great value for where it is. 

The internet worked really well & Ilknur always responded quickly to any questions we had. 

The flat has a fan & you can leave the windows open over night so it stays quite cool at night. 

We really liked the neighbourhood & especially enjoyed the Sunday night market on the next street. 

If you want a convenient base in Istanbul at a really good price id recommend this.
reviews[62].comments:
It was great place to stay in short-like trips. We arrived told them when to arrive and there were someone waiting us to be arrived.
If you tell exact time to check-in for them it would be nice.
We enjoyed our stay is Istanbul, room was clean and equipped for all basic needs and there was a small biscuit and WiFi code on the table which made us smile and feel really good.
Location of this place is more than good enough. Because it was 8 minute walk from "Taksim" square which is center of that area. Shops and restaurants nearby is very handy. There was a one more metro station "Sishane" 8 minutes walk away.

reviews[63].comments:
Lovely apartment and great hosts! Ilknur was extremely helpful, providing directions and a list of things to do while in Istanbul. The wifi worked well, and there was a washer and dryer in the hallway outside - just bring your own detergent!

No complaints; very close to Taksim, and from there it's no problem to get where you need to be. Great for one person, might be a bit of a tight fit for two.

Great stay in Istanbul!
reviews[64].comments: It was a great experience for us staying in this studio. We did not meet the host, but she made sure we were happy at her place.\r\nShe gave us very helpful tips a few days before the trip. She answered every question we had during the trip, and was always available for any inquiry. The house is as expected small, clean, and had what we needed at a very good price. The neighborhood is quiet, there is a small supermarket close to the studio, and the area is within walking distance from Taksim square(about 10 minutes) and even closer to the famous Istiklal street. Our stay in Istanbul was amazing, also because of the host Ilknur that gave us great suggestions of what to do in Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again, and would recommend it to anyone!
reviews[65].comments: Nice stay in Istanbul. The apartment was cleaned and nice. Very small but close to taksim and Istiklal caddesi. The owner has been amenable and kind. I recommend this place to young people.
reviews[66].comments:
We didn't see Ilknur but she was very nice and fast at answering our questions. She did everything to make us feel at home.
The flat is small and cosy, the price and the quality are perfect. This is not my favorite area but we were very close from everything and we could eat more with 'turkish price' and not 'tourist price' so it was good for our finances.
Don't be afraid if the street looks noisy because the flat is very very quiet and we slept very well.
I'll warmly recommend this place to anyone !
reviews[67].comments: Très bon accueil dans ce petit studio très fonctionnel et très bien situé! L'accueil et les conseils de Ilknur sont parfaits! Je recommande ce logement!
reviews[68].comments: The room is very dark, don't expect luxury.\r\n\r\nOtherwise everything is OK. Carrefour shop is almost next door, as well as the Sunday market. You don't even need to meet somebody for check-in and check-out.
reviews[69].comments: The room was super clean and warm, it had wi-fi and perfect proximity to Taksim. Exactly what we needed. Thank you!
reviews[70].comments: La casa è molto piccola ma in proporzione al prezzo è una giusta soluzione. La casa è situata vicinissimo alla via principale di taskim ma l interno in cui si trova rimane in una zona diroccata e un po' abbandonata, ma solo per pochi metri.\nL'host è comunque gentile e premuroso. \nQuindi se si vuole spendere poco per una visita a Istanbul senza troppe aspettative sul soggiorno è ideale.
reviews[71].comments: We were in this apartment for 5 nights. It is very cozy and it is a quiet area. Good for couples. Just 5 minute walk from Istiklal street and 15 minute walk from Taksim square. It was clean and though we never met the host she gave us some good advices.
reviews[72].comments: Ilknur's place was a nice and comfy studio . It has all required things and it is close to the main attractions . I also really appreciate the suggestions from Ilknur they were awesome specially the Hamami :) . If I come back to Istanbul Ilknur's place would be my first pick
reviews[73].comments: Let me say shortly, simple but suitable for couple. There's all system about heating, shower, cooking, laundary etc. This is a best place if you are couple and thinking about tour to historical places. :)
reviews[74].comments:
We had a nice stay at Ilknur's and Bülent's place! Thank you so much, you were really helpful! 
The location is great, very close to the city center and the most popular street in Istanbul - Istiklal caddesi. 
If I got it right it's something like a little private hotel and everything you may need is provided by the hosts whom I unfortunately didn't meet in person. Instead there's a special lady who helps guests check in. Checking-out is also very simple and we had no problems at all. 
The studio looks pretty much like the pictures, the bed is big but old and uncomfortable partly because the linen is also old and scratchy. Otherwise everything was fine. We really liked it there. Thanks!
reviews[75].comments: Ilknur was so kind and helpful! The room is cozy, but it has everything you need to enjoy your time in Istanbul. Taksim is only 10 minutes away.
reviews[76].comments: Le séjour à Istanbul dans cet appartement était juste parfait. j'avais seuleument besoin d'un endroit où dormir près de tout, et je suis bien tombé. J'était dans le centre d'Istanbul près de taksim, à deux pas de Istiklâl Caddessi. l'appartement était propre et chaleureux. \r\nJe recommende vraiment cet endroit. Je sortais el soir, l'endroit ne craint pas, on ne risque rien si on à 3h du matin en robe hyper courte :)
reviews[77].comments: Our stay at Ilknur's place was amazing, there was nothing to be dissapointed at. The room is in the centre, in the middle of a busy and alive street of Istanbul, meanwhile the room itself is very quiet. \r\nWe were extremely stupid to lock the door with keys inside, making troubles for ourseleves and Ilknur first of all. The problem was solved, but still, don't repeat our problem and pay attantion not to shut the door without keys. \r\nWe didn't meet Ilknur, but even n the phone she was so friendly and extremely helpful. Thank you and sorry again!
reviews[78].comments: The apartment is as it appears. Simple, Clean, and Secure. Before booking make sure that you do not have any reservation request changes because the host was not responsive in terms of accommodating my changes and seemed to avoid the question. Other then the inability to accommodate my revision to my reservation, everything is else was great.
reviews[79].comments: Studio propre comme sur les photos, bien situé à proximité de tout, Ilknur est disponible il nous a donné des conseils sur les lieux, les transports, les prix...\r\nNous avons passé un agréable sejour du 22 au 29 Mars 2015. Nous sommes très satisfait nous y retournerons sans hésitez !\r\n
reviews[80].comments: This apartment is perfectly located and very comfortable. It's an extremely accurate posting. Ilknur was wonderful in offering assistance and the apartment has everything that you could possibly need.
reviews[81].comments: Choosing the apartment of Ilknur was a perfect choice. Cosy room, convinient location, so many attractions in not so far distance. IIknur is a great host, gave us many helpful advices to not miss most interesting highlights of the city. All of this made the trip to Istanbul simply amazing! 10 out of 10! I wish to come back one day. :)
reviews[82].comments: The appartment is very simple, but is still charming in a way. Though it´s definitely not the one for couples: too small. For one person it is totally fine. reviews[83].comments: L'appartement est petit mais fonctionnel et surtout propre ! Il est bien situé, dans un quartier vivant et proche de lieux sympathiques, idéal pour sortir le soir.\r\nİlknur, l'hôte, s'est rendu très disponible lorsque nous avions besoin d'informations ou d'aides. De plus il nous a fourni tout un tas d'infos sur le quartier et sur Istanbul qui se sont révélées très utiles.\r\nOn conseil vivement !
reviews[84].comments: The studio was as described with everything you need (including cookware) in a small but manageable space (we were 2 but are used to sharing a small space). reviews[85].comments: The studio is great, it had everything we needed! :) It is small and cozy studio, it's easy to enjoy it... reviews[86].comments: Ilknur was very helpful and always available. The apartment was clean and tidy. It could be a bit too loud because of the heater on the other side of the wall.
reviews[87].comments: We were be easily able to find the location, and the room was cosy and described as it was, and it is very useful for short stays.
reviews[88].comments: Everything went well. I've lived in Istanbul before so I knew what to expect about the area. The store cookies were a nice touch upon arrival.
reviews[89].comments: Ilknur was very flexible and made our stay in Istanbul very enjoyable and easy! We arrived late, so never met her, but she made it easy to find and access the flat with her information. The flat is small and cosy, but well stocked with kitchen supplies and has everything one could want in a small space.  She even provided us a big bottle of water which was great as we arrived so late.  She emailed us some great local information about sights, transport, hammams and places to eat and even booked a fabulous restaurant for us.
reviews[90].comments: The listing was accurate. Response time was prompt.  She was very warm and inviting. reviews[91].comments: Petit studio très mignon avec les équipements pour passer un bon séjour. Ce logement correspond à l'annonce et il est situé tout près de la rue commerçante (5mn à pied). Il y a une supérette en bas de la rue, un café, deux petits restaurants dont une lokanta où on y mange bien et avec un bon rapport qualité prix. Ilknur est un très bon hôte, très disponible,  qui prend le soin de nous donner toutes les informations nécessaires sur la ville, les bonnes adresses et les commodités qui sont proches de son logement. Je recommande fortement cet hôte. Merci beaucoup Ilknur (Thank you very much Ilknur)
reviews[92].comments:
Квартира действительно маленькая, но достаточно уютная. Для одного человека точно подходит. Находится в 5 минутах ходьбы от популярной улицы Истикляль.
Небольшие минусы, которые не сильно повлияли на мое пребывание:
- пару раз с утра была чуть теплая вода, но мыться все равно можно было;
- кровать в одном месте немного проваливалась, однако я это заметил, только когда сел в это место, а так спать было вполне удобно.
В остальном все было отлично. Вентилятор был очень кстати, поскольку в августе в Стамбуле очень жарко. Также в квартире имелись два комплекта маленького и большого полотенец. В душе было жидкое мыло и шампунь.
Все было как на фото. Кроме, разве что, настольной лампы. Что было не так важно.
Самое главное - полезные советы от хозяина, которые он отправил мне в сообщении. С ними мой отдых в Стамбуле стал намного лучше!
reviews[93].comments: The apartment is very well located, clean and comfy. Very close to Istiklal avenue and Taksim Square. Ilknur is a great host, we didn't meet but she described the address precisely on the phone.
reviews[94].comments: Отличный бюджетный вариант,чтобы переночевать!квартира полностью соответсвует фото,расположение отличное!
reviews[95].comments:
The studio is small but with everything.
It's well located, 2 minutes from one of the most important commercial road, full of shops.

Ilknur was  very helpful!
I suggest this place :)
reviews[96].comments:
We spent good time in istanbul, very beautiful city. the flat is pretty but little like a room ; the district is old but it's near to taksim, galata and karakoy to take bosphorus ferry. sultanamet is easy to join from the flat because it's direct line of subway from the flat. 
Maybe we will go back to istanbul next year because we loved the city. if we do that think we will go back to illknur flat because it's a good flat for the price of the location!! Friends want to go to istanbul and we will told them to go to ilknur flat!!
And for people who want to make party it's the district to be... 
joker,indigo club, beats club..
Ilknur was very flexible for the hour of check in and check out... thanks for it!
be carefull of what we ear in Europe... we were outside during night and i really felt in security in Istanbul
reviews[97].comments: I stayed here from 14-18 Nov (5D4N). Apartment was a small 1-room unit at a very convenient location (Taksim). Utensils and basic amenities were available. Walking to the nearest metro takes about 10-15 minutes. Unit was generally clean.
reviews[98].comments: Great communication with Ilknur. The space is very nice also. We had a great time. Thanks Ilknur.
reviews[99].comments: Perfect location, just like on the picture, 3 minutes to taksim. Ilknur was helpful. She allowed me to check in early and check out lately. You can cook food. Good wifi.
reviews[100].comments: IIknur was very nice and send me many information about the city and offered me to call him any time, I needed help. The flat was small but nice and had everything one needs and was the same like on the pictures. The only deficit was the bed, which was a little bit broken, but could be fixed quiet fast and easily :) overall for this price a perfect place to stay in Istanbul.
reviews[101].comments: ilknur hanım çok yardımcı oldu istiklal caddesinde galata kulesine çok yakın küçün şirin bi yer herkese tavsiye ederim dairelere ve ilknur hanımın ilgisnden gayet memnun kaldım
reviews[102].comments: Perfect location, apartment is not big but fair enough if you travel alone, or even two people. I have to say the double bed is super comfortable!  I like this place, everything was simply good. Ilknur will make you feel comfortable and try to help you with anything you might need.
reviews[103].comments: We stay for 4 days.The room is small,but cosy and (Website hidden by Airbnb) was everything you need. The  price is good for  private (Website hidden by Airbnb) the landlady We  didn't see,but SMS communication was complete!;)Thanks for everything! Greetings! Hristina&Nikolay
reviews[104].comments: We had a great time in Istanbul and enjoyed the central location of the apartment. The communication was problemless and Ilknur was very helpful. Everything was great.
reviews[105].comments: Ilknur is very kind, and informative. The location of this studio was ideal for me.
reviews[106].comments: Останавливались уже второй раз в этом доме, квартира попалась другая, но она так же соответсвует описанию. Все было комфортно. Хозяин как всегда очень вежлив и гостеприимен.
reviews[107].comments: The host was extremely helpful and flexible. The apartment is as described and a short walk to taksim, istanbul is huge so a good central location made our stay very convenient.\r\nThere is a market outside on every sunday, which gives you a great feeling of  the Turkish lifestyle but it does get loud on saturday night/sunday morning when they set up the tents. With that being said, I would definitely stay there again.
reviews[108].comments:
I had a wonderful 9 day stay at Ilknur's.  She was very accommodating and helped me orient to the area with suggestions of ways to see more of Istanbul.  Very convenient location with 2 grocery stores 50 meters from the apartment, istiklal street a 5 minute walk and a 10 minute walk to the Metro.  Galata Tower, Tūnel and Karaköy ferry are also very close.  

The apartment is easy to get to from Ataturk by using the Havatas shuttle that drops near to Taksim.

The apartment is small and cozy but was ideal for me since I was traveling alone.  I look forward to staying here again.
reviews[109].comments: Nice place. Very helpful host. Close to main tourists place but the place is quiet. Local bazar on Sunday is awesome. Good value of money. Convenient check-in\out.\r\nWe had nice weekends. Thank you so much!
reviews[110].comments: We stayed in Ilknur's studio for 4 nights. Very good communication, we booked last minute and arrived couple of hours later without any trouble. it is easy to find and location is perfectly close to the center, as discribed. Room is like seen on the pictures and has everything you need and more...shampoo, towels, dishes, water, tea, spaghetti, oil, salt etc. Tv has foreign channels and in basement floor there are washing machine and dryer for common use. Street has small shops and farm market once a week. ilknur was kind to offer us bigger room with no extra charge, but we stayed in studio 7 that was smaller but less hot than big upstairs rooms. Rooms have fan but no AC, with sunny weather gets pretty hot.
reviews[111].comments: Small and nice studio in an interesting and amazing neighborhood. We haven't seen Ilknur, but we felt she very present and she has helped us when we have need. Good and cheap apartment to stay some days in a very good city!
reviews[112].comments: The host canceled this reservation 29 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[113].comments:

HOSPITALITY = 1/5 -  We messaged 5 days prior to arrival and received no replies about when we could enter the home. WIFI =4/5 - Worked perfect throughout the house 
Come again? = No, this place is really meant for 1 person, with the 2 of us it was really tight. For 1 person, this place is perfect.
reviews[114].comments: Ev ve bina gayet güzel. Mobilyalar eski fakat sorun olmadi bu. Muhit acisindan biraz kötü gözükse de biz sorun yasamadik.
reviews[115].comments: Every thing was great. İlknur is a very kind and helpfull. Thnx for all
reviews[116].comments: All is okey in her flat, she is nice lady you can easily communicate with.
reviews[117].comments: Great little flat located in central downtown Istanbul. About a ten minute walk from Taksim Square, the heart of the city. Shops, groceries, and public transportation are all less than five minutes away.
reviews[118].comments: My girlfriend and I had a pleasant stay at Ilknur's place. The location is great and the privacy of the room too. For two persons it's very tight to the point you have to move your luggage around depending on what space of the room you're gonna be using.
reviews[119].comments: close to istiklal, economical price, comfortable double size bed, kitchen, mini tv and fridge, bathroom, table and chairs, quiet neighbourhood\nfree space is enough but not very wide, as far as i remember there was no air conditioner but there were 2 radiators
reviews[120].comments: Orderly and nice studio, comfortable bed and towels provided. Close to Taksim but not on a touristy street (although cars could be heard before closing the window).
reviews[121].comments: My worst AirBnb stay ever. Mould, broken light, leaking shower, very dark apartment. The owner reacts only to the messages he wants. reviews[122].comments: Her şey fotoğraftaki gibiydi. Küçük bir mekan ancak temel olarak gerekli her şey var.
reviews[123].comments: Very simple place near Taksim...a good deal for a minimalist.
reviews[124].comments: ужасная квартира, сдает агент, хозяйка не говорит по-английски, район трущоб, белье грязное, утром - ремонт дороги, ночью - духота.\nНикому не советую.
reviews[125].comments: Lovely spot, convenient travel options for tourist locations. We suffered a little in the summer heat, but the cozy place was great for a couple for a few days.
reviews[126].comments:
Минусы:
Так как вариант очень дешевый, многого ожидать не стоит. Комната была грязная: повсюду пыль и грязь, которую, кажется, не убрали еще с прошлых хозяев. 
Комната находится в подвале. Возле двери две стиральные машинки, которые включают и ночью. Звук от них очень мешает спать. 
Хозяина ни разу не видели. Нас встретила работница дома, которая совсем не говорит по-английский и пришлось объясняться жестами.
На кровати не было простыни только наматрасник. Написала об этом хозяину, чтобы принес, но он ответил лишь на последний день моего пребывания. Спала на одеяле и укрывалась своей кофтой. 
Очень темная комната. Утром темно, как ночью, но это не существенный минус.

Плюсы:
Есть все для готовки: кастрюли, сковородка, тарелки, чашки и главное, электрическая плита. В двух шагах есть супермаркеты, где можно дешево закупиться, а напротив простое кафе, где готовят вкусные завтраки.
Цена. За такую комнату и расположение - это лучшая цена для бюджетного туриста.
До всех достопримечательностей можно доехать максимум с двумя пересадками, иногда можно и дойти. Рядом Истикляль, а значит, что вечером будет чем заняться.
