reviews[0].comments: Begum was such a great host! The aparment was exactly same as on the pictures, incredible apartment! Highly Highly Recomend!!!
reviews[1].comments:
Very nice and new place. Good location near Taksim. Nice bars and restaurants around which are not too expensive. Very lively neighborhood. It also appeared to be safe. But you have to accept some noise on weekends. 

Our host Begum was very friendly. Unfortunately, she left the company who operates the apartment house, so I can't really say something about the others. 

If you're concerned about the protests on Taksim square and in the neighborhood, take a look at the (Hidden by Airbnb) groups the protesters use for their planning or just ask some Turkish people on the street. Like this we were able to evade the protest on Saturday during our stay. We met with a friend and spent the night at his place. 

Despite this, Istanbul is an incredible city and was well worth the 'risk'!
reviews[2].comments: Great space in a great part of town. Serap and the staff were very friendly and helpful during my stay. Taksim is a great neighborhood to stay in for people looking to enjoy Istanbul's nightlife.
reviews[3].comments:
Awesome place. It is exactly like on the pictures, all new. Most of the furnitures are custom made, nice job. 
The apartment was cleaned, bed was made every day which was unexpected, in a good way; great service. Good Wifi too. 
Super location, you can easily walk everywhere. 
Definitely recommending it!
reviews[4].comments:
Extremely good experience ! 
Very very very friendly and communicative people  !
Very comfortable and beautiful room ! 
And in the heart of the city ! 
When I go back to istanbul , RAVEN will definately be my first choice  !
reviews[5].comments: I had a wonderful time at the Raven, nice neighbors and above all, I felt at home. Thank you Serap
reviews[6].comments:
I am very happy that I was able to find a place like Raven Istanbul. 
I stayed there for three nights.
The room was exotic and beautiful, Serap helped me book a ticket to Ankara (which was difficult for non-Turkish people to reserve), and the place was convenient for sightseeing.
Even my Turkish friend seemed to love the place after I told her where I had stayed.
I recommend the place to everyone who's visiting Istanbul.
reviews[7].comments: Raven is a cozy residence in a cool location. People working at Raven are friendly and helpful.\r\nIn the neighborhood there are plenty of bars, restaurants, pubs, music and people till 4 in the morning. It’s a little noisy too.\r\n
reviews[8].comments: Not the best choice unless you want very loud music coming from the bar until 2:00 AM and 4:00 AM Friday and Saturday.
reviews[9].comments: Great experience and nice staying in Raven. Just a bit noisy from our room since there was a lack of soundproofing in the building. We missed too some kitchen and cleaning utensils. On the other hand, guys running the pub and in charge of the rooms were very nice!
reviews[10].comments: This is our fourth visit to Istanbul and our family enjoyed the suite and hospitality. It was comfortable to have the two separate spaces and the kitchenette was ideal for us to prep food for long days out wandering. Yes, the space is incredibly loud from the bar below, but everyone including out 3.5 year old was able to sleep comfortable.  Taxim in general is a 24 hour area, so if you are seeking quiet, I would suggest you book in a different neighborhood.
reviews[11].comments: We really enjoyed staying in our apartment with Raven. The owner was very attentive to enduring  we had everything we needed and that everything was as expected. The apartment looks just as good as the pictures make it seem. The location was a great alternative to staying in the tourist saturated old town area. There is some noise from the bar below each night, so if you are a light sleeper you may want earplugs. It was no issue to us at all and we slept well!
reviews[12].comments: We stayed here for a few days and loved it so much we went back for another couple of days at the end of our trip.  Raven Apartments are a great place to stay to experience Istanbul.  Just off the busy Istiklal Street in a lively and vibrant area.  The noise really didn't bother us - you have to expect a bit of noise in a city like this!\r\nThe apartments were clean, spacious and great value, but the best thing about our stay was the great hospitality from the super friendly staff.  We couldn't have asked for better hosts!  They were so helpful in suggesting places to go - nothing was too much trouble for them.\r\nThanks to Cemre and the boys for a really great time - We will be back!
reviews[13].comments:
We really enjoyed our stay at the Raven. Perfect neighborhood. About a 25 minute walk to the "New Mosque" downhill. Steep uphill walk on the way home.
Pros: 
-Raven Pub downstairs
-Awesome neighborhood near Taksim and Istiklal (great nightlife)
-Balcony was great for a drink and to relax
-Bars are nearby but its not loud at night 

Cons:
-A little hard to find at first ( (Hidden by Airbnb) Raven Pub)
-Lots of stairs
-Looks a little different from the pictures (slightly smaller) but was still a great space
reviews[14].comments: The Raven is in a brilliant location if you want to make the most of the many bars, restaurants, pubs and clubs in Istanbul.  Its close to dozens of great places to eat, drink and shop as well as to lots of transport links to the rest of the city.\r\nThe apartment itself is nice and is as pictured in the photos.  We didnt have much contact with the host in advance or during the time we were there but they did answer all questions we had quickly and were pleasant to deal with.\r\nThe only downside is the noise level from the bar below and from other residents coming in and out as there is pretty much no sound proofing in the apartment.  However, we were aware that it was above a bar when we booked - its something to consider if you are planning on having a relaxing evening in Istanbul.  We were out and about most of the time so it was fine!
reviews[15].comments: Beautiful and centrally located place, but very noisy - it is at  the top of a pub and the walls are thin (feeling on sleeping right on top of the sound system) so we were waking up several times in the night.
reviews[16].comments:
This suite looks exactly as it does in the pictures. Overall, it was clean, and the furnishings were comfortable. It's a hotel, not at all a home, so it was much less personal than my other Airbnb experiences. As someone else noted, there is no kitchen--just a refrigerator.

Using (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps, I had no trouble finding the Raven. It's a very short walk (less than 10 min) from the Point Hotel, which is the main Taxim stop for Havatas, the shuttle to and from Ataturk airport (which is cheap and excellent).

I wish I had heeded other reviewers' warnings about the noise. I'm not a light sleeper, but I stayed on a Saturday night, and the volume of the music from the bar downstairs was extremely loud. I did not sleep at all. Also, I found the ventilation of the room to be very poor. It's a non-smoking unit, but smoking from down below fills the room, even with windows open. All of my belongings reeked of cigarette smoke the next day.

The intentions behind this place seem good, and it looks great. The experience of staying however is far, far from ideal.
reviews[17].comments: Location is perfect, easy access to the major highlights of Istanbul. The quality of the apartment is reasonable / but you may expect that downtown Taksim. The noise from the bar below is terrible (!) and certainly able to keep you awake until 03.00 - totally not adequate . unless you party yourselves until 3 AM.... The metals stairs will than wake you up again at 07.00 when other guests arrive ( or leave ) or the light on the hall way .. on my complaint the answer was very kind : I can bring you some cotton for you ears...(!) ...Reason for me to leave early and NOT finish my stay! and if you think after reading thos ...well...think (Website hidden by Airbnb) really that (!!) noisy !!
reviews[18].comments: The apartment was nice, comfortable and a good amount of space.  We liked the location near Istiklal Street which was very convenient for going out, and for transportation options.  \r\n\r\nHowever, the room smelled of smoke (which we think was coming up from the bar and street below).  And the hot water was not reliable, lasting only a few minutes before turning cold.
reviews[19].comments: We only stayed for a night here as part of a layover, but our stay was welcoming and cozy. There's so much to do around the apartment it's easy walking distance. Restaurants, bars, and shops are all very close. Location was a plus. The room was very nice, as described by the pics. If we ever return to Istanbul, I will not hesitate to stay here again! Overall, great experience.
reviews[20].comments: Great room, and managed by really nice people. Very central location 5 mins from Taksim Square. There can be loud music till late at night sometimes but that didn't bother me. Recommended!
reviews[21].comments: Flat were very well located, people were nice but if you are two and want separated bed, let them know before. Because the flat is on a very dynamical street, it s very (very) noisy. I think it s good for less than 5 nights. Anyway, thanks to the host.
reviews[22].comments: The place is good. It's a little bit noisy but it was fine for both of us after a big walking day of visit in Istanbul. The location is perfect.
reviews[23].comments: The location is great, and the room is tidy and clean. Recommend it for others.
reviews[24].comments: I had a great time in Istanbul.  The staff at Raven is very friendly and responsive to any questions and/or concerns.  The apartment is really quaint and in the most happening neighborhood.  With that said, it is not for everyone.  We stayed on the second floor and the music from the cafe downstairs is pretty unbearable if you're not a spring chicken.  And I am talking about every night of the week until 2:00 or 3:00 am.  The apartment is perfect for people who are young or who are young at heart, but if you are looking for a quiet relaxing place to lay your head then you should keep looking.  If you want to be in the middle of all the excitement, book this place right away.  It is surrounded by the best nightlife in the city.
reviews[25].comments: See previous review
reviews[26].comments: Unfortunately I missed my original flight to Turkey so I only got to stay here for one night. I say unfortunately because the place is great, has everything you need and the location is utterly brilliant! You will immediately feel the 'vibe' of Taksim when you arrive. I guarantee it! :)\r\nThe staff were very friendly and helpful. The wifi wasn't working when I arrived and they fixed it straight away. I really feel like I missed out not staying longer.\r\nOne warning - This room is above a bar on a very lively street. It gets pretty noisy up until till the early hours of the morning. If you can handle that then I can't recommend this place enough. If you are a light sleeper or go to bed early, best look elsewhere.
reviews[27].comments: We loved staying at Raven. It was a short walk from the Taksim train station and really easy to find. It's located in a great area, surrounded by very local feeling bars and restaurants. There is a small bar down-stairs but noise wasn't an issue. Staff were friendly. The rooms were really cool - spacious and nice design.\r\n
reviews[28].comments: We could not have asked for a more wonderful host and place to stay. Istanbul is a truly magical city and Raven Suites made it even more so magical. Miray was a superb host. The location is key , very close to Taksim square. We literally walked everywhere and the Metro station was also close. I wish I had the time, we would have liked to increase our stay...We will be back.
reviews[29].comments:
This listing at the Raven was great! We were only there for a night, but were able to easily check-in with the bartender (it sits above Raven Pub, which helps make it an easy location to find). 

The suite had AIR CONDITIONING, which was a rare and wonderful find. Beds/sheets/towels were comfortable and clean. 

Per other reviews, it was noisy due to the surrounding area, but we felt that this helped add to the atmosphere and honestly with the AC on, you couldn't even hear it. 

Last, but not least the bar gives you one (huge) beer upon check-in which was a great nightcap.
reviews[30].comments: Nice and cozy place. It kinda feel that room is bigger than it is when you watch on photo. However it is still enough place to sleep (: Friendly stuff in the Raven pub will always help you to find your way through the Istanbul
reviews[31].comments: Really amazing apartment in a great neighbourhood. Right next to Istiklal street where everything is you need. Great restaurants, bars and shops within a few minutes walk. The bar downstairs is relaxing as well and invites for a drink or two.
reviews[32].comments: Nice little quaint spot located in a great area of Istanbul just outside of Taksim. The flat was nice, clean and a perfect size for 2 people. It is located above a little cafe/bar which can be noisy at times.
reviews[33].comments:
Pros: 
- The place is really really good. It looks exactly as on the pictures.
There is everything you might need. 
The size is really good for 2 persons.

- The location is great, right next to Taksim, very central and 10mn from the Havatas shuttles to the airport.

- There is a nice cat chilling in the stairs.

Cons: 
- We had a huge check-in problem and complete lack of communication from Raven. I sent an email on the day prior to our arrival, telling them that we would arrive very late. We didn't hear from them and when we arrived at 3am, the bar was closed, with no way to get to the rooms, and their phone written in AirBnB was off.
Hopefully people in the street helped us and the owner of the liquor shop in front of the hotel called a guy, who called a guy, who took us to sleep at another place (belonging to the same group) until the next day.
When we arrived the day after at Raven we explained the thing to the staff but didn't get any apologies from their side.

- Noisy 8.30am bar deliveries
- No hot water on the first day

However the place is really great and I highly recommend it. I would just warn you about late check-ins...
reviews[34].comments: Das Apartment ist klein aber gemütlich. Was in einigen Bewertungen breite bemängelt wurde ist tatsächlich der Lärmpegel. Da man direkt über einem Pub wohnt ist bis teilweise spät in die Nacht laute Musik zu hören. Eine Küche öde Küchenutensilien gibt es bis auf einen Wasserkocher nicht. Bestimmt ok für 1 bis 2 Nächte jedoch für länger eher anstrengend.
reviews[35].comments: 位置在独立大街旁边,交通很方便｡房间设计风格很现代,我很喜欢｡楼下是Raven自己开的一个小酒吧,没事儿可以喝两杯｡
reviews[36].comments: Great place in a wonderful location. The bar downstairs is fantastic and was a great way to end each evening. They aren't the best at communicating in regards to check-in but don't worry; just go there and as long as the bar is open you should be able to access your room.
reviews[37].comments: The best thing about the B&B is the location. If you are a lone female traveler, wouldn't have any safety issues.Right on the Istikal Street and 3 minutes from the Metro as well as the Airport pickup station. \r\nThe rooms are clean and cosy and tastefully done though too compact. There is a nice buzz on the road which would further pick up your holiday spirit.\r\nWord of caution: Please try and confirm the check in and check out time previously beforehand,they did try to trick us on this.
reviews[38].comments:
Ein sehr schön restauriertes Haus in mitten des Party-, Ausgeh- und Szeneviertels.

Im Erdgeschoss befindet sich eine Bar und dann jeweils auf einer eigenen Etage die drei Appartemens, die mit Liebe zum Detail und schönem Design eingerichtet sind.

Alles für ein verlängertes Wochenende ist vorhanden: Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher, Föhn, zwei Fernseher, Klimaanlage (!), W-Lan, Handtücher, Pantoffeln, Seife, Schampoo, Bettwäsche usw. Somit guter Hotel-Standard. Dabei deutlich geräumiger, schöner und gemütlicher als ein "normales" Hotelzimmer. Und das zu einem relativ günstigen Preis.

Die Lage ist nahezu optimal. Mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, auch vom Flughafen aus, sehr gut zu erreichen (Haltestelle Taksim-Platz). In direkter Nachbarschaft unzählige Bars, Restaurants, Geschäfte und Clubs, die zu Fuß problemlos erreicht werden können. Selbst die Sehenswürdigkeiten in der Altstadt kann man mit einem ausgiebigen Spaziergang (ca. 30 - 40 Min.) zu Fuß erreichen. So erhält man einen schönen Einblick in das Stadtleben der einzelnen Viertel. Kann ich nur empfehlen! 

Check-In und -Out absolut problemlos. Einfach in der Bar melden. Das dortige Personal ist total freundlich und jederzeit um das Wohl der Gäste bemüht. An dieser Stelle noch mal vielen Dank an die gesamte Mannschaft!

Einziger Wehmutstropfen ist etwas der Geräuschpegel. Die Fenster sind zwar gut schallisoliert. Aber der abendliche und auch nächtliche Trubel in dem Viertel, wie auch die Bar im Erdgeschoss, gehen nicht geräuschlos vorbei. Wer also die Abende ruhig mit einem Buch oder vor dem Fernseher verbringen will -> schwierig. Wir waren aber jeden Abend unterwegs und es hat uns kaum was ausgemacht. Daher ok!

Also, absolut empfehlenswert!!!

Vielen Dank!
reviews[39].comments:
The stay was disappointing. The room smelled strongly of smoke.  I could hear people's conversations in the bar whilst I was in the bedroom because the room is directly above the bar.  The stairs are very loud and being in the room above the bar meant I could hear whenever another guest arrived to go to the apartments on the higher floors as the wall between the stairs and the room is very thin.
The bar closed at midnight (this was on a Monday so may be later at weekends) so this wasn't a problem. However if you go to sleep earlier, then it will be difficult as the music is loud.
Although I knew it would be loud and lively above a bar, I was not prepared to be woken up by other guests arriving during the night because of the thin walls, and to stay in a room constantly smelling of smoke. Unfortunately I cut the stay short and went elsewhere.
If the room was on a higher floor, then it may have been better but I'm not really convinced. I only recommend this place if you are not planning to sleep, and want a good location near to the busy pedestrian street.
reviews[40].comments: Lokasyon olarak İstiklal Caddesi'ne 2 dakikalık mesafede olması en sevdiğim özelliklerinden biri oldu. Daire küçük olmasına rağmen güzel dizaynı ile oldukça kullanışlı ve şeker görünüyor. Ev sahipleri ise oldukça sıcakkanlı ve yardımseverdi bize karşı. Genel olarak tavsiye edebileceğim memnuniyette kaldığım bir daire oldu. Herşey için teşekkürler. \nSevgiler
reviews[41].comments: Look exactly like the picture, feels a little small but pretty comfortable. Great location with decent night life and lots of food downstairs. However acoustic is not so good especially you are a light sleeper. But it is ok for me and my friend.  \r\nOne big problem is that it always small like smoke - no matter it comes from tobacco or the grill smoke down stair.\r\nOther than that it is generally a good stay
reviews[42].comments: Great location and very nice appartment. Especially for this price. Downstairs there is a small cafe where you can drink coffee or a beer for again a good price. The owner was friendly and helpfull. We enjoyed it very much. Best thing was the shower. Amazing!
reviews[43].comments: Thank you so much for the oppotunity to stay in one of your apartments. \nThe apartment was Small But really comfortable and clean. I even would say the size was perfect, not to big and not to Small.... its a very nice place in the middle heart of taksim! And one more thing: Raven is a friendly nice man Who Made for us the best stay in istanbul possible... he Takes care of his guests (Website hidden by Airbnb) sum it up: recommend! recommend! recommend! We will come back!
reviews[44].comments: if you come to Istanbul don't hesitate to go to Raven's suits, very very nice location and a lot of fun outsides for great night pubs and bars. And the host is very helpful and like a big brother to give you whatever suggestion you like.  Come on, or you will be regretful!
reviews[45].comments: Great Rooms in a convenient Location, just around the corner for the Taksim Square. The rooms are very clean and the Pub is a cozy place to stay.
reviews[46].comments: It was really great, Raven is very welcoming. As soon as we arrived he gave us great tips for the city, and was very helpfull.\r\nThe appartment was very clean and modern.\r\nWould highly recommend it to anyone!!!
reviews[47].comments: Raven was a very lovely host. Everything was taken care of and the location was in a perfect place if you want to explore Istanbul with its many attractions, dining and nightlife. The room was very cosy and the shower was definetly the most amazing part !!
reviews[48].comments: Amazing place in the middle of city center. Location is near Istikal street (the most famous one in Taksim), but it's not so crowded! The hotel is looking exactly like on the pictures! Very clean and private. We really like our host . He was there all the time to help us and answer on all our questions! We would definitely recommend this hotel! Thank you thank  you ❤️
reviews[49].comments: This place was an amazing location that was also very safe. Also public transportation was easily accessible which was awsome. The hosts were very helpful with regards to information needed to get around town. The space was very clean and comfortable which made the experience even more enjoyable.
reviews[50].comments: We loved our stay even it was just one night. Raven is a wonderful host, we also enjoyed a bit social life in his pub downstairs. Definitely recommend if you want an authentic airbnb experience.
reviews[51].comments: L'accoglienza è stata ottima così come la permanenza a Istanbul. L'host è sempre stato prsente, gentile e ha risolto subito un piccolo problema. l'appartamento è come nelle foto e assolutamente pulito. La posizione è ottima e centrale così come descritto.  E' la prima volta che mi rivolgo al vostro servizio ed è stato un ottimo inizio. Ribadisco la gentilezza e la presenza dell'Host e dei suoi collaboratori. Esperienza sa ripetere assolutamente
reviews[52].comments: This place was perfect! We only stayed one night but I would love to come back for a longer period of time. The bar downstairs is fun, and the restaurant across the street was delicious. Raven was very welcoming, kind and gave us great recommendations
reviews[53].comments: Great atmosphere, good area and nice host. recommended
reviews[54].comments: L'appartement est vraiment bien situé, au coeur d'Istanbul et vraiment pratique pour se balader .Le personnel vraiment agréable et disponible.  En revanche , j'ai logé dans une chambre du premier étage situé au dessus du pub très bruyant . J'ai profité merveilleusement d'istanbul avec cet appartement mais je n'ai pas pu me reposer .
reviews[55].comments:
Easy to find, easy check it , fast internet, clean , in the heart of istiklal night life. 

I've stayed there for one night and it was very convenient for me because of the location.

What I didn't like we the fact that the cigarette smoke from downstairs came into the room , extremely thin entrance door and walls.

I like the fact that you could hear the nightlife buzz directly in the room, but if you want a quiet place - this hotel is not for you.
reviews[56].comments: I had a wonderful stay.
reviews[57].comments: Todo muy bien.
reviews[58].comments: Raven est très accueillant, il nous a offert un verre de bienvenue dans son bar, un café le matin...\r\nIl nous a suggéré des restaurants, et était toujours prêt à  nous guider lors de nos questions. \r\nL'appartement est sympa, surtout entre amis festifs, car un bruyant. Il est très bien situé, à proximité de commerces et transports.
reviews[59].comments: Me and my girlfriend had an excellent time staying at Ravens apartment in Istanbul. Location was ideal - easy walk (5 mins) to the main shopping area and lots of cool restaurants and bars. It's also a few streets back from the main street so other than general hustle and bustle it wasn't too noisy at night. The appartment has a funky / urban feel too which we liked. Cool little bar downstairs too. They were excellent hosts being flexible with timings and providing helpful information before our trip. Would happily stay their again.
reviews[60].comments:
It was a nice stay at the Raven Suite Istanbul. I arrived very late due to the late flight plus delay with the notification. The communication was prompt and Nuri was very nice to welcome me even after midnight. 

The property is just look the same as the photo and very well situated, just 2 mins walking distance from taksim square and few steps away from istiklal cad, the famous walking street with shops, restaurants and everything you need during your visit to istanbul. 

The facilities works well, and very comfortable, even Nuri told me that i may check out a bit late with no extra fee. And there is a raven cafe just under the apartment, in case you need a refreshment.
reviews[61].comments: Un accueil très chaleureux, et en plein centre de Taksim!
reviews[62].comments: Nuri was a great host! Very friendly, a real gentleman and he helped us with everything. The room was very clean, and near everything. We loved the Istanbul atmosphere.
reviews[63].comments: We had such a great time in Istanbul. The apartments are set in a really vibrant area, so much going on and so much to see! They are a short walk from Beyoglu, an area with lots of amazing windy streets filled with cute little cafes and antique shops. Raven was an amazing host, our flight was delayed 3 hours but he waited for us until the early hours of the morning and it wasn't a problem. Thank you! Katy x
reviews[64].comments: Danke Nuri,\r\n\r\nfür die zu 100% weiter zu empfehlende Unterkunft. Die Gastfreundschaft, Hilfsbereitschaft und die Zimmer haben uns begeistert. Die Lage sucht wirklich seines Gleichen !
reviews[65].comments: Très bon accueil chaleureux de la part de notre hôte. \r\nNous étions aux petits soins. Je recommande fortement. Sauf pour les amateurs de calme :)
reviews[66].comments: 房间很洋气 楼下就是bar 喜欢high的少年少女一定会喜欢
reviews[67].comments: The location was exactly as advertised and the host was exceptional.  Our host spoke with our cab driver to ensure we arrived at the correct address and met us where/when the cab dropped us off ( a few blocks away from the hotel) .  On arrival, he treated us to refreshments and shared with us the best places to visit.  He even shared with us his public transit card!  He treated us to refreshments on our departure then walked us to a cab and spoke with the cab driver to ensure that we weren't charged too much for the trip to the airport.  I would highly recommend this location/host.
reviews[68].comments: Nuri was a perfect host and a very pleasant person as well.\r\nWe arrived very late but he made us feel welcome nontheless!\r\nThe aparment offered everything we needed for our stay in Istanbul.
reviews[69].comments: Amazing host and a great property in an ideal location in lively Istanbul. Couldn't have had a better host in Nuri, we would happily stay again.
reviews[70].comments:
The worse thing about this appartament are bugs. A lot of bugs! It was terrible staying. 

Appartament is tiny even for 2 persons so don't believ the ad saying that appartament can host 4 persons. 

Among the good things are location and balcony. Also the maid was very kind.
reviews[71].comments: Our host at Raven was very nice and kind! The whole place is very cosy and equally modern. The home is very well-situated; walkable. Also the Raven bar is really hip and a nice place to have a drink in the evenings.
reviews[72].comments: the place has a lot of charm and the host makes you feel special. thank you ! \r\n
reviews[73].comments: Great location; close to everything. Very authentic Turkish experience. Raven is an amazing host, and greeted me with open arms. He was available to assist with every request. Very clean and well kept. Awesome bar with a great vibe just downstairs. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
reviews[74].comments: Raven is in an extremely convenient location near Taksim Square. Upon arrival, our host welcomed us and gave us a cold beer to enjoy as he explained the space and gave us some advice for our time in Istanbul. The room, itself, was quiet, clean, and comfortable. I would stay here again.
reviews[75].comments: Nuri is a great host and very accommodating. The apartment is in a nice location and convenient for shopping and dining
reviews[76].comments: Fantastic host and perfect location\nCozy apartment. Ideal for friends and young people who would like to stay in the heart of Istanbul.
reviews[77].comments: Kaldığımız teraslı odayı çok sevdik! Beyoğlu gürültüsü çok fazla olsa da burada kalmaya değdi
reviews[78].comments: We have stayed at the Raven in the past and loved the location, vibrancy of the street below and the kindness of the hosts.  Since we stayed there previously we had requested a specific room and were told our request would be granted.  However when we arrived our requested room was not available and it was the only one with a balcony.  The hosts went above and beyond to try and accommodate us including finding another place to stay with a balcony.  We only stayed one night and ended up switching hotels, but they even helped us with our luggage and carried it on a 15 minute walk to the other hotel.  They did not have to do this and I was really surprised at how accommodating and friendly they were.  Even though we ended up switching places I would still come back and stay at the Raven again since the hosts are first class and I don't fault them for the mixup.  Our remaining fee for the other nights was refunded and they even followed up a week later to make sure our funds had cleared to make sure we got our refund.  You just don't see this honesty every day and we hope to come back and visit next time.
reviews[79].comments: Strongly recommended. Nuri and all the staff at the Raven provided an awesome service. We stayed on the 3rd floor for 4 nights. Location is very close to taksim square. Would stay again. Thanks Nuri and staff.
reviews[80].comments: Great stay in a great location of Taksim. Very local and packed with life, not far from everything you want to do. Our host was awesome and has his own cool pub downstairs of rooms.  Thanks for the hospitality Raven pub and staff!
reviews[81].comments: Raven calisanlari ziyaretimiz sirasinca oldukca sicakkanli ve ilgiliydi , Oda ve teras resimlerdeki gibi temiz genis ve ferahti , Yer taksimdeki eglence mekanlarina , gezilecek yerlere ve restorantlara oldukcada yakin , \r\nOda icerisinde hem oturma alaninda hem yatakta tv bulunmasi da kalicaklara ayri bir rahat ortam sagliyor
reviews[82].comments:
In one word: Great! 
Location: right in the lively Taksim area, the apartment belongs to a nicely modern designed building. 
Cool and relax bar on the street floor.
To/From IST airport, take the cheap Havatas bus, it gets you near Taksim square, walking distance to Raven suite. 
Host: Nuri and his staff are wonderful and genuinely helpful.
I will come back for sure)
Boris
reviews[83].comments: I loved the place, and the persons who working there, they are very helpful and awesome people, they was very welcome when i been there, to be honest i did not stayed for more than 1 night because there are stairs and it was not comfortable for my father because he is old, but i would like to say Thank you very much revan for the sweets welcome,
reviews[84].comments: Great place, amazing host. the bar downstairs was really cool. wish I stayed longer!
reviews[85].comments:
Located in the meandering street of one of the busiest areas, Taksim. Nori's bnb is definitely one to NOT be missed. 
On top of the cleanliness and convenience his bnb provides, he's also one of the friendliest and most caring hosts we've met. He was helping us with all directions and places to visit, often offering us beer from his pub and tea from the street eatery beside! When I twisted my ankle, he bought medicine for me along with my boyfriend and even offer to take me to the hospital.
The room we stayed in looked exactly like the picture; a house keeper came to clean our room within the 3 days of our stay. 
We really enjoyed our time in Istanbul with Noris hospitality! 

We will definitely stay here if we visit again!
reviews[86].comments: We absolutely loved staying at the Raven. The apartment was clean, modern and affordable and in a great location. Just minutes from Taksim square and surrounded by really great restaurants.\r\nThe host was warm and friendly and provided us with a beer on arrival and lots of great tips for our stay. We look forward to staying here again next time we travel to Istanbul!
reviews[87].comments: Raven is a really cool place to stay in the center of Istanbul. Its on the main street Istıklal. Lots of pubs and bars around. The apartment was exactly the same with the pictures. Very clean and cozy. Enjoy Raven!
reviews[88].comments: Great location, great people managing the place, really helpful and friendly. It is in the middle of the vibrant Taksim life and possibly could not be any better in terms of location. The place is really cosy and comfortable with great wi-fi, clean bathroom and very eccentric design. This has been a great experience for me. It would be even greater for people who look into making new like-minded friends in the town as this building also hosts a very nice pub/cafe. Definitely recommend it :)
reviews[89].comments: 房间设计完美 体验舒适度非常高 靠近塔克西姆广场是一个非常不错的入住选择
reviews[90].comments: Perfect location. Close to the main shopping street. Excellent for solo or small groups looking for nightlife. Tons of bars and clubs in the area, and most important they seem to be open all night! Lots of places to grab a late snack. Nuri was awesome, he gave us good advises on how to get to the old city and invited us some beers from his pub the first night.
reviews[91].comments:
Great location and fantastic host , Raven was very polite and helpful , place located at the heart of everything.
Only problem if you sleep early it will not be possible as location is surrounded by night clubs, its music can even reach to your ears in a bedroom. 

Overall Fantastic for live and love in Istanbul. .
reviews[92].comments: Very friendly and helpful. Excellent location.
reviews[93].comments: A few finishing touches to the apartment and a bit of noise from the tiny bar downstairs are the only things that are holding this place back from a 5 star rating. The location can not be better, 1 min walk to Taksim Sq! The area is really nice to walk around and all attractions on this side of Istanbul are easily reachable on foot! In fact we really enjoyed the walk from Suleymaniye on the other side of the bridge to the apartment with our 5 yr old son (took about 45 mins with some small breaks).  Unlike some other parts of Istanbul, we felt very safe here.\r\n\r\nThe host is fantastic, always helpful and providing all the guidance you need without being intrusive. He even let us check in early and check out late at no extra cost! And I have no doubt he will help all guests anyway he can.
reviews[94].comments: 탁심광장과 가까운 위치로 여행시 편리합니다 주인 레이븐이 매우 친절하려 체크 아웃 시간도 연장해 주셨습니다 덕분에 편안한 여행되었습니다.\r\n다음번에 터키를 오게된다면 꼭 다시 방문하고 싶습니다.
reviews[95].comments: Great location and comfortable accommodation. I would stay here again.
reviews[96].comments: Very easy meet and greet. Welcoming host and warm, cozy apartment (we happened to be here during a huge snow storm). Clean and comfortable. Would absolutely stay here again.
reviews[99].comments: Perfect location amd warm and welcoming people. If you plan to stay in the heart of the city, which of course comes with some noises at night, this is the ultimate place for you!
reviews[100].comments: Nice little apartment in a very centrally location near Taksim and Istiklal. Great value for money! However light sleepers should be aware that this is right above a bar and you can clearly hear the noise not just from the bar but adjacent clubs (bring earplugs!)
reviews[101].comments: Harika bir mekan. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.
reviews[102].comments: We spent 3 nights in the Raven and although the rooms were smaller than expected, the location was good and Nuri was a brilliant and very helpful host. The bar downstairs was a great place to hang out but was very noisy throughout the night. If you're in Istanbul for the nightlife, then this is the place for you.
reviews[104].comments: Nice place above a bar, only one real bed and a couch that is difficult to fold out. Allow a cat in the hallway which meowed overnight and my friend was allergic.
reviews[105].comments: Amazing place, really close to Taksim Square. A block away from the craziness that is İstiklal Avenue, this small little place is a really nice base from which to explore the rest of Istanbul. Really great hosts, they let us check in a bit early, took care of our bags etc. Would recommend 100%
reviews[106].comments: Great location. Bartenders are sweet and very hospitable. Bring ear plugs and you will sleep well. We were very fortunate to have the top (4th floor) balcony room. Note: this is the only room without a divider to separate the living room sofa bed from the actual bed in the bedroom. Floors 3, 2 and 1 have a moveable partition down the middle making it "2 rooms".
reviews[107].comments: Amazing place, lively and hip. Perfect bar downstairs and not too noisey. Right in the coolest area of Istanbul.
reviews[108].comments: Amazing place, friendly staff and great bar.
reviews[109].comments: İstiklalin göbeğinde küçük ama inanılmaz şirin bir apart fotoğraflardakinin tıpatıp aynısı. Küçücük bir alanı mükemmel değerlendirmişler. Çok memnun kaldık tavsiye ederiz :)
reviews[110].comments: If you're looking for a central location and close to nightlife this is the place for you. Its cheap, central, convenient. Host was very kind to let us check in pretty early before 12pm. Was welcomed with turkish tea and even provided us with free welcoming drinks. Great host great apartment! Value for money definitely!
reviews[111].comments: 탁심 광장에서 도보 5분 거리인 위치가 굉장한 장점입니다. 하지만 1층이 Raven pub이고 방음은 귀마개를 해도 소용없을 만큼 형편없기 때문에 예민하신 편이라면 힘들 수 있습니다. 마지막날 아침에 물이 잠깐 안나오긴 했지만, 에어컨이나 냉장고 모두 문제없었습니다. 소음 문제만 아니면 가성비 괜찮은 숙소입니다:)
reviews[112].comments: Good location right off taxim square
reviews[113].comments: Great location & hosts! Located over a bar - very good for partying.
reviews[114].comments: 装修很现代  很适合情侣  楼下就是Raven的酒吧  他说可以下去喝免费饮料  不过我们都是女孩子就没有去了  Raven和店里小哥人非常好  一开始没有转换插头也是找他们借的  房间很干净  民宿位置也是繁华地带  旁边商店饭店都很多  但是会有一点点吵  介意的话就不推荐咯  很好的住房体验~
reviews[115].comments: Helpful staff, central location. No lift which is a pain but rest was fine!
reviews[116].comments: Really nice place if u like staying around local urban vibe.(too much noise). But really nice vibe
reviews[117].comments: 照片看上去挺大,挺好看的,实际房间会小一点,现代感很强
reviews[118].comments: Brilliant location. It could not be more central. This is a great spot if you want to party and enjoy yourself until early in the morning. This is a lively neighborhood, so not for those that need absolute quiet and an early bedtime.
reviews[119].comments: This place is in a great location! Right in the thick of the nightlife of Taksim. My only feedback is that the apartment is not "luxury" as the listing notes. It is comfortable, but basic. \n\nThe hosts from the Bar downstairs were great and super friendly and helpful at all times.
reviews[120].comments: Great location, were helpful when asked.
reviews[121].comments: Convenient location, interior design finishing true to pictures and the hosts were friendly.
reviews[123].comments: The apartment is beautifully designed and located very close to Taksim. The area is vibrant and noisy till late at night. One thing to note is that there is no door between the bedroom and the living room.
reviews[124].comments: It was okay. It's located in the busiest part of the city. There was a small hiccup checking in but the hosts were very nice. We checked in around midnight, and we were just dead tired from traveling. So to be held up at the bar downstairs for a good 15 mins did not make things better. I just wanted to go in, shower, and pass out. The place overall was decent. It looked a lot better in photos. It's clean but the place reeked of smoke. I didn't mind the noise from downstairs that much but don't book here if you're looking for a quiet place.
reviews[125].comments:
Our stay was delightful. 

I checked other comments before booking here, as they say it’s quit small place but architect used every area functional and well. And also the place is very close everything you need ! I think it’s a good place for touristic visit and if you like nightlife the place is very close to some good night clubs. Although it can also be noisy to stay... on Monday we had to left early morning and couldn’t get our last sleep well. 

They have also pub at the ground level. Staff were amazingly friendly. In our last night we had time to hang out a bit with them, they offered us free tea and popcorn. That was nice. 

Thanks :)
reviews[126].comments: 工業風房間位在小酒吧的樓上,整體風格很喜歡,位置非常好
reviews[127].comments: Perfect spot for sightseeing in Istanbul, in the middle of the night huzzle. The apartment was clean and of perfect size for two persons exploring the city. Only minor point is the noise from the bar downstairs.
reviews[129].comments: Location is perfect for those who’s into late night shenanigans ;) you will get everything in a walking distance. Keep in mind that you probably won’t be able to get any rest when you stay anywhere close to Istiklal. Raven is also a lovely, cosy and inexpensive bar!
reviews[130].comments: The lodge is basically a hotel/hostel above a bar, huge space for the price I paid. Don’t send a message to host in Airbnb apps/site, better to contact him through (Hidden by Airbnb) . Otherwise, the place is centrally located about 10 minutes of walk from Taksim metro station, in the middle of Istanbul night life scenes.
reviews[131].comments: Отличное место в самом центре города. Рядом много пабов, баров и ресторанов. Музыка не стихает 24/7!!! Стильный интерьер! На первом этаже веселый пивной бар!
reviews[133].comments: Nice, clean accommodation with great location to walk to the sights or enjoy the local nightlife ☺️
reviews[134].comments: Location near to Istiklal Caddesi, the centre for Istanbul's nightlife. Hence, don't expect it to be quiet at night. However, very convenient to get around and nice food places around the vicinity as it is very centralised. 5 minutes walk to Taksim Metro. Host is a bartender at the bar below, very friendly and helpful if you have any queries.
reviews[135].comments: Good place, good host but really really noisy. 3 night spent and i only slept 7hours.
reviews[136].comments: 숙소위치도 탁심광장에서 멀지않고 필요한것만 딱 있는 느낌입니다.\n대신 밤에 노랫소리나 말소리로 시끄럽긴합니다.\n그정도빼면 괜찮았습니다.
reviews[137].comments: Çok güzel bir daireydi. Çok teşekkür ediyorum.
reviews[138].comments: Nice apartments in very good location. Host is super friendly
reviews[139].comments:
Ev bulunduğu konum itibariyle fazlaca gürültülü. Canlı müzik, kareoke ve barda oturanların sesleri geliyor sürekli. üstelik gece geç saate kadar.
Dinlenmek ve uyumak için ideal degil..

Bunun dışında temiz ve gayet modern dizayn edilmiş odalar, fiyat olarak uygun..
reviews[140].comments: 入住还是很愉快的,感谢房东帮我们订了接机车~ 房东很绅士帮忙提了行李箱~^_^唯一的问题就是楼下比较吵,但是看评价也有心理预期的,但从住宿讲和另外一家比还是逊色一点~
reviews[141].comments: Lokasyon çok iyi. Her yer çok temizdi. Işletme sahibi çok kibar ve ilgili. Sadece daire fotoğrafta daha modern görünüyor. Eşyalar yeni değil. Duvarlar bakımsız görünüyor ama belki de tarzı  oyle. Iki televizyon olması çok kullanışlı olmuş. Teşekkür ederim
reviews[142].comments: Great spot and great hosts. Super noisy till circa 6am if room is located on first floor.
reviews[143].comments: 탁심광장에서 가까워 이동하기 너무 좋았습니다. 숙소도 깨끗했구, 1층 펍에서 맥주 한잔하기도 좋습니다.\n평일에는 괞찮지만 주말 밤에 조금 시끄러웠던게 조금 아쉽네요. 전체적으로는 만족 합니다
reviews[145].comments:
Right off the main avenue, Istiklal, with café/bars very near and minutes from Taksim Square with a little park and transport links.

Small space, nice design, clean and cool. Not soundproof, but an easy stop for a citybreak weekend. 

Thanks
reviews[147].comments: Kleines Zimmer direkt über einer Bar gelegen. Ziemlich laut, aber wen das nicht stört, der ist da gut aufgehoben.
reviews[148].comments: Raven’s place was amazing. If you are looking to socialize, party or just visit istanbul, it is the perfect place for you. Close to shops, bars, pubs and the most central street in the old town of Istanbul. The only reason I might not find it suitable for everyone is because there is loud music and party around until about 4:00 AM - If you are a light sleeper and want to go ti bed early this might be a problem for you during the weekend.
reviews[150].comments: The place is nothing like the pictures shown  I don’t ever write a bad review but this one has to be done  so other people can see what they are booking the place is not safe for a woman they were many drunk men vomiting outside not pleasant to see i had to book another place
reviews[151].comments: Oda çok güzel design edilmişti ve temizliği, internet hızı vs herşey olması gerektiği gibiydi. Karşılayan kişi de oldukça nazikti. Gürültü hakkında yazılanlarla ilgili olarak, istiklal caddesi gibi merkezi bir yerde kalmak istiyorsanız civardaki kalınacak yerler gürültü açısından farklı değil, bu durum bu yere özel birşey değil. Ayrıca aşırı da bir gürültü yoktu. Ben tavsiye ediyorum.
reviews[152].comments: Great little apartment right in the heart of the city. They let us check in early and leave our stuff behind for a bit longer when we had to check out, which was very nice of them. \nThe place is anbit smaller than expected however has all of the basics (no shampoo or shower gel though) and is perfect for a quick stay. The location meant there was a lot of noise up until early hours of the morning, so don’t forget to bring ear plugs!
reviews[153].comments: We stayed on the fourth floor above raven bar for 3 nights. Reg was very nice and friendly once we were there, but no communication prior to check in. The apartment is an excellent location, and being in the 4th floor really helped with the noise. Our main issue was the cleanliness, a strong cigarette odor and in visible stains and mildew around the apartment, even still this is a great value, but people with allergies should be aware.
reviews[154].comments: Great apartment in a vibrant area. Perfect if you are in a mood for party.
reviews[155].comments: Host is very helpful with our queries, the place was very near Taksim square and metro, around 5-10 minutes walk. We were 3 girls and they were very nice to offer help to  carry our luggage’s as there were no lift. Very active nightlife area  and safe . Free coffee and tea , clean and stylish place.
reviews[156].comments: We had a great stay at Raven. Reg was extremely hospitable and the location was good night life.
reviews[157].comments: the space was nice and the area was very cool but it was above a bar so extremely loud. they did move us to a higher floor when we complained.
reviews[158].comments: Its cheap, centrally located, and in a bustling neighborhood full of little bars.  \n\nThe apartment is above a bar and the walls are _very_thin and the bar downstairs is loud.  But the hosts were great and the place is super cheap.  Great option if you're on a budget and don't mind sleeping  above a  busy place.
reviews[159].comments: Great location near all kinds of amazing food and cafes. Reg (sp?) at the bar was super helpful and great to chat with. We got the top unit with a balcony which was amazing to listen to people watch and see a bit of sunset. As the description says, and other reviewers have mentioned.. you’ll be on a lively street above a bar. It was beautiful weather and people were out past 3am. I loved the place and would definitely stay again if I’m lucky enough to get back to Istanbul.
reviews[160].comments: Very nice and cosy place next to Taksim square.  Will definitely come back!
reviews[162].comments: The apartment is absolutely gorgeous, really well equipped and perfectly located for exploring Istanbul. The hosts were really helpful in advance, the bar downstairs means there is always somone on hand. \nI would definitely recommend staying here, the only downside was the noise levels at night from the bar, although this might have been exacerbated by the world cup during my visit.
reviews[163].comments: A very nice place in the hustle and bustle of Taksim. We had a good time, even despite the noisy evenings.
reviews[164].comments: We just spent one night and had a very good time. The place has a good location and is near to many sights. The host is very nice and helpful. We would definitely come another time.
reviews[165].comments:
Would not recommend.

Unfortunately it was super loud in the flat, even with earplugs sleeping was hard:
The apartment is above a bar. That means loud music and people till 3 a.m. The stairs in the stairway are out of metall. Whenever somebody walks up or down the stairs, the whole house will here it. As the stairs are also used by costumers of the pub, it is very loud till late at night. During our stay there were also builders for two days, hammering and sawing for hours. Host was not helpful when approaching him on this.

You smell smoke in the room and the towels, though there is a "please don't smoke" sign.

Pro: Raven's place is located very convenient close to Istiklal and Taksim. Good to reach via public transportation. AC works.
reviews[166].comments: Really cute apartment right near to Taksim, staff are really nice and were so helpful when I arrived really early for check in.
reviews[167].comments: This was the perfect place for us. We had 5 days in Istanbul and we were comfortable, cool (it was quite hot while we were there!) and found Raven to be a lovely host. You will hear the noise from below and on the street so if you want a silent place, this isn't for you. But we really enjoyed listening to the world go by under our stylish apartment and we were very happy with the location as well! Would highly recommend.
reviews[168].comments: Friendly and accommodating staff. The place was nice but not as big as we expected from the photos. There was often loud music however this may be a feature of the general area of Taksim. Overall nice place to stay.
reviews[169].comments: 房间所在的街区真的很热闹,没想到就在独立大街旁边,旁边有很多酒吧不过房间的隔音效果很好还是不会吵到｡另外房间很干净哟,应为到的时候还没到入住时间,所以入住的时候我们在外面,房东很热情地帮我们把寄存的行李提上去了｡周围有很多商店和餐厅,并且离地铁公交站以及出租车站都很近｡总之是很不错的入住体验
reviews[170].comments: It’s really nice place. And i hope to stay here again. Host is very nice and considerable\nPerson.
reviews[171].comments: Great place in a central part of the city
reviews[172].comments: The appartment is nice. But you can hear loud music all night until 6am. Even the bed is shaking. But if you dont mind the noise the quality is good and the hosts very friendly and there is a nice bar downstair.
reviews[173].comments: This suite is really nice, clean and looks as it does in the photos. Staff were very helpful and friendly. However, do not stay here if you want to get any sleep. There's a bar next door that has live concerts every night, starting about midnight or 1am and they go until sunrise. It was incredibly loud and impossible to sleep for my entire stay.
reviews[174].comments: Nice apartment, as described. Excellent location, a bit noisy during the weekend.
reviews[175].comments: The noise is a real issue, we could not sleep anytime during the night. There was a real concert behind our wall, on a Tuesday it lasted until 6 am. It goes beyond regular street and bar noise. It is a shame because it is well located, but for us it was not a good experience, and the worst thing is that the host did not care about it.
reviews[176].comments: The best thing about the place is the location. It is less than a 5 min walk to Taksim Square. The one bedroom apartment is very well designed, and while small, it is still very comfortable.
reviews[177].comments: Apartamento muy cerca de la plaza Taksim, debajo con muchos bares, a pesar de esto dispone de buena aislamiento en las ventanas, el sitio limpio y ordenado, cerca del metro, en fin buen establecimiento
reviews[178].comments: The apartment was in a great location with easy access to transport, bars, restaurants and shops, and easy to find. However, the apartment seems to back onto a night club and we were kept awake on both nights of our stay by extremely loud live music with a heavy bass which we could hear and feel till early morning, even with ear plugs.  There was a lack of towels and bedding, couldn't get the tvs to work, had to ask for wi-fi code . Also the kitchen' is very basic. A fridge and just a kettle and cups and glasses with no plates, knives, spoons or forks provided and no toaster or microwave. It was smaller than it looked on the photos and would be ok for a couple but was a little crowded with the sofa bed in use.\nOn a positive note it was generally clean and  the bathroom had a good shower.
reviews[179].comments: As the previous guests wrote, Raven is situated at a top location. Flawless check out. Only 3 cons. First, the check in was not flawless since the guys at the pub did not speak any English and the process was really slow and uneasy. Second, there was neither shampoo nor shower gel, there was only a small hand soap available. Finally, the walls and windows' insulation was inaccurate for the music from the bar downstairs playing till 7 in the morning (but I was prepared for that :) ). Overall, a nice experience!
reviews[180].comments: Raven apartments are run by fantastic people whose communication and response times are great. The apartment is quite dark and a bit gloomy (it's not luxury, it's well lived in modern) but it is perfect for two people who enjoy being in the thick of it and go out a lot at night. The bar downstairs is good fun and run by lovely people. Our room was on level two and the bedroom wall is shared with a neighbouring club who play loud music from 11pm - 4am seemingly every night (the city never sleeps!). I live in the inner city back home and normally sleep like the dead but this level of noise made the bed vibrate and we had awful sleepless nights. Following complaints and two restless nights, we were moved off site to another hotel. I can't speak highly enough of the staff at Raven. We were treated incredibly well and it made the experience worth it. So I would recommend Raven for people who love the nightlife amd can tolerate excessive noise from the neighbours.
reviews[182].comments: The apartment is great! It‘s just a few meters to the Taksim square. It‘s a bit noisy at night because it’s in the middle of the nightlife in Istanbul, which is also good for people who want to go out in the evening/ night. The apartment was clean and perfect for two people! We would choose this apartment anytime again!
reviews[183].comments: We were ok with the noise from the bar and expected this based upon previous reviews. However the owners changed the beer kegs at 8am which was extremely loud, which then followed by over an hour of drilling and building work with little thought for the guests which was a shame.
reviews[184].comments: Nice and cozy apartment, missing kitchen but otherwise good.
reviews[185].comments: It was a great location, clean, and really cute.  No one in the building spoke English or knew the correct WiFi password.  Luckily we got it figured out but I took a few hours and I  needed the WiFi for work, which had been made clear to the host prior to staying there.  Also, the bar downstairs/next door is very noisy until really late, so bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper.
reviews[186].comments: The place is great, noise didn't bother me, infact it me sleep better because the music was relaxing. hosts were lovely and respected our privacy. The only down side is the bad neighbourhood it can be unsafe  but it is close to Taksim and everything else.
reviews[187].comments: Great location, however it should be noted that the street it’s on is extremely noise all throughout the night. There was also an overwhelming cigarette smell 24 hours a day. Finding the spot was another nightmare. Istanbul is a beautiful city, which made up for the issues with this Airbnb!
reviews[188].comments:
Turkcesi asagida:

The first three nights that we stayed there I actually thought “I don’t have one bad thing to say about this place”. The location is amazing, I loved the decoration and the place was spotless and wasn’t nearly as noisy as described by the other reviewers. The only thing that really left a bad taste on my mouth was the fact the host entered our room without communicating it to us first. We came back from outside and there were new towels new sheets etc. In an airbnb I don’t expect room service so I just leave my stuff around (underwear, money etc.). If I had been asked I would have said no thank you, I don’t want any room service. This also made me question if they were there before. Maybe other people won’t think this is a big deal but I would have very much liked to be advised beforehand.

Burada kaldigimiz ilk uc gece burayla ilgili tek bir kotu sey soyleyemem diye dusundum cunku yeri harika, dekorasyon da cok guzel ve asla soylenen kadar gurultulu degil. Dorduncu gecemizde beni rahatsiz eden sey su oldu: disardan geldigimizde odamiza biz yokken host tarafindan girilip yeni havlu vs koyulmus oldugunu gorduk. Ben normalde airbnblerde oda servisi gibi bir beklentiye sahip olmadigim icin esyalarimi baskasinin gorecegi kaygisi olmadan birakiyorum. Eger bana sorulmus olsaydi da oda servisi istemedigimi belirtirdim ama sorulmadi. Haberim olmadan odama girilmis olmasi beni gercekten cok rahatsiz etti. Belki bazi insanlar bunun buyuk bir olay oldugunu dusunmeyebilir ama benim icin onemliydi. Eger sizin icin de onemliyse hostla girmeden istemediginize dair konusun derim.
reviews[189].comments: nice place to have a quick nap and continue on with travel plans
reviews[190].comments: Great location in the city, however the flat is quite small and the furnishings are a bit tired. The apartment has a small pub downstairs that has a nice selection of beers available and live HD football. This location is definitely not for a light sleeper, even with earplugs. There is a live music venue directly adjacent to apartment block and you are likely to hear the sound of guitars and drums. Throughout our week here, this noise was present from midnight til 6:00 am every day and in one case til 9:00am on the 2nd Jan. After finally getting to sleep, on 2 occasions I was woken by a delivery of beer kegs that were dropped on the bottom of the metal spiral stairs. Unfortunately this resonates throughout the entire apartment block. You are spoilt for choice in the city with restaurants so don’t feel like you need to jump in the first place you see. You can wander around the side streets and restaurants are in abundance. Our host was extremely helpful and friendly and made us feel very welcome.
reviews[191].comments: Very good location. Right on Taksim. Highly recommended

reviews[16].comments: Overall I am pleased with my stay.  The Cihangir neighborhood is lively and comfortable, one of Istanbul's remaining secular outposts.  When I checked in there was an issue with the apartment I booked - the host was quick to acknowledge her mistake and allow me to stay in another room in the building for the night.  As other reviewers have written - as this is an attic apartment, the floors in the bedrooms and bathroom are sloped, making it difficult to maneuver comfortably.  The bedrooms also get quite stuffy. reviews[17].comments: Real nice place in central Istanbul. Not loud and with air con. Only thing, the roof is low, quite a problem for tall people.
reviews[18].comments: We had a great time whilst there and all the staff at the bar below were very affable. Nice view of Istanbul at the balcony. I would stay there again.

reviews[29].comments:
Zenka was a great host...very attentive to messages but because of the language barrier, it was not entirely clear that the keys were held by a night watchman at the Otto Cihangir Cafe. Thanks to a Turkish-speaking man who helped with translations at the airport, that this was the case. The cafe was difficult to spot late at night; for others who are arriving late, look for the Savoy Cake shop opposite the alleyway.

My six nights were comfortable though best for short folks like me. Unfortunately an earlier rainstorm seeped through the windows and both mattresses closest to the windows were wet. Good thing I was a single traveller and with a little rearrangement of the mattress in one of the bedrooms made the rest of the stay entirely satisfactory. There was a problem with the light in the bathroom on the first night but Zenka bounced in as soon as he got my message and got an electrician to fix it immediately. Less so with the sensor light that came on on day 3 and would not go off the rest of the stay. Admittedly it was during an important Muslim holiday.

The location was perfect, not far from Taksim and Tophane  for transport links. Lots of cafes and restaurants a short walk from the flat. Surprisingly quiet despite being in the middle of a lively area.

The building, though old, smelt lovely as did the flat. The towels and sheets were super clean. Air conditioner great for cooling the rooms down after a warm day under the eaves. The sloping ceilings can be a problem for some. Even I, at 1.63cm, managed to hit my head a few times.

The balcony was great though don't leave it or windows opened when out, as the roaming cats may decide to stray in.

Be warned that there is very little in way of cutlery or plates but perhaps Zenka will take my suggestion of providing some.

All in all a very highly recommended place because I liked the area and in a building with character, very Parisian in feel, and very safe. Thank you Zenka.
reviews[30].comments: Clean room with two full beds and living space. Apartment is an attic-like space so cannot stand in either of the bedrooms. Very strange check-in process. Getting the correct information about check-in, check out was nearly impossible. I went to a cafe outside and asked wait staff I was there for Zenak. They asked around and finally a woman who "checked me in" took me in through a back door, and practically ran up the steps, and left without saying a word. I understand language barriers but with no info and no welcome, I was not satisfied.
reviews[31].comments:

reviews[32].comments: As others have noted the ceilings are very low! The only place you can stand fully upright is the living room bit, and there is a stool to sit on when you have a shower. But we spent most of our time exploring so it didn't matter that the room was small, and it's good value for the location. reviews[33].comments: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay in the apartment. It is super clean with a beautiful scenery. The place might not be suitable for tall people, but luckily for me, the small space didn't turn out as a problem. reviews[34].comments: The apartment is very cute and central in Istanbul. TR: Fotoğraflarda görüleni tam olarak alıyorsunuz. Mekanla ilgili yanıltıcı bir durum yok. Yalnızca binanın gürültü çıkarmaya çok müsait olmadığını ve Cihangir'in yapısı gereği balkonda geçireceğiniz vaktin diğer dairelere ve pencerelere biraz yakın olacağını bilmeniz gerek. Fotoğraflar ve diğer yorumlardan dolayı, tavanın alçaklığı sizi endişelendirebilir. Biraz zorluk yarattığı doğru. Banyoda ve yatılan alanlarda biraz eğilmek gerekli olabiliyor ancak abartılacak bir şey değil. Büyük bir güvenle tercih edebileceğiniz bir yer. You should know the building is old and that means loud noises will travel along thin walls and as a classical Cihangir street, the balcony is very close to other windows but as long as you keep your common sense about manners it shouldn't be a problem. Apartment is clean, welcomes you with soapy smells. Wifi is decent and view is reasonable. You may be concerned about height of the place because of the photographs and other comments. reviews[53].comments:
Ich hatte diesen Unterkunft für meine Mutter, Tante und Kusine gebucht. Ich selbst bin Erasmus-Student an der Istanbuler Universität. Sie waren aus Tiflis zu Besuch.
Weil wir in meiner WG nicht genug Platz hatten, haben wir uns entschieden etwas über Airbnb zu suchen. So bin ich auf ,,Zenka Rooms“ aufmerksam geworden. 
Um uns einchecken zu können, mussten wir von einem Bistro den Schlüssel abholen. Die Frau, die auch unsere Ansprechspartnerin war, hat uns zu der Wohnung begleitet. 
Das Gebäude ist aus Holz und macht von außen einen sympathischen Eindruck. Auch beim Reingehen hatte ich sehr gutes Gefühl. Unsere Wohnung war im Dachgeschoss. Die Höhe des Daches im Wohnzimmer war c.a 1,80 cm. und in den ,,Zimmerchen“ 1,30 cm. Die Wohnung ist für die Kleinmenschen gedacht und nicht für die Menschen, die mehr als 1,30 groß sind. 
Meine Mutter und Tante, die beide Rückenschmerzen haben, mussten  die ganze Zeit krum rumlaufen. Beim ins Bett Gehen musste man sich schon direkt vor der Tür hinlegen und zur Matratze kriechen. 
Duschen war einfach Katastrophe. Das Bad war vielleicht gerade Mal c.a 3 Quadratmeter groß und 1,40 hoch. 
Als ich die Frau angesprochen habe, dass diese Wohnung nicht den Bildern entsprach, hat sie mir auf ihr Handy die Bilder gezeigt, die tatsächlich in der Wohnung gemacht wurden. Allerdings als ich gebucht habe, waren ganz andere Bilder drin, als die sie mir gezeigt hat. Sie haben mehrere Zimmer, die sie vermieten und auf der Seite sind die Bilder vermischt, sodass man die nicht zu einem Zimmer zuordnen kann. 
Ich wäre nie auf die Idee gekommen, dass man sowas vermietet. 
Es möge für Pärchen vielleicht schön und romantisch sein, aber nicht für 50 jährigen Menschen, die unter Rückenschmerzen leiden. 
Ich finde sowas muss extra groß geschrieben werden, dass die Wohnung 1,30 hoch ist!
reviews[54].comments: L’appartamento è carino e siamo stati bene. L’unico difetto è l’altezza, non è consigliabile per persone più alte di un metro e 80 cm. reviews[56].comments: Excellent location, hosts friendly and quick to respond both on email and in person, and to act should problems arise.  Place is clean and pleasant.  Would recommend. \n\nJust FYI: Not the place if you're looking for tips and host interactions, or cute little amenities.  Wifi is present but unreliable.  Ask for good directions before arriving (don't rely on street number).  Roof of bedrooms is low enough that short people need to bend over/mattress on floor.  Just to keep in mind....But not to dissuade!
reviews[57].comments:
Please read my review to the end, it might save your life.

The listing for this flat is very misleading.

I booked it for myself and a friend. We are 183 and 182 cm tall, and there is only approximately 6sqm in the whole place where we can stand up straight. You have to sit down to shower and pee. The bedroom I was in was horribly claustrophobic, and my friends was smaller. It's not "cosy", or "compact" it's just completely unusable. The vast majority of the flat is 160cm high or much less. 

This fundamental problem is mentioned nowhere in the listing.

If you are lucky enough to connect to the wifi, then you will discover that it is completely unusable. The hosts are aware of this, as previous reviews will show.

The listing states there is a half bath. There is not even a half shower.

The intro to the listing says you have a kitchen. You do not. There's just a sink in the living room, with an unfitted fridge handily placed to prevent you from reaching the sink, and to stub your toe in the process.

There is supposed to be a laptop friendly workspace. There is not. But then you won't need that because there's no wifi anyway.

On the first night we stayed here, I woke in the morning covered in bites. I did not see a single mosquito anywhere, so there's a good chance that I was bitten by bed bugs. 

The "curtains" are bits of fabric shut into the windows, so if you open the windows, the "curtains" fall down.

You only get one set of keys with this property. At first this appears merely a little inconvenient, but when you realise that you can not leave the property without a key, in the unlikely event of a fire then this is not inconvenient, it's life threatening.

In short this listing is misleading, and the flat is an uncomfortable, impractical, insanitary death trap. With very bad wifi.

reviews[87].comments: Было не трудно найти аппартаменты, заселились сразу по прибытии. В номере было холодно ужасно, батареи слабо грели, а та, что в гостиной вообще не работала, туалет не отапливается вообще. Спасло то, что за время нашего пребывание на улице потеплело, соответственно и в номере тоже. Одеяло одно на двухспальную кровать. Я не против, но кровать, это два матраца на плоду соединённых вместе, тут или нужно ещё сверху класть какой-то общий матрац или класть два одеяла, тк или я, или муж, спали в дырке. В первое утро не было воды от слова совсем, из-за этого пришлось сидеть в номере и ждать когда она пойдёт тк даже зубы было не почистить. Далее проблем с водой не было. Интернет ужасно работал, точнее он почти не работал. До поездки связалась с хозяином что бы уточнить этот вопрос, он заверял, что все проблемы улажены и в крайнем случае есть интернет в кафе рядом. В целом об апартаментах...чисто, один раз убрались и сменили полотенца (мы были 4 ночи), все необходимое есть, в ванной надо бы шторку повесить, близко к центру и не шумно, рядом магазин. reviews[88].comments: Check-in is very easy as the house is located behind the restaurant/bar where Zenka works and waiters are there to help. Nevertheless, you do have your privacy. Both are pretty, safe, very central and share an exiting lifestyle.  Everything is steps away or very nearby; gorgeous parks, mosques, Taksim and the TOP TOURIST ATTRACTIONS.  I'm surrounded by a huge array of cafes, restaurants, shops, bars and live music venues; all this contributes to making Beşiktaş one of the most sort after districts in Istanbul. Yet I live at a quiet and safe street. Witin 1 to 2 min walk: a hospital and pharmacy (at the corner) 3 supermarkets, including the cheapest chain in all of Turkey. The Saturday bazaar/farmer's market with very fresh and some organic products, only 150 meters away.  My street is quiet and with a line of trees. The Bosporus is a short walk away, f
notes: For avid walkers; the walk to TAKSIM trough Maçka park it's wonderful and it only takes about 25 min to reach Tksm. Or if you take the CABLE-CAPSULE ("teleferik") you can cross the park and have a gorgeous view from above and save a few min walk. You could even walk further to GALATA tower within 50 min (20 from Taksim square) and keep going down to Karaköy, only 5 min from Galata and another 10 min to Eminönū to the wonderful Spice bazaar and the Yeni mosque. All together you can walk from home to Eminönū in a bit more than 1 hr.
transit: **There are 3 bus routes that pass by the corner of the flat (130m) They go to TAKSIM, another to EMINÖNŪ (Spice bazaar) Karaköy & Yeni Kapı (very near the Blue mosque). 5 min walk there's the dolmuş (collective taxi) that goes to Taksim  in about 5 min. **Osmanbey metro is 15 min walk. This metro can lead you to Atatūrk airport within one hour with a short-easy change at Yeni Kapı. **Kabataş tram that leaves you at the door of the Blue mosque, Aiğa Sofia,  the spice and Grand Bazaars is 25 min walk or 1 bus ride away from this corner. Optional; taxi to Kabataş in 6 min and costs about €2.5 ** The ferries to Ūskūdar only take 5 minutes to reach ASIA! Or 20 min by luxurious ferry to Kadiköy (only 70 euro cents) From Beşiktaş centre there's another dolmuş to Taksim (5-7 min ride) and a huge selection of buses to go all around and mainly the most beautiful palaces in the city and near the Black Sea at Sarıyer!

reviews[17].comments: Do you want to have one of the best views in Istanbul while enjoying a glass of "cay" (turkish tea)? Is good communication to your host and a warm welcome important to you? My friend and I, both of turkish decent, stayed in this apartment for a week during March (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) Two days before our flight to Istanbuk, Chronis contacted us and gave us thorough information on address and what we should be careful about, like not being too loud with music for the sake of the neighbors. Furthermore he told us, that his assistant Ms. Margarita will welcome us at our arrival, since he was not in Istanbul during that time. He gave us Ms. Margaritas and his phonenumer to contact them upon arrival via phone or (Hidden by Airbnb) Messenger. After our arrival we contacted Ms. Margarita on (Hidden by Airbnb) and told her our approximate time of arrival in front of the apartment. She responded quickly. Upon arrival at the apartment we rang the bell of the flat, which Chronis told us in before and were quickly welcomed by Ms. Margarita. She gave us a very friendly and warm welcome and informed us on everything important about the flat. She had only prepared one bed in the big bedroom, since she assumed we'd be a couple. After having told her, that we need two seperate beds, the quickly prepared the second bed in the small bedroom, without any hesitation. Furthermore she informed us about possible issues like water failures, which is normal in Istanbul during this season, because of heavy rains and a bad water infrastructure. Так что квартиру рекомендую)

neighborhood_overview: Tarlabasi neighborhood was a middle class Greek neighbourhood when it was founded at the beginning of 19th century. The area is full of houses of eclectic Ottoman liberty style buildings and ours is one of them. By the 1950’s most of the greek population of the area had to immigrate to Greece because of political reasons.  The area was deserted and by the 1980’s got an internal immigration from the east part of Turkey mostly of Kurdish origin. In the neighbourhood very few Istanbulite Greeks remained, there is a big Kurdish community of rural origin, a gypsy community that settled down many years ago and work in the area as musicians, many transgender people, poor families from the East and the Balck Sea coast, expats who fell in love with decadent touch and reasonable prices of the area, young artists, old artists, students, and us.  We, in our extent, fell in love with the building and liked the spirit of the area that welcomes all the outsiders of the town. It is the gilded area in

reviews[0].comments: Comment raconter en quelques mots les trois semaines magnifiques passées chez Fatma ! Impossible. La pension est charmante et possède une terrasse très chaleureuse. Fatma est une personne extrèmement intéressante avec qui il faut absolument prendre un café dès quelle le propose (ce qui arrive très souvent !). Elle cuisine merveilleusement. Elle connait Istanbul comme sa poche. La chambre est au dernier étage, elle est calme et douce. Elle a un accès direct sur la terrasse ce qui permet de bouquiner avant d'aller dormir ou de faire un peu de yoga le matin. Le quartier est au coeur de Beyoglu avec une foultitude de restaurants et de bonnes adresses à découvrir. Si vous hésitez encore à réserver, n'hésitez plus ! Quant à moi, je reviendrais le plus vite possible !
reviews[1].comments: Ich bin unheimlich glücklich bei Fatma Abla gestrandet zu sein. Es ist immer was los und selbst wenn mankein türkisch kann,Fatma Abla versucht mit English und Händen und Füßen zu reden. Eine unglaublich sympathische und unterhaltsame Dame, die ich sehr schnell ins Herz geschlossen habe. Sonntags sind wir zusammen zum Bio Bazar gelaufen und an einigen Tagen kochen wir sogar was zusammen.  Mein Zimmer befindet sich im obersten Stock, wo ich komplett meine Ruhe habe. gegenüber von meinem Zimmer ist eine wunderschöne Terasse, die zum Yoga machen oder ein Buch lesen einlädt. Gäste sind auch immer willkommen. Fatma hat ihre eigenen Stil, welches dem ganzen Haus, bis auf den Eingangsbereich, einen unglaublichen charm gibt. Jedes Zimmer ist individuell und man muss sagen, dass bis her die Leute, die ich im Haus kennengelernt habe, echt toll sind. Wenn man sich für Fatma entscheidet, sollte man auf alle Fälle kulturoffen sein und sich diesem schönen antiken Stil und der Nostalgie einfach fallen lassen. Ich bin durch Fatma und durch die Wohnung in einem alten Istanbul angekommen und fühle mich super wohl. Zu meiner Arbeit in Cihangir laufe ich täglich zu Fuß. Die Lage ist sehr perfekt. Ich brauche kaum Bus oder Bahn zu benutzen, da ich alles in Beyoglu und Taksim finde, was ich brauche. Nur für meine Touristentour habe ich lediglich die Bahn benutzt. Obwohl man zum Eminönu auch zu Fuß laufen kann, wenn man spazieren gehen mag. Ich danke Dir, Fatma abla, so wie ich dich gerne zu nennen pflege, für Deine Offenheit und Deine Wärme. Ich werde Dich sehr bald wieder besuchen kommen und hoffentlich sogar mein altes Zimmer beziehen im obersten Stock.
reviews[2].comments: Fatma's home is a perfect place to enjoy Istanbul : peacefull place, independence, located close to main places ... Fatma is nice, and other people staying in Fatma's house so you can meet new people etc\r\nSo I recommend it !
reviews[3].comments:
I stayed with Fatma for many weeks in December 2013, in the attic room on my own, and then with my boyfriend in the larger double room, and had an amazing time. 
The neighbourhood, Tarlabaşı, is different and more down to earth than the posher neighbourhoods around. The location is wonderful: it's easy to get anywhere by foot, taxi, bus, dolmus, metro or boat.
Fatma, who lives there, and her daughter Elvan, who lives in Italy but is quick to communicate by email, are extremely friendly and helpful. 
Fatma also cooks wonderfully and even offers cooking classes. 
I would definitely recommend staying there, for three nights or three months, and hope to stay there again myself.
Be aware though that if you have respiratory issues, this might not be a good choice as there is a fair amount of smoking happening inside, and even the neighbourhood is quite smoky because of the coal heating.
