Il ragazzo che gestiva Mustafa era  gentile e si è scusato più volte per l'inconveniente ...  Posizione ottima
reviews[13].comments:
Very modern and clean room, in an ideal place to visit the incredible city of Istanbul.
Our host was really welcoming and arranged our transfers from and to the airport.
However, room n°3 is in the ground floor, and it was very noisy at night during our stay : trucks starting their engines, people yelling, the entrance door slamming...
But it is a good value for money and we had a good stay.
reviews[14].comments:
Everything was as expected based on the reviews and the original posting. 

If you're sensitive to noise, book one of the higher floors apartment!

The airport transfer was simple (though my name had some creative spelling), and Mustafa was there to greet me and set me up. Provided me with a map and gave me some suggestions. 

It's easy walking distance to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, but it is about 10 minutes and uphill so that's something to keep in mind!
reviews[15].comments: me and my boyfriend had a great time there !the location is super central but in a quite road! the room really clean and in line with the expectation from thr pics! one special word for Moustafa who supported us in every moment with his very super kind attitude! strongly raccomanded!
reviews[16].comments: Such a great little spot in the middle of the Old City! The renovation of the building was very well done, and the room was clean, modern and inviting. You're close to all of Istanbul's best sites like the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia, but you're far enough away from the tourist traps so you can feel like a local. Plus you can take in the city from your very own private rooftop! Mustafa was an excellent, very accommodating and super thoughtful host. He even brought me breakfast the morning I had to leave! I only got to stay there one night, but I would have definitely stayed longer.
reviews[17].comments: Very Pleased with accommodation. Good size room in great location. Mustafa was very friendly and helpful  throughout our stay. Airport transfer very easy. Highly recommend!
reviews[18].comments: Savas made me feel extremely welcome and was very accommodating on my late arrival. Always available to chat and if I had a question. As far as locations in sultahnemet, this spot was fantastic value a perfect walk to the tram, ferries, shops, and restaurants. I would definitely recommend this place! Thanks savas!
reviews[19].comments: The host Mustafa made us feel very welcome. He told us the best places to eat and best ways to get around. The room was clean and comfortable and Mustafa was very accommodating with any requests. The location was excellent and close to all the main tourist sights.
reviews[20].comments:
Stay here. Seriously. Book this room.  It is gorgeous, and perfect, and five minutes to the tourist sites and three blocks from an excellent fish restaurant.  The taxi driver called the number they give you and then drove us straight there without any problem. 

The room is completely new and the bed is comfy and the bathroom is perfect.  Savas' friend met us and gave us keys and showed us which way to walk to get to everything.  The a/c is FANTASTIC and you can sleep very cold if you want. 

There's wifi and cable and towels provided.  There is a little space in the hallway with guidebooks that you can use for sightseeing.  Keypad entry into the building.

I was not expecting this kind of quality in Istanbul.  When I come back, I am staying here. My only complaint would be that the bed was a full size and not a queen, but I sound like a stupid American for even mentioning it.  Plus, we slept like rocks because the bed was so comfortable.
reviews[21].comments: This accommodation was just as the picture shows - fresh with crisp white sheets and modern bathroom facilities. It is in an excellent location, just 5 minutes from all the interesting treasures in the historical part of Istanbul. We were welcomed by Mustafa who was so helpful and friendly. He answered our Istanbul questions, gave us good sightseeing suggestions, organised our laundry, helped us with our luggage - he couldn't have been more obliging. The rooftop area is great with a fabulous view over Sultanhamet to the sea. The address is a bit hard to find the first time but easy once you've become familiar with the neighbourhood. This is a very comfortable place to stay and we really enjoyed our time there.
reviews[22].comments:
Lovely room in excellent location. The only thing is that it's a little bit tricky to find the first time. The address on Airbnb is not complete. Make sure you ask for direction. The street doesn't show correctly on (Hidden by Airbnb) maps. We got lost. 
Mustafa was super helpful. The view from the roof terrace is stunning. Rooms are clean and really well maintained. 
I would stay there again any time. 

E
reviews[23].comments: We stayed only one night in this suite. The room was great and very clean. The bed was also comfortable. The place was easy to found and finds itself in 10 minutes on foot of the Blue Mosque and Saint-Sophie. I strongly recommend this room if you want to live in the district of Sultanahmet.
reviews[24].comments: A 5 to 10 minutes walk away from the main Sultanahmet area, we enjoyed the convenience of staying in the heart of the historic old district, yet away from the touristy crowds. The place was more of a hotel room than an apartment, clean, modern and tastefully decorated. \n\nMustafa (the building manager) was helpful in helping us get orientated with the place and giving travel recommendations and tips.
reviews[25].comments: I needed assistance in finding the suites and Savas gave me the number of his manager, Mustafa, to arrange help in moving both me and my luggage from the hostel I was staying in initially. Mustafa was wonderful - polite, pleasant to chat with, helpful in moving all my luggage, and extremely generous with his time when I asked him innumerable questions. Suite #3 is an extremely pleasant room, well-furnished with excellent lighting and facilities. The neighborhood is low-key - few tourists walk it on a regular basis - but close to all the historic Sultanamet sights as well as the sea, with wonderful restaurants within easy walking distance. I would certainly recommend this suite - and host - to anyone.
reviews[26].comments: A fantastic place to stay in Istanbul. Savas is very kind and helpfull we all the informations about the city. Super fast replay. The rooms are beautiful, clean and fully equipped. A good place to reach all the attractions of the city. Thanks also to Stephan's assistant! Very friendly and pleasant.
reviews[27].comments: 房子的位置非常好,位于伊斯坦布尔旅游区很中心的地方｡天台的风景也很不错｡房间稍微有一点点小,不过也是可以接受的｡
reviews[28].comments: Zeer goede accomodatie op een nog mooiere plek! Midden tussen alle hoogtepunten van prachtig Istanbul. We werden ontvangen door Mustafa met koffie en hij heeft ons meteen mee uit genomen de eerste avond. Super gastvrije kerel die terecht trots is op zijn stad. Turkse gastvrijheid zoals het bedoeld is...
reviews[29].comments: We enjoyed our staying at Savas' Luxury Suite in Sultanhamet. The B&B is really central, close to the main touristic attractions and to many restaurants and café. Savas was very quick in his replies, and his helper, Mustapha, is a reliable and friendly manager. The B&B is clean and well organised.
reviews[30].comments: I spent 5 nights at Savas' place in December; I would say it's essentially a mini-hotel but it really is what it is described as: small comfortable room with wifi and warm water. The thing that impressed me was Mustafa (hope I spelt his name right): didn't get to meet Savas but Mustafa was a great host - had a nice chat over tea with him and he helped to call a cab for my friend and I on one of the days that we needed it. With regard to location it really is a safe place with other hotels in the vicinity, and as said in the description: 5-10min walk to the blue mosque/sultanahmet tram station. Really is a great vantage point for the Old Istanbul area!
reviews[31].comments: magnífica ubicación!
reviews[32].comments: Great place
reviews[33].comments: They were just very very nice people! ( just like all other turkish people we met in Istanbul ) service was excellent and the location cannot be better! Bed was a little unconfortable and some broken things in the room but i am sure they will fix it if you ask. ( we were just too exhausted to tell about it from exploring city )
reviews[34].comments: My girlfriend and I had a 20 hour layover in Istanbul, so decided to stay the night here. The apartment is right in the old district, which is easily accessible via public metro/tram system. Savas gave us the address of his apartment, but without walking directions, it was a little unclear as where to go ( (Hidden by Airbnb) maps wasn't clear). We realized after the fact that there was a map in the photo section of his listing. He gave us the cell number of one of his employees who was going to meet us, but without international cell service, it is tough to use. Once we met the employee, he was very friendly and helpful.\n\nHis apartment was as pictured. The location was perfect: easy access to the big destinations, restaurants and a sweet view from the shared roof space. The space was mostly good. Warm, inviting, and ok wifi. Unfortunately when we settled into the bed, we discovered that the sheets hadn't been washed. There was no top sheet, and the bottom sheet had hair on it. Not what we were hoping to find. It was late, so we just slept on the blanket. We also found some of the molding in the bathroom to be breaking off as well. For the price, we expected a little nicer facilities.
reviews[35].comments: Our host was very nice and helpful. Room was like in the pictures and also clean. It was very close to Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque in the Sultanahmet area (10min on foot) but the neighbourhood was apart from the crowd and noise of Sultanahmet area. The mansion had also a nice terrace on the rooftop with a magnificent view of the sea and also of the Blue Mosque.
reviews[36].comments: Great location. My second visit at this AirBnb. The airport transfers were on time and much more enjoyable than a taxi ride.
reviews[37].comments: What a nice experience from beginning to end. Although we didn't meet Savas, he was very quick to response. Mustafa and his friend were very welcoming hosts and pleasure to deal with. They gave us good recommendations about sights, restaurants etc. The location was great. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for our 5 night stay. We had a little problem with the shower but upon contacting Savas, the problem was dealt with immediately. We had a great time in Istanbul and would definitely stay at Savas apartment again. I recommend staying here to everyone!
reviews[38].comments: We stayed 4 nights.  Perfect location, size and amenities for our stay.  Everything we wanted to see and do was a short walk (250m), or a few tram/train stops away.  Communication was great.  We used the offer of transfers from airport, but would use public transport next time.  We arrived early morning and left our luggage at the apartment building while we explored - it was safe.  Plenty of eating choices in the area.  Train station nearby was closed for renovations (April 2015) but the tram was not too far anyway.  Highly recommend to visit the Bascillica Cistern and walk Istiklal Cadessi (from Taksim Square downhill).  If you want to experience an authentic Turkish Bath without the tourist price, catch a tram to Yusufpasa Tram Stop, find the other side of the main road past Aksaray Train St., wander up Sofula Cadessi, under the bridge and Sofula Hamam is on your right - the best (55TL + tip).  Thanks Savas & Istanbul for a great holiday.  We would definitely stay there again.
reviews[39].comments: We were very happy with our accommodation in Istanbul. Our room was comfortable, modern and clean giving no reason for any complaint. The location of the house is perfect! Absolutely recommended!
reviews[40].comments: Great room, it was exactly as pictured. Excellent location, impeccably clean. Everyone that we met was kind and they let us store their luggage there for the entire day while we wandered town, waiting to depart Istanbul via night bus. One problem was that there are children who live across the street who yell and scream and generally have a lot of fun all day and into the evening, and sometimes people stop and have loud conversations just outside. As the room is on the ground floor, it was quite loud, which was surprising given it's tucked away location. The building seemed to have a number of other rooms, as well, so if we were to go back we'd love to stay at the same place, just a room on a higher floor.
reviews[41].comments: As described in the listing. Amazing location, clean, and convenient. I would definitely stay here again. Savas and others were very responsive and easy to get a hold of by phone to help our driver find the address.
reviews[42].comments: Clean, modern, and perfectly located for sightseeing in Sultanahmet! We had Savas arrange transit for us from the airport, which went perfectly and is highly recommended. Mustafa, the building manager who met us upon arrival, was a joy and a wealth of information. Recommended!!
reviews[43].comments: We extended our stay at Savas' beautiful apartment and everything went perfectly! Thank you!
reviews[44].comments: it was a nice apartment near the old city center. the room is clean and the hosts are really helpful and they showed me around the city for the first day. there is also a patio where you can get nice view of the sea. the only pitfall is that the bathroom is a little bit small and the toilet doesn't work quite well
reviews[45].comments: Comfortable lodging in the old city, in a converted and renovated house with 5 hotel style rooms. Modern facilities, very nice rooftop terrace. Lively neighborhood,  somewhat noisy at night. Our issues with the bathroom were quickly addressed after contacting Savas, and we had a pleasant stay.
reviews[46].comments:
Our stay at the suite was perfect. The location is amazing, easy to reach and close to all the major attractions.
Sadly, we did not get the chance to meet Savas because he was out of town but we were received by Mustapha. He was very nice. Had a really interesting conversation with him and even offered to take us around the city center.
The apartment itself is well furnished, clean and cosy!
The best part was the rooftop and its view. We just couldn't keep ourselves from spending at least a couple of hours, up there, every night.
Will definitely recommend it!
reviews[47].comments: We spent four nights in this perfectly located flat and we really enjoyed our stay in Istanbul. Mustafa was here to make our stay perfect, responding to every demands we had. The terrace with view on Blue Mosque is just amazing. We will come back with pleasure. Enjoy!
reviews[48].comments: We never met the host but a wonderful young man named Mustafa who was really helpful and even though our flight was 1.5 hours late he still met us and had a great attitude. The room was pretty much what you see in the picture, minus some of the decorative items. The hotel/ guesthouse is in an alley-way in the old part of city which was a bit odd but the view looked at the Blue Mosque and the Hagia Sofia on one side and the sea on the other. We could walk to our tour and there was a lot of places within a 10-15 minute walk. The down side to the location was that outside was a bit noisy and to no fault of their own, there was a wedding one of the nights and it was super loud as the walls are thin.\r\nOne of the best things in the roof top. A great place for the value in the right location.
reviews[49].comments: Good place to stay. Beautiful view on the rooftop. Nice room, very clean and large shower.
reviews[50].comments: The flat was perfectly located in Sultanahmet in a charming residential area. Only 10 minutes walk from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. \r\n\r\nThe room was perfectly clean and modern with an en-suite bathroom, TV and fridge. The best part of the flat was the terrace on the top floor of the building with a great view of Istanbul!
reviews[51].comments: We really enjoyed our stay in Istanbul. The apartment was clean and well furnished, and the best part is definitely the roof and its splendid view. I definitely recommend this location. Thanks
reviews[52].comments: We didn't actually meet Savas, but we had a lovely young man called Mustafa help settle us in :) Both gentlemen answered all our questions promptly, and made us feel extremely welcome and comfortable. The room was clean, and the house was in a really central area- very close to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, and plenty of other historical attractions. The only downside was that there was no cooking facilities- just a basic area where we could make tea and coffee. \r\nOther than that, it was a fantastic experience, and we would definitely stay there again if we are ever in Istanbul :)
reviews[53].comments: Thank you very much for our lovely stay. We loved the clean room and the kind help by Mustafa and the driver who was so nice. Loved the terrace  and the friendly neighborhood.
reviews[54].comments: Wie booked the appartement for 1 week and also the transport from the Airport from  Savas. We didn't met Savaş but Mustafa welcomed us very friendly at the appartemend and helped us during the whole stay if we had any questions. The room was exactly like on the pictures, the view at the rooftop is beautyful. It's the perfect place to discover  the great City Istanbul.
reviews[55].comments:
호스트는 저에게 자신의 전화번호와 집 전화번호를 모두 알려주었습니다. 또한 숙소 도착 전에 알아야 할 것들을 미리 메신저를 통해서 친절하고 체계적으로 전달해주었습니다. 저는 구글맵을 이용해 숙소를 찾아갔는데, 호스트가 알려준 주소는 정확했지만, 구글맵에 터키의 지도가 완벽하게 업데이트 되어 있는 것이 아니라서 숙소 근처까지 가서 정작 숙소를 찾지 못해 다소 곤란을 겪었습니다. 이때 호스트의 집으로 전화를 걸어 호스트의 아버지 되시는 분으로부터 필요한 정보를 추가적으로 얻을 수 있었습니다. 호스트와 호스트의 아버지 모두 영어를 하기 때문에 소통이 원활했습니다.

게다가 호스트는 여행 전부터 제가 여행 계획이나 이동 경로에 대해 조언을 구하면 친절하고 빠르게 답변해주었습니다. 덕분에 안심하고 제 계획을 따라 여행을 할 수 있었습니다.

숙소는 구시가지의 아야소피아와 술탄아흐멧 사원으로부터 도보 5분 정도 거리에 있습니다. 평균적인 체력을 가진 사람이라면 숙소로부터 이스탄불의 다른 관광 명소들로 이동하는 데 전혀 무리를 느끼지 않을 것입니다. 숙소 근처에는 상점가와 시장이 있어 간단한 음식이나 과일을 사는 것이 편리합니다. 그러면서도 주택가에 있기 때문에 상점가의 번잡함이 느껴지지는 않습니다. 숙소 건너편 주택에서 종종 파티를 열거나 아이들이 뛰어다녀서 아주 조용하지는 않지만, 평범한 주택가의 소음 정도를 벗어나지 않습니다.

숙소 설명은 정확했으며, 설명된 대로 화장실이 포함되어 있는 방 한 칸입니다. 시설은 말끔하고 침대와 화장실의 상태도 좋습니다. 변기를 사용할 때에는 버튼 두 개를 동시에 눌러야 물이 잘 내려갑니다. 처음에는 방법을 몰라서 물이 잘 내려가지 않는 줄 알고 걱정했지만, 이내 사용법을 알게 되었습니다. 청소 상태도 좋고, 에어컨 성능도 매우 좋습니다. 숙소 벽에 걸린 커다란 거울도 매우 편리하게 사용했습니다.

단, 저희가 도착했을 때 침대에 이불이 없어서 가지고 간 담요를 사용해야만 했습니다. 청소를 해주셨던 분의 실수인지, 아니면 원래 제공되지 않는 것인지는 잘 모르겠습니다. 다행히 터키의 여름 날씨가 매우 더워 이불이 크게 필요하지는 않았지만, 그래도 여분의 이불이 있다면 좋을 것 같습니다.

체크아웃 이후에도 숙소 로비에 짐을 두고 나갔다 돌아올 수 있습니다. 로비에 관리인이 없어 조금 걱정했지만, 안쪽에 가방을 잘 두면 의도적으로 누가 알고 가방을 함부로 가져가지 않는 이상 크게 걱정할 필요는 없을 것 같습니다.

숙소로 들어가는 대문은 열쇠로 열거나 번호키를 이용해서 열 수 있습니다. 보안 상태 역시 양호하다는 생각이 들었습니다.

위치 면에서나 위생적인 측면에서 전반적으로 매우 좋은 숙소라고 생각했으며, 이스탄불에 여행 가는 친구에게 추천할 수 있을 정도로 마음에 들었습니다. 편안하고 깨끗한 숙소 덕분에 이스탄불 여행이 더욱 즐거웠습니다.
reviews[56].comments: This was a reasonable room in a beautiful and convenient part of town. While we would have preferred a few more square feet and space to stow things, what was there was lovely and well kept. Unfortunately the toilet flusher persisted in having mechanical issues and while they serviced it the first time promptly, the second time they didn't come at all and we resorted to several days of pouring water bottles down the toilet to flush it. The hosts are generally responsive and helpful, keeping the roof terrace quite nice. If you're hypersensitive to smoke, don't stay in room 3 because when folks smoke outside it wafts in under the door and pollutes the room. It's also a little noisy some nights, but not overtly so.
reviews[57].comments: The room is very nice and clean. There is everything you could need. The location is fantastic because it is located just 5 minutes walk from the Blue Mosque and Aya Sofia. Mustafa was very kind and friendly and helped us in our demands. Highly recommended!
reviews[58].comments: Best place for sightseeing in Istanbul! The apartment is located 5 minutes walk from the Blue Mosque, other attractions also near by. And you have evrething you need down the street, stores, restaurants, souvenir shops. The apartment is nice and clean. There is also a roof terrace, which offers amazing views and a small kitchen in the vicinity.  Separately, it should be noted the hosts Savas and Mustafa. They work very professionally and efficiently. Always ready to help and answer questions.\r\np.s Mustafa makes an excellent Turkish coffee!
reviews[59].comments: Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Mustapha, qui nous a servi un café turque dès notre arrivée. Nous n'avons été en contact qu'avec lui pendant le séjour et il a toujours été très agréable et disponible. Un super toit terrasse avec une vue imprenable sur la mer de Marmara et sur le Bosphore. Seul petit hic, l'appart donne sur la rue et c'est très bruyant le soir.
reviews[60].comments: Lovely simple appartment and perfectly located next to all the main sites. A warm welcome and would visit again.
reviews[61].comments: lovely house , good location and great host
reviews[62].comments: We stayed 6 wonderful Istanbul days in this perfectly located appartment with a stunning roof top terrace. Our host Mustafa was waiting for us the night we arrived (pretty late); he even asked us on our way to the appartment if we needed any help in finding the place. We felt welcome immediately. \r\nOur room was perfect for a city trip: good bed to rest after a long day acting as a tourist and a good shower (although you certainly have to do the hamam experience!). We made our own breakfast in the communal kitchen and consumed it 'with a view'. Early evening, it's a great place for a drink and a read or for just enjoying the view.\r\nIf you like to stay very close to the old town (Sultanahmet), but without the hassle and noise of a city... go here!
reviews[63].comments:
Exactly as described. Lovely room, fridge, air con, very clean and great shower! 
There are more suites in the building and there are tea/coffee amenities on the top floor near the roof terrace.

We didn't get to meet Savas but his colleague Mustafa was very welcoming and set everything up in terms of airport transfers, local knowledge. Sultanahmet is a great place to stay if you are looking for a slightly quieter area (compared with Beyoglu and Galatasaray)
5 minutes walks from the Blue Mosque which you can see from the roof terrace. there is also the main street which is full of great bars, cafes and restaurants. 
wo minutes walk to the port where all the ferries depart for Bosphorus ferry trips.
We couldn't fault our stay at the apartment. Highly recommended
10/10
reviews[64].comments: Die Unterkunft ist schön, sauber und die Lage ist sehr gut (viele Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß zu erreichen). Die Gegend ist eher ruhig, auch wenn das Haus an sich ein wenig hellhörig ist. Absoluter Pluspunkt ist die wunderschöne Dachterrasse. Unser Gastgeber war zwar leider weder beim Check-In noch beim Check-out anwesend, er hat sich aber zwischendurch gemeldet und uns sehr gute Restaurant- Tipps gegeben.\r\n
reviews[65].comments: Fantastic place in a great location. Easy to book and find. The real gem of the place is Mustafa - he helped us with directions, showed us into the apartment, and kept top-notch recommendations for Istanbul's many great spots flowing throughout the weekend! Thank you Mustafa - highly recommend this place!
reviews[66].comments: Great position close to the Blue Mosque, perfect small room, typical building and a breathtaking view from the roof...Mustafa is a nice guy very kind and he does a good Turkish coffee! Only thing: room 3 is ground floor and from the street come some noise: better ask highest floors.
reviews[67].comments: An ATTRACTIVE place in an ATTRACTIVE location at an ATTRACTIVE price. Very comfy bed (2 pillows). A large room with modern ensuite, small 'frig, TV with many stations, central heating and air con.  Great open roof terrace. Good price, and friendly greeter/fixer Mustafa.\r\n\r\nRoom is in a block of 6 or so assumedly similar rooms. Not a self contained APARTMENT, & nice but not luxury per se.  Washing machine, elec jug, large bar 'frig, small micro wave, 4 plates & bowls, cutlery, cups & glasses, free tea/coffee in shared utility room adjacent to terrace 3 floors up. Tables & chairs only on open terrace. No pots, pans, hot plate or oven.  A fold up is the only clothes drier.
reviews[68].comments:
I was in Istanbul only for 3 nights and stayed at Luxury Suites owned and operated by Mr. Savas. Everything was perfect with the apartment. Very clean, internet worked great. No ever bothered me and it located only couple blocks from all main attractions in old Istanbul. It's a very safe area. I was coming back to the apartment quite late at night and I never felt unsafe walking the streets to get there. 

The apartment has a very nice terrace with a great view of the city and the mediterranean. They also have a little kitchen with coffee and tea, and dishes for you to prepare some light meals. You have access to it 24/7.

It's a highly recommend apartment and very inexpensive. I will definitely stay there again.

I did not meet Mr. Savas only Mustafa who I saw the very last day but I did not need him at all, since everything was fine and working perfectly.

If you ever visit Istanbul and want to stay in a great, comfortable and inexpensive apartment just meters away from main attraction, look no further, stay in this beautiful suite.
reviews[69].comments: A nice room with an excellent location. Less than a 10min walk to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. Local restaurants are great too.\nMustafa who is the point of contact is friendly and useful.
reviews[70].comments:
Location is near the blue mosque but still spend some effort to find it.
Room is clean and everything daily necessary are ready.
The manager Mustafa helps me a lot.
The top floor can also enjoy good view to the city.
reviews[71].comments: Very lovely area, safe to walk to town. Breathtaking rooftop balcony with a view of water and Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. We were only there for a one night layover. Would have loved to stay longer. The room was very nice and comfortable. Mustafa was very welcoming and helpful. I requested transportation to and from Airport and Savas hired a taxi, so all we had to do was get off our plane. Everything was wonderful and took the stress away, so we could just enjoy every moment in beautiful Istanbul!
reviews[72].comments: Mustafa went out of his way, literally to meet me on way from airport. Lovely man and most helpful.\r\nsadly, however, as a high user of Airbnb, I had a different experience to many of the other clients. the area is VERY noisy... kins and teenagers on the streets late at night, playing loud music on ghetto blaster on Saturday night, about 10-14 teens I think... I begged them twice to quieten down and had to get out of bed twice and go out to them.... same thing on Monday night, when a local man walking a dog chased them. also alot of cars and vans coming and going until maybe 1am at weekend. I understand, the kids have no playground, so this is where they meet and play... not their fault.... but do not say quiet area when it is not.\r\nbedroom fine.... but if you wish to sleep, I suggest maybe somewhere else. Clean , tidy, and adequate. One thing though, I paid €184 for three nights, incl cleaning and fees.. much better and cheaper hotels in the area, so Savas might need to rethink his prices... lovely hotel, with breakfast €40 about 100m and very quiet.. many others similar.
reviews[73].comments: I stayed at Seba's place for 3 nights while in Istanbul. The room is comfy and very well located. If you're looking to spend a long time in the room, I wouldn't recommend it, but if you just need it to sleep then it's perfect! Sevas was very nice and he would answer right away to anything.
reviews[74].comments:
We met with the the local contact, Mustafa, who took good care of us. Mustafa offered to make us tea and coffee. He's friendly and easy to get along with.

After some initial confusion about the location (I recommend you have Mustafa's phone number handy), Mustafa showed us around the nice property. The views are stunning from the rooftop -- even better at night.

Our suite was on the ground level facing the street. While there was some initial noise from neighbors speaking outside, no noise was heard when we went to sleep.
reviews[75].comments:
We stayed two nights in Istanbul. This amount of time was enough for us to feel like we experienced everything we wanted to do / see. 
The apartment is comfortable and features the basic essentials - bed, shower, toilet. There's a terrace 3 or so flights of stairs, it was too cold to really sit and enjoy. 
The apartment itself certainly isn't 'luxury' in any form of the word but we were fine with that. 
Location wise, we got a airport transfer organised by Mustafa and it was a lot more expensive than any other private shuttle company you could find by a (Hidden by Airbnb) search but for simplicity we opted to go this way. 
If you're on a budget look for alternatives. 

The place is located in the Old Town, it's quite a trek to get anywhere. I do strongly recommend if you book this place you go to Tria Terrace Restaurant for the best meal we had in Turkey - short walking distance from apartment.

We would walk to Grand Bazaar and it would take 30 mins or to Galata and it would take 1 hr - fine for us because we're active people and enjoyed the walk but for those not up for lots of walking and don't want to get cabs everywhere then consider somewhere else. 

We didn't get to meet Mustafa directly but he was helpful with any correspondence via messages sent.
reviews[77].comments: We spent two nights at this place, and it was good. Nice cozy room, very close to the city center, and absolutely wonderful patio with a sea sight. Minor negative things: there was dark in the room, the shower was leaking, and we could not find a warm blanket. But it was not serious for us.
reviews[78].comments: Amazing view from the rooftop of Bosphorus, Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Great hosts and clean rooms, perfect
reviews[79].comments: Güzel bir daire, turistik mekanlara çok yakın mesafede. Teras manzarası Haliç'i bir taraftan, Sultanahmet'i diğer taraftan görüyor. Telefonla görüştüğümüzde oldukça yardımcı oldular.
reviews[80].comments: Savaş ve mustafa beyler çok ilgili ve yardımseverlerdi. Ev genel olarak temiz, iyi aynı belirtildiği gibiydi. Tavsiye ederim. Mr. Savas and Mr. Mustafa were very helpful and very kind. The house is generally clean, good for stay. I recommend all of you.
reviews[81].comments: Une super expérience et un logement propre et proche de toutes les commodités. Ayasofia et la Mosquée Bleue sont juste à côté, alors que la place Taksim est à quelques stations de tram. À recommander.
reviews[82].comments: The apartment was very nice, modern, and located in the center of the Sultanahmet neighborhood. The staff person who helped us get into the apartment, Mustafa, was also really helpful - he gave some good recommendations for restaurants and called us a cab to get to the airport. The roof top patio had amazing views of the bay and the neighborhood. If you are in Istanbul as a tourist, staying in this neighborhood is a great idea because everything you need to see is in walking distance.
reviews[83].comments: Savas/Mustafa was very helpful and quick to respond to messages. He organized transfers to/from the airport and our arrival & departure were very smooth.  The apartment was fine if you don't plan to spend much time there - I wouldn't describe it as "luxury" but it has all the necessities and is close walking distance to the attractions as listed.
reviews[84].comments: Mustafa (Friend of Savas) was very helpful, he explained all the interesting places I should visit, ordered me a taxi at the last day. Savas apparment is really close to historical center. And the view from terassa was amazing. The appartment was comfortable and cozy. Definitelly would stay here next time and recommend to any of my friends.
reviews[85].comments: The room was ready we did not see our host but received a message about how to get in. This is convenient to all important Sultanhet sites so we were quite happy.
reviews[86].comments: Savas friend Mustafa warm welcome made us feel right at home. The room we had on the lower floor was close to the street where families hangout till around 20:00 some boys played football which was interesting for us to hear. The room is bright and modern with aircon and with little fridge however no kitchen which we expected. There is a comunity kitchen shared on the top floor but no cooking facility. All in all good experience and Mustafa took the time to show us everything and gave us good tips etc.
reviews[87].comments: Had a great time in Savas' place. The building manager, Mustafa, was friendly and helpful in arranging transportation to and from the airport. Check in and out was simple. The lodging was exactly as expected - close to the square and updated and clean. Rooftop terrace had great views of the bay and the mosques.
reviews[88].comments: Sava's place is clean, comfortable and well- located. He was helpful and allowed us to leave our luggage the last day so we could continue sightseeing. Would stay here again.
reviews[89].comments: An amazing experience hosted by great hospitality.
reviews[91].comments: Sava's place was amazing. The room was really clean and quite. The top view was amazing, especially during night times. The location is a centric and easily accessible. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely stay again. They were also helpful in accommodating my luggage storage. Thank you
reviews[92].comments:
Contrairement à ce qu'on peut croire sur les photos, la chambre se situe en rez-de-chaussée, donnant sur une rue fréquentée jusque tard dans la nuit.... Et il n'y a pas de terrasse 

Pas de drap non plus 

De plus, quand je suis revenue dans ma chambre le deuxième soir, quelqu un y était entré car la télévision était en marche ...j'ai d'abord cru que quelqu un était venu faire le ménage ( je ne pensais pas que c était prévu mais bon, j'avais peut être mal compris) mais le ménage n'avait pas été fait 


Bref, basique et un peu décevant 

Le quartier en revanche est très bien
reviews[93].comments: The location is very good if you want to be in the touristic area. Mustafa was very kind with us answer our questions and waiting for us.\nWe thought that the room include the terrace as the picture, but not. A little noisy in the weekend nigth.
reviews[94].comments: Mustafa was very helpful and communicative during the entire stay. Close to lots of restaurants and shops. Would stay here again!
reviews[95].comments:
Very good location in the old part of Istanbul, barely 5 minutes from sultanahmet and the square in front of Blue mosque and Aya Sofia. 

The house is nice - though its more like a hotel rather than an apartment (individual kitchenette or utensils are limted in the room, have to go all the way up with the stairs for the kitchen).

However if you can ignore that everything else is good. Special mention for Mustafa who was very helpful also shared a lot of good local shops to eat and places to see.

would surely recommend the place for the price.

regards
Saptarshi
reviews[96].comments: I arrived very late and they were able to help me by picking me up at the airport and bringing me directly to the room. The room was in a very convenient place for everything. I was able to walk everywhere I needed to be. If you want to immerse yourself with the Istanbul society, this is your place. Very clean and comfortable.
reviews[97].comments: The apartment was great. I enjoyed my stay. Looking forward to stay in it again
reviews[98].comments: All good location, ground floor so a bit noisy but it's a quiet area so not too bad
reviews[99].comments: das Appartment liegt ideal in der Nähe der blauen Moschee und Hagia Sophia. Mustafa hat uns super betreut und Tipps gegeben. das kleine aber feine Zimmer ist mit allem wichtigen ausgestattet. die Dachterrasse ist zur allgemeinen Nutzung.
reviews[100].comments: We highly recommend this wonderful place to stay. Mustafa met us and gave us a great introduction to the apartment. He gave us many suggestions on restaurants to eat at. The apartment is extremely clean with a comfortable bed. There is a mini fridge in the room. The bathroom is small but it works perfect with plenty of hot water. Just  around the corner we ate our Turkish breakfast at a little cafe with a super nice owner. It is also a great place to have a glass of wine. Istanbul itself was a fabulous stay and I encourage all people to visit - don't let the media scare you away. We are so happy we went.
reviews[101].comments: Great apartment, very close to the tourist points. The terrace and the kitchen were very handy. Mustafa helped us with any questions and helped us organize a taxi to the airport. I recommend this place to everyone visiting Istanbul
reviews[102].comments: Местоположение отличное, все рядом, Мустафа очень гостеприимный, проинструктировал, дал рекомендации по интересным местам. Терраса на крыше очень располагает к душевным завтракам и ужинам!)
reviews[103].comments: 没预想的好,倒是还是很实惠,地理位置超棒,楼顶超级棒,但是我们住的是一楼,所以有一些小虫子,开窗透气也不是很方便｡
reviews[104].comments: Sava's place was great. A fantastic location near very touristic places but close to transport to get to other places. He was super helpful and answered all the questions we had.
reviews[105].comments:
My wife and I were very excited to stay at this wonderful little spot in Istanbul. Our host was incredibly gracious. Since we don't speak Turkish, he spoke to our taxi driver over the phone to give directions from the airport and greeted us when we arrived. The room was cozy, but very welcoming, and the rooftop has an incredible breathtaking view of the Sea of Marmara and the nearby mosques.

We had a great night walking around the cobbled streets, eating musakka, sampling Turkish delights, and drinking salep! The location is a 15 minute walk from many great spots to visit (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, etc), and there is a great coffee shop downstairs with WiFi where we sat and worked and had Türk Khavesi (Turkish coffee) and çay (tea).

We would definitely recommend this spot to travelers looking for an affordable spot with easy access to the sights and sounds of Istanbul.
reviews[106].comments: Great spot! Definitely has more of a hotel feel than most Airbnbs... But that suited my needs perfectly. Excellent value and location.
reviews[107].comments: La casa muy buena, limpia y la terraza con buenas vistas. El anfitrion muy servicial, ayuda con todo y esta en contacto contigo si fuese necesario.\r\nLo menos bueno es que en mi opinion esta un poco alejado (5minutos a pie de la mezquita azul). No es mucho pero de la parte de Galata esta lejos.
reviews[109].comments: I came to Istanbul for 5 nights in December. Our flight arrived very late, but a late check in was not a problem at all. This place has the best location and it was also very easy to find. Room was very clean and cozy. Heat and shower also worked very well. All in all, Savas's place is more like a tiny hotel, than a local apartment, but very lovely in any way. Would visit again anytime. :-)
reviews[110].comments: The place is small, but really all a single traveler needs. It would be cramped for a traveling couple. I found it a little small even for myself, but open the window and you forget about that. I was in room #3 which is at ground level. Bring your Apple TV, iPad, and/or HDMI cable. There is a TV, but I could not get it to work. The internet is decent. For some strange reason the electricity in the city went out for several hours. This was no fault of Mustafa's though. Just beware when traveling to Turkey! The place is really clean, and the bed is comfortable!!!! Enjoy! I recommend it.
reviews[111].comments: Замечательное расположение аппартаментов в историческом центре. Постоянная связь хозяев и их коллег по поводу заселения. Отличный вид на Босфор с крыши.
reviews[112].comments: The location was great for exploring the city- only about a 5 min walk to Aya Sofia and the Topkapi Palace, very easy to find as Savas directions were great. Lots of local bars and restaurants within an easy walk. Just be aware that the kitchen is shared with the other guests - which was never a problem. We were there in January and it was a lovely warm place to retreat back to out of the snow.
reviews[113].comments: Mustafa is nice and friendly. He even ordered a taxi for me early in the morning.
reviews[114].comments: 房东很热心,积极为你解决问题｡这位置附近有相当多的旅馆,在淡季其实无需预订,可以直接过来一家一家挑选｡\n这家非常干净整洁,公共区域有洗衣机､烧水机､咖啡机,有各种杯子和红茶､土耳其咖啡,你可以好好利用它们,悠闲地在屋顶上看海上日出｡
reviews[115].comments: Its a great location, close to main attraction. Tram station is walkable, grocery shop is next door and the place is clean, cozy and warm.
reviews[116].comments: Location is very good, close to all place for tourist. Easy contact to the host and get answer fast. Strong recommend!
reviews[117].comments: I didn't get a chance to meet Savas but Mustafa greeted us and was fantastic! Really helpful, sent me all sorts of suggestions for places to visit and eat. The room was super clean, spacious and comfortable. Would definitely stay again  - thanks!
reviews[118].comments: It was a great location and there is great food around.
reviews[119].comments: Great location. Mustafa is the best host! He made sure we would be able to find the place, then gave us tips and recommendations how/where to go. Highly recommended!
reviews[120].comments:
perfect!
Although it takes a little time to get the room from the tram station, Sultanahumet, very good apartment it was!!!
他の皆さんのﾚﾋﾞｭｰ通り､本当にとても良い部屋､良いﾎｽﾄです!!
近隣のお店の方々もとてもﾌﾚﾝﾄﾞﾘｰで､安心してｳﾛｳﾛできます｡
屋上の景色は写真通り本当に美しくて､反対側のごちゃごちゃした景色もｼﾞﾌﾞﾘｱﾆﾒに出てきそうな雰囲気で私はとても好きです｡
料理ができるｷｯﾁﾝはありませんが､ｸﾞﾗｽ等の食器､ﾎﾟｯﾄ､ﾁｬｲはあります｡
#3は1階なので､重い荷物のある場合でも楽でした｡
部屋は9~10帖ぐらいの広さかな｡広いとは言えないけれどｽｰﾂｹｰｽ2個広げられるｽﾍﾟｰｽは十分あります｡冷蔵庫もあり､ｺﾝﾊﾟｸﾄで無駄がなく過ごしやすい部屋でした｡
とにかく､ﾎｽﾄ､立地､部屋､周辺環境､その他いろいろ含め､ｺｽﾄﾊﾟﾌｫｰﾏﾝｽがめっちゃ高い部屋でした｡絶対おすすめです!!!
reviews[121].comments: Clean room. Good communication with hosts.
reviews[123].comments: Sava's place was great. It's nearby the coastline and walking distance from shops, places to dine, mosques and more. We were in Istanbul for a 16 hour layover and the location allowed us to see many things within a short time frame. The room itself was clean and comfy. Thank you!
reviews[124].comments: Perfect place to stay, safe, clean, close to all the sights. I watched the sunrise from the roof terrace! Will stay here again
reviews[125].comments: Savas' place is situated near the most frequented historic sites of Istambul, still it is quiet. There is a highly rated fish restaurant 50ms from the place, which we enjoyed twice during our 5-day stay. The view of the city and the Marble sea is spectacular from the roof terrace. And you can't miss the muezzines' call to the five daily prayers even if you wanted to. But hey, you are in Istanbul!
reviews[126].comments: The place is in a great location, 10 min from Hagia Sofia and the Blue Mosque. Savas arranged transit for me from and to the airport. A warm greeting with a cup of Turkish coffee on the roof top terrace upon arrival. Will definitely stay there again!
reviews[127].comments: Very nice view and the host is friendly. Also there's all the stuff you might need during the travel.
reviews[128].comments: Great location and clean. I would definitely go back again!
reviews[129].comments: A great base from which to explore an incredible city!  Make sure you head up to the roof terrace
reviews[130].comments: Great location very close to Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Savas was very friendly and communicative and the check in was perfect even though we arrived late at night. I would recommend.
reviews[131].comments: Lovely place, with a very nice terrace with great views. Excellent location, 5 minutes walking from Hagya Sophia. If I come back to Istanbul, I would repeat and I recommend it! The landlord was very helpful and flexible!
reviews[132].comments: So weit so gut, \nder Lärm war schon störend (EG Zimmer). Gastgeber hat aber alles getan um uns zufrieden zustellen. \nDas Bett war eine Zumutung und auf meine Beschwerde hin wurde es sofort ausgetauscht.
reviews[134].comments: A really nice room, clean and well maintained with a very nice bathroom. A little noisy being on the ground floor, but not a problem. Nice shared roof terrace with a great view. Location is good, a few minutes walk to the seafront and 5 mins walk to restaurants and bars.
reviews[135].comments: The description of the apartment is quite deceptive. The apartment is far behind of what could be possible called luxurious.
reviews[136].comments: I only spend 24h in Istanbul.\nThe room was very clean and close to the great mosques. The neighborhood is really nice and the view on the roof is very beautiful.
reviews[137].comments: Very clean room and balcony has insane views. However from the pictures I assumed the balcony was part of the room however it was for all guests' uses. Very good location, close to the mosques and the square.
reviews[138].comments: Savas' place is exactly as described. It is in an excellent location, very clean, and the rooftop view is awesome. We were even allowed to keep our bags in the room for a while after we checked out so that we could pick up later before our flight. I recommend this place if you are visiting for a few days and plan to see lots of the sights in Sultanahmet.
reviews[139].comments: After what seemed a long ride from the airport, I was dropped off at the location. I was welcomed and shown  the room. The room was perfect. At first I thought I was in the middle of nowhere when I started walking, then I turned a corner and realized I was blocks from everything I wanted to see, the bazaar, the mosques, the old city. Turkey is beautiful and the people very friendly.
reviews[140].comments: Nice and clean apartment in a decent location.
reviews[142].comments: Хорошая комната прямо в историческом центре города (около 8 минут пешком до Голубой мечети, недалеко от набережной). Качественный ремонт, мебель. Великолепный панорамный вид с террасы на Босфор и мечети. Комната была на первом этаже и вечером иногда были слышны разговоры людей на улице, так что рекомендую захватить беруши, чтобы выспаться.
reviews[143].comments: Good location and cheap, however this is not a full flat as advertised and is little more than a room. There is access to a coffee machine and the balcony, but they are shared. Also, the bedding had stains on it which we weren't too impressed with. For the price, it was ok, but the description is misleading as this certainly isn't "luxury".
reviews[144].comments: This was my second stay at Savas's place. I love the location and the staff is very friendly. Highly recommended!
reviews[145].comments: Clean, close to central tourist area, close to the water. 5 minute walk to Sultanahmet metro station. Beautiful terrace.
reviews[146].comments: Savas is very nice, he help us in everything
reviews[147].comments: Amazing place, clean and modern and with classic touch. The host communication is outstanding and very helpful. Definitely recommend this place for those who's looking explore the main landscapes of Istanbul.
reviews[149].comments: Savas's place i great. Clean and comfortable. It is very near to sultanahmet area too. Very walkable. The rooftop balcony is super nice. The view is great. Can see blue mosque and hagia sofea from there. Thanks for the experience. I highly recommend this place :)
reviews[150].comments: 5 stars. The apartment was easy to find, close to everything, and host was extremely helpful. Would stay again.
reviews[151].comments: Savas building is simple, clean and great if you're staying in Istanbul for 3-5 days. It's located in a cozy and quiet neighborhood which we really enjoyed. There were tons of restaurants in a short walking distance which was helpful in the morning and evening. The roof deck view exceeded my expectations and it was very relaxing to spend time up there in the evening (and during the day). If you are just looking for a place to rest your head and shower, this is the spot. There is a washing machine and a small kitchen, but I would say the roof deck is the real treasure.
reviews[152].comments: The location of Savas's place is perfect- a short walk from the water, major attractions, good restaurants, and public transportation. The building has a small kitchen on the top floor and a terrace with beautiful views. The room was clean and well-equipped. \n\nI didn't meet Savas, but he was very responsive through messages. I did meet the housekeeper, Lale, who was very sweet and welcoming. I would definitely stay here again!
reviews[153].comments: My stay was great, the place was clean, quite and comfortable, Savas was very friendly and it was very easy to communicate with him, the check in was quite easy and straightforward as Savas was waiting for my arrival.
reviews[154].comments: Everything was as listed, had a pleasant stay. Thanks Savas
reviews[155].comments:
Das Zimmer liegt ca. 5 Gehminuten (bergauf) von der Hagia Sofia und Sultanahmed Moschee entfernt, also super zentral. 
Ich musste bei der Anreise etwas suchen, aber ein Freund von Savas kam nach einem Telefongespräch heraus und hat mich auf der Straße empfangen, also super Service. 
Bei Eurer Anreise am besten bis Sultan Ahmed Station der Straßenbahn fahren und dann (bergab) von (Hidden by Airbnb) (oder mit Stadtplan) bis zum Zimmer führen lassen.
Klima, Kühlschrank und Sat TV ist vorhanden, habe ich aber nicht genutzt. 
Das Bad war sauber und heißes Wasser beim Duschen auch durchgehend sofort ausreichend da.
reviews[156].comments: This place is in a prime location. Walking distance to the blue mosque and haga Sofia. The place is good for a couple nights not longer than that. It can be a little noisy outside in the early morning. The host came in our room late at night to get the TV fixed even once we said no. Savas was great and easily contactable about any issues and offered to help as much as possible.
reviews[157].comments: Muy bien el lugar solo que la gente no lo ubica y la dirección no la\nConoce casi nadie
reviews[158].comments: A little hard to find the first time, but in a great location. Bring good walking shoes for Istanbul's  cobblestones and hills.
reviews[159].comments: The host is great and gave all the information needed for staying in Istanbul. The place is walkable to various attraction and many restaurants.
reviews[161].comments: We had a good stay at Savas's apartment. It was really close (& an easy walk) to a many of the principal sights. The apartment was clean and comfortable with access to a shared kitchen and roof terrace.
reviews[162].comments: Quarto muito limpo e localizaçao sensacional. Foi um pouco dificil de achar ao chegarmos a noite de taxi do aeroporto. Melhor chegar de dia.\nSavas nos acompanhou por mensagens até entrarmos no apartamento e foi muito solícito.
reviews[163].comments: Decent location close to the sea and within an authentic Turkish neighborhood.
reviews[164].comments: My husband and I flew into Istanbul very late night and we checked in at 1:30am despite that Savas was super responsive and we checked in and settled with great ease. The space is cosy and the place is at a comfortable walking distance from all main attractions and a lot of great restaurants. Cabs are easily available at a 3 min walk. Great experience and highly recommended.
reviews[165].comments: En realidad viene a ser un Hotel, fueron muy amables y estuvieron pendientes a nuestra llegada, la habitación básica pero si piensan tener una estadía corta pues no es mala elección, lo mejor de todo es la vista desde la terraza.
reviews[166].comments: The house's location is well because near all the famous place....but if you don't know where the house...maybe you would difficult to find it....and I felt not easy to contact the host...for the environment in the room.. Not the same as the Airbnb's photo...but if need me give a summary...all is ok for this house....thanks Savas...
reviews[168].comments: Хорошее местоположение, на самом деле рядом с Султанахмет, но как только проходишь под ж/д дорогой, райончик кажется немного забытым, хотя это только ощущения. Рядом магазинчики, рестораны на каждом углу. До моря 3 минуты ходьбы, можно выйти на классную набережную. Поднимитесь на крышу! Наверху открывается потрясающий вид на море и Голубую Мечеть. Наверху есть маленькая кухня, где можно сделать чай/кофе. Комната красивая, стильная, уютная, что не скажешь о кровати. Нам было крайне неудобно, матрас "деревянный". Во время нашего проживания случился потоп: прорвало трубу на крыше, и вся вода лилась по лестнице куда-то вниз. Хорошо, что не залила номера (не уверены насчёт номера на цокольном этаже). В здании не было никого, я звонила хозяину, отправила ему видео и сообщение. Муж метался по округе, чтобы понять, где найти кого-то, чтобы остановить потоп. Хорошо, что минут через 40 пришла женщина, которая нас заселяла и стала метаться вместо мужа. За реагирование на проблему жирный минус. Понимаем, что потоп - не вина хозяина, но вот реагирование на проблему (тем более такого масштаба) могло бы быть более быстрым. Хотя справедливости ради отмечу, что когда в ванной перестал работать слив унитаза, а также были перебои с горячей водой (её не было), я написала хозяину, к вечеру проблемы были устранены. В общем, рекомендовать не стала бы. Но если решите заезжать, берите беруши, т.к. слышимость очень хорошая. \nИтог. Плюсы: вид, комната, расположение, инфраструктура. Минусы: общение (ситуация с потопом), матрас, слышимость.
reviews[170].comments: Very nice place in the middle of the old town.
reviews[171].comments: Great location, just 5-10 mins walk to blue mosque :) Nice and clean and comfy :)
reviews[172].comments: Savas place was perfect for seeing the sights in Sultanahmet! Only 5-10 minutes walk from the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace as well as tons of restaurants and shops. The room was very clean and comfortable. We also loved the view from the terrace.  Would definitely stay again!
reviews[173].comments:
Номер нам понравилась. Хозяин быстро отвечает на сообщения. Нас встретила и разместила приветливая девушка(забыла как ее зовут) Она говорит на русском, что очень нам облегчило задачу.
Всегда была готова прийти на помощь. Терраса  на верху имеет вид на море и мечеть. Очень красиво, но не помешало бы ее облагородить. В номере чисто. На кухне имеется микроволновка, холодильник, но он был и в номере, посуда, фужеры, стиральная машина. Плиты нет, но и необходимости в ней нет в Стамбуле.  Готовая вкусная еда на каждом шагу продается. До моря спуститься минут 10 максимум даже чуть меньше. 
До Голубой мечети идти минут 15.
Минимаркеты рядом с домом. 
Из недостатков: не было фена в номере, ночами шумно за окном, слив в душе и туалете плохо работал.
В целом все понравилось.
reviews[174].comments: Savas is very friendly and helpful. Check in and check out very convenient. The location is good. Would recommend this studio
reviews[175].comments: Staying at the mansion was excellent! The location was perfect if you're going to be visiting a lot of the attractions as it's a walking distance from plenty of restaurants and things to do. It's located on a quiet street, so noise wasn't a problem while sleeping. The room was the perfect size for 2 of us as we had little luggage and were barely in the room. I think this is a perfect spot if you're going to be touring the city all day as we were. Make sure you spend your mornings and/or nights on the terrace. It's a beautiful view of the city and Bosphorus! Note that this room is on the first floor, so we kept the blinds closed most of the time, which left the room pretty dark. I highly recommend staying here!
reviews[176].comments: Amazing location and host was very good at replying to all our messages and was very accommodating. Would highly recommend this place especially for small groups or solo travelers.
reviews[177].comments: Savas placed was exactly what I expected on the listing. Hot water went out for 2 days. Savas managed to get someone out to fix it. The area is safe. I recommend the place for location and value
reviews[179].comments: Clean and central location. Near by Restuarant and ocean .
reviews[180].comments: Awesome location for tourists. Nevertheless overrated! The quality of the room for this price range is low.  I therefore do not understand why so many people gave such a high rating.  The high grades might only come from the location.
reviews[182].comments: We loved our stay! Is only 5 minutes walking from the Blue Mosque. The building is beautiful, and the terrace has great views from the Bosphorus. Is not a common apartment, is an hotel boutique. The staff is very kind, we are very happy wit the experience!
reviews[183].comments: Sava is very approachable, easygoing, friendly and wiling to help. You can reach him and solve the problem any time. He helped us to solve the bed issue when it was already late night. He also helped us to arrange transport to the airport in the early morning. The apartment is new, clean and cozy. You can easily find restaurants and grocery shop near by.
reviews[184].comments: Lo recomiendo, es como una habitación de hotel y está buen ubicado. Todo limpio y acorde a las fotos.
reviews[185].comments: Rien que l'accès à la terrasse pour le lever et le coucher du soleil c'est magique !
reviews[186].comments: Savas place is central but kind of difficult for a taxi driver without a GPS to find it. loved the neighborhood and was very close to the blue mosque and other famous attractions. it is on the 1st floor so expect a bit of noise from outside.
reviews[187].comments: Perfect apartment! Specifically in terms of accessbility to the city-centor, cleanness, flexibility! I strongly recommend this apartment!
reviews[188].comments: Great value and amazing location. The place is modern and clean, while pretty basic.
reviews[189].comments: Very nice place, clean, good location, and Savas was very responsive to my messages.
reviews[190].comments: Basic, nice and clean, easy access to area attractions, great and timely communication from the host. Would stay again!

host.host_about:
Hey!

I'm Naz, a teacher living in istanbul trying to survive and enjoy at the same time :) I have been in istanbul for many years and i love sharing my ideas about the hidden parts of istanbul. As i like talking a lot, do not hesitate to ask anything.
I share the flat with my sister. Either my sister or I will be meeting you. Both of us are generally described as very friendly and easy going people . Hope to meet you
reviews[0].comments: Naz and her sister Gülcin were very gracious hosts. We appreciated all of their help. The house was conviniently located with a great view from the terrace. 5 minute walk to metro, bus stop, and Cevahir mall; well-located yet surprisingly quiet. We would recommend staying here
reviews[1].comments:
Staying with Naz was a very wonderful experience for my girlfriend and I. Her and her sister are great people, and I would highly recommend booking at her apartment. The apartment is well located next to a large shopping mall that also has the metro station in it. Only two stops to Taskim Square.

The room was exactly as described in the listing and is very comfortable, clean and spacious. We spent one week there and we would definitely stay again if we are in Istanbul.
reviews[2].comments: To met naz and to visit istanbul was a great experience and .\nFirst of all we want to say thank you to naz for her  wonderful hospitality.Our room was very comfortable and clean
reviews[3].comments: Naz was the best host ever. She was very comunicative, friendly and helpful. Everything was like in the pictures. What we liked the most was the hygiene. It was very very clean. The location is central, 3 min away from the metro which can take you to any part od Istanbul, you just need to ask someone. I want to thank Naz for the great time and I highly recommend her place!
reviews[4].comments: Naz was a great host! The room was big with a really comfortable bed. Both Naz's sister and her flatmate are very warm & easy-going people, I enjoyed our conversations. I hope to see you again one day!:)
reviews[5].comments: The reservation was canceled 11 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[6].comments: Naz, nous sommes contentes d'avoir passé ce court séjour chez toi! La chambre était lumineuse et spatieuse, tu nous as très bien accueillies, merci pour tes conseils! Bonne continuation
reviews[7].comments: We really liked to stay here. Naz and her sister Gulcin are very good and friendly girls, always ready to help and gave a lot of useful information. Location is perfect, 5 minutes to big shopping mall, subway and other transport points. Thank you very much! Hope to see you again someday ;)
reviews[8].comments: I had an amazing time with Naz and her sister. The room was spacious and clean and both hosts were lovely, very helpful and hospitable. I was offered to join them for tea and coffee and had great conversations with them. It was also possible to relax in my room whenever I needed some rest from this lively city. The location of the flat is very convenient due to its proximity to the metro, metrobüs, supermarkets and Cevahir Shopping Mall and the neighbourhood is safe. \r\nI felt very comfortable there and would always recommend to stay with them :)
reviews[9].comments: Naz and Gulcin are very nice and available we had a great time staying in their apartment and we are really grateful for their hospitality. place was really clean and comfortable in a nice and quiet neighborhood, also location was really good around 3 minutes walking to metro, bus and shopping center. We felt the real Turkish culture, they made us Turkish breakfast and shared a lot of useful information about Turkey and Istanbul. We really enjoyed our time staying there and we definitely recommend for everyone.

name: Perfect location to reach allaround
summary: Hello, We are looking forward to hosting you at our house 3 minutes to Cevahir mall, Şişli, one of the center of İstanbul. There is a one and half bed in your room. You can stay by yourself or with a slim friend :). With plain decoration and well lightning, it is a good place to live and organize your personal work., We are hoping to host you!
space: Hello, I am looking forward to host you at my house which is 3 minutes to Cevahir Shopping Mall. It is in Şişli( one of the main districts of İstanbul) This room is very comfortable for one or two guests. There are a double bed and a seat to drink coffee or chat with a friend. TL;DR: That was my worst Airbnb experience to date. Terrible coordination, intentional misinformation, and lack of sleep is what you gonna get staying here.

The place is a typical student den. Disgusting bathroom, stains, hair everywhere, the rug on the floor is permanently soaking wet and smelly, the toilet is often left filthy even though there's a brush right next to it. Selim barely speaks English, so we could only communicate through a translator app. That's all fine though, pretty much expected when traveling on a tight budget, that's not the worst part.

The worst part is all the random people snooping around, moving in and out without notice, and being loud during the nighttime. Before booking I specifically asked who else lives in the flat, and Selim said there's only him and his girlfriend. The reality is, neither is ever present (I believe we've seen each other 4-5 times during my month long stay), and the rest of the flat appears to be rented out separately (it is, see PS), meaning that you're left dealing with a bunch of strangers on your own.

Admittedly, most of the visitors were nice and considerate, but the last week I've had the pleasure sharing the flat with four guys, cramped together in the other room, drinking, leaving food rotting in the kitchen for days, using my soap and towels, arguing at 3am, slamming doors, and being completely unresponsive to numerous requests to keep it quiet at night. Selim didn't do anything meaningful to handle the situation. Either he's too shy to keep his guests' act in check, or simply didn't care, since he's almost never around anyway. So I had to resort to talking sense into them myself, which is a pretty awkward thing to do being a guest on someone else's premises, if you think about it.

Eventually we ended up installing door locks, so at least now it's possible to go outside and not worry about your stuff being stolen or messed with.

PS: There's another listing circulating in the Similar Places section, 'Comfortable and Nice Room in a Good Location', posted by Erinç, Selim's friend, per his own words. Be careful because it's the same flat, just a different room. In fact I stayed in that one, judging by the photos. Didn't mind it though, it's a better room.

Nisantasi, Istanbul’s equivalent to London’s Chelsea or New York’s Upper East Side, used to be dominated by strawberry orchards in the 18th century. Besiktas is the best place to observe the lively Istanbul city life. It is also the popular meeting point as well as the most important junction for sea transportation. reviews[1].comments:

reviews[2].comments:
Rather good flat. Nothing special, but great for such a low price. Two good beds, all other things that you need. One little problem: water in the shower stream down too slow: so, 5-10 sm water remain in the floor for next hour) But its not a big deal. We were happy too see, that photos don't lie, that Taxim and metro/buses/funicular/shops/clubs/restaraunts are really near, that Volcan is very helpful guy, who did everything we ask.

So, it was fine. For that price - excellent.
reviews[3].comments: Very good appartment, it has everything needed and it is really close to Istiklal. \r\nVolkan is a very welcoming and supportive host! He showed us around and did everything to make us feel comfortable.
reviews[4].comments: I would highly recommend this apartment and a host. We had a late flight to Istanbul and for Volkan that wasn't a problem. He waited us and showed us some cool bars the same night. Apartment is very close to Istiklal (the street where everything is happening), but yet it is very quiet an clean (pictures don't lie). There is no need to use public transportation, you can reach the main historical buildings on foot. Also if you need anything ask Volkan, he knows everything about Istanbul and he is willing to tell you.
reviews[5].comments:
Great spot!
Great location! Everything is really close; Taksim square, Galata shopping, and the Old-City. Apartment is spacious, clean, and cozy. Located in a good neighborhood; we walked around at night with no fears. 
This was our first trip to Istanbul and Volkan really helped us have a positive experience. He was able to provide us with a lot of details about the city. I would highly recommend this location!
reviews[6].comments:
Hi Volkan, thank you for these wonderful moments spent in your appatement! The warm atmosphere and the sympathy you have shown we were right in the heart. 

Very sensitive to the many kindnesses you regaled us during this trip, we wanted to thank you. more: The apartment is good for 4persons, it is new and comfortable, it is well located, walking distance to Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue ...... the neighborhood is old and very nice, with a fruit market on Saturday :) 
We returned from our vacation satisfied 
Stay as you are! 
Encore merci Volkan
reviews[7].comments:
Volkan was nice and easy to reach at all times. The house is like in the pictures, new and clean, it is an old building but he did a fine work renovating it. 
I didn't walk much on this neighbourhood since I didn't have a lot of days. It was noisy for me in the living room, sometimes we couldn't open the window all the way but I guess this is Istambul, like my country Spain, noisy. The room was quiet, so good for sleeping.
There are two things that I wasn't very comfortable with,  one being the bathroom, I didn't realized in the pictures that it was so small, the shower was very good but you have to take the toilet paper out every time you shower and there is no place really to leave your toiletries, and the second one was that we couldn't really cook because there was nothing to cook with, so it was not completely equipped, just basics. Not a big problem since there are a lot of restaurants to try out!
The stairs to the flat are very narrow and a bit steep so if you have trouble climbing stairs keep this in mind, other than that, you get use to it easily, Volkan helped us with our heavy luggage.
I must say that we are on our 40's and that is why I think this is a flat more for young people than for a mature couple. But it was all right for 3 nights and for the price.
reviews[8].comments: Great host. Volkan is very helpful and speaks great English. The location is close to taksim. The apartment is good for 1-2 people. It's small and bathroom is very small. As long as it's 2 people max you should be good.
reviews[9].comments: Volcan was a great host. Thanks for a lovely stay
