reviews[11].comments:
I booked this place for my niece, her husband and her one year old daughter. It was very clean and it met their expectations fully. The neighborhood is part of old Istanbul and family oriented with a lot of children playing in the street. There is great access to main street with public transports. Taksim square is only 10 minutes walk. Volcan is a great guy and he made my family feel very welcome. For sure we will work with Volcan again if we end up coming back to Istanbul.

Thanks Volcan
Nasser
reviews[12].comments: L'appartement de Volkan est plutôt bien placé par rapport aux endroits à visiter dans Istambul mais malheureusement il se situe dans une petite rue excentrée peu accueillante pour 2 jeunes femmes désireuses de faire la fête et de rentrer tard le soir. Nous avons en effet été suivies en rentrant de boîte de nuit et nous avons dû nous cacher chez un commerçant voisin :-(\r\nToutefois je recommande ce logement à des hommes ou éventuellement des couples mais pas des femmes seules. Sinon Volkan est relativement serviable et pourra répondre à vos questions concernant les modalités pratiques de votre séjour.
reviews[13].comments: Appartement sommaire mais fonctionnel, très bien situé dans une rue calme à proximité de commerces et surtout proche de la grande rue commercante de Taksin et de sa vie nocturne. Volkan nous a très bien accueillit, très arrangeant et pret à repondre à toutes vos questions. Nous avons été très contentes de notre séjour à Istanbul. Nous recommandons cet hôte.
reviews[14].comments: Great apartment with a nice location. We enjoyed our stay here. Thanks Volkan !
reviews[15].comments: It was wonderful holiday! Thanks!\r\nНебольшая, но уютная квартира! есть все необходимое-шампунь, фен, полотенца. Рядом улица с барами, ресторанами, магазинами. Мы приезжали поздно ночью, Volkan нас ждал, помог объяснить таксисту как доехать, был очень приветлив несмотря на позднее время.\r\nВсем рекомендуем!
reviews[16].comments: Everything was great, Voltan is a perfect host, with lots of advices and always ready to help at almost 24/7! The place itself is pretty small, but the position near the entertainment center is awesome! Great for short-time staying!
reviews[17].comments: The location is great, close to Taksim, there are small stores and food options close by. The place is very clean and Volkan was very helpful. The only drawback was the fact that we were 4 people and the sofa bed was not sleepable for even one person. The problem was not with space but with the comfort you need from a bed. Other than that, great place, great location, great host!
reviews[18].comments: Volkan was a wonderful host. He waited until after 1am for us to arrive as our flight was late. Volkan sat down with us and gave us tips on where to visit in Istanbul. He also let us borrow a travel guide book and gave us a map of the city. The apartment was spotlessly clean and had everything that we needed. The apartment is in a great location- a short walk to Istikal street. I would recommend staying here. It's great value!
reviews[19].comments: Really nice place, cozy and tidy. Volkan was really helpfull and very nice!
reviews[20].comments: Volkan is a careful host,although i changed my mind and i moved.He wasnt enthusiastic but...For couples its ok..For lonely person not so good....its 15 min.to taksim square with a quick walk...all over are strange people after eight p.m..But Volkans ap.has everything u need...but if u want smtg u need to ask....He takes care a lot...when u have a problem write him he will help for sure...The accomodation is exactly the same as on the (Website hidden by Airbnb) its nice to see that the reality=photo,coz here in Turkey its rarely to see the same as u choose....In general im satisfied....
reviews[21].comments: Thanks a lot for an awesome stay Volkan! Great apartment! Awesome shower! ! Great location! Everything was easy to get to and Volkan was an extremely helpful and an attentive host...Responded immediately to my messages and made me feel very welcome. All the best man!
reviews[22].comments:
Volkan was a great host. Very accommodating, genial, very easy to communicate with (both upon the time of the booking and during the duration of our stay), clearly loves the Istanbul culture and can give good suggestions on how to go about the trip.  

The flat was as advertised. Clean, amenities all working, wifi was good, sheets, towels and extras were provided. Volkan was also nice enough to take care of our laundry.  I travelled with my family (dad and sister) and found the flat to be very comfortable to fit us all. Bathroom may be a bit small but it's easy to get over that with the space we got anyway. 

The neighborhood is a bit raw and hilly (steep in some parts - so get a good cab if traveling with heavy luggages) but very very near the Istiklal Caddesi which is basically one of the major veins of Istanbul. So that's a plus. Very near the flat also are small restaurants serving good and inexpensive local food and minimarts for basic needs. 

Istanbul is a great city with nice people and amazing food. Volkan provided us a good flat to rest ourselves after a day of walking the city. Would recommend.
reviews[23].comments: Volkan met my girlfriend and I at the apartment even after our last minute booking. He was extremely helpful in getting us settled in and teaching us how to turn on the apartment's radiators. The place itself was very clean, the bed was comfortable and the high pressure hot shower was a godsend. \r\n\r\nThanks so much for the great stay, Volkan! We will definitely come back if we're ever in Istanbul.
reviews[24].comments: The apartment is well located, nice and very confortable even when it's freezen outside. Volkan is a very good host because he gave to us some maps and an historical guide to discover the city and he is also permissive about late check out .
reviews[25].comments: Everything was really nice. The apartment was very warm despite the city being covered in snow. Very close to lots of cool places. Volkan is very nice and available for any questions or problems. Overall a great experience :D
reviews[26].comments: Amazing little apartment. Perfect location to get around. Volkan was super flexible which we appreciated. Stay here!
reviews[27].comments: We had a great time at Istanbul! Volkan was very helpful and showed us the way around the apartment. The location is great. Quiet but near everything you want to see or do. The apartment looks like the pictures. We had a great weekend!
reviews[28].comments: La experiencia en el apartamento de volean fue genial. Es un lugar muy céntrico muy cerca caminando de la Calle Istiklal y de Taksim. El lugar está ordenado. Volean es un excelente anfitrión y al comunicación con él es muy fácil y fluida desde el inicio. Gracias por tu colaboración y ayuda.
reviews[29].comments: Nice and clean place, not far from anywhere we wanted to be. Volkan was great with getting in touch when we needed him. Overall a good experience in Istanbul.
reviews[30].comments: Accommodation match the photos. The apartment is in the historic district. Near the main street of Istanbul (Istiklal). Good combination of price and quality. There is air conditioning.\r\n
reviews[31].comments: Volkan was there to meet me at the building and was very welcome.  Before, during and after stay, he was always quickly available to answer any questions I threw at him.  The apartment was basic and located in a working class family neighborhood, but I always felt safe.  It has two rooms separated by a hallway and a bathroom.  It's a youth hostel version of an AirBnB, but everything you need is there.  Great deal!
reviews[32].comments: Volkan is a great host. Our flight was delayed and we ended up reaching his place only at 1AM and Volkan was available to provide our taxi driver with directions as well as welcome us and show us around the apartment. The apartment itself is perfectly sized for 2. For a group of 4, it may be a little cramped but again it is not too bad. The proximity to Istiklal street makes it a perfect place to spend time in Istanbul. Given a chance, I would definitely stay in Volkan's place.
reviews[33].comments: Great location. Five minutes to Istiklal Street by walking. Restorated old Ottoman appartment. Pretty comfortable matress. Shower is quite good. If you are a tourist couple or a lone ranger, this flat is for you. The guy ‘Yusuf’ was so friendly and helpful.
reviews[34].comments: Отличная, уютная, стильная квартира в старом доме со свежим ремонтом. Звукоизоляция хорошая,  намного лучше, чем в недорогих гостиницах с картонными стенками. Квартал не туристический, здесь живут местные жители, и этим он хорош - низкими ценами и хорошей инфраструктурой. Буквально за углом совсем недорогое кафе (вкусная еда, цены как в столовых), пекарня с вкусняшками, два минимаркета - carrefour и sok.  по выходным через дорогу открывается овощной рынок, где овощи и фрукту можно купить раза в два-три дешевле, чем в в супермаркете (где и так и не очень дорого).
reviews[35].comments: Volkan very nice person. I stay him apartments 2 week very cute and clean flat. Near Taksim istiklal metro station bus station.ıstanbul travel for very nice apartments. Thank you very much Volkan!!! I hope again visit your flat
reviews[36].comments: Спасибо нашим хостам Волкану и Зине за тёплый приём и чудесную квартирку. Их небольшая уютная студия оснащена всем необходимым для длительного проживания ( мы даже расстроились, что у нас было так мало времени) и находится всего в 3х минутах от самой оживленной и колоритной улицы Стамбула - İstiklal!
reviews[37].comments: Good location, main street reachable in a few minutes, everything needed in the flat.
reviews[38].comments: Volkan is great, his apartment is much more beautiful than in the photos, it has style, it is warm and it is in an excellent neighborhood, I would recommend it to anyone who wants to visit the beautiful city of Istanbul. I'll be back very soon. regards
reviews[39].comments: Very cozy and light apartment. Great location, 2 minutes away from Istiklal avenue - the most amazing place to visit in my opinion. \nVolkan is great host, very communicable and response quickly. Thank you so much. Hope to see you again at the same place!!! \nAlina and Aleksey
reviews[40].comments: The host was very hospitable, interested and gave a very quick response to everything. home is comfortable, clean and convenient space. it is very close to omer hayyam bus station and short walking distance to  metro station. Thank you for comfortable stay...
reviews[41].comments: Perfect for a short stay. Volkan's place was clean and close to Taksim square with many restaurants close by.
reviews[42].comments: The location and the apartment itself are just perfect for exploring Istanbul! Everything you need is close by (bars, restaurants, shops etc) but the apartment is still in a quiet area with a local vibe. The apartment is cosy, clean, and has everything you need for preparing breakfast etc. The size is perfect for couples. We really enjoyed our stay there and enjoyed a very warm welcome from Volkan‘s brother. Thank you!
reviews[43].comments: Квартира на третьем этаже (физически четвертый). Но если в Вас весу не 120 кг, как во мне, довольно крутая винтовая лестница не сильно испугает. Интерьер очень приятный, полностью соответствует фотографиям. Особенно понравился деревянный пол, неокрашенный, просто лакированный или пропитанный маслом - приятно ходить босиком. Так как мы были в гостях у Волкана 16 дней, очень выручила стиральная машина (правда все надписи на ней на турецком, но при наличии Wi-Fi - это не составило никаких проблем).  Звукоизоляция отличная.Двери входные надежные, стальные. С балкона можно наблюдать обычную жизнь местных. По воскресеньям овощной рынок с утра и до восьми вечера. Автобусная остановка в 5 минутах ходьбы. До Таксима - макс. 10 минут. Рекомендую - для двух человек  и цена и качество - самое то!
reviews[44].comments: The appartement was clean and in a quiet area. We enjoyed our stay. Volkan and his brother are very nice people. You can get easily to the Taksim square or to the metro station. Very nice !
reviews[45].comments: Its a nice condo good for 2 persons. The location was perfect as expected, Taskim square, Istiklal street, grocery story, Tram station, all are at walkable distance. It takes around 10 to 15 minutes to reach Tram station. Overall, its worth staying here.
reviews[46].comments: Great little flat in a great location. You can walk to most major sites if you want to; and if not—multiple local transportation options are very close by. Plenty of local amenities available in the neighborhood, and on Sunday there is a street bazaar that begins on the cross street opposite the apartment with a wonderful selection of fresh produce, fruit, nuts and more. And Volkan is very quick to respond to any communication.
reviews[47].comments: Отличное расположение квартиры, тихий район, несколько кафе где можно позавтракать. В 10 минутах ходьбы центральная улица Истикляль, 15 мин до Галатской башни. Удобное расположение к общественному транспорту - автобусы, фуникулер, метро. В квартире чистота и есть все для длительного проживания - холодильник, плита, посуда, посудомойка, фен, хорошая звукоизоляция. Отзывчивый и доброжелательный хозяин.
reviews[48].comments: Excellent location very close to Istiklal Caddesi, the main shopping street, but in a quiet neighborhood. The apartment has all the necessities, new and clean! Volkan was quick and clear in the check in, great host!
reviews[49].comments: Se puede llegar fácil a muchos lugares y hay muchos otros para comer cerca
reviews[50].comments: Very good location in center
reviews[51].comments: It was very nice and cozy place, close to main street (Istiklal) and Volkan's brother who welcomed us was very nice and helpful, I recommend this place.
reviews[52].comments: Мне понравилось, район такой старинный, дома стоят на горе. Идти приходится или вверх или вниз. Лестница в доме шикарная, винтовая вокруг балки. Свет на ней включается от движения и надо очень быстро взбираться по ней, что бы успеть от одной лампы к другой. Я не успевал, а оказавшись на такой лестнице без света то ещё удовольствие. Сама квартира не большая, но мне самый раз, я жил один. Архитектура дома понравилась, он сам из кирпича с деревянными полами. Вид из окна лучше не смотреть. В пяти минутах пешеходная улица, куча баров, мини рынки. Расположение хорошее.
reviews[53].comments: The apartment is in an old house, bright, clean and stylish. The only thing that was not, it's toiletries, they had to buy yourself. To the main street of Beyoglu 5-10 minute walk.
reviews[54].comments: Спасибо огромное за гостеприимство! Наши ожидания оправдались, все очень чисто и стильно. Хозяин дружелюбный,отвечает мгновенно на все интересующие вопросы. Месторасположение очень удобное, недалеко от площади Таксим, рядом много супермаркетов. Будем рады вернуться.
reviews[55].comments:
Небольшая квартирка в старом кирпичном доме на 3-м (почти 4-ом) этаже. Как мы поняли, абсолютно аналогичные квартиры находятся этажами ниже и выше, с небольшой разницей. Только наша квартира была с небольшим открытым балкончиком. 

Прекрасное местоположение, до центральной улицы рукой подать. В воскресенье из окон туалета открывается прекрасный вид на рынок и жизнь турков :))) 

Квартирка показалась нам уже немного потрепанной, было бы замечательно чуть обновить ремонт(покрасить стены, починить смеситель на кухне) и получше убираться (часто натыкались на чужие волосы, пододеяльник был старый и в катышках). 
Но брат Волкана - Атилла извинился за не очень хорошую уборку, сказал, что обычно они сами тщательно чистят квартиру, но в этот раз не смогли, и убирался кто-то другой. И, пожалуй, за такую цену можно простить эти небольшие недостатки. 

Встретил нас Атилла, все объяснил, показал и был всегда на связи. По всем просьбам быстро откликался. За что ему большое спасибо!

reviews[19].comments: What is a typical Airbnb moment? Our stay at Nalan's apartment must be one of those special  moments. You arrive to a foreign land and city, where you never have been before. After an excruciating journey with an dishonest taxidriver from the wrong airport, you arrive at somebody else's home, and greeted with a warm welcome. After a short introduction where to sleep, and where to hang your your clothes, you are left alone in somebody else's nice and shiny clean apartment. Really a big wow type experience. And it is of course the very basic Airbnb, to tactfully and with great respect of other people's belongings stay in another person's apartment. What more is there to say? Of course the apartment was well cleaned, in very good condition, with all the necessary tings to cook, fry, iron, wash and so on.\nWe slept very well, and the whole area is full of shops, restaurants, bars and so on, all very closely together and in an small area easily reached by walking.\nTo visit Istanbul from Nalan's apartment is very simple,  you have the boats close by, going to most parts of the town. Going to Taksim square? Easy - take the boat to Kabatas, when there take the Metro one stop, and you are there. Grand Bazaar? Again easy, boat to Karaköy, cange to tram going over the bridge you just went under, get off at Beyazit stop. Get a Istanbul card, works at trams,  boats, metro and busses. Thank you Nalan for letting us use your apartment,  we had a wonderful stay, and we warmly recommend her apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul.

We spend 5 nights from 24 - 29 Aug at Mehmet's place. It was a family trip with my parents, younger brother, wife and our toddler aged 2 years and an infant just 3 months old; the reason I detail our group is to mention how perfect the apartment is for large families. The highlight is the living room which is just like in the photos, well laid out and large - giving us and the kids ample space to spend quality time whilst in the flat. 

Mehmet as a host has been extremely friendly and supportive - we had a few instances when if it were not for Mehmet's very responsive nature to calls and messages, we would have had a difficult time. Once when my younger brother had fallen ill with very high fever late into the night, I had contacted Mehmet and he immediately provided details of the nearest hospital and also offered to talk to the Taxi driver once we are in the car. What was more personal, was when he cared to check up on my brother the next day and asked how was keeping. 

We also had an incident when unfortunately my wife's wallet was pickpocketed, and it contained the flat keys. I was quite distressed as the kids were tired and it was at the end of a long day. Just one call, and although Mehmet was in Izmir, within 10 min he had arranged his sister to drop the spare keys to the flat. 

Thank you very much Mehmet for your prompt support, we really appreciate it and I am delighted I chose a wonderful host. I would strongly recommend Mehmet's flat to future Istanbul visitors, there is a Carrefour market downstairs, the bus stand is just 1 min walk away. One small word of caution, do travel light! The flat is on the third floor or spiralling stairway, on normal days we had no issues at all - guess being a large family trip we came with way too many suitcases - the move in and move out took some energy out of me! :-)
reviews[14].comments: Before anything - Mehmet is a great communicator: he immediately shared his (Hidden by Airbnb) number, and we clarified the location, check-in process (as our flights were at awkward hours) and everything. That's great, great hospitality!\n\nMehmet's place is conveniently located near the tourist attractions in İstanbul. After climbing three stairs, you'll find a very secure door letting you into a very spacious apartment with two bedrooms, one kitchen, a bathroom and a huge living room. Only the living room has AC, on the other hand even when it is 35 degrees Celsius outside the AC managed to cool down the whole flat in about 2 hours. Mehmet kindly provides you with clean sheets, towels and various amenities and tips to make you feel home.

Very caring and cooperative host. We could not expect more. Definitely a place to stay the next time we visit Istanbul.\n\nPS. If you are hesitating due to this apartment being in fourth floor, remember it is the old town Istanbul and literally no new building with elevator is available for AirBnB. reviews[27].comments: Mehmet is a super Host....he answer almost everytime fast and he is kind and can speak english very well...i will come to him again.
reviews[28].comments: Mehmet’s place is really nice and clean, it also close to the tram station! Mehmet is a nice person, he helped us with our luggages and send messages to check if we need anything everyday! He also give suggestions about where to go and eat! :)

reviews[3].comments: 离圣索非亚步行十分钟,楼下有小超市,挺棒的哦

reviews[7].comments: Great location . Close to tourist attraction places. Hotel staff very cooperative
reviews[8].comments: The host is ready to assist when you need Communication is not s problem as he has a good command of English. \nHands down,  I would recommend this place to anyone I know.
reviews[9].comments: Great location and great greeting!
reviews[10].comments: We enjoyed our stay there. The only issue was the ride back to the airport. The driver was about 30 minutes late to pick us up. Be sure to give yourself lots of time.
reviews[11].comments: The host was very welcoming and hospitable, and organised cheap and punctual airport transfer for us. The hotel is located in an excellent place and was only a 4 minute walk from Istanbul’s main sites, this allowed us to come and go as we pleased during the day. The rooms were very clean  and air conditioned and the beds were comfortable. The hotel is located off the main streets so it is nice and quiet in the evening. The view from the terrace is amazing and all the staff spoke brilliant English. We felt comfortable around the staff and also organised activities such as a Turkish bath through the hotel. The host was swift in responding to queries, I would definitely go back and recommend this affordable and comfortable hotel !
reviews[12].comments: Place highly recommended. Perfect location, perfect communication, perfect accomodation. If I would come back to Istambul, I will definitively repeat Artika Hotel. Thanks for everything.
reviews[13].comments: The hotel is an excellent location, really close to the blue mosque, the grand bazar and many restaurants,  the hotel staff will try to do as much to help you have a great stay.
reviews[14].comments: Artika Hotel was outstanding. The rooms were clean and nice. We liked the bathrooms especially. The personal attention of Salih Bey was remarkable. He gave us tips on sights and was there for us in all respects. Salih Bey - thank you!\n\nI can recommend artika to everyone who wants to discover Istanbul!
reviews[15].comments: Outstanding location and clean rooms. Easy to reach attractions. Nice host.
reviews[16].comments: Beautiful stay, very nice hotel, super helpful staff, perfect location :))\nWe enjoyed our stay and if in Istanbul again will absolutely stay at Artika hotel again :))\nHighly recommand :)))
reviews[17].comments: Perfect location, clean, good hospitality, very kind staff. Highly recommended!
reviews[18].comments: Staff are extremely  helpful\nLocation is very convenient less than 5 minutes walk to blue mosque \nBreakfast is basic
reviews[19].comments: I would wholeheartedly recommend Artika to anyone. Communication was spot-on, the staff friendly and helpful to a fault, cleanliness was acceptable and the location just right. Being a 20 minute walk away from the Blue Mosque meant that we were never disturbed by the early morning call to prayer - so many reviews mention how noisy it can be. The beds were comfortable and we slept well. Breakfast was more than adequate, in fact, everything exceeded our expectations for a hotel in this price bracket. Salih and his team are able to arrange anything and provided us with good advice and tips on what and what not to do. We were travelling with my elderly mother who has mobility issues but she managed the location without difficulty: turn left out of the hotel up the steep hill and keep climbing until you hit the street with trams OR turn right and walk to the mosque along mostly level roads then walk back up the tram road from the Blue Mosque and then down to the hotel - easy. And DO check out the newly opened Roman cistern  just up the hill. Discovered in 2010 it is smaller than the Cistern Basilica but equally impressive and the crowds haven’t discovered it yet; we were the only visitors to this vast underground space with towering columns.
reviews[20].comments: 房间不错,挺大的,设施也比较新,位置很好,离蓝色清真寺非常近｡半夜到的飞机,前台很热情的接待我们｡推荐

neighborhood_overview: The neighborhood is what makes me pay a lot for this place actually :) It's right at the center of locals: Taksim; where all the cultural activities are going on. I can smeet my friends and find the best bars or cofee shops in the city right here.  And also it is the most convenient place for a tour guide (meaning also for tourists:) to go just by tram within couple of minutes to historical peninsula -Sultanahmet- or the Bosphorus.  In addition; it is not the real bourgeois bohemian section of the city, rather it is still a somehow traditional neighborhood where you don't feel like in a buble but also experience the daily life as a common Istanbul resident.
notes: I am a tour guide also taking turkish people abroad.  So, from time to time I am away for business. A friend of mine takes care of you and the flat in the meanwhile. Those days, I also rent my own room. Unless there is no booking the flat is shared And I have two kitten!
transit: Could not be better!!! 3 minutes to the tram connecting you to Sultanahmet or Dolmabahce Palace or the ferry (although it is soo easy to walk to ferry station max around 10 min) 5 minutes to several bus stations and if you are a real adventurer wanting to use the main subway 5 to 10 min walk again.  No exaggeration while saying it is the heart of the city :)

house_rules: In Turkey, we do not walk with shoes at home. So, I ask you not to step into the flat with your shoes and you can place them into the cupboard behind the door after entering.There are carpets on floor and flip flops to wear. And after having lots of guests I feel the need to write detailed rules. Although they all sound really basics I realised that it might be useful;) It is a shared flat and we have a shared bathroom. So, I also use it. It is normal that one wants to take hours long showers during vacation or just wanna get prepared for soo long, but I also need to use it. Thatswhy, I ask my guests not to stay for really long especially in the mornings. And it would be nice if you clean the shower after yourself. Also, the window in the bathroom needs to be open at least after shower. In the kitchen we have a dishwasher. I ask you to put your dish into and if I am not home please turn it on, it still does not know to clean itself;) and it really stinks. I really like to share but it
host.host_about:
I love traveling, thus I decided to have it as my full time job and travel with people from Turkey  (although it did not take me long to understand that to travel for the sake of working is not the same thing:)

 I also host people from other countries here especially in Istanbul as a professional guide. It makes me happier!

 I love dancing. Any music can make me dance but I am taking belly dance courses, so at least just for fun I can teach you some moves:)

Other than those, similar to most of us, I enjoy usual staff like watcing movies, reading, spending time with friends etc.
reviews[0].comments: We spent 1 week at Zuleyha's apartment. She was very welcoming and friendly. Apartment's location cant be any better. its only couple of minutes from lively Istiklal street, it is well protected from the crowd; and its very quite and safe. We traveled to the most of the city from here on foot. We also took metro and tram which were quite close too. We were also walking within the neighborhood which is full of beautiful and trashy historical houses, arty shops and cafes. The room had a nice view from the window, bright and very quite. The whole apartment was very clean.
reviews[1].comments: The time we stayed at Züleyha's place was very precious. We learned a lot about life in Istanbul and the culture. Her experience as a tour-guide helped us save a lot of trouble and money. We also enjoyed chatting with her and she also took my wife to her belly dance class once. She also showed us how Turkish Tea is boiled and she knows where the good restaurants are. Thank goodness we didn't take an apartment in the old town where all the prices are for tourists. We were five minutes walking distance from the main live centre in Istanbul, where the students and young people are spending their time in the evenings. And it was only three tram stations from the old town centre. We really had a great time with Züleyha.
reviews[2].comments:
Flat: Spacious, well decorated, very colorful like istanbul, clean, good collection of books, maps and DVDs in lounge and great collection herbal teas and coffee in kitchen, balcony with nice view of french place gardens and walls 

Room: Clean and comfy bedding, small cupboard, window with nice view of gardens

Location: Just less than 5 mins walk from the lively and most happening place of the city - İstiklâl street. But still very quite and residential. Very close to Taxi stand (1 min walk) and Tophane, Galatasary, Tunel and Taksim stations. Location is filled with cafe, bar, restaurant; shopping, embassies, historical buildings, so spend a day for new-city. Easy and quick access to old-city and asia-side thru public transportation Tram/Ferry

Host (Zuleyha): Very friendly and helpful over entire stay. Being in tourism industry and localite, she has provided lots of information and tips about istanbul (esp shops) which can not be sourced anywhere from (Hidden by Airbnb) . She and friend/neighbor prepared a nice breakfast and lots of various great herbal teas for us

Summary: Me and my wife stayed for 4 nights and had a very pleasant and enjoyable stay in March (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)
reviews[3].comments: We stayed four days at Cozy Flat and it was amazing! The flat is  very clean and organized and Züleyha is thoughtful and helped us a lot with touristic information. We also had the opportunity to talk to her and found out more about Istambul and people. \r\nThe location is very convenient! Although it looks like difficult to find it the first time.
reviews[4].comments: Time with Zule and her friends is definitely one of the highlights of my trip in Istanbul. Besides all the good things other visitors mentioned, I also feel very fortunate to have a chance to experience the daily life of young professionals in Istanbul. The very first thing she did after we met is to invite me to join her and her friends for a authentic Turkish breakfast! :) After typical tourism topics we also talked a lot about each other's culture and traveling experiences, etc. I would certainly recommend Zule and her neighbor to any of my friends traveling to Istanbul. And, girl I would see you soon on my next trip in Turkey. All the Bests, Beaux\r\n
reviews[5].comments:
I had a fantastic stay with Zuleyha last weekend. The apartment is really well kept, and the bedroom was bright and comfortable. Zuleyha was an excellent host, gave lots of really great advice (the dance show at the cultural centre is highly recommended) and took us out for night out to see some local live music. She even showed me how to belly dance!
Did I mention that I was fed delicious home baked pastries by her lovely neighbour(also a airBnB host) every 20 minutes?
reviews[6].comments: Zühleyha has a very nice and clean appartment on a perfect location in Istanbul. \r\nShe herself was not present during our stay so we didn't get to meet her, which was a pity as we use Airbnb mainly because we like meeting local people. Zühleyha did arrange for a friend of her to be present in the house when we arrived, which worked out perfectly fine. I would definitely recommend staying in this appartment.
reviews[7].comments: The apartment is great. It is just a 10 minutes walk from Taksim square and it is located in a great neighborhood. Even though great nightlife a so close, the apartment is in a very quite area.\r\nZüleyha was away for a business trip, but her friend took care of us, who provided us with very helpful tips and advises about Istanbul We had a great stay.
reviews[8].comments: It's been a very pleasurable stay at Zul's apartment - it's as central as it gets, within walking distance of many of the namable restuarants and bars, and first and foremost it's clean, neat and nice to live in. The apartment is also very quiet, with a backyard balcony that's right in front of the Italian Consulate Generale, a fully equipped kitchen and a spacious, cool living room. Host Zul is a very, very helpful, accomodating person, although she hasn't been around the apartment most of the time of our stay. Besides us, there has been another German couple living with us for a couple of days in the 2nd room. Friendly people, although it might have been nice to know up front who else we'd be sharing the apartment with. A minor flipside is that the apartment is a little hard to find, since there're no nametags on any of the bell buttons. But the minute you're there, you'll be able to be looking forward to a great and unforgettable stay at the heart of the city of Istanbul!
reviews[9].comments: When we arrived delayed in Züleyha's flat she welcomed us with warm chai and homemade pastry. We felt very comfortable all the time and  were happy to could share a glass of wine with our host. Furthermore, all the advices and recommendations she gave us helped us a lot.\r\nWe could reach almost everything walking from the flat.\r\nTo sum up: very nice atmosphere and host, perfectly located and very recomendable! :-)
reviews[10].comments: The flat is great, and also the localisation. Züleyha couldn't be there for profesional reasons, but all was perfect, and contact by messages wery good.
reviews[11].comments:
Züleyha was away for a few days (because of work commitment) when I arrived, but she arranged for someone to be there to let me in - unfortunately I got caught up in a bit of a riot on arrival in Taksim Square and didn't arrive at the apartment till 9 pm. Züleyha had left a good collection of books on Istanbul and I bought a detailed map when I was there.
The room was clean, the bed comfortable. A couple of coat hangers would have been useful.
Location was good - 5 minutes walk (uphill - so if you have knee or foot problems, be aware) to İstiklâl street and only a few minutes walk (downhill) to the tramstop at Tophane - for 3 Lira you can travel across the bridge to the Hippadrome, the Blue Mosque, Hagai Sophie etc. Alternatively you can walk - if it is not too hot, the walk is pleasant. Lots of places to eat nearby. From the ferry (not far from the tram - you can (for 3 Lira) go over to Asia - at Karidoy.

Züleyha is easy going and provided you are fair and thoughtful you will have no problems. On my last night her lovely neighbour - Gushane - prepared an evening meal for us and a few other friends. It was a great end to a lovely stay. Thank you to Züleyha and her friends for a delightful end to an exciting and happy holiday.
reviews[12].comments:
I have spent 4 days at Züleyha's apartment and it was a great time. The apartment is really well-located! It's in the heart of Beyoglu and the pedestrian street 'Istiklal' is 5 min away. There are nice shops, cafés and restaurants in close area. 
Züleyha as a host was absolutely great! She has a real good insight when it comes to sights and places which are worth visiting. She can also give you some great advice on bars and nightclubs.
The apartment is nicely decorated and she has a very nice balcony with a view on a French palace. 
It was fun to stay at her place and I can really recommend it to everyone!
reviews[13].comments:
Me and my boyfriend had a wonderful time in Istanbul and at Züleyha´s appartment.
She couldn´t be there because of work but her friend took care of us and was really helpful and gentle. Also the "american Girl" was a great roommate.
I would recommend this place to everyone who likes a nice, quiet place near all the Hotspots of Istanbul.
Close to Tram, Taksim, Galat-Tower.
And: Visit Limonlu bahce, best place around the corner.
reviews[14].comments: Züleyha was traveling, so her friend Emrah let me in and got me set up. They were both very hospitable, and patient when my flight was delayed and I arrived late. The flat was quite comfortable, and right in the middle of Taksim (and a short walk from a metro station), which was great for walking places and getting around. \r\n\r\n(Warning to light sleepers, though, the entire district is pretty loud at night. I was glad to have some earplugs, as I'm not used to that much activity in the early morning.)
reviews[15].comments: I stayed at Zuleyha's for 3 nights in July 2014. The place was conveniently located, a short uphill walk from the main st of Taksim. The room was small and basic. The room was noisy, very hot and there were also cats from neighbouring flats who would jump through the window in the middle of the night, so if you are precious about your sleep or don't like cats I wouldn't recommend it! Zuleyha did provide some tips on where to eat and what to do. She had just arrived back from a trip so the place was not clean or tidy when I stayed, but maybe it was just a one off.
reviews[16].comments:
Zuleyha is absolutely great. A professional tour guide in Turkey and all over Europe! Compliments for her knowledge and the way she treated us. 

We have a travel agency ourselves in Costa Rica but if each AirBNB is like this one, we would only recommend such places in the future. 

Thanks Zuleyha!

Renee and Ed
reviews[17].comments:
Vielen Dank noch einmal an Züleyha für die tolle Unterkunft. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Ein kleines gemütliches Zimmer zum schlafen sowie ein Wohnzimmer mit ausreichend Platz und einem schönen Balkon mit Aussicht ins Grüne. 

Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral allerdings in einer weniger einladenden Seitenstraße in Taksim und war der perfekte Startpunkt die Gegend zu erkunden. 

Leider musste unsere Gastgeberin beruflich verreisen, wir haben Sie aber für zwei Stunden bei unserer Anreise noch gesehen und sie hat uns wirklich viele wertvolle Tipps zur Besichtigung der Stadt gegeben. Da wir Katzen lieben, haben uns Ihre zwei kleinen Mitbewohner sehr viel Freude bereitet. 

Kurzum: Wir können die Wohnung und Züleyha als Gastgeber sehr empfehlen.
reviews[18].comments: Zül was a great host very helpful and nice. Here apartment is lovely and in a good location; the highlight were here two kittens who made us feel at home.
reviews[19].comments: The room is clean and the host is very nice,She gives us some advises,like how to go to the airport and bazaar. and i love her cats!
reviews[20].comments: The house of Zühleyha is in a great area with nice streets with shops and bars. The tramstation Tophane is nearby.
reviews[21].comments: Great stay, great host! Perfect location! Everything was perfect in this wonderful city

By using the ferry, you will both have the chance to see the great Bosphorus view and go to the very center of the old city (Golden Horn) where you will find the Grand Bazaar, famous Galata tower, the palaces and mosques. You can also go to Taksim, Beyoglu street, which is the living center of the European side. (Alternatively, you also have the chance to take the mini buses that work 24 hours from Kadikoy to Taksim Square.) In the Asian side of the city, you can go to the beautiful Prince Islands and the Maiden Tower by the ferry as well.

We had a pleasant stay in Eren’s apartment. It is very well located – really close to the metro and bus station and to the ferry (about 5 minutes from the door) – you can easily reach all the important tourist sites in just few minutes by metro or by boat. (We highly recommend you to take a boat – it takes about 20-30 minutes to Eminonu – Sultanahmet or to Karakoy – Galata – and see the city from the Bosphorus.) In the neighbourhood of the apartment you can find everything you need – shops, restaurants, bars, cafes (local Turkish and also Starbucks) and services etc. 
We met Eren the first day we arrived. We did not need any special help or advices, as it was not our first visit to Instanbul, but Eren was constanly within reach on the phone, willing to help or advise all the time. There is no reason not to believe him. In all cases, he responded very quickly on all our messages.
We should note that people with very light sleep could be disturbed by the disco which is somewhere in the quarter, which can be heard in some days in the front room. Otherwise the apartment is very quiet.
We appreciated the balcony – it is a great place to unwind after a long day or to take a breakfast.
Anyway, we definitely recommend a stay at Eren’s place and we will be happy to return if we have an opportunity to do so.

Beside the spacious living room there are two bedrooms, which makes the apartment perfect for bigger groups or two couples. Thanks Eren for everything!

Their flat is situated in a good, genuine area where we felt safe and from where we found easy and quick transport. The flat itself is very clean, comfortable and artistically decorated.

I was a bit worried when I saw that the flat was on the 4th floor, but this was not a problem for us at all. At the end of our stay we all felt rested, fit and happy!

I highly recommend this lovely place.
reviews[5].comments: April's apartment is just as pictured if not better. It felt as a home away from home; even the pantry was filled with food for us to use. April's husband was gracious and helpful. The apartment is clean, functional, cozy and very convenient to the Metro station, bakeries, cafés, local restaurants and the fabulous Bomonti organic farmers market on Saturdays where we had the freshest fruits and snacked on Local Turkish delicacies, all washed down with tea. On Sunday the Bomonti flea market made for a wonderful shopping experience and some unique souvenir to take back home. The terrace was without a doubt our favorite place for breakfasts and dinners, while our girls thought the kids bedroom was the best thing about Istanbul! :) \nThank you April and Ufuk for opening\nyour home to us and for your help in making our stay a memorable one.
reviews[6].comments:
We really liked it very much to stay at April's flat. The flat is a perfect place also for a longer stay in Istanbul. It is located in a central but silent little street in Sisli. It is very large, spacious and cozily furnitured. If you like to cook on your own you find everything you need in the kitchen. We loved to sit on the roof-terrace in the early morning and in the evening, especially on the very hot days in August. 

We did not meet April personally because she were on a journey, but everything was prepared just perfectly and welcomingly. April's husband allowed us in and introduced us very friendly to everything which was necessary. 

The house is an older one and for this it has some little patina. But we didn't miss anything and we were perfectly satisfied. The flat is nicely decorated, you can really relax after an exhausting day in the city. I can really recommend April's place, also for a little family.
reviews[7].comments:
We have just arrived in London. In the last two weeks, we felt in April's flat like "Home away Home". Specially our two boys enjoyed in the kid's room with lots of toys that much that they didn't want to go out. On our arrival in Istanbul, April and her husband with their son Devrim waited for us in the bus station. We will never forget the warmest welcome we have received from them. They organised our travel card, and accompanied us to the apartment. They provided us  with all the information, so that we could enjoy our trips to Istanbul. The house was in excellent condition, nice and clean, exactly (even more than accurately) in the pictures and descriptions. She looked after us all the time. We got everything that we needed. Even she was so kind with our very late  check out time, let our kids to have rest until 22:00pm though the checkout time was 12:00pm. We just can say our staying in April's house will be always an unforgettable experience in the memory. If we go to Istanbul again in the future, definitely we will choose her house again. As a host, she is highly recommendable. Specially someone/couple with kids should not look further, just choose her house straight way.
In German: April ist eine unvergleichbare Gastgeberin, sehr emfehlenswert besonders fuer familie mit kindern.

THANK YOU SO MUCH!!
reviews[8].comments:
April was incredibly nice, friendly and dedicated. She welcomed my parents, my sister and I as we were old friends and we felt at ease very quickly. Furthermore, she was available and answered quickly when we send a message to her. 

The apartment was clean, comfortable and very convenient, perfect for a four persons family ! April terrace is just the best place in Istanbul, sooo cosy !

Finally, the apartment is located next to Osmanbey station, which is very convenient !

I highly recommend this apartment for those who have the chance to travel to Istanbul !
reviews[9].comments: What a cosy and quiet apartment! We felt at home immediately. The numerous travel guides on the table helped us to plan our days in Istanbul. And April's 'welcome-wine' helped us relax after a full day of sight seeing.
reviews[10].comments:
This was an amazing stay. April is the most helpful host, she met us at bus stop, guided to her home, and even provided with two Istanbulcards for public transport. She and her son Devrim are just great. 

Apartment is very close to Osmanbey metro station. It looks totally like shown on pictures. It has everything you may need and even more. Kitchen tongs? - yep! A screwdriver? - here it is! Adorable kids room, full of toys, is a lifesaver. Our toddler loved it. I appreciated it most, when we overslept and I had only one hour to pack, and really needed that kid to be busy :)

Neighborhood is great. Clean and comfortable, with lots of places to eat and shop. Far enough from tourist catwalks, but they're still easy reachable by foot. Our favorite spot was the War Museum, within a five-minute-walk from apartment. Biggest collection of weapons and arms in a historical building, and hardly any visitors, so you can enjoy it all for yourself. 

I should mention that there is no elevator in the building, but it may only be a problem for elderly or handicapped people. We got stroller and toddler up and down with no effort.
reviews[11].comments: It is the second time my friends and I have been guests at April's beautiful flat, and we couldn't be happier with the experience.\r\nGreat location, amazing equipment in the kitchen, good heating and hot water in the winter (which was truly precious given the weather conditions during our stay) and cosy atmosphere. Once again, the perfect choice for Istanbul!
reviews[12].comments:
We had a lovely stay at April's home! 

The apartment was quiet and comfortable and a super place to come back to after a day of exploring the city. 

April is a thoughtful and kind host. She was wonderful with communication and she left information and lots of resources about Istanbul that helped us. We arrived while she was away and she arranged for a friend to meet us and guide us to the apt on our arrival . 

The neighbourhood is close to access all city sights by metro ( maybe a two minute walk away) but far enough to be outside of tourist areas which was great. Small grocery is minutes away, lots of cafés nearby as well. 

April's son had left some toys and books out which was really appreciated by our two kids! 

Recommended stay !
reviews[13].comments: The apartment was roomy and well equipped. We had some difficulties in getting connected with April when we arrived as we had not made arrangements to have cell service. April's family was gracious and came and got us in the rain. \r\nThe location was great once we got our bearing and public transportation was pretty easy. \r\nApril had left us snacks and coffee. My granddaughter loved the children's room. We would defiantly recommend this apartment to anyone.
reviews[14].comments: Wonderful, comfortable apartment and close to the city. Everything was organised and the guides were really helpful. It was a pleasure!
reviews[15].comments: We had a wonderful, wonderful time is Istanbul, and April and Ufuk's apartment certainly played a part in it. Ufuk was kind enough to welcome us in Taksim Square as soon as we got off the airport shuttle, and to take us to the apartment with his own metro card, which he left for us to reload and use throughout the week. The apartment is ideally located, with a supermarket just a the corner of the street, and less than 3 minutes from Osmanbey metro station. April and Ufuk left us a nice bottle of red wine, and plenty of extras : we had coffee, juice, etc... The apartment is absolutely lovely (I just love the square frame in the bathroom), decorated with charm and great taste. The beds are extremely compfortable, the four of us slept like babies. And my youngest son certainly enjoyed Devrim's toys! We would definitely recommend this charming place to anyone travelling to Istanbul.
reviews[16].comments:
We have been welcomed by Ufuk, April's husband, who came to pick us up at the suttle station, and drove us in taxi until the flat. It was so nice from him. We also had the pleasure to drink a good bottle of wine offered by April, a very nice attention ! 
The flat is really nice and big. The main room is very comfortable. We were 4 people, so 2 of us slept in the kids' room, where the bed are actually not so much comfortable but it was ok. The convertible sofa in the living room is actually not for 2 persons. 
The only problem we had was the bathroom : very very low pressure (complicated to wash your hair when you are a girl with long hair !) and sometimes some bad smells (but if you keep the window open it is ok). 
Other than that, we really enjoyed the terrace, which is huge and very nice for a drink outside at night. 

The flat is located quite at the north, with the Osmanbey metro really close by. It is out of the touristic spots, wich is quite nice when you want to discover something else. We didnt really find places to eat or have a drink  in the neighbordhood; but we didnt search so much (i am sure there are some).
We really felt good in the flat. 

Thank you again April !
reviews[17].comments: April and ufuk were really nice and helpful. They had left us two metro cards, city guides, coffee, juices etc. Apartment was roomy, quiet and clean.
reviews[18].comments: Das Appartment hat uns alles geboten, was wir als Familie brauchten: Die Kinder konnten spielen, es war genügend Platz für eine Familie und alles vorhanden was wir brauchten. reviews[1].comments: Metin was great. I had arranged to have him pick me up at the airport. My flight was 2 hours late but someone was there when I arrived. The place was just as listed in Airbnb. It was nice and modern. I don't think the location could have been any better. It was on a cobblestone street about a one to 2 minute walk to Hagia Sophya. Also quite close to the blue mosque and not too far to walk to Taksin Square and the Grand Bazaar. He answered all of my questions and even responded to an email late because I had lost his address and needed it to get home. Also, he, himself, got up to take me to the airport at 5 am. I head back to Istanbul in 3 days and am hoping to stay with him again.
reviews[2].comments: This was my second stay with Metin. It was another great stay. I was treated like family and it made my short stay even better. I will certainly stay there again when I return.

reviews[4].comments: Wonderful host, who has a fantastic apartment in an optimal location. I will definitely stay here again!
reviews[5].comments: The location of this place is AMAZING. It looks over the water and main and best part of Old Town, but the entrance is opposite of the crowds and is in a cozy alley. The best of both worlds. The building is 500-600 years old and the room was so charming with a canopy bed and huge tub. And the room had AC!!! Also, there is a very large, communal room, garden area, and rooftop. No other guests were ever there when we used it--all to ourselves. The host, Metin, is very kind. Highly recommend this place!
reviews[6].comments: Metin was very good about prompt communication and welcomed everyone openly. The place was lovely and very central. We had an excellent stay!
reviews[7].comments: Magnifiquement bien placé, cet appartement est un cocon au milieu de l'hypercentre. La rue est à la fois calme et sûre.
reviews[8].comments: This apartment is great base to explore Istambul! The location is fantastic, the flat is clean, beds are comfortable and Metin and his family are always available to assist you with anything you need, at any time (including moving furniture!). We felt safe and relaxed during all our stay. The only issue is that the flat might get a bit noisy for some people (we could hear other guests both in the building and from the street), but it was never until very late, so we had a good sleep anyway. Very much recommended!
reviews[9].comments: We couldn't have found a better accommodation for our weekend in Istanbul. The house is in a nice and quiet location by the Gulhame park, yet just a few hundred metres away from Sultanhamet, very close to the tram line, restaurants and other services. The house is tiny but it worked well for us (a couple traveling with a toddler). Our kid was excited to sleep on the couch but Metin also offered a baby bed.\r\nWe found all the logistic support we could wish for by the building staff, and we only wish we could have stayed longer and had more time to connect with the owners. We will definitely come back and recommend this place.
reviews[10].comments: This place was the best! Situated in a great part of town just steps from the major sites Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, Cisterns, and Grand Bazaar.  Unit was exactly as the pictures, quaint and cozy.  Loved that just outside the door was a cafe.
reviews[11].comments:
I can only echo what other guests have said, Metin was an excellent host for our 5 night stay, and very helpful in advice on the City attractions and things like arranging an airport transfer as we were nervous arriving in a new City after dark.
The appartment and the location is as described - a historic building on Soguk Cesme street - part of the walls around the Topkapi Palace - so central that the entrance to Gulhane Park with its Archaeological Museum is at one end of the street, and Hagia Sophia further up the slope. The 'Blue Mosque' is no more than 5 minutes walk, whilst trams (to the metro/Airport connections or to Galata) and the main rail station and ferry routes (for Marmary/crossing to Asia side) are also extremely close. 
The area is served by abundant restaurants and cafe's and we were able to experience the sights and sounds of the historic centre of Old Istanbul at our leisure, without needing to worry about long journeys to and from our accomodation.
There was a little noise from the cafe outside the appartment, but certainly not enough to trouble us after many full days exploring the City we slept soundly each night!
My daughter and I would certainly go back and Metin's ayasofya house would be our first choice location!
reviews[12].comments: Perfect location and very helpful landlord. If I have the chance to come back to Istanbul one day, I will choose the same place to stay!
reviews[13].comments: Notre hôte nous assuré un transfert privé de l'aéroport à l'appartement. Nous étions attendus à notre arrivée. L'appartement est très cosy tel que décrit dans l'annonce propre et confortable (nous étions 2 adultes et 2 enfants). Il est très très bien situé à côté de la plupart des grands monuments (ayaSophia, mosquée bleue, Palace Topkapi, Parc Gulhane, Bazar Arasta, ...) station tramway à proximité ainsi que beaucoup de restaurant, café et boutique souvenirs et artisanat.  Nous avons adoré la ville et surtout la proximité de l'appartement de tous les monuments historiques. Notre hôte nous a également assuré le transfert à l'aéroport au retour. Si je reviendrai un jour à Istanbul je prendrai certainement le même logement.
reviews[14].comments: Nous avons beaucoup apprécié l'accueil très sympathique de Metin malgré notre arrivée tardive. Pour nous faciliter la vie durant notre séjour, il nous a prêté sa carte de transports en commun (tram, métro, bus, bateau-bac) que nous n'avons eu qu'à recharger de temps en temps.\r\nEt puis, évidemment, ce qui était extrêmement appréciable était la localisation de l'appartement adossé aux remparts du palais Topkapi, à 100 mètres de Sainte-Sophie, à 300 mètres de la Grande Mosquée bleue et à vingt minutes à pied du Bosphore. C'était magique. Des restaurants de toutes sortes étaient également très proches.
reviews[15].comments: Metin was great. Really helpful and friendly. Good contact beforehand and helped arrange the early morning airport taxi on our way out. Flat was perfect... very clean and well kept. We were with our 2 small children (4 &1) and everything was just as described. Great neighbourhood. Locals very friendly and a 2 minutes from Ayra Sophia and the centre but a quiet and secluded pedestrianised road (although a taxi can still get to it outside of peak times which is handy). Recommended very highly as a perfect bolt hole for a short visit.
reviews[16].comments: L'appartement est très bien situé (collé à la muraille de Topkapi), cosy, sympa. Metin est un très bon hôte ainsi que son neveu qui prenait la peine de venir nous saluer tous les matins (il a un commerce juste en bas de l'appartement). Nous avons été bien accueilli et je recommande vivement cet endroit près de pas mal de sites touristiques. \r\nSi je repars à Istanbul, je reprendrais cet appartement.
reviews[17].comments: great place to stay, all very close. I was there with my wife and three year old son, in a flat place enough for all.\r\nThe apartment fits the description. Only positive feedback.
reviews[18].comments: I booked Metin apartment for my parents whom were visiting Istanbul for the 1st time, It couldn't have been much better experience for them with Metin hospitality, help, and quick response, the apartment was so clean, not to mention its perfect location in the middle of the historical city, they actually felt at home.\nI do recommend it so much for single or couple travelers.
reviews[19].comments:
If you are coming to Istanbul to visit some of its must-visit-places, then this is the best place to stay at. Amazing location, located exactly behind Hagia Sophia and sharing the same wall with Topkapi Palace. It's located in one of a historical and famous street in Sultanahmet called Soğukçeşme (you even can find it in Wikipedia). A very decent and safe neighborhood. 24/7 there will be polices and security guards in the neighborhood, given that it is in the museum, historical and touristic area. We were given the bigger room with no extra charge. You definitely can explore Sultanahmet area (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Gulhane Park, Basilica Cistern, etc) simply by walking, even it's closer than the famous hotel you can find in the area. We (me and wife) loved this place so much! We stayed there comfortably. Highly recommended. Metin was a very kind and good host. Communication was quick and simple. He helped us a lot, such as providing and fixing an electricity plug converter, lent us a temporary simcard, and also his nephew who happened to work in the cafe besides the place was really helpful. 

Please note, that Sogukcesme street is only for pedestrian most of the time. I think its only at late night up to early morning, cars are allowed to pass. Also, you need to climb up to the house a little bit through the stairs (from the entrance of the house), which  was just one floor up. So with these, if you have a lot and big luggages, you might want to consider this. We personally had quite big luggages with us, it wasn't that big deal, since it just happened once during the checkin and Haroon (Metin's nephew) and Metin himself helped us carrying the luggages up to our room.

At night, we did hear some music played from the cafe next to the house like what other reviewers said, but it was not a disturbance to us at all.

Overall, fantastic place and host! We loved it and will definitely be back.
reviews[20].comments: Great location! We were able to walk to most of the sites. Clean and safe apartment.

reviews[2].comments:
Great location: Close to Galata tower, İstiklal avenue, the Şişhane metro stop.

Nice enough flat for the price, and the pictures are quite accurate. However, also as seen in the pictures, there’s no laptop friendly work space – even if it’s listed in the Amenities section.

We arrived to a cold flat after having some trouble finding it (the building doesn’t have a street number), and heating it up took all evening – partially because there’s a big gap under the flat’s entrance door, and the stairwell is open to the outside at all times. Which leads us to the next issue – stray cat feces and stains on the steps. It was cleaned now and then, but not nearly often enough.

The building is old and full of ‘old house noises’, from neighbors and the environment. While some of this can be charming, I would have expected other things to be in order, easy things like tightening a door bolt so that it doesn’t rattle whenever someone downstairs breathes.

All in all we’re happy enough considering how cheap the place is and its great location, but there are things we want people to know about before deciding whether to rent.

This small place is a gem in the old historic part of Istanbul--and for a great price! It was a very clean & well-kept place, in an excellent location in the old city. There were many restaurants & stores within walking distance, and it was a quick 10-minute walk to the Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet) area. 

Ms. Ece, who lives just downstairs, is the Manager of this place, has good English and was very friendly & welcoming. We were served cool juice and cookies upon our arrival and were given a good map of the area. Ms. Ece also did a great job in arranging our late night departure for the airport by a private car.

The "apartment" was small, but adequate, with not much room for your luggage, if you are two people like we were. It has a small kitchen area and bathroom, and the roof terrace was a nice touch. This is really not a full apartment, as there was also an open living area and another "apartment" (or room?) on the same floor. But it was private and comfortable. There was also good A/C (split) and internet.

I really recommend taking a taxi from the airport.  Show the driver your address and ask him how much it will cost.  It cost us 50 lira to get there.  When we left we took a taxi to the bus station and it cost us 35 lira.  Taking the tram for the first time might be a bit too much.  

The room was clean and big enough for two people.  It had a fridge and a hot plate if you choose to cook anything.  It had air conditioning which was quite nice to be able to close the window at night to block out the noises.  The building was nice as well.  We did not go on the terrace, but I'm sure it was lovely.  

The area is touristy enough that you still feel safe at night and not too secluded.  Plenty of restaurant options and little markets to buy snacks are around.  My friend and I got lost often, so I highly recommend taking photos of street names and make sure you know where you are.  The streets are confusing and sometimes there aren't street names.  

Sultan was very sweet, as well as her husband, but we mostly dealt with Ece her daughter who spoke English pretty well.  She was very sweet and very helpful with setting up a bus ticket for us, calling the taxi, etc.  A very smart young lady who has a bright future.  

I highly recommend staying here and hope maybe someday I can go back.
reviews[6].comments: We had a wonderful stay with Sultan. The room was clean and in a great location of the city. Our hosts were lovely-they were incredibly communicative and kind, and were helpful in all regards. We would stay again. Thank you!

reviews[8].comments: Sultan and here daughter were great hosts as I requested last minute. Communication and arrival were smooth. She even brought us coffee and cookies! We checked out very early (3:30) and Sultan woke to send us on our way back to the US.
reviews[9].comments: Wonderful! Book it, you won't regret it. Perfect room for two people with a giant wardrobe, super comfy beds and a beautiful terrace and roof access in a stellar location in Old Town area. Sultan and her daughter were so kind bringing my sister and I a welcome snack of Turkish coffee and candied almonds. They were perfect hosts and very helpful. It's not very large but it's everything you need to lay your things, sleep well and take a nice shower. Wifi runs very fast, too. So close to Blue Mosque and Hagria Sophia and the Grand Bazaar area. Perfect to explore those sights. Highly recommend! We really enjoyed our time.
reviews[10].comments: Superb! Sultan and her daughter Ece are great hosts. We got a map of Istanbul and also some good tips where to go. They also organized the transfer from and to the airport for us. The room was nice, clean, ideal for two people in a great location really close to the historic center. The kitchen and bathroom are quite well equipped. We had towels,shower gel and shampoo and even slippers at the disposal. We really enjoyed our stay there. Highly recommend! Thank you for nice time.
reviews[11].comments: Very welcoming hosts, Sultan and her daughter. They provided me with a map of the Sultanahmet and recommendations for places to go and things to see. The room was fantastic, the top floor of their building, lots of light, patio overlooking a schoolyard. The apartment is literally a 5 minute walk to the center of the Sultanahmet. You might need a GPS to find it initially, but after that, it's all good. It's close to numerous little eateries and stores, as well as Little Aya Sofia. The people in the neighborhood were very friendly. I got lost looking for the street and a local man kindly used his iPhone to get me there. The wifi worked great, the bathroom was very clean and the hot water came up immediately. The bed was comfy. Sultan was also very accommodating about my early arrival; I was able to check in at 8:30 am. I would certainly stay here again and recommend it to my friends.
