reviews[13].comments: Very Nice room with friendly host.
reviews[14].comments: The location of the hotel is perfect, very central. When we arrived, it appeared that the person who lived in the room before us, stayed for one more night. We haven't been informed about it before and we were very unhappy about this fact. However Sultan and her husband dealt with this problem well. They did the following to make it up to us: for the night of the double booking we have been relocated to a better hotel. The day after when we came back to the hotel they gave us an  upgraded room and a bottle of wine. Hence all in all we were satisfied with how they dealt with the issue. Our apartment was very clean and functional. This place can be recommended and we will be back if we are in Istanbul.
reviews[15].comments: Sultan and her daughter, Ece, were like old friends, since we had stayed here back in July 2014. Their location is ideal for visiting the historic Sultanahmet area of Istanbul. They were very welcoming & helpful all-around. Wonderful hosts!
reviews[16].comments:
The room is as pictured - it is small but comfy! Enough room to walk around if you're a couple and more bedspace if you're on your own. Sultan's family live in the apartment right below, so you will always get assistance should you require it. The apartment is close to all the historical sites in the old city (about 7 minutes walk to the blue mosque and Hagia Sophia). Sultan's family members are warm and welcoming and gives great suggestions on where to eat, what to do and where to go, should you ever need some help. 

I would totally recommend this place if you want a no-frills kinda place to sleep in for the night. And because it's so close by to great food joints and the historical sites, it's easy to head back to the apartment for a quick cat nap or rest before moving on to other parts of Istanbul. 

They also do daily clean up of the room, just like hotels, but you can tell them to not disturb the room should you not want the service. 

If I'm ever back in Istanbul, I'll definitely go back to this apartment. Thank you for a wonderful stay! xx
reviews[17].comments: Wonderful.a warm, clean and tiny (Website hidden by Airbnb) just takes 10 minutes to blue mosque, Sophia, old palace by foot.
reviews[18].comments: Yes our hostess made us feel welcome. We were greeted when we arrived around 4:30 and we had not given her a good arrival time. The room was clean and orderly and we had everything we needed. It is a quaint neighborhood with many small reasonable restaurants and shops nearby. It is about a 15 minute walk to the big tourist attractions - the Blue Mosque and the Haya Sofia. \r\n
reviews[19].comments: The room is quite small but it has everything you may need. Very good location - close to Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia; there are souvenir shops nearby and some nice restaurants and little supermarkets around. The members of Sultan's family were very nice and helpful. I really appreciate their help with organizing a taxi for us at 5 a.m. to the airport. Sultan's daughter Ece Nur was helping with everything we needed. A nice place to stay in Istanbul!
reviews[20].comments: Sultan is a very good host. She helped us to return our wifi device. And her daughter told us a lot of information about Istanbul at the first night. They also provided a book which is very useful. And the location is good. It's not far away from  the historical interest. And also good restaurant nearby. :)
reviews[21].comments: Sultan organised transport from the airport and that worked fine.\r\nWhen we arrived he came to our room and he and his daughter made us feel welcome with suggestions and a map. If you have read the other revues you will know that the room is quite small. However it is well equipped with everything you could need. It has a large window with door leading to a small balcony so it does not seem claustrophobic in any way. One evening we  took our drinks up to the roof terrace which was fascinating. The view is not beautiful but very interesting. When the call to prayer comes it is an amazing sound with so many mosques nearby.  The location of the hotel is excellent with lots going on nearby. We loved the fish restaurant area in Sultanahmet.
reviews[22].comments:
My experience at Sultan's place was very pleasant. We were received by Sultan's daughter Ece who was super helpful and gave us a lot of tips about the city.

Location: very well located within the Sultanahmet area, minutes away from the main landmarks.
Room: the room is super clean and comfy and has everything you may need. Only comment is that it's quite small, so you won't want to spend a lot of time in there.
Hosts: super nice. They even gave us a public transportation card that allows you to use the tram at half the price.

In summary, we had a great Istanbul experience.
reviews[23].comments: Sultan and her family were wonderful hosts for our three nights in Istanbul. The view from the rooftop terrace was unforgettable, and it we will never forget having Turkish coffee and sweets, made by our host, sitting up on the roof with them and watching the sunset! The location is perfect for seeing the sights, and there are many great food options in the area. Thanks so much for being so generous and kind during the entire trip. We would love to see you again if we come back to istanbul someday!
reviews[24].comments: Sultan and her family were wonderful hosts -helped us with airport transfers, gave us a map and some tips where to go and made us feel at home. Room itself is as shown and very, very clean - they even cleaned and tided for us when we were out. Location is perfect - a five minute walk from Sultanahment but far enough away to be outside of the mega tourist zone and in an authentic Turkish neighbourhood where you can dig out some great places to eat.
reviews[25].comments: We had a wonderful stay at Sultan's apartment! The room is very cozy and clean. Excellent location with access to the Blue Mosque within 10-min walking and tons of restaurants & shops nearby. Sultan and her families were very friendly. Her brother welcomed us in and gave us lots of good travel advice. Our three-day itinerary was pretty much based on the route he suggested. We also had wonderful chats with Sultan's daughter at nights. Btw the view from the roof top is absolutely AMAZING!!! You have to see it to believe it! I highly recommend Sultan's place!
reviews[26].comments: Hosts were very friendly and welcoming. They showed us a map of the area to help us get our bearings. They also helped to organize taxis and make dinner reservations for us. Neighbour is centrally located to all the main attractions. Nice room for 2 people with a good shower.
reviews[27].comments: Ece was an excellent host. Right from the moment we had made the booking, Ece reached out to help us organise our arrival as well as proposing some options for getting to the apartment from the airport. We arrived quite late and Ece was nonetheless there to offer a warm welcome, get us settled. Throughout our stay, we received tips and recommendations about what to see and where to eat. The location is excellent, just a short walk from the Blue Mosque and other attractions. The apartment was super clean and comfortable and on a calm street considering the central location. Towels, sheets and even a travel guide were provided! Great value accommodation and very friendly hosts.
reviews[28].comments: We found this apartment to be very clean and comfortable, and the owners were very professional about everything, providing a book about Istanbul and a map. The room had means for cooking, good clean shower, cosy, etc.. It's in a great location, one way going up to the Blue mosque, the other going into some interesting local streets. There are some decent looking bars and restaurants within a minutes walk. The tram line is 5-10mins walk away (near Blue Mosque), which makes everything fairly accessible. We enjoyed walking the mile or so to the ferry and crossing over to the asian side for food and a walk about. The family owners are friendly and helpful. We had a nice stay in Istanbul.
reviews[29].comments: Bedirhan is a great host, I spent good days in his place
reviews[30].comments:
Acceuil très professionnel et cordial par Ece, cependant elle ne cherche pas à échanger davantage, et accueil très sympatique par son frère qui nous a donné quelques bons plans pour nos visites. 
l'appartement est petit mais confortable et équipé.
il ets situé dans une rue vers la mosque petite STe Sophie, à minutes de la mosquée bleue. Le quartier est toujours bien animé et les gens y sont très sympatiques.
Il nous a paru surprenant pour un Airbnb que quelqu'un rentre dans notre chambre pendant notre absence. 
Bon rapport qualité prix, dommage que l'accueil d'Ece manque de spontanéité et de chaleur.
reviews[31].comments:
First of all, I am going to say that I am so glad that I found this little gem of a place on AirBnB. Right from the first moment, Sultan's daughter Ece took great care of us, bringing us a map and a guide to Istanbul. She went over our itinerary with us and would chat with us almost daily asking us about our day and giving us advice. She was even available on (Hidden by Airbnb) if we had doubts about prices at Grand Bazaar and such!
The room is beautiful! It is very stylishly decorated and very cozy. The room had counterspace, provision to make tea or coffee and even an electric stove. Like most other hotel rooms in the area, it has less square footage but it is not a problem if you are spending the day sightseeing anyways. The room has a balcony as well and at no point we felt that we were cramped. The bathroom was cleaned daily and served its purpose. Just outside the room is a lobby and you can see the picture of that with a spiral staircase. They keep the fridge filled with bottled water that you can take anytime. Ece gave us a tour of the building as well later to show us their backyard and cute fruit trees. It was overall a very clean, cozy space and we thoroughly enjoyed staying at Bright Apartments.
The biggest selling point of this place is the location! It is a 10 min walk to Sultanahmet square and the places of historical importance. The tram station is also right there near the Blue mosque and made traveling very easy. Ece had explained to us about the tram system and all the trains available to places of importance. There are also restaurants, and Arasta Bazaar and some decent bars close by if you want to dine somewhere close by to the hotel after a long day of sightseeing. There are shared shuttles also available very close by to and from airports if you dont want a private transfer. Very convenient.
Overall, it was a great experience staying here and we thank you for making our visit so memorable!
reviews[32].comments: Sultan's delightful daughter, Ece, speaks fluent English and was most welcoming. She spent a few minutes giving us an orientation to the area and explained things within the apartment.  Sultan, her daughter and mother treated us to Turkish tea and cake two of the nights we were there, on their rooftop terrace.
reviews[33].comments: A anfitriã e sua filha foram extremamente amáveis e atenciosas. Mantiveram o apartamento sempre limpo, trocando diariamente as toalhas. A única ressalva é quanto à área do apartamento que é menor do que parece ser no anúncio.\r\nO bairro é bem localizado no lugar mais turístico de Istanbul, a poucas quadras da praça principal da cidade.
reviews[34].comments: Nice place and amazing experience
reviews[35].comments: Sultan was a great host very welcoming. I stayed for 10 nights. Located in a very peaceful area ,very quiet and very safe. The room was very clean and had everything I needed.
reviews[36].comments: Adequate place in a great location. Sultan and Ece were excellent hosts. The room was cleaned daily and had various appliances for you to use. The balcony overlooking the school yard was a nice addition to the room. We had a great stay at Sultan's place and would recommend it to anyone who wants to explore beautiful Istanbul.
reviews[37].comments:
My mate and i had a great stay with Sultan, Ece and their family.
We arrived just past midday, and was greeted by Sultan and her son, who was able to provide us with a map and explain things to do in Istanbul. We met Ece later that night after she finished school.
The room was as described, but what really makes this AirBNB great is the people. Sultan doesn't speak much English, but is always friendly, smiling and helpful. Ece speaks great English, and was extremely generous and chatty. Although still in high school, i can already see that Ece has a bright future in the travel industry, or as an English school teacher - as long as she puts her mind to it. (She was teaching me Turkish while i was helping trying to explain high school maths to her)
Thanks to Sultan, Ece and their family for the wonderful stay. Will definitely be back next time I'm in Istanbul!
reviews[38].comments: Great location and clean.
reviews[39].comments: Sultana et sa famille ont été accueillants, et disponibles en cas de questions. La chambre est propre et bien équipée.\r\nAttention cependant au plan (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps qui n'indique pas le bon endroit: nous avons mis du temps à trouver la chambre!
reviews[40].comments: The apartment that we received was not the one that we had reserved online, but it was very similar. The place has a very good location close to Sultanahmet and to the tram line that brings over to the Beyoglu (Kabatac). \r\nThe apartment was cleaned every day so it was like a hotel. Sultan and her family was very kind, they did everything to make our stay comfortable. This place is recommended.
reviews[41].comments: The room look exactly as the pictures shown. 10mins walk to main attractions like the Hagia Sophia, Blue mosque and etc. Ece and her family are very welcoming and friendly. Communication was easy through (Hidden by Airbnb) .
reviews[42].comments: Merci pour tout! l'accueil, le quartier, les réponses aux questions, l'arrangement... tout était super.\r\nMerci à Ece, la fille de Sultan, qui a pu me rendre un super service et m'indiquer ce qu'il y avait de mieux à faire à Istanbul. \r\nJe recommande!
reviews[43].comments: I had the pleasure of staying at Sultan's place for two weeks. I am a girl travelling alone and I could say this place is pretty safe. The room is super clean, and very well equipped. There are close supermarkets and restaurants so you can find anything you need. The room is a bit smaller than it seems in the picture, so if you are two people it might be a little snug, but if you are alone it is perfectly fine. The hosts are super friendly, communicative, and available. I definitely recommend this place and would stay there again if I visit in the future.
reviews[44].comments: Отличное место для проживания для не требовательного туриста. В "квартире" есть все что требуется для проживания. Посуда, микроволновка, чайник. Чистое постельное белье. Удобная терраса на крыше. Очень доброжелательные хозяева. WI-FI стабильный, были проблемы только в один из 6 дней. Фото туалета не соответствует действительности. Там нет душевой кабины.
reviews[45].comments: Un appartement vraiment très bien situé dans la ville ! Nous avons été très bien accueillis avec des conseils de lieux à visiter. Je vous le recommande !
reviews[46].comments: The place we stayed at was a snug double room that was close to Sultanahmet and Ayasofya. The neighborhood was safe and offered quality food at good prices. Everything you need is in the room: cooking amenities, TV, fridge. The hosts were very welcoming and answered all of our questions. Very good customer service.
reviews[47].comments: We had a pleasant stay! The apartment is very central, we walked everywhere and several main attractions are within 5-10 minutes. The rooftop is perfect for breakfast. The shower was different from the one pictured but it was not an issue.\nThe room was very clean. Not large but it suited us well and had all we needed! We got good service with the check-in, good tips for experiencing the neighborhood, and very responsive communication!
reviews[48].comments: La ubicaçión es muy buena para recorrer los puntos principales del centro historico de Istanbul. Es un barrio tranquilo y pintoresco. Ece siempre esta atenta y dispuesta ayudar en todo. Un 10.
reviews[49].comments: Apartments are in the Old City. Way to the Blue mosque takes no more than 10 minutes. Excellent arrangement! Apartments are small, but there are everything that it is necessary for you here. Everything is serviceable and clean. Owners clean the apt every day. The hostess is very benevolent, always in touch and helps with a case of emergence of questions. Before New Year we got a compliment from the hostess - a bottle of wine and fruits. We have been pleasantly surprised! Wifi worked well. From minuses - the subway and the tram is far, it is necessary to go to them on stone blocks on hills. It is inconvenient with freight in hands.
reviews[50].comments: Connection is well, location is great, around 5-7 minutes to Blue Mosque. There is all what you need for staying. on the roof there is a small terrace where you can have breakfast or dinner, drink coffee, surfing a Internet (wi-fi is stable).
reviews[51].comments: This is such a fantastic little apartment. It is small but was enough space for my friend and I. The room has a kitchenette which was very handy for quick, simple meals. But the terrace! That terrace is amazing and I miss it already. The apt is located in a great part of town, ten minutes to the main sights and restaurants. Sultan is very hospitable and kind. I highly recommend this flat if you're looking for a place in Instabul
reviews[52].comments: We spent a great time in Istanbul. The apartment is well located, though streets around are very steep. Edge is a great host, and arranged transportation from and to airport. The place is really small and we could not find a place for our suitcases. (Had to put them under the table) The main problem for us was the bathroom. It is quite different from the one on the  picture. It is too small and has no curtain, so when you take a shower everything gets wet. On the other hand, It has a tiny balcony, where we could take the two chairs and enjoy a beautiful view. Nice terrace to have a drink (a bit difficult to get there).  Lots of shops and restaurants nearby.
reviews[53].comments: It`s a pretty clean room with good location. The room is quite small but has its own balcony. \nSultan and all her family are very responsive and friendly people ready to help you in any case.\nThe minus is not strong wi-fi quality.
reviews[54].comments: Спасибо большое за гостепреимство. проживание в этом апарт-отеле понравилось. номер на 1-2 человек подходит. ванная комната не соответствует фото (в других отзывах это есть: нет душевой кабины). но во многих квартирах турции ванные комнаты именно такие. мне было вполне комфортно, т.к. сталкиваюсь с этим не первый раз. Султанахмет в 10 минутах ходьбы. требавательным туристам нужны пятизвездочные отели. аппарт-отели такого типа для нетребовательного туриста. мне все понравилось. чувствовала себя с сыном как дома. следующая поездка - именно сюда. Sultan, Ece - большой привет вам из России.;)

Ceylan a été une hôte extrêmement agréable et accueillante. Malheureusement je ne suis restée chez elle qu'une seule nuit, mais elle m'a attendu jusque tard dans la soirée pour faire ma connaissance, me donner les clés, me faire faire le tour de l'appartement et me proposer des guides et autres cartes pour mes visites du lendemain. J’étais vraiment contente qu'elle me recommande des petits restaurants hyper typiques, que je n'avais vu dans aucun de mes guides! De plus, pour moi qui adore marcher, la location de l'appartement - a 2 minutes de Taksim - était parfaite pour visiter tout Istanbul en se baladant.
L'appartement de Ceylan ressemble exactement a ses photos: il est très beau, épuré, et lumineux. Le bonheur, ça a été de pouvoir prendre un thé et fumer une cigarette sur sa terrasse au soleil le matin. La chambre était très bien aussi, très cosy! Et très important: le lit était confortable et j'ai très très bien dormi chez Ceylan. 
La situation de l'appartement 
Comme je le disais a Ceylan, mon séjour chez elle a vraiment représenté tout ce que j'attends de AirBNB: de belles rencontres et un moyen de découvrir de nouvelles villes différemment. Je recommande chaudement l’appartement de Ceylan, qui je dois le préciser est a un prix très raisonnable par rapport a sa location et son confort.

Do not make the same mistake i made, as i got lost in those streets and started freaking out. Put the building number as well while trying to find the flat and you will see it is located right below the main road (Gumussuyu) next to five star hotels. The proximity of the flat to the transport links dazzled me once i went out to discover the vicinity. The restaurants, bars, shops, everything is within 10 min walk tops. I stayed in the smallest room in Ceylan's flat and it was good for one night stay. However if you have a massive suitcase, i would strongly advise you to book one of the larger ones, i have seen them, quite beautifully decorated and spacious, as you may not fit your suitcase in the tiny room. Ceylan was great, literally went out of her way to get me the keys, postponing her plans to meet up with me at a place of my convenience. reviews[1].comments:
I booked Cesim's place for a group of 8 people but 2 didn't make it so the apartment was extra spacious for us. The upper floor actually consists of two smaller flats, each with a bathroom but only one containing the kitchen. This situation was positive in some ways, and if we had any issue with the separate keys (as sometimes we'd split up), Cesim was able to help us with access.

The beds were of a good standard, though one of them (next to the kitchen area) was subject to direct sunlight because there was no curtain there. However, as we were visiting in winter there was darkness throughout the times we wanted to sleep. The bathrooms are a good size, especially in Room 8.  The kitchen was adequate and there is a shop directly opposite where anything we needed was readily available.

The location is ideal as a launchpad for the Sultanahmet area and there are some decent and affordable cafes/restaurants on the same street. You should keep in mind that the street can be fairly noisy in the morning, and the other side can be noisy for other reasons (such as birds!). If you're a heavy sleeper then you'll have no problem.

Overall I was very pleased with the apartment and especially with Cesim's kind welcome and his help when I faced a few personal difficulties. Thank you!
reviews[2].comments: Good place, Cesim is very friendly and helpful\nlocation is good and walking distance from the main tourism areas in Istanbul.

In three words: loved this place!

Aral was a friendly and hospitable host.  He lives next door in a detached house and was always happy to help us, provided spare toilet paper when we ran out, etc.  Originally, I was concerned about the proximity of the two houses as my fiancee and I wanted a private place to unwind for a few days after a hectic trip, and we didn't want to be bothered.  Totally needless worry as Aral probably guessed our intentions and played it cool =).

The house itself was fantastic and the photos don't do it justice.  It looks like a cabin on the outside, but actually it's a complete and newly renovated home with a washer, dishwasher, full bath, good wifi, brand new windows and bathtub with water jets.  Lacks an oven/range as well as a dryer, but there's a big George Foreman-style grill that you can use.  Beautiful wood cabinetry and floors everywhere, and there's even a real live tree growing in the middle of the house.  (In case you're concerned, there weren't any bugs.)

The location was also great for us, far away from the island's town center and way uphill in a completely residential area with no foreigners.  Buyukada has become overrun tourists in the past decade or two, but Aral's place is completely isolated from that.  I'd say it's a 10-15 minute walk downhill to the town center.  I think that you can use one of the ubiquitous horse-drawn carriages, but we love walking so we went by foot.

One more comment regarding the first photo that's visible on the listing as of 9/15/2014.  The photo is kind of weird and makes the house appear as if it's not detached.  I want to assure you that the building is totally separate, and to the left of the house toward the back (not visible in the photo) is the backyard of the neighboring house that Aral lives in.  There are very effective shutters for all the windows.

If you're looking for privacy and a getaway from hectic Istanbul, rest assured, look no further.

I was admittedly skeptical upon booking the flat as such a low price for such a great view and location couldn't be true...but this place is spectacular.  The room is very nicely sized for 2 quests; the bed is quite comfortable; the bathroom modern and nicely lit...and the view is just amazing.  A true panoramic view of the Bosphorus and Topkapi, the Blue Mosque, etc... and you see it from sunrise to sunset.  The south facing floor to ceiling windows slide open and the west facing bamk of windows open to provide a nice cross breeze (but it's nice there's an ac unit as the sun heats up this top-floor room).

And Ali is a wonderful host.  He made check-in rather quick and was very available when needed.  (The elevator didn't work one morning and upon telling Ali this he hopped on the phone and we arrived back to the flat after lunch to a working lift.)

And the location is fantastic.  There are several nearby restaurants and cafes and attractions...and it's a great jumping-off point for those who like to walk.  That said, it's difficult to find if you don't know the area, but once there it's easy to arrive at.  Also, it is a place for walkers as it rests at the bottom of a hill on a cobble-stone street.

I cannot recommend this location enough and I hope to be fortunate enough to return.
reviews[17].comments: Excellent communication from Ali who, in addition to providing information on the neighborhood, graciously assisted us in solving an issue with our taxi when the road was temporarily blocked.  He walked some blocks away to find the cab and suggested a detour to the driver so we could make our flight.  Neighborhood is quiet and safe, filled with coffee houses, family groceries, and small restaurants.  Outstanding location, very close to Istiklal Caddesi, Galata Tower, 11 minute walk to the Galata Bridge, and short walk to public transportation.  Flat is quite comfortable and the view is amazing.  Highly recommend!
reviews[18].comments: The view from the flat is beautiful. It is a good space for two people, and the neighborhood is very well located near lots of restaurants and transit options.
reviews[19].comments: I warmly recommande the place: near to transfers, near to shops, bars, clubs .... Clean, easy to approach. The view from the flat is amazing!!
reviews[20].comments:
First off, the view from the floor to ceiling windows in the penthouse apartment was spectacular, amazing views over the Bosphorus to Asia and across the Golden Horn to old Istanbul. Absolutely fantastic. 
The neighbourhood is great, a really hip and young area with great bars, restaurants and shopping all within 5-15 min walk from the flat. Loads of quirky boutique shops for clothes, accessories etc on the same street, and some great little coffee shops that do lovely breakfast. 
Definitely the less tourist end of Istanbul, and a short (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) min uber ride across the Golden Horn to all the major tourist sites. 
Ali was a great host, perfect comms, came out to meet us when (Hidden by Airbnb) maps and the taxi driver could only get us to within 50m of the apartment. Had some good recommendations, very approachable and friendly and charming.
Apartment was an open plan area, perfect space for a couple for a long weekend, had all the amenities needed for a pleasant stay.
reviews[21].comments: Thanks very much Ali for the very comfortable apartment and especially for your availability to the late check-in on Tuesday night. It was a very nice flat with a beautiful view, we've enjoyed it! The coach and the bed were comfortable, the shower was perfect, the decoration was nice. The location was perfect in a very cool street in an authentic neighborhood with different kind of boutiques and cute little coffee places. Thanks again and I will definitely recommend your flat! Best, Pauline and giacomo
reviews[22].comments:
Thanks so much for a wonderful stay! The view really is as good or better than the pictures, exactly what we were looking for.

Details are so important, and this place has them - no dust, lovely selection of soaps, clean fridge etc...was very pleased overall.

Ali Bey was there to warmly welcome us and was extremely helpful. How do I buy this apartment?! :)
reviews[23].comments: Nice STUDIO, please note that there is only 1 room for the whole apt. Super nice views and comfortable apt! Thanks for the stay!
reviews[24].comments: Ali was very correct and pleasant host. He asked us for arrival information beforehand, recommended how to get to the location with minimal expences.\nThe flat is not very high in cellings, but spacy enought for couple. We concider it to be a true romantic place. The panoramic view of Bosphorus, location near Galata Tover and metro are worth to come back here again. Very positive impressions from both of us!
reviews[25].comments: The host canceled this reservation 43 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[26].comments: Beautiful location. Unbeatable views of the Bosphorus. Would definitely stay again! Thanks for a wonderful stay and great hospitality.
reviews[27].comments: I have had the pleasure of having stayed in here. ALI is a wonderful host and the location is fantastic. Loved the fact it is peaceful - yet so close to everything. It is my first time in Istanbul and definitely God willing not my last. Recommending anyone looking at places to have a peak at this place.
reviews[28].comments: We have great time in Istanbol and this place was wonderful with great view have nice balcony.\nAnd Ali was great man very very kindly , he always help us when we need a help.
reviews[29].comments: This is a nice little place very close to Istanbul's main shopping street with fantastic views over the Bosphorus. The bed is comfortable and supportive. Would have been nice to have a proper duvet though. The aircon works well - and is needed as relief from the August steam outside. Just missing a nice balcony but generally good value for money.
reviews[30].comments: We enjoyed the amazing view from high up and that we could open the window doors. Sadly there is a lot of trash and construction stuff right outside. And some men were working there. It really scared us when we had one of them on the roof right outside our window door, since we didn’t know they would be there. We felt our privacy was completely invaded. We wished Ali told us about the construction and the men being there. \nThe kitchen was well stocked and equipped, however we were missing dish soap. After telling Ali that there was no dish or hand soap, the cleaning lady brought us some hand soap the next morning but no dish soap. Some other things that were disappointing was the weak wifi, low water pressure in the shower, the last day of our stay the water and power went out altogether and one of the blinds broke.
reviews[31].comments: Clean, great view, fantastic host, central location! Highly recommend it!
reviews[32].comments: Everything is great
reviews[33].comments: Super locatie en echt adembenemend uitzicht! Het appartement zelf is heel schoon en heeft alles wat je nodig hebt :)
reviews[34].comments: Location is perfect... and what a view!!!
reviews[35].comments: 5 stars cant even begin to describe the view from this apartment. Beyond amazing, it took this trip to the next level. \n\nThe place was clean and perfect for our stay. And the bed is ultra comfortable for those long hill walks. Great location and easy to find. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to travel to Istanbul.
reviews[36].comments: On the plus side, the flat is very nicely located near Galata and the view is amazing. Sadly, on the downside the host was not comprehensive at all as regards our delayed flight (we had to book a hotel for the first night) and the constant noise in the ceiling of the flat because of mice (or birds according to the "expert" who came to check). This was my first lower than average experience in Airbnb. I would still recommend the flat if these elements change in the future.
reviews[37].comments: A unos pasos de Galata y de zona comercial con tiendas y restaurantes, muy cerca del metro con una vista increíble a 10min del centro en taxi.
reviews[38].comments: Ali’s apartment offered a beautiful view of the Asian side of Istanbul as well as the main sights. The apartment was nice and served us well for our 3 night stay in Istanbul. Ali was q great host and responded quickly to all messages.
reviews[39].comments: The view from Ali’s Apartment was even better than anticipated! Absolutely stunning and is an outstanding feature of the studio with views of the Bosphorus as well and the Blue Mosque! The studio is spacious and very contemporary. Perfect location a mins walk from the Galata Tower and close to shops. Highly recommended!
reviews[40].comments: What can I say, great apartment with the most amazing view!  The apartment is stylishly decorated and the bed very comfortable. Ali was so accommodating and made checking in so easy.  Very close to Galata tower and great coffee shops and of course our favourite bar the Tower Pub!  A great stay, thank you Ali.
reviews[41].comments: We have truly enjoyed our stay in Istanbul in Ali's apartment. It is located in a quiet, charming, picturesque, delightful and well-connected area. The flat is clean, comfortable and provided with all required facilities. In addition, it has a breathtaking view of the city; one can see the Bosporus, Uskudar, Hagia Sofia and the Blue Mosque, among others, all at the same time.\nOn top of it, Ali is a wonderful host; he is always available, easily reachable and ready to help with any inconvenience one may encounter.\nWe fully recommend Ali to anybody who wants to enjoy Istanbul to the fullest.
reviews[42].comments:
A dream come true. 

If you like mainstream anonymous package TOURIST hotels, this is not for you. 

If, however, you are a TRAVELLER with a soft spot for comfort and modern style in an authentically renovated historic building, you will LOVE this place. 

I will come back if I may.
reviews[43].comments: We stayed here in July 2018. The location is excellent (it is hilly though) - <5min to the metro underground and 7min to the tram. The neighborhood is stylish and filled with cafes and cute shops. The closest market is 2 min away and will have everything you need (water, coffee, drinks, snacks). It's a 10 min walk from one of the nicest hamams in the city. As everyone has already said, the views are truly unbelievable. The a.c. works well. There is a 5 star hotel nearby with the same views that charges 2-3x so amazing value. Ali is really nice and responds super quickly.  I'd definitely recommend this space
reviews[44].comments: Could not have stayed in a better place.  The view from the flat is incredible and the memories of sitting out on the window ledge overlooking will sit long in the memory.  Add to that an amazing location and an excellent host.  Highly recommended.
reviews[45].comments: Perfect location, super nice little flat with million dollar view! I recommend! Thanks a lot Ali
reviews[46].comments: The apartment is perfect for a single our couple stay, with magnificent view!
reviews[47].comments: We felt like we hit the jackpot with Ali’s place. Every day we would look out at the view and think how beautiful it was. And the neighborhood is great. So many cute and stylish shops and restaurants, and very walkable to galeta tower, karakoy ferry, subway, istiklal street. Ali was there to let us in, and was quick to respond to any communication.  He’s a very nice and genial guy. I would highly recommend this place.
reviews[48].comments: Beautiful apartment in an excellent location!
reviews[49].comments: Upon arrival and first stepping into the studio apartment the view takes your breath away.  The bed is very comfy. We sat for hours on a night time watching the ships travel up and down the Bosphorus. The photos of the apartment do not do this airbnb the justice it deserves which is very beautiful. Local area of the apartment is very friendly with some great breakfast locations nearby. The location is very centralized for most attractions in Istanbul. Thank you for having us and hope to be back in the near future.
reviews[50].comments: Great host I will go back again if I'm ever in Istanbul
reviews[51].comments: Great city, great apartment, great location and nice host. I will book again when I am in Istanbul.
reviews[52].comments: Amazing location and amazing host. Near Istiklal, near Galata tower, and near key transportation ports. Most of all, the neighbourhood is an up and coming hip area. There are amazing local shops selling unique art and goods. Also, there are some great local places to grab a traditional Turkish meal with a modern twist. I'll definitely stay here again when I return to Turkey!
reviews[53].comments: My husband and I stayed at Ali’s place for 4 nights. This was our first time in Istanbul and Ali’s place made the stay exceptional with the breathtaking views, elevator, A/C etc. From Ataturk airport to Ali’s place it took about 40-50mins due to rush hour (7pm). Ask to use the meters as the taxi drivers will give you a fix price which is much higher than the meter price. Once we got to Ali’s place there were a lot of shops/restaurants/cash exchange offices nearby. His place is near the Galata Tower. It’s pretty easy to get around in the area and walkable. We definitely recommend this place and will stay here again.
reviews[54].comments: A very comfortable apartment, in a great location close to Galata tower and lots of restaurants. The highlight of the apartment is the fantastic view. The lift was good so we didn’t have to carry heavy bags up the stairs. \nAli was very helpful organising transfers to and from the airport.
reviews[55].comments: Ali’s apartment is located within 3 minutes from the Galata Tower. Panoramic view of the Bosphorus, Topkapi Palace, Haghia Sophia, the Golden Horn, and the Blue Mosque was breathless from his living room. Located close to shops, restaurants and cafés. Taxsim Square is a hop with the street car, too. Ali is an excellent host, gentleman and punctual. I will definitely be back again.
reviews[56].comments: Despite our extremely late arrival to Istanbul, Ali went out of his way to meet us at the apartment at approximately 0100AM. Great communication and always available since he typically works out of an office adjacent to the flat. The view from the penthouse apartment was incredible. The location is also prime as you can easily walk (10 min or less) to all the restaurants, cafes and shopping on Istiklal and Karakoy (port/down by the water). It is at the same time a quite residential area. Also if your up to it, walking to Old Town isn’t terrible and takes about 40 minutes across the Galata Bridge.  While we never used the kitchen, you could easily make breakfast or sandwiches as there are electric kettles, pans, cooktops and dish sets. Very enjoyable and a great value. Will stay with Ali the next time we visit Istanbul. Also, if you are just thinking about a Turkish holiday my advice is to do it. Amazing ancient sites, museums, food and people. More importantly, I always felt safe, just use common sense. Cheers and safe travels.
reviews[57].comments: A stylish, studio apartment with truly spectacular views.\nWell equipped kitchenette and good shower room.  Very useful lift up from ground floor. Really great location, convenient for transport, bars , cafes and restaurant.
reviews[58].comments: the location is perfect as there are many options to help you seeing Istanbul (walking distance to Galata Tower & Istiklal Cad.). Viewing Bosphorus from the apartment is fantastic, esp. at night, plus the elevator helps a lot. The host is also a nice guy.
reviews[59].comments: 这个位置和楼层很棒,可以看到博斯普鲁斯海峡,无论是日出还是日落都无与伦比的美丽｡而且有电梯,省去了搬运上下楼梯的辛苦｡有基本的厨房用品,自己买点煮煮吃吃,很舒服｡\n有两个我个人认为略有不便的地方,一个是因为房子地处高处,这里都是台阶路,最好出租车送你到门口,不然自己带行李爬坡很辛苦｡另外一个是房间里没有洗衣机,如果你住多日,还是要找房东楼下办公室去洗衣服,不太方便｡还有床太软了,不过床品很舒服｡
reviews[60].comments:
As others have said, it’s an amazing view. I say stay for the view if nothing else. It’s spectacular. 

The apartment is on a very steep hill which leads to a vibrant area with lots of cafes and shops.

Be careful when you depart the metro station as there are several exits, some far from the apartment and it makes it difficult to find if you take the wrong exit. We had the address but no one we asked had ever heard of the street so it took us some time to find. We are long time world travellers so it’s not like we are new to finding remote places. Do be sure to get detailed directions from the host in case you take the wrong exit. If you take the right one, it’s very easy to find the flat.

Both metro and tram are close by but we preferred the tram as you get to see where you are going and it’s at the bottom of the hill as opposed to a steep climb to the top for the metro!

Istiklal is very nearby and an exciting street for strolling in the evening.

Lastly, the bed is extremely comfortable and this is not always the case when you are travelling!
reviews[61].comments: Ali was extremely super host and he was very helpful
reviews[62].comments: This a great flat, close to Galata Tower. Well appointed, beautiful views, in a lovely building. Ali was super helpful and very welcoming. *****
reviews[63].comments:
It's hard to imagine there's a better spot in Istanbul than Ali's apartment. Not only is it extremely well located in (much less touristy) Galata, but the view alone is worth every penny. Too bad we wanted to do so much exploring around Istanbul, as looking out at the Bosphorus from this top floor apartment is entertainment in and of itself. 

The apartment is the perfect size for two, and is super well equipped - just such a lovely, well-designed space. Ali was so helpful and hospitable (amidst our changing travel dates), and made check-in a breeze. 

Can't say enough about this place; I've rented innumerable Air BnBs around the world at this point, and this might be my favourite of all.
reviews[64].comments: Excellent location and lovely view. Great base from which to explore Istanbul. Would recommend getting Underground from airport to Sishane whence Ali’s apartment is a short walk. The Big Bus tour is worth doing as is a bike tour.
reviews[65].comments: Este es un apartamento muy agradable para 2 personas, con una vista inigualable, igual que en las fotos. La parada del tranvía está a 3 cuadras y este lleva a los principales lugares que ver en el centro de Estambul. La calle súper turística İstiklal Caddesi está también a un par de cuadras, con restaurantes, cafés y tiendas de todo tipo. Ali, el anfitrión, estuvo pendiente de nosotros todo el tiempo. Alojamiento muy recomendado.
reviews[66].comments:
Great location with easy access to the Metro, great restaurants nearby, close to Istiklal street and really easy to get to the old town. 

 Amazing view from the flat, comfy bed, well equipped kitchenette. We loved the call to prayer from the neighbouring mosque, very beautiful.

Would definitely stay again.
reviews[67].comments: Ali's place is in the perfect spot to explore the area - shops and restaurants and Galata Tower at the doorstep.  And a beautiful view over the Bosphorus, incredible to watch the sun rise.
reviews[68].comments: The view is incredible. If you are looking for a view then look no further. Whether it’s the morning or evening, the view from Ali’s apartment is stunning. The location is wonderful with easy access to the ferry, public transport, shopping areas and cafes. Ali was very kind and responsive. He was so helpful with arranging a taxi for me to the airport and answering any questions I had. The space is sparkling clean. I would highly recommend staying here!
reviews[71].comments: Appartamento fantastico, a 5 minuti a piedi dalla metropolitana (facilissimo arrivare dall'aeroporto Ataturk). 5 minuti a piedi anche dalla Torre di Galata. La vista è spettacolare (Bosforo, Corno D'oro, Sultanahmet: si vede sia la città in Asia che l'antica Costantinopoli) e tutto nell'appartamento è perfetto per passare qualche giorno tranquillamente. Consigliatissimo, di sicuro a tutti i nostri amici!
reviews[72].comments: The view from Ali’s apartment is to die for! You will not be disappointed day or night, cloudy or sunny-  it is simply perfect. The apartment is modern and tastefully decorated with a few stylish pieces. Everything you need for a short stay. The location is also super. Right in the heart of the artists’ quarter and a few minutes from either the main shopping area or the Galata Tower. The tram (which is very cheap) is also near and the metro so it couldn’t be easier. Lots of restaurants nearby and thanks to Ali we would recommend the terrace at the top of the Radisson Blu Hotel, which is also in easy walking distance . This was a great stay made even better by a welcoming and hospitable host. Thank you so much Ali!
reviews[73].comments: This apartment is the perfect base for exploring Istanbul! It was clean and comfortable, and the view was absolutely amazing - waking up in the morning to the sunrise over the Bosphorus is a great way to start the day! The bed was comfortable, and no loud noise at night. Ali was an excellent host, check in was quick and simple, and he was very responsive to all our communications. \nRegarding directions If you are taking the metro from the airport - make sure you look for the Istikal Cadessi exit as soon as you get off the train (don't just pick any exit!). It is a straightforward walk down the hill if you get the right one:)

reviews[0].comments: Outstanding host! Ali is very accommodating and communicative. The flat is well-appointed and very charmingly decorated.
reviews[1].comments: We had a very great stay at Galata Junior Suite. The apartment was exactly what it's look like in the pictures. Our host Ali was always answering rapidly and was accomodating. The location is very great, with a lot of cafe and shops nearby, but also quiet at night. The tramway station and metro station are also very close. Thank you Ali!
reviews[2].comments: I had a great time at Ali's place! It was clean, cozy, and located near metro stations. Would definitely recommend
reviews[3].comments: This flat was perfect for me, and the neighborhood has charm and convenience. I'd stay here again with pleasure. Ali was very understanding when I arrived late.
reviews[4].comments: Ali was a great host! The place is exactly as advertised. super central, super clean, cozy and Ali was very helpful! Would stay here anytime.
reviews[5].comments: Ali's apartment was perfect for our first trip to Istanbul. The location was central to other neighborhoods Ortakoy, Kadikoy, Eminonu, Sultanahmet, and close to the public transit to get you there. (you can also take the nearby M line to Ataturk airport). Galata is quite hip with great cafes and coffee shops. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and quiet, and just a great place to relax for a few hours or enjoy the city. Ali went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Can't say enough about our stay! 5 stars for everything.
reviews[6].comments: Ali's place was beautiful, comfortable, and clean. It looked just like the photos. Ali was very accommodating, going beyond necessary service for my stay. It's also very near to the metro and some great cafes.
reviews[7].comments: Great host and very accommodating! Stylish room was very clean and comfortable - great place which was super close to the metro and galata tower - Thanks Ali for a wonderful stay in Istanbul
reviews[8].comments: Ali is a great host. The building is in a perfect location and the apartment is complete and comfortable. Highly recommended!
reviews[9].comments: I almost felt like I didn't need Istanbul Card for public transport. Grate location...!!!  However, if you are light sleeper be aware that you could experience some noise from people staying in a flat above your apartment and flat in back yard...
reviews[10].comments: Excellent stay. Central location, the room was in excellent condition and the host very responsive and helpful. 5/5
reviews[11].comments: Ali's place is lovely - a great location and a comfortable space.  Ali was very kind, and was easy to work with when we needed to coordinate with him to use the laundry machine in his office.  We would certainly stay here again.
reviews[12].comments: This place is amazing. It has everything you want: really clean, very nice shower, the bed is just great, much little cosy details to feel at home, perfect location. Ali responded very quick everytime and was flexible. Thanks for the great stay.
reviews[13].comments: Very stylish apartment, in the center of the town, near Galata towel.
reviews[14].comments: Ali has been very professional and welcoming. The apartment is clean, quiet and very comfortable, and is located in one of the best neighbours in Istanbul and everything was perfect.
reviews[15].comments:
This apartment is same as on the pictures. Very clean and nice for two people.
Positive: LOCATION is super nice to visit istanbul. Ali is a good and responsive host. Apartment clean, good bedding.
Negative-improvable: Internet is slow, especially in the evening, we had 1 day internet totally out. Bathroom is small, no shampoo, only bath gel provided. MISSING LIGHT, the appartement is very dark. 
Overall, we recommend staying in this place.
reviews[16].comments: Ali's suite, was extremely stylish. Its was extremely well located, and was both near the main shopping street/area with the most restaurants and was on a quite street. It was 5 minutes of walking to whichever type of cuisine  you could imagine.\nThe apartment itself was very stylish, with beautiful exposed bricks and a nice lighting. The two seats featured on the photos were actually for the hall area rather than the room, but everything else matched perfectly. The bed was one of the most comfortable ones I have slept in. I renewed my stay twice.
reviews[17].comments: Άψογη φιλοξενία...πολύ όμορφος και περιποιημένος χώρος σε ιδανική περιοχή! Ο οικοδεσπότης εξαιρετικός και πολύ συνεργάσιμος!
reviews[18].comments: Ali is a warm and considerate host who did his best to make us feel welcomed. The studio is uniquely furnished with a distinct character, clean and has all you need for a short trip. The apartment is located in the most charming area in Beyoglu, with cozy cafés and sophisticated restaurants nearby. It is close to the shopping mile Istiklal Cd., the metro station Sishane but you can also easily walk to the main attractions from Karaköy through the Galata Bridge to Eminönü.  We had a wonderful time here and the apartment definitely enhanced our Istanbul experience. We would come back.
reviews[19].comments: Thank you for your hospitality, Ali!\nThese are very nice and cozy apartments. Very stylish design, Furniture and equipment are in good condition. Maybe the area of the room is a little less than I would like, but it also gives a kind of charm))). I will recommend it to friends!
reviews[20].comments: (Website hidden by Airbnb) location. Stone throw away from subway, Taksim main shopping street, Galata tower and the restaurants and bars nearby. Ferry stop to cross Bosphorus 15 min away by foot. \nStylish, clean and cozy apartment. Comfy bed and quality shower. \nWe would stay again!
reviews[21].comments: Beautiful little apartment in possibly the best location in the entire town. Loved Ali (our host) and our stay, however unfortunately had to knock the review down a couple of notches for one reason - the noise! The street noise was one thing (noisy sellers yelling walking past, traffic over cobblestones, call to prayer) but the noise from our upstairs neighbors was unbearable! Constant thump thumping as they walked around at all hours of the night. I’d recommend the building, but make sure you get one of the apartments on the higher floors.
reviews[22].comments: Mycket trevlig och hippt inredd lägenhet, nära till det mesta. Ali var väldigt trevlig. Rekommenderas varmt!
reviews[23].comments: Stylish and quiet apartment near Tunnel and Galata tower, 3 minutes to metro station. It has everything for traveler needs. There are many nice cafes/pubs/restaurants with great food within easy reach. We had a good time there.\nAli is very helpful host, he quickly responded to our questions.
reviews[24].comments: I loved this place! Near Galata tower, but very quite street. ALi very nice man, i wish i will come back to his apartment! Ali, i wish you good luck and it was realy nice to meet you! I recommend this place! !
reviews[25].comments:
Apartamento muy bien situado cerca de Galata y de la calle Istiklal. Si no os perdeis, está a cinco minutos del metro, eso sí, en una calle en cuesta, como casi todas en Estambul.

reviews[0].comments: I had a very nice experience staying at Irmak's apartment in October 2014. reviews[1].comments:
Irmak was a fantastic host, and we thoroughly enjoyed staying in her flat. The apartment is conveniently located in one of Istanbul's chicest residential areas, Nisantasi, in the basement of a nice old building. Prime location for cafes/brunch spots, small bakeries, grocery stores, but also a heaven for luxury shoppers. Having been to Istanbul before, I must admit Nisantasi was a better choice than the very touristy areas around Taksim or Sultanahmet. There were dolmus buses and taxis just round the corner from the street we stayed, which made it easy for us to commute to all the places we wanted to visit. 

The flat itself - exactly what you see in the photos, and more. Clean, super cozy & homey, warm (mind you, we visited Istanbul at he end of December 2014, so the warmth was well needed), with everything necessary made available for our 4-day trip. It was definitely spacious enough for two people, and the way the flat is organised makes it very liveable. It really felt like home, and the flat has a lot of personality: family photos, nice artsy touches here and there, hand-crafted antique furniture, they all make for a vintage-y and boutique-y feel. Bonus points for the nice Christmas tree waiting for us in the living room, which made the whole atmosphere feel even more like holiday. 

Though we haven't met Irmak, she has been a great host and arranged for us to pick up the key from someone. Flexible, very accommodating and willing to share tips and recommendations about restaurants and places to see in Istanbul, Irmak was always available to chat and responded promptly when we had any queries. 
 
Highly recommended place for travellers who enjoy a clean, cosy flat with plenty of personality, in a nice quiet neighbourhood.

reviews[0].comments: Ati was a great host. He responded quickly to all of our questions, requests, and concerns. On numerous occasions I texted him and he responded within minutes. In regards to the flat, there were definitely pros and cons. Pros: great view, elevator, air conditioning, full size fridge and fully stocked kitchen ideal for eating in. Cons: The flat is not great for tall people... the kitchen and back bedroom both have fairly low sloped ceilings. The hot water was unpredictable but I didn't bring this to Ati's attention so I'm sure he would fix it. There was a strong chemical odor almost like a hair salon that seemed to come and go. Also there seemed to be a mold/mildew problem in the bathroom. I know this is common in old buildings but with the humidity it was particularly bothersome. Overall I had a great time staying here. In my experience with Istanbul flats this was a normal experience. I would also mention that the flat is smaller than the photos make it look. Luckily the balcony is nice ;) In regards to the neighborhood, it's a fantastic location especially if you plan on doing touristy stuff but want to also be close to Taksim. It's a 5 minute walk uphill to Taksim and a 10 minute walk downhill to get the Tram which can take you to all of the sites like Sultan Ahmet, Top Kapi, and the Bazaars. You can also easily walk to the Kabatas ferry station. I felt totally safe in the neighborhood. There is a lot of construction so it's not the most beautiful street in the city but it's convenience makes it worth it. Overall I would recommend this flat. Like I said, any problems that were brought to Ati's attention were dealt with promptly so that was great. Thanks so much!
reviews[1].comments: The flat  is nice located with a beautiful view to the Bosporus/ sea of marmara. Always  again.
reviews[2].comments: Ati’s apartment is in a great location in New Town. A bus goes straight from the airport to Taksim Sqaure and the apartment is a couple of blocks from Taksim square and only a tad furthur in the opposite direction to the T1 tram that is easy to maneuver. It connects New Town to Old Town and makes it really easy (and cheap!) to get around. The place also has a fantastic balcony with a lovely view. While Ati was a responsive communicator, we did have an issue with meeting up to get the house keys. Something came up and he was unable to meet the first person in our party to arrive. This made it very difficult to access the apartment since she told him that her phone would not work in Istanbul beforehand. The neighbors who had the keys didn't seem well informed that we were coming and there is a trick to opening the door that is not very intuitive. After a long day of traveling, it is notable that this process could have been much smoother. The only other issue that we had was with the hot water. During our stay, the hot water was very unreliable and alternated between ice cold and scalding hot, when it worked at all. Ati was responsive, came to take a look, but couldn't seem to get repairmen out to fix the problem(it seems the hot water heater failed). The water problem was a bit out of Ati's control. He was very apologetic about the meet up. He bought us a beer, stayed in contact and let us leave our bags past check out time on the day we had to leave since we had a late flight. He also suggested a great place for us to eat. Other than the 2 issues, we had a lovely stay and found the apartment to be a perfect fit for the three of us!
reviews[3].comments: Very nice place, just a few minutes walk from Taksim. The house was very clean and comfortable and the view amazing. Ati gave us the keys and explained the few things you need to know about the place. Very good experience.

reviews[24].comments: The apartment is nice and cosy - we were very happy with it ! Some reviewers have complained about the wifi but Ati had sent me the passwords beforehand and it worked well. Communication with Ati was a bit slow but didn't pose much of a problem. There is a steep hill to reach the apartment (as in most of Istanbul) but this can be easily avoided by taking two sets of stairs which was a great relief ! It took barely 7 mins to walk to Taksim square (which has a lot of shops/cafes/bars/restaurants and the metro) and has a few mini supermarkets 2-3 mins away which have all the essentials. The only thing that wasn't that easy was that we were reaching the airport at 9am but the apartment was only ready at 2pm as Ati had guests before. He did allow us to come in and leave our bags and take the keys at 1pm while the cleaning lady was there which was very helpful but I wish I had known this before making the booking as I may have tried booking a place with an earlier check in time. As the time is not on the description page - I suggest you check with Ati what time you can check in before booking if you are planning to come in early ! All in all, we really liked the apartment - and I would definitely choose this place for my next stay in Istanbul !

reviews[47].comments: Eravamo in 4 con una bambina di 8 anni.Siamo arrivati la sera tardi e stava nevicando. ATilim era presente e ci ha dato tutte le informazioni del caso.
