reviews[49].comments: The place was central near Taksim square and Istiklal street. The apartment was cute in a quite area and good neighborhood. the view from the balcony was impressive, and you can see Bosphorus. I am really satisied of the place and I will consider it for next visits in Istanbul. The house was also clean and well equipped for everything one needs.
reviews[50].comments: Kommunikation stimmt. Gute Ratschläge.
reviews[51].comments: Very good information from the host! Not only about practical stuff but also recommendations for restaurants, cafes and bars. The photos and information in the ad are correct. The apartment is very close to Taksim and Cihangir where there are lots of thing to see and places to explore.\r\nIt was however hard to sleep in the bedroom since there are doves (?) living on the roof above it and they were loud. We used the bedsofa in the living room instead. \r\n
reviews[52].comments: The apartment was great - very clean, loved the view off the balcony! The shower door was broken but it wasn't a problem for us. We had an issue with the keys not working when we arrived but Atilim came quickly and was able to sort it out within an hour or so, he also showed us the main street a bit and gave us good information on where to eat/drink/go out. There was an explosion in the city (very rare) and he immediately contacted us to make sure we were OK and to advise us not to go near that area. Would definitely recommend the apartment. Thanks!
reviews[53].comments: Top location! Would highly recommend.
reviews[54].comments: Emme tavanneet majoittajaa vaan soitin hänelle läheltä asuntoa ja avaimet olivat kuulemma mailboxissa mutta sen löytämiseen meni aikaa ja oven löytämiseen koska hän sanoi vääriä numeroita. akadulla oleva mies auttoi meitä!! Kaikki meni lopulta hyvin ja wifi toimi hyvin sekä tuli lämmintä vettä. Asunnon keittiö haisi todella pahalta kokoajan ja linnut katolla alkoivat häiritsemään aamuyöstä joka yö todella kova meteli joka yö niistä. Suihkun ovi ei toiminut myöskään edes valmiiksi joten aina märkänä koko wc suihkun jälkeen. Ilmastointia emme käyttäneet kertaakaan.
reviews[55].comments: Atilim is the most friendly and correct host we could have wished for. He received us at 10 o'clock in the evening with a big smile and led us the same evening with pleasure to his favorite places in the beautiful city of Istanbul. We look back at a great evening with him. He gave us good tips and advice for a perfect stay in this beautiful city.\r\n\r\n
reviews[56].comments: The flat was great and had the perfect location for me, really close to Taksim square. Atilim is a really nice and kind person that will help you if you need! I wanted to stay one more day and he found another flat for me. I highly recommand this airbnb :)
reviews[57].comments: Atilim was a great host. The communication was just fine. The apartment is very nice located. The view from the balcony is amazing and you can chill there in the sun. \nThe noise of the pigeons and seaguls on the roof is very annoying, so it is not the best place for people with a light sleep.
reviews[58].comments: This apartment is great value for money, is in a good location and has a lovely view from the balcony. Atilim was also flexible with our check in time.
reviews[59].comments: The view from the balcony definitely met our expectations and we enjoyed some wonderful hours out there. The neighbour hood was fine but we did have a hard time finding the apartment. The price of the apartment was awesome but the washing machine didn't work and the apartment smelled funny. Another plus. though, was the AC since we visited Istanbul during a very hot week in June. Also, Atilim sent us a detailed list of recommendations in the area that was very helpful.
reviews[60].comments: The apartment was v nicr. close to taskim square on a quiet street. I was able go to the market and cook in the kitchen. sitting on the balcony at night was really lovely. \r\nAtilim was so helpful. He helped he find a taxi at short notice. He liaised with my  dentist when I was running late for my apoinment. He sent someone over to do my laundry when I couldn't get the washing machine to work. I can't begin to thank Atilim enough. He is kind, thoughtful.
reviews[61].comments: A nice place with an amazing side view of the Bosphorus. It is situated a short walk away from Taksim square. There's a steep slope which should be ok with most travelers but is not convenient for some old people or those having cardiac problems. The design of the apartment is such that the person or people staying in the bedroom will have complete privacy and feel far from the person or people staying in the living room. Atilim was kind and professional. There was a problem with the washing machine so he asked the cleaning lady to wash my clothes somewhere and hang them to dry in the apartment the same day! I complained about the AC (it was a very hot weekend) so he came with the technician to check it up.
reviews[62].comments:
Le logement au dernier étage (5eme) accessible en ascenseur est très bien situé à quelques minutes de marche de la place Taksim dans une petite rue en pente très calme.
Un espace très bien pour 2 personnes, grande chambre sans rangement, cuisine sympa et petit salon avec sofa et TV. Le plus est bien sur la terrasse avec une belle vue sur la ville et le bosphore. Lieu idéal pour le petit dejeuner et prendre l'apéro le soir au coucher de soleil.
Un plus serait un rideau plus épais dans le salon pour bien stopper le soleil car il y fait très chaud (le climatiseur est un peu leger pour la surface de l'appartement) et un rideau de douche dans la salle de bain serai idéal. 
Je conseille vraiment cet appartement, je n'ai pas eu l'occasion de rencontrer Alilim mais il a toujours répondu rapidement à mes demandes par sms ou message. 
Je reviendrai à Istanbul et surrement dans cet appartement !
reviews[63].comments: We did not see Atilim but we had a great stay at his place. The appartment is perfectly located in Taksim district and the balcony is just great.
reviews[64].comments: English feedback here. По Русски в конце. Good choice for the money. Great host. Location is great, just few blocks away from Taksim square and subway. The only one I didn't like there that part o the apartment part  and specifically bedroom and kitchen has a really low ceiling, and I'm a tall guy and this was a problem. But at the same time l used a living for sleep and it was fine. For me it was nice the place has a nice terrace. \r\nОтличная квартира за эти деньги. Хороший хост. В нескольких минутах ходьбы от метро и Taksim squre. Единственно что не понравилось это то что в части квартиры, в спальне и кухни низкий потолок. Но я спал в гостиной и это не было проблемой. Главно плюс это террасах с хорошим видом.\r\n
reviews[65].comments: It was very easy organising access to the apartment and Atilim was very helpful. The apartment is spectacular! I don't think you could ask for a better view. Very easy access to Taksim
reviews[67].comments: We spent a week in Istanbul and stayed in Atilims apartment, witch was a very good choice. The apartment waS spotless clean and exactly as promised. Because we stayed for a week, Atilim offered us an extra visit from his cleaninglady. The balcony is big and with a fantastic view.\r\nShould we ever come to Istanbul again, we will certainly stay there again.\r\nTHANK YOU, ATILIM
reviews[68].comments: The apartment is small but has everything you need there for a pleasant stay. The only thing that might be a problem is the fact there are lots of pigeons living in the roof, which often sounded like there were people in the house. If you have some good earplugs then you'll be fine here. Atilim was great with communication and willingness to help, and everything was thoroughly clean.
reviews[69].comments: Anyone who loves coziness and warmth will enjoy this apartment.  It is small but not claustrophobic and the location is FANTASTIC!  Ati was very casual about check-in and check-out and was always available if I needed advice.  The only disappointment was that the listing promises a Bosphorus View from the balcony; what you get is a slice of the Marmara Sea.  Otherwise, exactly what I expected and wonderful!
reviews[70].comments:
Tolle Lage des Appartments direkt unterhalb des Mehdan Platzes in Taksim
Alles wie beschrieben - für diesen Preis nicht zu schlagen !!!
optimal für 2 Leute - geht aber auch ohne Probleme mit 3 Erwachsenen oder 2 Kindern 
Die Tauben auf dem Dach können störend sein
Die Heizung läuft etwas zu laut nachts - geht aber wenn mann sowieso müde ist !
Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder wenn wir in Istanbul was suchen !!
reviews[71].comments: It was a pleasure to stay in Ati's appartment. The flat is very central and closed to Taksim square. Internet connexion works very well and, above all, the view is stunning. Don't hesitate to stay here ! It's not expensive and perfect for a short stay in the city.
reviews[72].comments: Die wohnung von Atilim ist sehr gut gelegen. Man ist in kurzer zeit beim Taksim Platz und dann an der Istikal street, wo alle wichtigen Geschäfte sind. Im moment kann man auch die madame tusson ausstellung bewundern. Die strassenbahn ist auch nur 5 minuten entfernt. Mit dieser sind sie in kurzer zeit beim gewürzmarkt, der blauen mosche, hagia sofia und dem grand bazar.\nMan hat von der wohnung einen schönen ausblick auf das Marmara Meer. Die wohnung hat von morgens bis abends sonne. Die wohnung ist super für 2 personen. Ich kann die wohnung nur empfehlen. Ich habe die wohnung im märz wieder gebucht.
reviews[73].comments: Eve ulaşım çok rahat. Giriş-çıkış kolay. Ev iyi ısınıyor. Sıcak su var her zaman. Yatak çok rahat. Evin terası güzel, manzarası güzel. Yemek yapacak kap kacak mevcut. Ev sahibi Atılım ile iletişim kurmak rahat ve her konuda yardımcı oluyor kendisi.
reviews[74].comments: Die Lage ist top, man ist nahe an viele Sehenswürdigkeiten. Preislich fand ich es auch ganz gut. \nDaher würde ich es aufjedenfall weiter empfehlen
reviews[75].comments: We had a good stay in the appartment of Atilim. It has a great location, right near subway and trams and gives you a great view form the terrace. Atilim was very helpful in giving directions to get to the place, even with our plane arriving late (1 at night). \nOnly minor point is that there are some birds on the roof in the bedroom making some noise, which can be a bit irritating at some point.
reviews[76].comments: Thank you for everything Atilim! Perfect location, perfect host! Apart is small but absolutely cozy! Amazing view from balcony. Highly recommendation!
reviews[77].comments: I spent a week here and was happy for it.  Comfortable though basic apartment with a gorgeous view.  \n\nOne note: the apartment is on the top floor of the building.  There's considerable bird activity on the tile roof - if you're a light sleeper they may wake you in the night.
reviews[78].comments: Ich war schon das 2. Mal bei Atilim in der Wohnung. Ich fühle mich hier zu Hause. Du kannst in hier nach den Einkäufen auf der Terrasse abschalten und die Aussicht auf den Bosporus geniessen. Ich kenne Istanbul sehr gut, da ich schon über 20 Mal in dieser wunderbaren Stadt war. Sie ist immer wieder eine Reise wert. Diese Wohnung ist sehr gut gelegen. Wenn man nicht nach oben laufen will, nimmt man die Metro von Kabatas nach Taksim und spaziert von da nach unten. Überall findest du Einkaufsläden um etwas mit in die Wohnung zu nehmen. Du hast die so viele Möglichkeiten von dieser Wohnung aus. Sie liegt sehr gut und man kann alles in kürzester Zeit erreichen. \nAlles in allem buchen Sie diese Wohnung - klein fein und alles was man braucht - ich denke Sie werden nicht enttäuscht sein. Die Tauben können am Morgen nerven, aber man gewöhnt sich daran. Etwas gibt es überall.\nAuf jeden Fall wünsche ich wunderbare Tage in Istanbul. Diese Stadt ist immer eine Reise wert. Für mich auf jeden Fall.
reviews[79].comments: Atılım war sehr zuvorkommend die Wohnung ist super,sehr Sauber und zentral gelegen. Empfehle ich weiter
reviews[80].comments: Perfect place to stay in Istanbul ! Close to public transports, restaurants and bars.
reviews[81].comments: This flat is perfect for a visit to Istanbul if you want to be in the Beyoglu area. It's within walking distance to Istiklal and Chihangir and the tram stop that will take you into Karakoy, Eminonu, and Sultanahmet. The living room and patio are sunny and have great views. It's on a quiet street, but the pigeons are quite loud on the roof.
reviews[82].comments: Nice, well situated place with great location and view. Excellent value. Many thanks!
reviews[83].comments: Отличное расположение, уютно и отличный балкон с видом на Босфор. Для того, чтобы ночевать просто супер! Из минусов: голуби на крыше, небольшие трудности при регулировании температуры воды ( видимо из-за бойлера), холодильник не холодит на полную.
reviews[84].comments: The flat is clean and nice. We absolutely fell in love with the balcony and the charming view to Istanbul and Bosphorus. Sometimes it was little bit noisy because of gulls scratching the rooftop by their paws. But that wasn't really disturbing. We were pleased to name Atilim's flat our home for these three days.
reviews[85].comments: Very good view, comfortable apartment. You can hear birds on the roof, but it is a minor flaw. \nAtilim is a great host, always ready to help. Had a great time at his place.
reviews[86].comments:
Birds nest right on top of the bedroom. They make so much noise. At all times. Day and night. Dont be able to sleep.

As a traveler will not recomend it to another traveler.
reviews[87].comments: Great location and excellent view. \nThe birds on the roof can make it very noisey in the bedroom though. But otherwise excellent.
reviews[88].comments: Atilim's apartment is lovely! It has everything you might need for your stay! The Bosphoru view is amazing! The location is perfect.\nHighly recommended. :)
reviews[89].comments: Die Lage der Wohnung war top und auch der Balkon mit einer wundervollen Aussicht. Einziger Nachteil sind die Tauben und Möwen, diese waren wirklich unglaublich laut am Morgen.
reviews[90].comments: 位置距离电车和码头以及地铁非常近,交通很方便｡阳台景色不错,房东非常热情,能及时提供详细的信息｡
reviews[91].comments: Perfect location, amazing view. Minuses - not that many towels and too warm or too cold water in the shower, but manageable. I'm sure Atilim will take care of that in the future. Overall a very good place to stay.
reviews[92].comments: Ev özellikle temizliği ve konumuyla çok çok iyidi. İnternet de birçok evle karşılaştırıldığında oldukça hızlıydı. Güvercinler sabahları biraz rahatsız ediyor bu gerçek ancak yine de çok tavsiye edeceğim bir mekan.
reviews[93].comments: This place was cozy and nice, well located and ideal for 1 or 2 people that want to go to the Uni or enjoy Taksim nightlife, because both places are really near. If I have to come back to the University, I'd probably book here again.
reviews[94].comments: El apartamento está muy bien localizado en la zona cercana a Taksim, de modo que la vida nocturna está asegurada. Lo mismo si se quiere tener acceso a la Universidad. Además. está muy bien conectado por metro con cualquier punto de la ciudad. Atilim es un excelente anfitrión, y es muy fácil coordinar detalles con él. Recomiendo el apartamento y sin dudas lo volveré a rentar en próximos viajes.
reviews[96].comments: Decent location. The AC is not great however it keeps the apartment cool enough to fall asleep at night
reviews[97].comments: It has been a pleasure to have been welcomed Ati. He is the best host ever, his person conveys the whole essence of Turkey: kindness, hospitality, simplicity and great doses of sympathy and sense of humor. His apartament is not extravagant but is comfortable, full-equipped, centric, clean and has amazing views.
reviews[98].comments: Очень хорошее расположение, всё необходимое есть, даже лишнее. .В предыдущих отзывах писали о проблемах с голубями. Когда мы заехали - в комнатах было жарко и мы, кроме кондиционера, включили вентилятор. Шум от вентилятора напоминал полёт в самолёте и ни одного голубя не было слышно. Вентилятор ставили в кухне - рекомендую для желающих остановиться в этом месте.
reviews[99].comments: The location is perfect and the view from the terrace is very enjoyable. The host is helpful and you can always relay on him. He is very friendly also and add personal touch in every accommodation. I strongly recommend the place! :)
reviews[100].comments: I had a great time staying at this airbnb. Perfect location. 3 minutes walk to Taksim Square. In a quiet neighbourhood which can be hard to find in Taksim! Oh, I also did a couple loads of laundry! Thanks!
reviews[101].comments:
Хороший район - рядом транспорт (прямая линия до Галата бридж), недалеко до паромов, есть локальный и сетевой супермаркет, рядом с Таксим с кафе и магазинами, лифт в подъезде, подъезд закрывается. 
Квартира небольшая, низкие потолки - но это не мешает особо. Спать в спальне невозможно - очень громкие птицы - то есть минус одна комната и спальное место. Диван раскладывается в другой комнате, но он расшатаный, не супер комфортно спать, но хоть тихо.
С двух сторон террасы - соседи. Их видно. Вид с террасы хороший. 
Не работает холодильник (в жаркую погоду!) - вернее, работает слегка морозилка, но ее не хватает, если вы хотите купить свежую рыбу или мясо. 
Горячая вода есть, но плохо регулируется - либо слишком горячая, либо холодная. 
Вся кухонная утварь есть, в принципе. Мангал тоже есть, можно пользоваться. Это хорошо. 
Мы уезжали вечером, а следующие жильцы заселялись в этот же день. Но хозяин квартиры разрешил оставить сумки до отъезда в отдельном помещении. За что ему спасибо.
В целом, квартира ничего, но хуже ожидаемого.
reviews[102].comments: problem with birds on bedroom roof made it hard to sleep but everything else was good, excellent communication and easy check in and flexible on check out which was much appreciated
reviews[103].comments:
God lokation og udsigt! Vi var der i 6 dage og nød at sidde på balkonen og se ud over Taxim.
Det skal nævnes at køleskabet ikke virker særligt godt. Fryseren holder tingene kolde, men fryser ikke. Vand trykket i bruseren er ustabilt. Det varme vand er også ret ustabilt. Det kommer og gå og er svært at indstille.
På taget over soveværelset bor en del store fugle, hvilket larmer ret meget om natten.  Vi måtte flytte ind i stuen på sofaen for at få sovet. Flere gange troede vi at nogen havde brudt ind i lejligheden, så meget larmede det. 
Kan alligevel godt anbefale stedet, trods kritikpunkterne.
reviews[104].comments: I left my heart in this marvellous terrace. If you read this and still have some doubts, come.
reviews[105].comments: Good location and nice view of the balcony, helpful host!
reviews[106].comments: A central spot in Taksim, with nice view.Public transport is a short walk from the apartment although walking to Istiklal is a very good idea.Broblem with the birds at night ,made noise on the roof
reviews[109].comments:
Très bon séjour. L’appartement est propre, pratique. La vue sur le Bosphore et Istanbul est très belle. Il convient très bien pour 4 personnes.

L’hôte n’a pu être present, mais il est très réactif, quasiment dans la minute à la moindre de question (nous avons discuté par whatapps). Il nous a conseillé des adresses, donné des informations...

Le seul point gênant peut être le bruit que font les oiseaux, leurs nids étant très proche de la fenêtre. Mais c’est normal en prenant un logement sous les toits!
reviews[110].comments: Good location, great terrace and view, clean and basic, good value! \n(Remember to bring earplugs for sleeping since there's noise from the birds on the roof - but it wasn't a big issue for us.)
reviews[111].comments: Great flat with an amazing view. Perfect location. The host was helpful and thoughtful, gave us loads of very good tips about the neighborhood. Definitely would love to come again and stay in the same place
reviews[112].comments: The apartment is perfectly located and has a great roof terace. Only drawback were the astonishingly loud birds in the morning. However, with earplugs it was ok and everything else was good. So we recommend and would stay again!
reviews[113].comments:
-Le plus important à savoir: il faut vraiment aimer les pigeons et les mouettes pour se sentir bien dans cette appartement!!!

-Il est impossible de dormir dans la chambre
=>l'appartement est sous les toits et impossible de dormir dans la chambre à cause du bruit des oiseaux! 
=> le matelas est comme une courbe de Gauss

-Il est très difficile de se doucher (eau trop chaude ou trop froide) => urgent de changer le kombi
-les draps étaient vraiment très vieux
-il est temps de faire un peu de peinture => les murs sont tellement sales!!!

Pour conclure, je ne conseillerai pas cet appartement même à mon pire ennemi!
reviews[114].comments: Everything was fine, as always. This was my third time in this apartment, and I will book again for the next one. Atilim is a great host.
reviews[115].comments: This was such a perfect spot for exploring Istanbul! Walking distance to most of what we wanted, otherwise a short walk to the Taksim metro. The view is beautiful and the place is simple but satisfied our needs. Definitely recommend! The birds weren’t even that bad ;)
reviews[116].comments: Great value in a great location. The patio and view were great for evening drinks. Would definitely stay here again.
reviews[117].comments:
The house was fine and the position it’s good if you have to be around Taksim square you just have to go up and down for few back streets.
The host wasn’t there when we arrived but this is fine because we did a bit of late. The house was clean but full of ants everywhere the bed it’s a bit uncomfortable because on the right side you fall down. 
For the price i paid was a good solution for few days in Istanbul but for the same price if you book in advance you can find better places considering my personal experience there.
However loved İstanbul and the people in Istanbul I wish you’ll love it too
reviews[118].comments:
We had a really pleasant stay at the apartment, close to all important sights (by walking or train) of European side of Istanbul. Inmidst of beautiful Beyoglu.

Everything needed was provided, but the only reason for giving four instead of five stars are the loud pigeons on the roof of the bedroom. Even with ear plugs it was unpleasant.

The host is very hostile and took us to a very authentic Turkish restaurant and invited us to drink the famous Raki.

Thank you for the stay!
reviews[119].comments: All was good, just for long stay guests better to leave more towels. I recommend this place. I enjoyed my stay.
reviews[120].comments:
Da mein bevorzugtes Apartment in Istanbul nicht frei war, 
wählte ich dieses. Und es war eine gute Wahl.
Das Apartment ist sehr schön und sauber, 
die Einteilung ist zweckmäßig und gut durchdacht,
die Aussicht auf den Bosporus vom Balkon ist grandios,
auch das gegenüberliegende Häusermeer ist faszinierend.
Die Lage ist perfekt. Ich habe meine Ausflüge meistens mit der Tramway
in Findikli begonnen. Zurückgekehrt bin ich mit der Metro oder dem
Füniküler nach Taksim, so vermied ich den steilen Hang. 
Die Gegend ist sicher, nachts ist es ruhig, denn es sind keine Lokale in
unmittelbarer Nähe.
Der Krach der Tauben war für mich kein Problem, denn ich habe
einen guten und tiefen Schlaf.
Atilim war sehr hilfsbereit, Probleme wurden sofort gelöst.
reviews[121].comments: Clean apartment with a beautiful view in Taksim, which is a lively and central area of Istanbul. The apartment is a five minute walk from a metro station that will take you anywhere in the city. There’s also an airport bus near there as well. Communication, check-in - everything went smoothly. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience in Istanbul. Will definitely stay again!
reviews[122].comments: The location of the flat is perfect, everything there thats needed, but not much space for eating together. Bathroom and kitchen could have been cleaner. The communicationwas perfect!
reviews[123].comments: En deçà des attentes même si la localisation est extraordinaire. \nProblème de prise dangereuse, de mur à peindre dans le séjour et de serviette qui ne correspondent pas au nombre des personnes.

Fully equipped Kitchen:  Fridge, Kettle, Crockery, Cutlery, Cookware, Teapot, French press, Kitchen Utensils, Coffee, Tea Bathroom:  • Shower  • Hairdryer  • Towels  • Toilette Paper  • Soap  • Washing machine/dryer  • Iron&ironing board Other location features:  5 minute walk to Istiklal Street and Galatasaray Square.  12-13 minute walk to Taksim Square.  15 minute walk to Galata Tower.  45 minute walk to the his
neighborhood_overview: This flat located in the Beyoglu district is a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street, the heart and soul of Istanbul's cultural life with many cafes, bars, shops, cinemas and cultural centers.
host.host_about: I am from Istanbul, Turkey. I like to travel and meet new people. I lived and studied in Sweden and Spain and traveled to many European countries, I would like to visit South American countries in the future.\n
reviews[0].comments: Garen been extremely helpful during our stay, his flat is brand new with everything you will required for holiday! The location very close to the heart street of Istanbul, highly recommend for Garen's place. 房东人很好,很热情,英语也很不错,我住的几天,一直在帮我当翻译,帮了我大忙!!
reviews[1].comments: Garen was an amazing host. He accommodated every single wish of ours. He responded to my text immediately and helped us book several activities in the city including eating at an authentic Turkish restaurant nearby and attending a Dervish dance event that was overbooked. I highly recommend staying at his place. It's super clean, it has everything you need and best of all it's very centrally located, only 7 min walk to the most famous boulevard in Istanbul "Istiklal Caddessi". We will return again and will book the same place again if it's available. Thank you Garen for everything.
reviews[2].comments: Great location next to the lively main pedestrian street (Taksim to Tünnel) with its crowded life from early afternoon until late night. The way there is about ten minutes from the flat. There's a bus stop on a main road on this way, but we couldn't really figure out which bus to take
reviews[3].comments: Very nice apartment in a great location. There is a good opportunity to experience the local flavor. The street on which the apartment is located, runs every Sunday street market. This is impressive. Responsive host. When he learned that we were going with the kids bought an extra cot. Here live impurity residents and diverse population. The area is not very clean, but in many places in Istanbul. During their stay there were problems with the plumbing, but Garen repair it. And still need to use mosquito repellant. We were bitten by some insects. Overall, I recommend everything else is great and very pleasant and friendly host.
reviews[4].comments: Acceuil très sympatique, Garen nous a organisé un transfer du aéroport ce qui était très confortable en voyagent avec des enfants.\r\nL'appartement est propre, bien rénové et agréable à vivre. Bien situé.
reviews[5].comments: Garen arranged an airport taxi to the flat and met us half way. He was extremely nice and sent us additional information about places to go.\r\n\r\nThe flat was well equipped and located very centrally.
reviews[6].comments: La rencontre avec Garen a été facile grâce à un point de rendez-vous fixé à l'avance. Mais Garen peut aussi organiser l'arrivée à l'appartement. Garen a répondu rapidement à nos différentes questions. L'appartement était spacieux, confortable et proche de la rue Istiklal, ce qui permet d'avoir presque tout ce que l'on veut proche de soi.
reviews[7].comments: Garen was very kind and flexible with our check-in and check-out. The apartment is exactly as described and pictures are accurate. It is clean and has everything necessary. There is a parking just next to the building which is very useful. We loved our experience in the authentic area of Istanbul. Sunday market on our street was nice surprise for us.
reviews[8].comments:
Garen is very nice guy and great host!
The apartment is spacious, super clean and located just few minutes from the center (by walk).
I would love to stay there again when I come to Istanbul next time!

Thank you Garen ;)
reviews[9].comments: Garen war uns ein sehr guter und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Er hat uns super Informationen über Istanbul gegeben und war immer gut erreichbar. \r\nDie Wohnung ist sehr zentral und super eingerichtet. Sie hat ausreichend Platz und verfügt über alles notwendige, das man so gebrauchen könnte. In wenigen Minuten zu Fuss ist man im Stadtzentrum.\r\nWir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in Istanbul und ich hoffe das es eine nächstes Mal in Garen's Wohnung geben wird!
reviews[10].comments:
L'appartement est parfaitement situé, en plein centre de la ville (place Taxim) ou on trouve le côté moderne et le côté historique et vieille d'Istanbul. 

Les chambres sont très propre, avec des draps, serviettes, et oreillers. 

Un grand séjour et un salon sympa ! 

Le métro est a la place Taxim avec une correspondance vous pouvez visiter la ville en toute tranquillité ! 

Pour les fêtard la nuit, l'avenue istiklal est parfaite ! Pleins de pubs de boîte de nuit l'une derrière l'autre. 
Garen le propriétaire a organisé pour nous le transfert de l'aéroport  à l'arrivé et au départ à un tarif correct.
Appartement à conseiller pour ceux qui veulent bien visiter la ville
reviews[11].comments:
Хочется поблагодарить хозяина квартиры!
Жилье превзошло все ожидания! Хозяин (Гарен) очень вежливый и тактичный человек. Квартира большая, просторная и чистая. Есть все самое необходимое и все работает и исправно. Видно, что не так давно в квартире был сделан ремонт, причем, достаточно качественный. Есть wi-fi и цифровое телевидение с российскими каналами. Везде кондиционеры.
Поразила улица, на которой находится квартира. В воскресенье из обычной улицы она превращается в большой торговый ряд, где можно купить любых свежайших овощей и фруктов. 
Очень удобная геолокация. Пройдя по улочке вверх, сразу оказываешься на крупном проспекте, где легко взять такси и за 15 лир оказаться в историческом центре. Рядом хамам и магазины, где можно купить продукты. Прямо под окном есть паркинг, где можно оставить машину.
Конечно, в полной мере присутствует национальный колорит турецких кварталов. Но это не портит общего впечатления от квартиры.
Очень рекомендуем. Близко, недорого и качественно!
reviews[12].comments: Garen was a great help welcoming us to Istanbul, giving us information about the area, and arranging airport transportation! The flat was beautiful, very true to the photos!
reviews[13].comments: His apartment is clean and comfortable as introduction in web. When we met he explain informations and make us feel free.
reviews[14].comments: Это было прекрасное путешествие! Квартира точно такая же как на фотографиях - даже лучше! Гарен отличный хозяин - очень гостеприимный и переживающий, он даже оставил нам тарелку с фруктами и шоколадки в холодильнике!\r\nКвартира очень чистая, уютная и стильная - иногда даже никуда уходить не хотелось))) Находится она в самом центре и добираться очень удобно куда угодно. Возле дома огромный рынок с очень приятными ценами, а также рядом есть круглосуточная дешевая кафешка с вкусной едой и приятными хозяевами. А еще Гарен может вам посоветовать очень многие приятные и безопасные места - рестораны, клубы, кальянные и тд. Очень все понравилось! Приедем еще обязательно!
reviews[15].comments: όλα ήταν μια χαρά!!!!
reviews[16].comments: The host welcomed us warmly, though we arrived late in the night. The flat was as nice as it was described. Especially nice was the central heating system in the flat, since the weather was unfortunately pretty cold. \r\nThe neighborhood with the narrow steep roads bordered with historical buildings gives the feeling of old Turkey. Istiklal Caddesi is only 8 minutes on foot away from the flat, perfect for long and relaxed (window) shopping or taking the Tunnel tram and train to reach other historical parts of the city like Galata Kulesi, Galata Kopru, Hagia Sophia, Sultan Ahmet Cami, Grand Bazaar and others. In short the location is perfect to explore old Istanbul.
reviews[17].comments: Garen is a perfect host, he was always helpful. There were some problems with the shower's sink in the flat though. The flat itself is ok. Rooms are not big but there is enough of space. However I would recommend this flat to young guys who are looking for something inexpensive not far from Istiklal. If you travel like we did with lot of kids, you'd better think twice: the neighborhood is rather dirty and doesn't look safe.
reviews[18].comments: Apartment was clean and equipped with everything you may need. Great location. Garen was incredibly helpful and responsive.
reviews[19].comments: Гарен очень гостеприимный и отзывчивый хозяин. Нам квартира очень понравилась чисто, уютно, супер. Все соответствовало описанию. Гарен был очень заботлив, оставил нам фрукты и шоколад, было приятно. рассказал куда можно сходить в Стамбуле.
reviews[20].comments: Garen прекрасный хозяин. У нас был поздний checkout в 16:30 без дополнительной платы. Трансферт из аэропорта Ататюрк был  организован идеально, на большом автомобиле и во-время. Я не мог включить стиральную машину,  там все надписи по турецки, он сразу мне ответил и проблема была решена. Квартира соответствует заявленной. Район немного отдает турецким колоритом, но жители района весьма дружелюбны. Местонахождение квартиры и район соответствуют описанию. Интернет быстрый. Квартира подходит для семей и компаний. Буду в Стамбуле остановлюсь в ней еще раз. Всем рекомендую.
reviews[21].comments: very nice host apt like fotos definitly a central and very good place to stay
reviews[22].comments: Garen was nice and welcoming. The place was quite clean, although the whole building and the neighborhood was not. This gave us a true experience of living in Istanbul. In general if you want to see real Istanbul I recommend to staying at Garen's.
reviews[23].comments: Garen was a very nice and welcoming person. He arranged our transportation from and to the airport and was very reactive.\r\n\r\nHis listing is exactly as presented in the photos. The apartment is 10mn to the central Istiklal avenue in an old neighborhood.
reviews[24].comments: Garen was an amazing host. We were an admittedly demanding bunch, but he responded quickly and generously to all our requests (help with transportation, apartment needs, etc). Staying in his apartment was a great option for us during out stay in Istanbul. The apartment is somewhat smaller than it appears in the photos, but it was clean, modern, attractive, and well-stocked. Thanks Garen!
reviews[25].comments: Special Thanks to Garen, Everything was easy with him.  The flat was amazing just like in the pictures. very easy to contact him. we were 08 persons And Garen has arranged the transfer from the airport to the flat. Nexte I want to travel to istanbul he will the first to know. so I recommand Garen for all people who are looking for a nice appartement. he's a very nice man.
reviews[26].comments: Our stay at Garen's apartment was wonderful. We arrived late into Istanbul and Garen organized a private transfer from the airport which made the transition very easy. The apartment is conveniently located in Taksim in a local area. There was plenty of room for 6 people and although there is just one bathroom, it didn't pose any problems!
reviews[27].comments: We went to Istanbul with a group of 6, so the flat was perfect for us. I didn't meet Garen personally because I arrived after my friends already had a key, but I can say that Garen is a great host, he gave us a lot of advices and also helped with airport transfer. The flat is great and is very well located.
reviews[28].comments: Accompagnés de nos deux enfants de 5 et 8 ans, nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Istanbul. Garen est un hôte attentif, qui nous a accueillis à l'appartement et nous a fourni nombre de bons plans pour découvrir la ville. \r\nL'appartement est grand, clair, très propre et très fonctionnel. Il est aussi et surtout très bien situé pour visiter la ville, non loin de l'artère principale de l'Istiklal, à proximité de la place Taksim et non loin de la tour de Galata.\r\nBref, un excellent séjour !
reviews[29].comments: We travelled in winter and arrived after dark, it was in an old building in what we later discovered was a rough part of town. Had to walk up steep rough roads to reach public transport, not ideal if you have any mobility issues. The flat was clean but small. Our main issue was with the hot water which we could not get to function properly, none of us had a pleasant shower, it was either boiling or freezing and ran out after 1-2 minutes. The kitchen was small and poorly equipped with only one small sharp knife. Overall it was an average experience
reviews[30].comments: It was a really nice stay in Garens flat. It was really clean and safe. The flat is well located, to taxim square it's just 5 min walking. The flat has a nice balcony where you can sit. Bathroom and kitchen was really clean and everything was working. At Sunday there is a big market directly in front of the house where you can buy fresh foods and otter stuff. Garen offers us a transfer from the airport to the flat, that's a really good idea to use it. Thanks for everything!
reviews[31].comments: We enjoyed our almost 2-week stay in this spacious apartment. Garen was very helpful and responsive from the very first day. He showed me around the neighborhood and gave excellent suggestions for places to visit in Istanbul. The apartment looks exactly as shown in the pictures. Everything was renovated and in working order. The neighborhood looked safe to us, although not well-taken care of. The neighbors were very friendly and helpful. The Sunday market right outside our doors was a pleasant surprise :)!
reviews[32].comments: Best of the best! \r\nI would like to express my gratitude to you for providing us with a wonderful house to stay in while our time in Istanbul . We had a great time.If i will be lucky enough to come to Istanbul once more i will most definitely try to rent your appartment .Many thanks, Garen.
reviews[33].comments: Garen was a great host, thank you for every thing.
reviews[34].comments: Nice and central place to stay. Garen was very responsive and helpful. Clean and quiet appartement. It's a working class neighbourhood though,   but friendly and safe.
reviews[35].comments: Perfect place for bigger groups
reviews[36].comments: Garen was a great host. The flat is in a hilly section of Istanbul that is a working class neighborhood, but my family of six loved it. Each day we would stop at the corner market half a block up where my kids gave the owner hugs and the owner gave my kids candy. We become good friends with the store clerks about a half block away at the main supermarket and keep up with them on (Hidden by Airbnb) . The flat had everything we needed to stay their for a month and was very new and well equipped. The market literally right outside your door step every Sunday is something not to be missed. You are within 5 minutes walk of Istiklal street and all the night life you could want. We were very happy with our stay and plan on going back next time we are in Istanbul.
reviews[37].comments:
Ça restera sans doute le meilleur voyage que j'ai jamais fait ! La Turquie est un pays magnifique et son peuple très accueillant et serviable ! Garen a été très à l'écoute et très arrangeant.
Le quartier est calme et vraiment pas loin de taksim et de l'arrêt de bus. L'appartement est bien équipé et correct niveau propreté j'ai quand même dû nettoyer le micro onde pour pouvoir chauffer les biberons de mon fils car il y avait des éclaboussures à l'intérieur, mais sûrement un oubli de la part de la dame de ménage. Le quartier est un peu bizarre au premier abord mais on s'y habitue très vite. Nous avons vraiment apprécié le marché en bas de l'immeuble tous les dimanches ! L'appartement est grand bien éclairé et beaucoup de place pour que les enfants puissent jouer.
Encore merci à Garen pour son hospitalité !
Je le recommande à 1000%!
Nous reviendrons certainement ! Gros coup de coeur!
reviews[38].comments: the flat was great and we close to most busy street in istanbul
reviews[39].comments: The apartment is great, it had no surprises, i.e. exactly like the pictures. It's in a good location, metro stations are near. Most of all, Garen was very responsive and helpful whenever we had questions.
reviews[40].comments:
Arabic and German versions are below :Since it was one of my best trips I will make it an extensive review!
1-Garen as a host:
Garen was a very nice person from the day of booking the apartment to the end of our stay. He gave nice hits and suggestions to enjoy our stay in Istanbul by providing helpful websites.  During our stay, the communication with him was really perfect in terms of language and being kind to us.  In addition to that, he offered us to help in booking our transportation from the airport to the aprtment.

2- The apartment:
The apartment was nice and clean. It was sufficient to accommodate us (9 people) without any problem. The location was not far away from Taksim area (Istiklal street) where people can find a lot of shops, restaurants, cafe's, clubs and pubs.  The apartment is around 2-4 min from the bus station (Ömer Hayyam) which can take you to many places in Istanbul and 15 min walking from Taksim metro station. 

3-The area:
The area was hilly ( which is also the topology of a lot of places in Istanbul) which makes the movement with a baby trolly a bit difficult(as in our case). Next to the apartment, there is a market which opens on Sundays. You can get nice fruits vegetables and much more for cheap prices. However, the people leave the place with a lot of garbage and wastes ( it won't be cleaned before the next day by the city).
The buildings and streets in this area are pretty old. You can hear the sound of neighbors till late ( even after 10 pm).
The building where Garen has his apartment does not have an elevator, which can be difficult for old people or little children in the trolly. As well as the lights in the building ( along with the stairs ) were not working properly.    الشقه ممتازة ونظيفه كافيه لمجموعه كبيره تصل إلى تسعه  أشخاص يوجد فيها كل ما يلزم.  غارن صاحب الشقه لطيف ومتساعد جدا ولم نواجه ايا مشكله بالتواصل معه باللغه الانجليزيه . موقع الشقه استراتيجي ولكن سلبيتها الوحيده انها بمنطقه شعبيه جدا .قريبه جدا من السوق(سوق تقسيم ،سيرا خمس دقائق) والمواصلات العامه(من اثنين لأربع دقائق) ، أنصح بالاقامه  بسبب قربها من   الاماكن السياحيه . die Wohnung liegt in Top Lage und entfernt nur 2-4 min zur Bus Station . Sie geeignet für große Gruppe . In der Wohnung befindet sich alles ,was jemand braucht. Die Wohnung is sehr empfehlenswert.
reviews[41].comments: Garen is more than perfect host really friendly great apartment everything you need is available hope everyone try there at least one time in life
reviews[42].comments: Garen is a very friendly and nice host. He offered to order a transfer for us from the airport, met and led to the apartment as we would have simply got lost without any guidance even with GPS. The flat was very neat and clean. There is everything you need for a comfortable stay, sometimes we forgot that we are not at home but rented this apartment. Also, Garen provided us with a number of must-visit places and we were very pleased to go there. Any questions and inquiries were answered and assisted in time with a great empathy. If you wish to stay in Istanbul downtown for a week, Garen's flat is a great place to live in.
reviews[43].comments: The flat is amazing! Very big, bright and clean. Garen is a great host who is always willing to help you out with an excellent attitude. The flat is located close to Istiklal street but in a working class neighborhood so it’s best to not walk alone at night.
reviews[44].comments: It was nice staying at Garen flat. It is not far from Istiklal street and Taksim square. In the evening was very nice to walk in Istiklal street. He was very friendly and available when I asked him any question. He arranged for me  and my parents airport transfer and the driver was on time. Thank you Garen.
reviews[45].comments: Am Anfang hat uns der Ort also die Straße und das Haus von außen nicht so gut gefallen. Aber die Wohnung ist echt sehr schön und groß. Es war alles sauber und bequem. Garen hatte uns am Anfang viele Fragen beantwortet und sich Zeit genommen. Er kann gut Englisch. Leider gab es für 5 Personen für 2 Wochen nur 2 Rollen Toilettenpapier. Die Wohnung ist ganz in der Nähe von Taksim und einer Shopping Straße Istiklal. Das ist sehr gut. Nach einer Woche Aufenthalt funktionierte eine Klimaanlage nicht mehr. Garen hat sich direkt darum gekümmert, den Service angerufen und uns einen Ventilator vor eingebracht. Ich würde auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.
reviews[46].comments: Garen’s apartment is really looks like photos,\nIt is clean , wide and comfortable ,,, just 7 minuets from taksim street ,,,, Garen was very nice and kind host I recommend this apartment.\n
reviews[47].comments: Garden was nice and friendly. The house was sparkling clean. We would highly recommend his place
reviews[48].comments: Garen its a really good host, nice and attentive. His apartement  its really good located near to Taksim. Moreover his recommendations were amazing!
reviews[49].comments: Apartment is very nice and clean. It is what you see in the pictures. It was cleaned prior to our stay and it was not smelly or dirty. Everyone was very satisfied with that. The apartment is very close to Istiklal st and Taksim square. It was very convenient to walk there and stay out late. The neighborhood is not the best but we did not have any issues with safety. It is close to two grocery stores and a bakery which was convenient. It was easy to get a taxi. The host helped us with transportation from and to the airport which was nice. He also was very helpful with tips about places to go and visit.
reviews[50].comments: Garett’s place was close to the center and pretty accurate to pictures also very clean.
reviews[51].comments:
I had a family reunion at Garen's place last week. It was great. The apartment is super clean and comfortable. The building is kind of old but inside the unit is very well-renovated. The area is also an old area and we got a chance to see the Sunday market in the neighborhood with so many fresh fruits and vegs. 

You need exactly 7 minutes walking to reach Istiklal Street which is great. The only thing is that the way is little bit hilly, we didn't face any problem but you might want to consider it if you are traveling with children or elderly people. 

Garen is such a nice, responsive and friendly host which never says no to anything! I really really thank him for his hospitality and I hope to see him again soon :-)
reviews[52].comments: Very tidy and spacious AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. Three bedrooms, a sitting area and nice bathroom. It was more than enough space for my husband and I. Garen is a great host and there when you need him, Very nice and quick to respond to messages. The neighborhood is very conveniently located- we walked everywhere. Would absolutely recommend to stay there!
reviews[53].comments: Large clean apartment with everything we needed. Easy walking distance to Istiklal Street and Taksim square. Good communication too.
reviews[54].comments: Appartement spacieux, literie confortable et propreté irreprochable. Un confort correct pour passer un bon séjour à Istanbul. Le quartier peut surprendre au début car trés populaire donc un peu vétuste mais c'est relativement calme et securisé. Garen est trés attentif et réactif. Ses recommandations sont interressantes.
reviews[55].comments: Logement très propre, bien situé 10 min de taksim, Garen été très  réactif quand nous avons eu une fuite d’eau a notre arrivé, sympathique et serviable il nous a donner une liste de resto et endroit a visiter.\nAdresse à recommander.
reviews[56].comments: Garen was really helpful and nice , \ni recommend his place for big groups and families.
reviews[57].comments: it's good for the price and the place...but very old building with noise from other apartments....
reviews[58].comments: Appartement bien situé, propre, sécurisé dans un quartier typique, proche de place Taksim et tour Galata !! Garenne est un hôte disponible sur place et agréable à la conversation !\nje recommande
reviews[59].comments: Хорошая квартира за свою стоимость, без излишеств, но есть все необходимое, чисто, светло, горячая вода и отопление через проточный водонагреватель, без перебоев. Две небольшие комнатки с двухспальными кроватями, одна из комнат без окон + одна комната просторная, также с двухспальной кроватью, гостиная с диванами, небольшой совмещенный санузел с душевой, маленькая кухонька с газовой плитой (есть вся посуда в большом количестве, сковороды уже немного подубитые), большой обеденный стол во входной зоне. Дом может показаться расположенным в достаточно специфическом месте: настоящий старый жилой квартал, выглядит местами заброшено, несколько полуразрушенных домов вокруг. Но мы чувствовали себя безопасно, вечерами было тихо, а буквально 10 минут вверх по улице пешком - и ты попадаешь в совершенно другой мир на Истикляль с модными кофейнями и кучей туристов. В пяти минутах ходьбы от квартиры два небольших супермаркета. Интернет работал без проблем.\nGaren оперативно отвечал на сообщения, встретил нас в квартире, не было никаких вопросов с заселением, при выезде мы просто оставили ключи на столе. Кроме того, он посоветовал нам закусочные и кафе в районе проживания, два ресторана из них мы посетили и остались очень довольны. Спасибо за рекомендации!

transit: Walking distance to Public Transports:  • Metro Station – 4 min.  • Bus Station – 4 min.
access: There are many popular restaurants, clubs, art galleries, historical monument within walking distance from our apart in Taksim area. You will find maps and Istanbulkart on your desk. This card will help you to pay less and go wherever you want with the public transportation. The only thing you need is to load some money in it..  Galata Tower (10min),Taksim Square (18 min), Asmalimescit (10 min), Karakoy (20 min) are very close, walking distance, to hang around in Istanbul. It is very easy to reach historical places like Ayasofya, Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar, by walking it takes less than 20 min . All central places like Sultanahmet, Eminönü, Karakoy, Mecidiyeköy, Sisli, Besiktaş are very close by public transportation. From Atatürk Airport, there are two transportation options except taxi - You can take the metro from airport (M1A line- Airport - Yenikapı line) to "Yenikapı" station and change to the other line M2 ( Yenikapı - Hacıosman Line) to "Şişhane" station. Şişhane metro statio
interaction: You can reach me by phone, by airbnb or e-mail also if you want by viber or (Hidden by Airbnb) for free texting.
house_rules: You can smoke but please admit fresh air into the room and be careful for yourself.
host.host_about: I am an architect and made the renovation of this building by myself. Besides my business ; I love to travel , meet new people, spend time with them and curious about different cultures, history, languages so I decided to run here as an apart hotel. I am trying to host my guests as ideally as I can do. Also it is a chance for me to meet so many people face to face. \r\nGot so much more to see and experience around the world and am hugely excited to stay in different countries
reviews[0].comments: Mert and Gökçe are really friendly people!! They were always available to help us and advise about the city, they met us very late on the first night and they arranged the taxi to the airport too. They even took us on a tour!!! to the Asian side showing us some of their favourite places. We really enjoyed our stay there and Mert and Gökçe are fantastic hosts. \r\n\r\nThis review is for the "Mayata Apart-Flat#2" which was not yet advertised on Airbnb as the others were not available. The flat is big and really nice, all new and clean with separate kitchen and living area and a small balcony. It is in a traditional style building that Mert and Gökçe are renovating and where there are only three other apartments that they rent. The area is safe as you can find a Police station meters away from the building and it is possible to walk to the Galata Tower and Istiklal Street in just a few minutes. There is also a metro station (Sishane) just five minutes walking from the building. Really recommended, you'll have a great time!  :)
reviews[1].comments:
It was really great to meet Mert and Gökçe! They were were very friendly with us and helped to find the way to all places that we wanted.
Their flat is situated on the safe place near the police station. It was very clean and comfortable there.
I decided to stay at their apartment next time when I go to Istanbul. I recommend the flat of Mert and Gökçe for all my friends. 
Thank you for your hospitality!
reviews[2].comments:
Many thanks for our highly sociable, friendly and helpful host.

Not only for providing a very charming and well equipped flat good to stay in, but also for being ready for 

giving help.

Finding the flat was so easy as they picked us at Taxin Square. 

Getting familiar with the local facilities was also so easy with their kind help.

Mert Üncü was a so kind and correct host that I can highly recommend him and his apartment to anyone 

who is looking for a well equipped and well prepared place to stay in.

István

from Budapest, Hungary
reviews[3].comments:
Mert and his wife were more than helpful. They were very welcoming and immediately showed us where to go and where to take the metro. We couldn't have asked for a more comfortable, cute place to stay. It was very safe and a perfect location. Next time we go back to istanbul we will definitely contact them. They went out of their way to make sure we were happy and that things went smoothly...and they certainly did! Thanks so much!
___________________

Mert et sa femme ont été tout simplement incroyable avec nous lors de notre séjour à Istanbul. Ils ont prit le temps de bien nous montrer les environs pour que nous puissions nous retrouver aisément. Ils nous ont conseillé des bons restaurants et endroit où aller. 

On ne peut demander mieux comme hôte et nous allons les recontacter lors de notre prochaine visite en Turquie :) 
Merci infiniement !
reviews[4].comments: It was the first time I used airbnb when booking Mert and Gökçe's place and I must admit I was very happy. The flat was very clean, comfortable and functional, newly restored and furnished as well. Additionally It was very close to the metro station (4 mins walking), to the Galata area and Istiklal where there are many shops, bars, restaurants etc. but the neighborhood is at a very calm spot, which is a great combination. Not only that, Mert and Gökçe are two wonderful people as well as hosts. They waited for us, even though we arrived late at night, so that they could welcome us and showed us around to the neighborhood. They provided us with a map of the area and a metro card, they even booked us a taxi at the day of our departure and they are at all times available when we needed information on the city. Last but not least they were great company - we had such a lovely time going out with them! \r\nI highly recommend their place for the hospitality and the comfort and wish them all the best.
reviews[5].comments: Mert et sa femme sont deux personnes d'une extraordinaire gentillesse et prêt à donner tous les conseils utiles tout au long de votre séjour. En ce qui concerne l'appartement, il est très bien situé proche de la tour Galata et idéal pour un séjour à 2. \nVraiment je recommande Mert à tous sans hésiter.
reviews[6].comments: We had a wonderful stay, the room was clean and modern with everything we needed provided (towels, cooking equipment, hairdryer etc.). The location was a 5 min walk from restaurants, bars and public transport - very convenient! Mert and his wife were super helpful and called taxi's for us - they were on call 24 hours which is wonderful for peace of mind. Perfect place to stay for a winter weekend city break with lovely hosts.
reviews[7].comments: Mert and his wife our lovely. They we're very welcoming and even took me on a tour through the neighborhood. The apartment is nicely decorated, and has everything you need. We really enjoyed the area and our stay! I would absolutely recommend staying here on your trip to Istanbul.
reviews[8].comments: Mert was very helpful - provided a route, which was helpful because Istanbul is a maze. Would be great if he send beforehand a map of the exact location too - the one in Airbnb I found not clear enough for use given Istanbuls complex street map. He stayed in touch and was easy available for anything we would further need. \r\n\r\nThe place is new, very clean, good atmosphere and the bed is great. Kitchen had only the basics. We had a great stay and can most definitely recommend both the renter as the place. Only not for people who aren't fit to walk - the neighbourhood is very hilly, and the particular street is a steep stairwell! The location in general we found as excellent; felt at home in a rustique area, combined with only a short 5 minutes from the main shopping area heading to Taksim / amazing load of restaurants / pubs within easy reach.
reviews[9].comments: La casa e' bellissima e molto confortevole, vicina ai mezzi e in un quartiere tranquillo e molto silenzioso.  L' appartamento e' molto pulito, nuovo, con un letto comodissimo dove abbiamo dormito benissimo. La doccia e' calda e comoda. Mert e sua moglie sono gentilissimi, sempre disponibili e veloci nella comunicazioni, sempre attenti a non far mancare nulla. Siamo stati davvero bene e torneremo
reviews[10].comments: The apartment was extremely clean, cozy and well-situated. It is exactly as described and while being there it gives you the impression for a real home. Not to mention that it is located in a perfect area from where you can easily reach one of the most remarkable spots in the city.\r\nBesides, it is a great opportunity to meet Mert and Gökçe who are such a wonderful and lovely couple. It is a pleasure when you get to know such people.\r\nI highly recommend the place for all the hospitality and the comfort the hosts provide to their visitors, and I wish Mert and Gökçe all the best!
reviews[11].comments: My fiancé and I spent 11 nights at Mert's place. First of all Mert and his wife both welcomed us with a smile and very informative conversation like the closest subway station and the distance to the attractions of Istanbul. Apart of the fact that Mert and Gökce were very friendly people, the apartment is located in the heart of Istanbul. You can literally walk to Taksim, Galata Tower and also to the Galata bridge. The subway station Sisli is the main line which takes you to the best shopping malls such as Cevahir, Kanyon, Istinye Park and many more. The neighborhood is very authentic with local people. You really feel like you are a part of the city. It was very cold in Istanbul during our stay but Mert did everything so we feel comfortable and warm. He even bought a new heater and new blankets so that we are not cold and the apartment was warm even though the weather in Istanbul was about -6 degrees. All in all I would highly recommend to rent this apartment!!! Thank you Mert and Gökce for everything! You guys are great hosts.
reviews[12].comments: Mert and his wife made us feel very welcome. They were willing to help with pretty much everything, from laundry to finding places. The apartment was clean, quiet and close to the main district. I would stay there again if I ever go to Turkey again.
reviews[13].comments: It was Great staying at Merts appartement. Everything was perfect! Thank u so much!
reviews[14].comments: Mert stand jederzeit für Rückfragen zu Verfügung (hat immer innerhalb von 5 Minuten geantwortet), hat uns zuverlässig am Bahnhof abgeholt, uns sogar herumgeführt und uns alles wichtige gesagt und gezeigt. Das war wirklich super. Die Beschreibung der Wohnung war zutreffend und detailliert. Die Nachbarschaft ist nicht besonders schön, aber man fühlt sich sicher und kommt überall zu Fuß hin.
reviews[15].comments: This was my 2nd Airbnb experience and it was another good one. Mert got in touch right away and was very helpful throughout - giving cab driver directions from airport. When we arrived, he took us for a little walk around to give us some bearings which was really nice of him. The location of this place is great. It's nice and cosy and everything in working order. It's not someone's home if that's the vibe you're going for and if you want to cook there's only a hob and microwave - we were sampling the Turkish cuisine so wasn't a problem for us. So overall, it's a good little place, everything works (TV, Wifi), quiet and great location for Beyoglu and Taksim square. Recommend a walk to Galata tower for Menemen breakfast in the sunshine. Enjoy
reviews[16].comments: From the moment I booked this place, Meet was very cordial, informative and helpful.
reviews[17].comments: We stayed at Mert's Perayata Flat for a week visit to Istanbul. Everything was perfect -- Mert was so helpful in answering questions before we left on our trip, he arranged a car hire for us to and from the airport, he even walked around the neighborhood with us when we arrived to make sure we had our bearings. The apartment is great and exactly as pictured. We loved being in a residential area away from large crowds of tourists but also very centrally located. Very safe, nice area near an elementary school and a great little cafe around the corner, "La Perla Cafe" -- go there for a cup of tea, the owner is wonderful! In addition to being clean, the apartment was nicely heated and had everything we needed. The building felt secure and quiet as well. Mert was very friendly and incredibly responsive whenever we had a question. We couldn't recommend this rental more! Thank you Mert!
reviews[18].comments: Mert was incredibly hospitable and helped us to arrive from the airport to his apartment. He then personally showed us around the neighborhood and always made himself available for help and suggestions. He even booked us out early morning taxi to the airport upon leaving Istanbul. In my time using airbnb few hosts have done as much as Mert to make our stay enjoyable and easy. And a beautiful apartment in a great location too!
reviews[19].comments: Mert nous a très bien accueillis. A notre arrivée, il nous a fait un tour de quartier et donné de bonnes adresses de restaurants pour bien commencer notre séjour ! Il est très facilement joignable toujours prêt à aider en cas de problème.\r\nNous avons passé 7 jours à Istanbul et l'appartement s'est révélé parfait. Il est localisé dans un quartier calme tout en étant proche du métro, de la Tour Galata et de tous les restaurants en direction de la place Taksim. Idéal pour des vacances à deux.
reviews[20].comments: This was the first time using airbnb and it worked out.\n\nThis apartment was great and it was walking distance to everything.

reviews[24].comments: We had a wonderfull time at Mert's appartment. Although we didn't meet him in person he was very helpful and very friendly. The appartment was very clean and just a few minutes from the bar and restaurant area Istakil street away. We would definitely come back again.
reviews[25].comments: Mert was a fantastic host! Met us upon arrival, helped with our luggage, showed us the apt and walked us around to familiarize us with the neighborhood. The apt was as pictured clean and bright. We love to walk and the location was great. Near metro and we liked to walk down to the Tram. We stayed 2 weeks the end of May and there was so much to see. We are delighted that we chose to stay in Mert's apartment!\nDan & Lucy
reviews[26].comments: Mert is a great host! Even before arriving he was very responsive and explained us the best way to get to the apartment from the city. Upon picking us up from the metro stop he walked us through the neighbourhood and gave us great tips. I could always write to him while we were exploring the city in case of any questions.\r\nThe apartment is great for two people and was very clean. reviews[27].comments:
We rented the appartment for a 3 nights. The appartment was nice and clean (exactly like the photos). There is airconditioning in the bedroom, which was very useful.
It's a rather quiet street, but still close to nice restaurants and cafés and you can easily reach the touristic sighs by tram. 
Mert and Ozan took good care of us during our stay and were very helpful.

If you are going to stay here, it's advisable to mark the exact location of the appartment by gps in your phone. All the streets look alike in this area and it took us a while to find back the appartment the first day by using the tourist map only.
reviews[28].comments: We had a great stay in this flat. It's clean, convenient and  in a quiet neighborhood close to Istiklal avenue.  Mert gave us clear directions on how to meet our host (Ozan) and he showed us around the neighborhood.  I would not hesitate to stay in this flat again were I to return to Istanbul.
reviews[29].comments: Mert was a great host! He met us at the flat and showed us around the neighborhood - pointing out how to catch the metro, good restaurants and various sites. He also gave us tips for the rest of our travel in Turkey and was very responsive to any questions/requests we had. The location was great - we generally just walked everywhere, but it was off the main streets so there wasn't too much noise.
reviews[30].comments: The flat was exactly as listed on the site, light and cozy. The location is absolutely perfect -- a walking distance from the busy main walking street with a lot of shops, bars and cafes, as well as to the river and the Galata bridge, from where you can walk into the old City or take a tram to the  Blue Mosque and the Palace. Yet, the location was very quiet and allowed for a good night sleep. Mert was very welcoming and helpful: he explained how to travel from the airport and met us at the subway station, showed us around the neighborhood and even helped with a reservation of a restaurant we wanted to visit. \r\n\r\nIf you're coming to Istanbul, it's hard to find a better location. Highly recommended!
reviews[31].comments: It was a pleasure to stay a Mert's flat. The flat was super clean and it is located in a safe neighborhood. It is a family neighborhood.  The metro station is a block away.  From the flat you can walk to Istiklal Avenue in few minutes where you can find hundreds of restaurants and shops. Our host, Mert, made our stay a great experience.   He helped with information on how to go around the city. He got us taxis when needed and answer multiple questions that we has. If you are going to Istanbul I highly recommend Mert's place to stay.
reviews[32].comments:
Istanbul is a fantastic and historical city. Most of the time you are going to be out. Probably all day, when you do come home at night, you want a nice, comfortable and quiet place. This is the place. 

When we arrived, Mert arranged for transportation for us from the airport. The apartment is located near a police station (very safe) and near the Metro (very convenient). The apartment was clean and tastefully decorated. There was a television, very good wifi services and all the basics you will need including a steam iron. The building also has a community washer which is highly efficient (we suggest using the quick cycle). 

After we got settled in, Mert and his wife walked us around the area for about 30 minutes. Showing us where to catch the train, where to eat (traditional) Turkish food and showed us Taksim square an outdoor wonderland. While we were there, he was always a (Hidden by Airbnb) message away and responded quickly. This is how good he is, one night, my husband had an issue with a crooked cab driver. Mert showed up within 10 minutes to make sure we were all ok. 

When you stay here you feel like you are part of the community. The neighbors are very friendly and warm. 

If you want an authentic Istanbul experience, this is the place to stay.

Side note: we recommend that you do not take a taxis and take the metro or tram. If you want a taxis just ask Mert to arrange it.
reviews[33].comments: Had a wonderful stay in Mert's flat. It's very close to the Sishane metro station which is accessible with a transfer from the airport. Mert was kind enough to meet us at the station and walk us to the flat. He also provided great recommendations for food and sites to see. His cousin showed us around the flat and Istiklal street to get us oriented. Onut was great and personable. Mert was easy to reach and responded to our questions very promptly. The flat itself is comfortable and clean. Laundry, wifi, and a/c were all super.  I'd definitely recommend his flat.
reviews[34].comments:
Highly recommended! A great place to stay to explore the incredible city that Istanbul is!
Mert is an excellent, organised and kind host. Welcoming us after a delayed plane arrival at the Sishane train station, just a few mins walk from the apartment. Mert generously offered to show us around the local spots, speaks very good English and made us feel at ease straight away. He also gave us some great restaurant tips and a handy 7 day guide to Istanbul! Everything is closeby including great food, cafes, bars and architecture all hugging the cobblestoned streets. Its a downhill walk to the bridge across to Sultanahmet for all the amazing old city sights. Catching the tram to/from Karakoy worked really well, and then the Tunel cable car back up the hill.
The apartment is in a quiet residential area. It's clean, tidy and the air conditioning in the bedroom was great during the Summer heat. There is also a handy washer on the ground floor.
reviews[35].comments:
We spent an amazing week in Istanbul and staying at Mert's apartment made us feel right at home.
Before our arrival, Mert answered all my messages within no time and arranged four us to be picked up at the airport.
We were met by his cousin at the apartment who was very nice and welcoming and showed us around the neighbourhood and Istiklal Street and recommended a bunch of places for us to go for food and drinks.
The apartment is as advertised, very clean and convenient and a good size for two people. The house is in a very quiet, safe and nice neighbourhood with friendly neighbours and small shops, cafes, bakery and a supermarket only a few minutes away.
Mert immediately offered his support when he heard that my partner was sick and arranged a taxi for us back to the airport for a very good price.
Overall it was a very good experience and I will definetely stay in one of Merts apartments again when I get back to Istanbul some day.
reviews[36].comments: Mert was great, responsive, friendly, etc. The unit was clean and worked well. The kitchen is not well equipped, for example, no toaster, no oven.
reviews[37].comments:
First, Let me say that Mert was a gracious host, very accommodating, and couldn't have made us feel any more welcome to stay at his apartment. Mert, was accessible via email and text before and after we arrived to Istanbul and made sure to give us a nice long tour of the neighborhood and Istiklal Avenue (Famous Avenue) in Istanbul.  

The Apartment is very conveniently located near the Sishane metro stop, walking distance to the New District (Taksim Square), and 15-20 min walking distance to the Old Town over the Galata bridge. Overall in great neighborhood and friendly neighbors.   

Highly recommended!
reviews[38].comments: Great little flat, looks exactly like the photos. In a rather calm street so you can rest up after a long day exploring Istanbul.
reviews[39].comments: Excellent location that was just a stones throw away from the subway and tunnel square. Mert was nice enough to even take us around istiklal street to help us understand our location better. Clean and nicely kept apartment. Would stay here again if I returned to Istanbul.
reviews[40].comments: Well located, clean and cozy apartment for exploring Istanbul. It is located in a safe and friendly neighbour hood and is less than 10 minute walk from  several good eating joints -  Cafe Privato and Varka Antakya Lezzetleri are must try - and pubs. Well connected by public transport. Host Mert is quick to respond to messages and is helpful. would rate the entire experience 5/5.
reviews[41].comments: Nice clean apartment in good location, but quite hilly. Our host Mert was very helpful and very quickly (within minutes) responded to our questions during the stay. Our first night we were shown the surrounding area and main street, it felt very welcoming. Overall great experience.
reviews[42].comments: The description matched the actual space. We didn't meet Mert, but his cousin delivered the keys and showed us the space. The neighbourhood is quiet and very central, 5 minutes from the Galata tower.
reviews[43].comments:
El apartamento es exactamente como se describe en el anuncio. 
Además de ser especialmente luminoso, dispone de todos los servicios que uno podría necesitar (calefacción, aire acondicionado, toallas y ropa de cama, secador de pelo, plancha, microondas, cocina eléctrica, kettle, vajilla, batería de cocina, televisión, ...
El apartamento está muy próximo a Refik Saydam Cd., y se puede llegar andando a la Istiklal Cd. en menos de 10 minutos. 
El anfitrión ha estado muy atento y ha sido muy servicial. Ha mantenido conversación con nosotros durante toda nuestra estancia.
¡Absolutamente recomendable!
reviews[44].comments:
Mert and his cousin, Ozan, were excellent hosts. Ozan met us from the Metro station, showed us to the apartment, and then gave us a quick tour of the local area to help us orientate ourselves. This saved us a lot of time and potential stress, when arriving at night, hungry, and with a 7 month old baby. Mert also kept in contact throughout our stay (via AirBnB, text message and (Hidden by Airbnb) ), to make sure we had everything we needed.

The apartment building is in a quiet street, only a short walk from a buzzing and lively area with lots of shops, restaurants, cafes and bars. The Sishane Metro station (Kasimpasa exit) is only 5 minutes walk away. Overall, the location is ideal - easy to walk to Galata, Karakoy, Cihangir, Taksim, etc.

The apartment itself is simply designed and spacious enough for us as a couple and our baby. The bed was large and comfortable, and the shower was powerful with plenty of hot water. The apartment was also clean. The wifi connection was good. The kitchen is not especially well equipped, but with such tasty and affordable food options nearby, you would be unlikely to do much cooking. There are also a few small shops nearby for snacks and breakfast supplies.

This was our first time using Airbnb, and we were really pleased with the experience.
reviews[45].comments:

The approach of the property, to off-load from taxis etc was not convenient - but for the rental price of the apartment - this was a good value for money.

B rgds 
Capt INAM
reviews[46].comments:

The Sishane metro station is just a few blocks from the apartment as well as "Istiklal Caddesi" street which has an incredible night life, or you can also reach the "Tunel" tramway to "Karakoy" pier.

Thank you again Ozan & Mert for eveything!
reviews[47].comments: Reviews and photos are accurate I would only add we made breakfasts and some dinners in the kitchen just fine and the comments about the climb, well that's Istanbul!\r\n Could have used a secondary light in bedroom.\r\n Mert was one of the most welcoming and available host of our 4 month journey of Europe. We really liked this side of the city and recommend this apartment.
reviews[48].comments: Mert´s appartment was well located, great for walking to all the shopping and restaurants, great bars nearby. Perfectly clean, most comfortable bed !!! Mert's cousin showed us around the first night, so we could get to comfortable with the area. Would recommend this flat!
reviews[49].comments: Mert was a great host. He was so helpful to make us feel like at home. Highly recommended and will definetely come back again.
reviews[50].comments:
Mert was such a nice Host. He organized our airport transfer and waited for us at the apartment even if we arrived after midnight.  The flat is clean, calm and very convenient. It is central and we could visit Istanbul by walking. 
Mert gave us any information we needed and replied when we had a question. He gave us good restaurants address, places to visit, hammam, etc. 
I really recommend this place and I would definitely come back!! 

Thank you again Mert for your hospitality!
reviews[51].comments: I had a great stay at Mert's apartment. It had everything I needed and not far from the Metro station.  He was very helpful.
reviews[52].comments: We had a wonderful stay at Merts apartment. He was kind enough to give us directions and wait for us at the metro. reviews[66].comments: *Please read: how to deal with issues with an Airbnb stay."\nWe had to change our dates last minute because of the recent turmoil and events in Istanbul. Mert is a nice host who accommodated the date change request and spent time with us over tea showing us how to get around the city. However we had the unfortunate situation that the city was working on the water lines. Mert let us know there was no running water in the unit when we checked in(not before).  At first, we were not concerned since Mert told us it should be on that evening. We went about our day sightseeing and at dinner, we sent a note asking him if it was on. He said no. It was too late so we bought some bottled water to brush our teeth and wash our face. But the water still did not come on in the morning. After a night of not being able to use the toilet and needing to shower, we contacted Mert several times to figure out what to do. After not hearing back from Mert, we decided to check out and find a hotel at 11am. I waited until I returned home to the states to try to resolve our stay with Mert directly before going to Airbnb but sadly, he did want to refund any money believing it was not his fault. I am disappointed because it is not unreasonable to expect the basic need of running water for an Airbnb stay. My recommendation is to always let Airbnb know immediately of any issue so they can get involved with the host and you are not left trying to figure out what to do on your own, especially in a country you do not speak the language. Also, you can request to cancel during your stay and Airbnb will provide you a number to call to get help instead of sending an email.  I have traveled the world using Aurbnb but unfortunately it was the first time for my friend and this experience was so horrible, she will never do it again.

В спальне очень удобная кровать, шкаф для вещей гостей, неплохой кондиционер. Общая комната, объединённая с кухней, тоже достаточно уютная, но на кухне только раковина, одна электрическая плитка и холодильник. Кроме того на кухне, по пути в ванную, имеется порожек на котором можно споткнуться.
