Стиральная машина стоит внизу, в общем пользовании и постоянно была заняты - стирать приходилось поздним вечером и ночью. Качество и скорость стирки не хорошие (часто нужно спускаться и проверять процесс стирки, проблемы с открытием дверцы). Расположение жилья не плохое, есть где погулять и не очень далеко от метро. La salle de bains est bien et il y a tout le nécessaire, cependant, les canalisations sentent, ce qui se propage parfois dans tout l'appartement. L'un des grands inconvénients était la présence d'un nombre non négligeable de fourmis, qui a donné un certain nombre de problèmes. Near to the entrance door there is a market where you can buy everything you need, and the owner is extremely kind and joyful! To take bus to Eminonu  area would takes about 7-10 mins (flat walk), and walk back from bus station will take about 15 mins walking down the hill. The route for going and back within Istanbul is not using the same route, so it can be quite confusing.

Overall, i would highly recommend this clean and trusted hosted.
reviews[11].comments:
Pinar's apartment is clean, light, cozy and full-equiped.
It is situated in good location. If you want to use public transport to explore Istanbul, Pinar's apartment is right for you. In 12 minutes walk is metro station (to get there you have to use the steep street, better - Tepebasi street) and in 12 minutes walk is stop of touristic sightseeing Big Bus tour (to get there you have to use a very steep street). In 8 minutes walk by flat street is bus stop to get Eminonu (Egyptian market, New Mosque, 10 minutes walk from historical centre and Sultanahmet square). From this bus stop you can also get Taxim square, Miniturk park. But one of most interesting public transport is the ferry boat. Ferry pier is also in 8 minutes walk by flat street from apartment. By ferry boat you can get to Eminonu, Karakoy and even to Uskudar (in Asian part of Istanbul). Price is the same as the bus.
Next to the entrance door there is a small grocery store where you can buy everything you need. 
Pinar is extremely good host and if we had some questions she promtly gave the answer.
So we highly recommend Pinar's apartment.
reviews[12].comments: Pınars Apartment ist groß, sauber, zentral gelegen, voll ausgestattet. Pınar war vor und während der Reise dauernd erreichbar und wirklich, wirklich hilfreich. Die Lage im Bezirk Beyoğlu ist toll, in der Gegend gibt es auch alles, was man braucht (Bäckerei, Bank, Apotheke, Supermarkt, Greißler) aber vor allem Richtung Tünel/Taxim ist es echt wirklich steil. Stellenweise steiler als Lissabon. Pınar kann aber Tipps geben, wie der schlimmste Hügel umgangen werden kann. Ich würd jederzeit wieder Pınars Apartment mieten und kann es nur fitten Reisenden wärmstens empfehlen.
reviews[13].comments:
Pinar hat in ihrer Wohnung auf unsere Ankunft gewartet, obwohl wir Verspätung hatten. Das hat die Schlüsselübergabe sehr erleichtert. Außerdem hat sie uns alle paar Tage gefragt, ob alles in Ordnung ist. Wenn wir eine Frage hatten - bspw. wo man gefüllte Müllbeutel entsorgt -, dann antwortete sie meist innerhalb einiger Minuten. Insofern blieb sie sehr im Hintergrund und stand dennoch jederzeit für Fragen zur Verfügung.

Die Wohnung war ordentlich und sauber. Alles dort hat funktioniert.

In der Nachbarschaft hat man kleine Supermärkte, eine gute Verkehrsanbindung und es ist ruhig (abgesehen vom Muezzin, der ja gehört werden soll). Restaurants sind 10 min. zu Fuß entfernt.

Die einzigen zwei Kritikpunkte, die völlige Nebensächlichkeiten sind, waren: (1) Das Bad ist klein und vor allem um die Toilette herum ist es eng. (2) Die kleine Wohnung hat nur eine mäßige Küchenausstattung: Kochen kann man durchaus, aber man sollte von aufwändigeren Gerichten absehen. Weitere Kritikpunkte fallen mir wirklich gerade nicht ein.

Absolut empfehlenswerte Adresse und Gastgeberin, um Istanbul zu erkunden!
reviews[14].comments:

reviews[55].comments:
The listing was accurate in all the details (except for the view to the Bosphorus Canal, which we did not see). It is a nice room in an appartment with two other rooms for rent with which the bathroom is shared. The address is not public - I found it through some (Hidden by Airbnb) -fu - but once we got near the entrance to the flat, a short call to Faisal solved the "check-in" problem - he sent his brother to open for us and show us the room.

The temperature of the hot water from the shower tap fluctuates continuously (from hyper-hot to mildly warm in 1 minute), so you must always turn the cold water knob higher or lower - however, at any moment there is a setting which makes the water tolerable.

The bathroom had a full set of 10 toilet paper rolls so I did not panic that we were going to run out of it even though I used very little. The toilet itself flushes thoroughly and has a bidet included.

My mother, who stayed with me, said that the room was sometimes too cold because of the window above and the heating which was irregularly on (we went in late November). I note that this did not bother me. Also, there is a large supply of blankets and towels available.

The other inhabitants of the apartment did not bother us in the slightest (we had the key to our room).

reviews[11].comments: The host in this hotel is out of the ordinary. We believe he can do much more than just accommodating guests. We arrived at the hotel at 11 pm. After dropping us off, the driver asked if the host who was standing in front of the car can give a hand to lift our luggage. But the host seemed to so enjoy resting his hands in his warm and lovely pockets that he refused to help us. It is definitely the first time for us to receive a NO from a host of a hotel when we asked for help to handle the luggage. But luckily, it is also the last time - in following trips to Pamukkale, Ephesus, and Ankara, all hosts helped us without even asking. After we were inside the hotel and ready for checking in, the host suddenly claimed that our reservation has been altered. Another group of guests who lived in our reserved rooms and should check out this morning had their flight cancelled. So they quickly made a reservation again for the same room. Very coincidently, their reservation request was sent right before ours, the reservation system on hotel`s computer approved theirs and ignored ours, but somehow our reservation still got a confirmation though it should not. Hence, our reservation was actually failed in the system and now we had to move to another apartment. We found this explanation rather funny. Our reservation was confirmed in November, a month ago. Nevertheless, that reservation request sent today by other guests still managed to appear on the reservation system one second ahead of ours. It got approved, and therefore kicked us out. Hence, we made the assumption to explain such impossibility: 1. The reservation request by other guests can time travel, and it successfully went through a wormhole and arrived in the reservation system one month before it sent. 2. The internet connection between Germany and Turkey is inhumanly poor, such that our reservation request has delayed for a whole month and unfortunately conflicts with other guests` request. 3. The reservation system software is buggy. After we pointed out the illogic points in his explanation, the host`s shining face turned grey as his feeling was hurt. He decided not to defend for himself or find excuses anymore; he solidly told us, if we are not satisfied with the alternation, we could, of course, call Airbnb customer service for help, and we could, of course, go out and find another hotel for settling. I had to admit it was a brilliant fight back against us. He clearly understood that, on a December night, one is not stupid enough to give up an available apartment and risk spending all night on finding a new one. We have no choice but shut up. As a result, four people of us moved from an apartment with 6 beds to a smaller apartment with 2 beds, which is smelly and noisy. During the whole conversation, the host did not apologize for...

reviews[18].comments: This apartment is in an amazing location and we had an absolutely beautiful view of several mosques and even the Topkapi Palace at a distance. However, do not expect what the photos portray for the inside of the apartment. It is extremely outdated and needs a major renovation. The towels are very dingy and we had issues with the hot water not working in the shower. That being said, any issue we brought upon the front reception they were very responsive. In fact, the reason I am giving 3 stars is solely based upon how amazing the front staff was as they were considerate to the fact that we were three women traveling alone. They went out of the way to help us with even the smallest of tasks (thank you again for the birthday gift!) and we felt safe that there was a 24/7 reception. Also, you can't beat the location - it is walking distance to several cafes and shops. This apartment has a lot of potentials to be better regarding cleanliness and the outdated atmosphere. Since we were on the top floor the generator made a lot of noise which will bother light sleepers (such as my mom) but some soundproof windows can solve this issue! I would come back and stay in this apartment because of the location and the hospitable staff.
reviews[19].comments:
Please note that this apartment is, in fact, part of a hotel, with a small cafe in the "lobby" and a front desk and most features that a small hotel or hostel would have. 

And it's a place with many excellent attributes. Let's start with the fact that the view from this room/suite is fantastic. I don't have a basis for comparison, but I was wary of hotel rooms that claimed a view because I didn't know how good the views were. The pictures on the listing are actual pictures from the room. I spent a lot of time just looking out the windows.

Also positive was the attitude of the staff.  They were very friendly and helpful. One man walked me to a nearby supermarket to show me, another started breakfast a bit early for me, and they were all responsive in every way. 

Breakfast is fantastic, given that this is a small hotel, not a big multi-star place. You get a large plate of cheese, bread, fruits, yogurt, a boiled egg, some meat, honey, butter, jam. There is also coffee and tea and cold cereal and so on. It's a simple place, but they do a very nice job on breakfast.

The location is outstanding, too. It is at the bottom end of a steep tourist street very near the main bridge connecting the two old parts of Istanbul. You can walk to the Metro/tram in a few minutes and even walk across the bridge to the Hagia Sophia or Sultanahmet mosque (Blue Mosque). The Galata Tower is just a hundred meters or so just up the very steep street.

I loved the place, other than the fact that the living room furniture was sparse and quite stained. The bathroom is very high quality, you get a fridge and a sink and a microwave, and the bedroom is very nice. I am planning to go to Istanbul again in the next few weeks and the only reason I wouldn't stay there is because I might want to try a different neighborhood next time.
reviews[20].comments: Perfect location with an amazing view. one thing to keep in mind was that because the location was so central there was quite a bit of noise from the road. This is only something to consider if you're a very light sleeper though, otherwise I couldn't recommend this place more.

reviews[22].comments: I will start my review with the wise Turkish people's saying: Cevahir is Istanbul, Istanbul is Cevahir! The thing that Biray didn't emphasize enough is that her neighbour is only the best shopping-entartainment mall in the entire world - Cevahir! :D\r\nOn a side note, there really isn't anything that a guest could complain about while staying at Biray's residence. The location is perfect, since it's also 5-10 minutes on foot to metro, that gets you to Taksim in just 2 stops. The room is nice, and so is the toalet, kitchen, and the balcony. Only bit of an issue can be a WiFi which reaches to around the door of the room. Regarding the hosts, Biray and her cat were very considerate and polite. We didn't get much of a chance to get to know Biray very well, but she certainly is a professional host and always ready to give you useful advices and insights of her city. Overall, for the price we payed, this place is a true bargain.
reviews[23].comments: We was at Biray's home for 2 week and it was perfect! Great host, great location, lovely cat! It's in the center of the Istanbul and you have everything you need - shops, fish markets, mall, places to eat, metro and bus stations. Apartment is worm and cozy, fully equipped kitchen, WiFi. Biray is very friendly and she respect your own space. She is very clever and nice girl - glad to meet her!\r\nI highly recommend it!
reviews[24].comments: We had a very great stay at Biray's place. We found the apartments location close to a metro line to make all areas we wanted to see very easy to reach. The room was comfortable and her cat made it even more cozy. Most of all, Biray was an exceptionally kind host by helping us out with some flight scheduling issues we encountered, by calling the airline in turkish, for example. We also very much appreciated the tips she gave us about what to see in the city. Staying there made Istanbul a great trip, thanks again Biray! :) \n\nGerco and Lily
reviews[25].comments: My boyfriend and I stayed with Biray for a week during New Years and we had a blast! Biray's apartment is located in the European area of Istanbul and there is both a Carrefour and a Migros grocery store close by along with various other shops, so it is certainly convenient. Biray gave us great suggestions for restaurants to try in the area as well as where to go to celebrate NYE. Her cat is adorable as well!
reviews[26].comments: I'm really glad we had opportunity to stay at Biray's home. We've got a lot of advises, what to see or eat, we had nice chat about Istanbul culture and people. Room was very spacious, clean and cosy. Location is very good, close to touristic attractions and public transport. Thank you Biray!
reviews[27].comments: Biray was a good host. She showed us nice places to have lunch and recommended good food. The room is nice and comfy and the location is great. Cute and friendly cat!
reviews[28].comments:
I with my friend spent nine wonderful days visiting Biray. After almost 20 hour of traveling we arrived in cozy flat where was all set for comfortable rest. Every evening after our walks we met with gentle black girl (cat) Zeytin.
There is bus stop, metro and metrobus near home, you can reach almost any place in town, include Old city. Nearby is a lot of different shops where you can buy anything, from food to whatever you fantasy can imagine. One of unexpected pleasant thing for us was Cevahir AVM (biggest shopping mall of Europe) which is nearby too.
Our host, Biray, is charming, graceful girl with intresting look at things. She is great companion, we can just listen for her fascinating speech. Thank to Biray for a warm welcome, Kadıköy tour, wonderful evening with wine, and for essential gift. Special thanks for helped us to get acquainted with the magnificent city Istambul.
See you again!
reviews[29].comments: Nothing to complain about. Everything as described. Nice contact. Valuable hints.
reviews[30].comments: Very nice and clean room (as well as rest of the apartment) with a very friendly and welcoming host. Hey, what more can you wish for? :) Thank you very much, Biray!
reviews[31].comments:
Hi Biray! Sorry for delay feedback ;) I would like to say thank You and your funny, active cat! We had only one night to talk, however I understand that you are a good person. It was easy to talk with you. Thanks for SMS support during all my trip!
About apartments - everything as described on the picture

P.S. Biray speaks English very well:)
reviews[32].comments:
Birary was a fantasic host who was great with communication from the beginning, providing directions to her place easily in English and Turkish. She also provided valuable insight into local and distant attractions and transport options.

Her place was comfortable and spacious and we felt very welcomed. Her cat (Zeytin) is very friendly, often coming up for pats and rubs. The room is soundproof and Sisli has everything you need; food, shops, etc. The people in Sisli are also warm and receptive of people who can't speak English.

Transport is close and runs frequently to get you into Old Town.

The experience was fantastic overall and cannot be recommended more highly.
reviews[33].comments: Staying with Biray was an excellent experience. She is a really nice and helpful person, full of great advices. With her, we felt like living with a close friend. We went to have breakfast, shared stories and talk a lot about everything. Her house and the room is really nice, modern, big and with lots of light. The neighbourhood is perfect, near the metro and bus stations, lots of shops, markets, bakeries, cafes, restaurants, etc. I definetely recommend staying with Biray, for me, an excellent place to get to know Istanbul!
reviews[34].comments:
Bonjour Biray,
On te remercie, Ramzi et moi, du fond du cœur pour ta gentillesse et ta disponibilité. Tu nous as beaucoup aidés pour découvrir la ville d’Istanbul.
La chambre était lumineuse et bien aérée, on se sentait chez nous et en bonne compagnie. L’appartement est bien situé et le quartier est très calme.
Merci encore et à la prochaine.
reviews[35].comments: It was perfect to stay at Biray place. Everything was well prepared, comfortable and we felt like at home. She is great host which offer you the best and is very helpful. Flat is very well located in great district where you can find really everything. Big plus is here cool and friendly cat which we really lovec.
reviews[36].comments: The room is clean, nice and comfortable.  Biray is a good host - friendly, full of recommendations and kind.  Her cat is very cute and friendly.  Lastly, the area is great -- very local with no tourists -- lots of great places to eat and explore, and well connected to transport (5-10 minute walk to the metro).
reviews[37].comments: My friend & I had a great experience staying with Biray! She is extremely friendly, welcoming, and helpful. Her apartment is really nice, clean, and in a GREAT location. I would highly recommend staying here!
reviews[38].comments: We loved our stay at Biray's! Very well located for our needs and very affordable. Biray was a lovely host that made us feel welcomed and very comfortable, just like we were visiting a friend. Her cat is the most amazing roommate we could ask for and we were very happy with her company.\r\nThe house was as messy as a friend's house which made it feel more homy, the room was clean and very comfortable and the internet worked perfectly.\r\nI would recommend it and return, for sure!
reviews[39].comments: We had booked the Biray Anil place for 6 night stay. The choice was made initially as it was an excellent location very near to the to Taksim .The room was very clean & comfortable The kitchen had all necessary items .Durring our stay Biray was out of town so we could not spend time with her The place is very well connected through local transport - bus stop metro  is a in 10 minute walk.it is a great value for money and an excellent choice.
reviews[40].comments: Biray is a very helpful and hospitable person. The apartment looks exactly as it is on the photos. The location is perfect! Central district with lots of shops, and the biggest shopping mall in Europe is also near. It was nice and comfortable to stay in this apartment!
reviews[41].comments: The host canceled this reservation 26 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

reviews[0].comments: Staying at the Design Loft  in Pera 1 was an amazing experience! I felt at home as soon as I arrived to the property. The hosts Aylin and Jeff were superb. The apt exceeded my expectations. The pictures are 100% accurate and yet looks even better in person. It is centrally located in one of the best neighborhoods in Istanbul. The train station, the newest Soho house and all shopping and restaurant areas are nearby. I would stay here again when I go back to Istanbul! 100% recommended.
reviews[1].comments: We spent a great 5 days in Istanbul. It was our first time and we are still dreaming about it back to Paris.))))) Aylin was very responsive to my messages while booking as well as during our stay. Easy communication.The location is great for getting around the famous sites of Istanbul. The apartment is cozy, stylishly decorated and has all the necessities for a short stay. There is some humidity smell coming from the kitchen, but nothing an ambience refresher would not manage to solve. All in all, a good place to stay in the heart of the city.
reviews[2].comments: Aylin ha sido una muy buena anfitrona, nos ha recomendado sitios para comer, nos ha conseguido una cuna para nuestro bebe y un transfer desde el aeropuerto. La habitación era muy bien situada, súper bonita, limpia y perfecto de tamaño. Volveremos seguro. Gracias Aylin!
reviews[3].comments: Aylin hat unser sehr nett empfangen und hat uns auch immer geholfen wenn wir Hilfe gebraucht haben ! Das Apartment ist sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet ,es liegt sehr zetral so das man in der Früh und auch Abend immer in der näheren Umgebung des Apartments was Unternehmen kann .10 meter etfernt im Nachbarhaus ist ein kleiner Kiosk wo man kleinigkeiten einkaufen kann und in 3 minuten gehweg ist eine tolle Bäckerei.Was noch gesagt gehört das Apartment liegt in einem neuem Haus wo nur Ferienapartments ,dadurch finde ich es sicherer !Das einzige es riecht bissl unangenehm von der Klimaanlage oder Badezimmer. Wir würden das Apartment zu 100% Weiterempfehlen !
reviews[4].comments: The apartment is really great. There are no negative comments to make. Perfect location, very clean, easy access, calm, good reception. \r\nWe had a really great stay at Aylin's place and Aylin was very helpful in terms of restaurants, places to go etc ...
reviews[5].comments: Very nicely designed and decorated, we had a great time in Aylin's place. fully furnished with all the comfort. Nice view. Perfect location, 5 min by foot from the living heart of istanbul or the subway without the inconvenience. Aylin is a cool and great host. I can just recommend her place warmly.\r\nThanks Aylin for sharing places like this. \r\nJulien&Anne
reviews[6].comments: Our flight to Istanbul was cancelled on the departure day at the airport, so we weren't able to make it to Istanbul. I contaced Aylin, and she was very understanding and nice, even we cancelled on very short-notice.  As soon as we come to finally do this trip to Istanbul, we will definitely again book the apartment (and hope this time to make it- with another airline ;) ).
reviews[7].comments: Nous avons adoré ce studio très bien situé dans le quartier moderne d'Istanbul. Il est décoré avec beaucoup de goût, refait à neuf, les équipements sont en parfait état, la literie très confortable et la vue dégagée sur la ville très reposante. Il est vraiment conforme à ce qu'on peut voir sur les photos. Tout en étant à proximité des quartiers vivants de la ville, il se trouve dans une rue calme ce qui en fait un hâvre de paix quand on rentre. L'accueil d'Aylin était fantastique. elle nous a trouvé un excellent chauffeur de taxi pour le trajet de retour à l'aéroport. En bref, nous le recommandons vivement à tous ceux qui veulent un hébergement dans la partie animée d'Istanbul.
reviews[8].comments: The apartment was beautiful, clean and with a very comfy bed. A great view over the Bosphorus, with double glazing so no traffic noise - but we preferred leaving the windows open so we could hear the call to prayer! A great location to explore the trendy area around Taksim full of bars and restaurants, and an easy taxi ride to the old sites. Also near the port to get the ferry to the Asian side, which is fantastic. So all in all, a great and comfortable place to explore the city. \n\nAs well as this Aylin was a wonderful host - so warm, welcoming and friendly, had great recommendations and answered all our questions and teacher very quickly and helpfully. We can't recommend her place highly enough. Thank you so much Aylin for a wonderful weekend, we can't wait to come back!!
reviews[9].comments:
The apartment was a great base to explore Istanbul. Aylin was very helpful in booking us taxis and recommending places to eat. 

The apartment is clean and has everything we needed for our stay. We walked to most places from here but public transport is easy to use and there is a metro stop nearby.
It can be quite loud at night as it's in the city centre.

An app we found really useful for places to eat listed by area was called zawarib. 

A must see is the basilica cistern and I would also suggest getting a ferry to Kadikoy to eat. It's very cheap and the food is amazing.
reviews[10].comments: Perfect place, standards of cleanliness are really high which I mostly appreciate. Aylin is a lovely host and was extremely helpful. The modern decor is lovely and the location is great in a quiet area (I think there is no more quiet area in Istanbul). We really enjoyed the view from the big windows, the very comfartable bed. I will stay there again next visit to Istanbul.
reviews[11].comments: What an amazing flat!! Not only is it in a happening part of town, but it is also also perfectly sized for a stay in Istanbul. We stayed there for 6 days. Aylin iş lovely and I'd definitely recommend staying  here. Tips: Have dinner at Milka across the road at night the view is stunning over Istanbul (apx 175TL).
reviews[12].comments: We arrived in a little later in the evening, but Aylin was a superb hostess - she not only met us, but took the time to provide local recommendations on places to visit, eat, and also helped us arrange transportation services to the airport. The arranged taxi driver didn't actually show up on time, but that was a bit beyond her control and we were able to arrange otherwise. The flat is super cute and conveniently located - we absolutely loved our stay at Design Loft in Pera 1! Thank you!!
reviews[13].comments: I had the most wonderful stay at La Casa Pera. Aylin is uncompromising when it comes to quality and cleanliness. We spent the entire day walking around the city, averaging 50,000 steps a day. It made the visit that much more enjoyable to be able to come home to a cosy, clean and safe place that's right at the heart of the city but in a quiet corner. I highly recommend anybody to stay here on their visit to Istanbul. Aylin was always available to answer any questions and her response time is impeccable
reviews[14].comments: We very much enjoyed our stay at the Pera Lofts and Aylin was a great host. The space was perfect for a few days of leisure travel in Istanbul - ideally located in the great Shishane neighborhood, walkable to restaurants, shopping, and a few really shops (bakery, wine, cheese, etc.). The space was comfortable and we would definitely stay again when traveling to Istanbul!
reviews[15].comments: Aylin, das Loft und Istanbul waren wundervoll und haben unsere Reise zu einem tollen Erlebnis gemacht. Die Wohnung ist ruhig und zentral gelegen, picobello sauber und wunderschön. Ausserdem ist das Bett sehr bequem. Aylin war super hilfsbereit und sympathisch. Schon im Vorfeld half sie mir, den Geburtstag meines Freundes zu organisieren und auch vor Ort war sie stets für uns erreichbar. Alles in allem  sehr empfehlenswert!
reviews[16].comments: Alles Super! Apartment entspricht Beschreibung und Bildern. Die Lage Top und nette, hilfsbereite Gastgeberin!
reviews[17].comments: Aylin, thank you so much for this wonderful stay!  \r\nThe flat is perfect, clean, bright, located in a safe area and it is exactly like in the pictures. If you are looking for a nice place to stay in Istanbul, this is it!
reviews[18].comments: Aylin was a wonderful host. The apartment was well located and clean.
reviews[19].comments: Aylin was a great host and my husband and I just loved the apartment! Without a doubt we will look nowhere else when we come to Istanbul. I would highly recommend this apartment and Aylin to anyone. \nWe were looking to stay an extra day and Aylin was able to accommodate our request with no hassle at all. The location is perfect. Walking distance to Istiklal and Galata Tower, but not full of tourists. After just a day we felt like locals and made friends with the shop owners on the street. We can't wait to come back and stay here again.
reviews[20].comments: The perfect place to visit Istanbul. The apartment is small but convenient enough for a couple and very clean. Aylin provided us some local tips.
reviews[21].comments:
Excellent host, excellent location, great price.

Spotlessly clean.

Perfect.
reviews[22].comments: Great location and excellent apartment. Very modern albeit on the small size. It had everything we needed for our 3 night stay. No washing machine which was a pain but we just washed at the next place. The bed was super comfy and the apartment was secure. The room can be a little noisy when people are walking up the stairs and the internet is temperamental- which Aylin was looking into. The location was very central and only a few minutes walk from Istaklal. The apartment was hard to find for our taxi driver and a your we did, so get the taxi driver to speak with Aylin before you start driving to avoid any confusion. Highly recommended
reviews[23].comments: My boyfriend and I had two great nights in Aylin's apartment! The apartment is centrally located on a quiet side street, really close to Galata and loads of restaurants and shops. The apartment itself was spacious, clean, tidy & super cosy! Aylin & her husband were also lovely and made us feel very at home, providing tea, coffee and juice, even slippers were included. One watchout is that the pin drop on Airbnb is a little off location, and doesn't come up on (Hidden by Airbnb) maps (it's a small side street) & our taxi driver didn't know the street, so might be worth making sure you've got directions just in case. However, this was no bother and would highly recommend staying here!
reviews[24].comments: Design Loft Pera 1 was a delight to stay in. Tucked away in a quieter street, yet about a 5 minute walk from a main street of shopping and food that leads right into Taksim Square. The room was small but fit 3 of us comfortably. It is very clean and had everything we could need. There are also two small markets right around the corner where you can get all the essentials. We never got to meet Aylin, but she was very helpful - always quick to answer our questions and calls. Would definitely stay here again!
reviews[25].comments: My husband and I spent 9 days  in casa pera for our honey moon. Everything was perfect and even better than expected. Aylin is siply the best host you can have: very present, helpful and kind as turkish people everywhere :) Of course, I recomend it and I will come back very soon.
reviews[26].comments: Great Place, extremely clean and a perfect neighbourhood to be in. A few mins away from Taksim/Istiklal in a quite area with a newly renovated building. The place was exactly like shown in the pictures and we had an amazing time staying in such a comfortable loft. Aylin was a wonderful host and lovely person to talk to. Will see you soon!
reviews[27].comments: Aylin is a great host. She was very welcoming and available. The appartement is very nice ( like on pictures ), stylish, clean, comfortable and perfectly located. \r\nBuilding fully renovated in 2015, 15min walk from the Galata tower and few minutes from the subway station Shishane. Many little grocery stores around the flat.\r\nWe enjoyed our trip to Istanbul and will recommend the appartement anytime ! Thank you Aylin !
reviews[28].comments: The apartment - Exactly like shown in pics, modern, cosy, clean and well maintained and easily accessible by walk/cab. The location - Perfect, walking distance from Istiklal street but just distant enough in a quiet and upscale neighborhood. The host - the best part of all, she is ALWAYS available, helpful, resourceful and goes an extra mile to help and accomodate your requests. 5 stars for that. This is a gem of a combination, so if your next stop is Istanbul, this should end your search for the perfect place to stay.
reviews[29].comments: Perfect Stay, Perfect Host with great recommendations locations!
reviews[30].comments: The apartment is just as it looks in the pictures and beats any hotel room for quality and value. The location is also ideal, set on a quiet hillside but a perfect launchpad for all of the restaurants, cafes and bars in Galata. Very good access to public transport which we took everywhere without issues. Aylin was also very responsive to our questions and made the logistics of checking in and out completely hassle free!
reviews[31].comments: In short this is best Airbnb I've stayed in... The photos accurately reflect the interior, which is excellent. The space is spotless with everything you need, the little extras (such as mini shampoo) are a lovely touch too. Aylin a pleasure to liaise with and was available if we had any questions. I thoroughly recommend staying here!\n
reviews[32].comments: The apartment was excellent and had recently been refurbished to a very high standard. Absolutely no complaints. Well located near restaurants and bars with good public transport and grocery shops seconds away. We did not meet Aylin during our stay but she responded to online queries immediately and arranged transfers from the airport for us. Would stay again and recommend her to our friends.
reviews[33].comments: Great location. Not too far to some of the tourist areas and very close to some very nice restaurants, cafés and bars. Accommodation was clean and as described. Alyin was great in organising transport to and from airport too. Would definately recommend for a trip to Istanbul.
reviews[34].comments: We had a great time in Istanbul in October 2015. Ayline organised everything and the flat was just great. It is located in a nice and calm neighbourhood, with small shops and a very nice caffee close by. It takes not more than 10 min. walk to the heart of Beyoglu with nice locantas and bars.\r\nThe flat is abundantly recommendable and we would definitely book it once more, when coming to Istanbul again.
reviews[35].comments: Beautiful flat in a great location. Would highly recommend!
reviews[36].comments: Weary nice apartment, everything just like on pictures. Perfect location and housekeeping
reviews[37].comments: Our stay with Aylin was very easy and comfortable. The location is great with access to grocery stores and restaurants. The "big" tourist destinations are within walking distance from the apartment and public transport seems readily accessible if you don't have the time. Aylin was very helpful in confirming a day tour we had organised as we had no phone and could not speak the language. I definitely hope I make it back to Istanbul and Aylin's loft again.
reviews[38].comments: Aylin è molto gentile e simpatica;  parla inglese ma anche un ottimo italiano e tedesco. All'inizio il posto è un po' difficile da trovare (da Sabiha Gokcen) ma dopo un giorno ci accorgemmo che  l'appartamento è situato in una ottima zona: si tratta del cuore di Beyoglu Istanbul, con tantissimi ristoranti, bar, negozi; c'è anche l'Hotel inizio novecento dove soggiornava Agata Christie! Posto stupendo! La fermata Sishane della Metr (Website hidden by Airbnb) minuti, e la linea del tram T1 è vicina. \r\nIl nostro soggiorno è stato bellissimo, nessun problema, e spero di tornare di nuovo.  Istanbul è una città affascinante e l'appartamento di Aylin è perfetto per visitarla!
reviews[39].comments: Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit in diesem Loft. Die Lage und die Ausstattung lassen keine Wünsche offen. Aylin hat uns vor der Anreise und auch während des Aufenthaltes mit Tips versorgt. Vielen Dank!
reviews[40].comments: Pretty cool place, it was great having the airport transfer, that made it really easy. It's a really good location, close to the hustle and bustle of Istanbul but not noisy. Best of both worlds! Very comfortable and clean, and I would definitely stay their again. Aylin is a great host and this place is the perfect blend between a hotel and a home away from home.
reviews[41].comments: Aylin is a great host. She was very warm and communicative throughout our stay and helped us to schedule airport pick-ups with a local car service. It works out cheaper and easier than taxis or other services one might book. The flat is well decorated and maintained. The only downside is a slightly musty odor around the bathroom. It's in a great location and very comfy, and you won't be in the flat enough to worry about that since here is so much to do close by and across the city. It's well worth the price.
reviews[42].comments: Very nice place, good location. Host was extremely nice. Helped arrange taxis to airport
reviews[43].comments: Great apartment perfect location
reviews[44].comments: We loved the apartment. Great location.
reviews[45].comments: We had the most fabulous five night stay in Aylin's apartment. The location was amazing- so close to all the fantastic restaurants and bars and a quick tram trip across to Sultanahmet. Aylin was a fabulous host providing lots of helpful advice for navigating Istanbul as well as great places to eat. We will definitely stay here again the next time we are in Istanbul.
reviews[46].comments: We stayed in Istanbul 2 weeks ago. This appartment was just as it is in the pictures and a great location! Aylin The perfect host and recommended some great restaurants. We would definitely stay there again!
reviews[47].comments: Aylin is very kind and amazing host. She made sure that everything is perfect and smooth. The flat is very central, quiet and comfortable. Just few minutes to Istıklal and other central locations around Taksim. You can take a cap around the corner and Istanbul waits ahead in its charming invitation.
reviews[48].comments: Great location for this beautiful and comfortable apartment ,Aylin was very friendly and care all the time for us all the time i recommend to anyone who want to visit the Istanbul.
reviews[49].comments:
Bugüne kadar yaşadığım en iyi Airbnb deneyimiydi. Ev, fotoğrafta görülenden çok daha iyiydi, lokasyon her yere çok yakın. 

Ev gayet temizdi, ve Aylin'le iletişim kurmak çok kolaydı. Çok kibar ver yardımsever biriydi.

İstanbul'da tekrar bir yerde kalmam gerekirse muhakkak tercih ederim.
reviews[50].comments: Your apartment was perfect and the help you gave us with bookings and tours was fantastic. Everything worked out perfectly and it was all stress free! We loved our visit to Istanbul and our trip to Gallopoli and Ayvalik. Thank you so much for your personal touch!
reviews[51].comments: I had my best stay so far. Aylin's place felt much more like a luxury hotel then an apartment. The location was superb. Close to almost any intresting place but also very close to places from where you can catch transportation to places of interest that are more far away.  The bed was very comfortable, shops for small needs were steps away and Aylin was very friendly and helpful during all my stay. When i return to beautiful istanbul again i would love to stay in Aylin's place again without hasistation.
reviews[52].comments: Amazing apartment, would really recommend!!
reviews[53].comments: We had a fantastic time at Aylin's apartment beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean, just like in the photos. Great location in walking distance to tourist attractions and tram-line. Aylin was very helpful with all the questions we needed to ask her and we always got an answer back promptly, she even organised our shuttle to and from the airport. Thanks for a great stay Aylin!!
reviews[54].comments: Amazing apartment. Aylin was very communicative and hospitable. Fantastic location! Aylin let us arrive early and stay a little later. Would definitely come back here again!
reviews[55].comments: Wir haben uns in dem Loft sehr wohl gefühlt! Es war hell, gemütlich und sehr zentral zu allen Highlights Istanbuls gelegen. \r\nBei Fragen oder Tipps hat Aylin innerhalb kürzester Zeit geantwortet. \r\nVielen lieben Dank für alles, wir kommen gerne wieder:-)
reviews[56].comments: The apartment is amazing and Aylin is the perfect host! She arranged our transportation from the airport and made sure everything was perfect for us during our stay. Will definitely come back to this places when I'm back in Istanbul.

name: A Lovely, Modern, 1bd Apt in Center
summary: This is the top floor flat of my historical building, which I bought and completely renovated it in late 2011. I originally designed this flat for my partner and myself but unfortunately we don't live in Istanbul right now and rent it out.
space: - it has 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a living room with kitchenette. - very conveniently located in the city center, kurdela street, omer hayyam in Beyoglu. Only five minutes to walk to bustling Istiklal Street and Taksim. - electricity, central heating system, water and unlimited wireless internet connection are all included in the price. - great orientation, bright apartment. - security and alarm system for the entire building, including gas and fire detectors in kitchen and bedrooms, cameras in front and back facades. - shared laundry room with two washing machines, iron and vacuum cleaner. - basic furniture (bed, study desk, wardrobe, coach), double glazed wooden windows and warm and noiseless floor, 24 hours hot water, newly fitted modern kitchenette (cooking unit, fridge), common backyard. - available for short or long term rent.
description: This is the top floor flat of my historical building, which I bought and completely renovated it in late 2011. I originally designed this flat for my partner and myself but unfortunately we don't live in Istanbul right now and rent it out. - it has 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a living room with kitchenette. - very conveniently located in the city center, kurdela street, omer hayyam in Beyoglu. Only five minutes to walk to bustling Istiklal Street and Taksim. - electricity, central heating system, water and unlimited wireless internet connection are all included in the price. - great orientation, bright apartment. - security and alarm system for the entire building, including gas and fire detectors in kitchen and bedrooms, cameras in front and back facades. - shared laundry room with two washing machines, iron and vacuum cleaner. - basic furniture (bed, study desk, wardrobe, coach), double glazed wooden windows and warm and noiseless floor, 24 hours hot water, newly fitted modern kitchene
neighborhood_overview: It is a very central place, walking distance to main pedestrian streets full of cafes and restaurants, and also transportation hubs. 5 minutes walking distance to bus station, and 10 minutes to metro. There is a local market in the street on Sundays, which you can buy cheap and fresh vegetables and fruits with good quality. A small Carrefour and SOK supermarket is around the corner. Another local market is located just opposite the street, which you can buy all essentials. It is not a touristic neighborhood, more of a local, working class one. Municipality started a huge regeneration project couple of years ago, not too far from our street. This triggered the transformation of the area. Low-income families are moving out, and recently many students and foreigners have been moving in due to its location. We still have the traditional social life in our neighborhood. Next door carpenter and electrician, owner of the market, or the guys from the local tea house are great helps whenever we
transit: The location is very central. 10 minutes walking distance to main pedestrian street with lots of cafes, bars and restaurants which is called Istiklal. To the historical sites and museums you can go by bus, metro or tram, you may need to combine couple of them. It takes only 30-40 minutes.
access: You'll have the entire apartment for yourself.
interaction: Unfortunately I don't live in Istanbul, I live in Nairobi. But especially summer time I try to spend my time in Istanbul as much as I can. When I am in Istanbul, you can be sure that I spend a lot of time with my guests! And sometimes it turns out to be a good friendship :) When I am not in Istanbul, my nephew, Baran, who is also a university student, lives in the same building and helps me to welcome my guest. He is a great guy!
house_rules: - Smoking is not allowed inside the flat due to the wooden floor, windows, doors and furniture. - Your security is at your own risk and I do not accept responsibility for any loss. - Please keep the windows closed when you are not at home. - Do not reset Internet settings and modem setup, and do not touch or adjust security cameras. - Do not adjust the level of central heater. Due to the security, it should not be exceeded 60 degrees. - Do not throw your hairs in the shower drainage, and use particular chemicals to remove blocked items regularly. - Do not use towels to wipe up floors. - Be responsible in using the cleaning materials and replace the amount you use. - Keep all shared items and materials at common place, do not keep them in your room/flat. - Do not leave bad foods in the fridge. - Gas stove and electricity bulbs should be switched off after use.
host.host_about:
I am an urban planner and bought a historical building in the city center of istanbul. I completely renovated my building and let it now.

Currently I live in Nairobi, but I have a friend called Firat, who assists me excellently to welcome my guests in Istanbul. We try to provide our guests a warm atmosphere, with basic and comfortable accommodation at reasonable price. Because this is simply what I want while I am traveling!
reviews[0].comments:
I have stayed in Pinar's apt at Kurdela Sok for 8 nights in June 2012. She told me that I was her first renter via this website after the students who rented the apt before had left. It's located in a lively and colorful and relatively poor popular neighborhood, in which it is one of the very few renovated buildings. This means that you get in touch with the life of real Istanbul people that you normally might not meet as a tourist in the regular tourist aereas. It is very near very well known and touristy aeras as Taksim Square, Istanbul's main shopping street Istakal Caddesi and the major aera with bars, cafés and clubs (all 5-10 mins walking). On Sundays there is a nice and busy market on the street. Lively means also quite noisy: bring your earplugs if you want to sleep early or sleep in the morning. 
The apartment itself has been renovated in a simple and tasteful way: wooden floor, simple but adequate bathroom and kitchen 
tyhe only inconvenience I acn think of is that the bathroom floor isn't perfectly inclined to the shower drain, in a way that the bathroom floor remains partly wet. The absence of airconditioning is not a problem, since the large number of windows make that there is enough ventilation. Pinar has been very kind: she even left some food and drinks in the fridge. 
Last but not least: istanbul is a great cuity, which will make your stay unforgettable!
reviews[1].comments: We had a really nice time in Istanbul and enjoyed to stay at Pinars flat. It is in walking distance from the main shopping area around Istiklal and Taksim Square. The street and area is very lively (also in the evenings) and there is a local market on Kurdela Sokak on sundays.\r\n\r\nThe flat itself is very nice, but staying there in the middle of summer with 35 C, air-condition would be a nice upgrade.
reviews[2].comments:
A clean and nice flat in the center of Istanbul.
Close to accomodations.
Pinar is a friendly host.
You have laundry,little balcony etc.
The area can be very busy during the market and sometimes a bit noisy in the evening.
Good spot!!
reviews[3].comments: Расскажите другим участникам сообщества Airbnb о вашей поезкде. Это будет показано на странице объявления.
reviews[4].comments: Pinar's place is a cute, well-renovated house in a working class neighborhood near Taxim pedestrian area. The place is spotless, only hiccup is that it does not have ac, however if you are visiting out of season it should not be a problem. Pinar is a cool host. She responded to our last minute request and since she lives in the sme building she was superflexible with check-in/out. She was really nice and helpful.
reviews[5].comments: We can only affiliate with the previous reviews. Pinar`s flat is comfortably furnished, clean and excellently located. We spent a wonderful time in Istanbul and can only recommend Pinar`s "cosy flat".
reviews[6].comments: Pinar's apartment is very well renovated, comfortable and clean. We had a very pleasant stay! The flat is located in an authentic, non-touristic Istanbul neighbourhoods which we enjoyed very much. Pinar is a very quick responding and nice host. She organised all we needed for a good stay, and there was a lack of nothing! We would select the flat again.
reviews[7].comments:
we had a wonderfull time in pinars apartment.
the flat is situated in a very original part of istanbul, which i find great.
off the beaten track, this is where you really get to know turkey.
especially the market is fascinating and super tasty.
the perfect place for two, if you are looking to stay in istanbul from one night to a year!
reviews[8].comments: The apartment of Pinar was very cosy, nice and clean. It felt immediately like home. It was a very great location in a neighborhood very close to the Istiklal Cadessi and Taksim, but far enough from the real tourist area. Wednesday, there was a market in the street, with a lot of fresh fruit and vegetables. If we come to Istanbul ever again, we will certainly book this great flat. Pinar and her friend were also very helpfull!
reviews[9].comments: The flat looks exactly like in the pictures: very clean, newly renovated and sunny. The area is a quiet, non-touristic neighborhood, but only a 10 minutes walk from the frenzy of Istiklal Caddesi. We enjoyed it very much, especially the Sunday market. We did not meet Pinar, but her her friend Firat welcomed us to the flat. Everything was perfect and I would definitely recommend the flat!
reviews[10].comments:
The flat was really the same as the pictures show - it is very cosy! Also the equipment of it was very good - the kitchen had everything you need. There was even a hair dryer in the flat. We also used the washing machine in the basement which enabled us to keep our luggage small. Which was important to us as we spent there 3,5 weeks and with two children (3 years, 8 months). Pinar and Firad were so nice and gave us extra mattresses that we put on the floor so that the four of us could stay in this apartment. 
It was also great to have WLAN which worked pretty well.

Opposite the apartment there is a small grocery store (and several more in the street) where we bought most of our food. Generally, the people were very friendly in the neighbourhood, a neighbourhood with "normal" people, not touristic at all. Which we liked a lot and was also one reason why we took this flat. Secondly, it was the location of it: maybe a 15min. walk to Beyoglu. 

It was very easy to communicate with Pinar, she was very accommodating so that we would love to be her guests again. Next time...! 
çok teşekkürler!
reviews[11].comments: The apartment is great and in a really good location! The market on Sunday is amazing. Firat was a great help and suggested places to eat and go in the evenings! He also came and rescued us when I locked us out of the flat!
reviews[12].comments: We spent an amazing 3 weeks in Istanbul.  The location, the flat, the wifi, the neighbourhood - everything was awesome.  The flat is huge and there is a lot of room to relax, work, rest, or people watch at the windows!  The water was shut off one day - but that had nothing to do with the flat as it was the whole neighbourhood.  The flat isn't exactly as it is in the pictures - it is definitely more worn than they appear, but still a great place. The market on sunday is an added bonus - as are the hills to help burn off some of the cheese we ate! :)  I would love to stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone. Thanks again Pinar!
reviews[13].comments:
+  The apartment is sweet
+  There are 5 other People who are very nice
+  During the day the neighborhood is nice
- at night it was very spooky, their are many men on the street
+  Dining options and Shops, very good, lots of people to help you learn Turkish if you  like
-  For this area the rent is to much (we were their for 5 months)
-  in winter it is very cold in the Apartment, the Windows are not good, when it rains, it's damp inside, it is very windy.
- Tarlabasi has Problems with electricity and water supply
- in the garden their are a lot of cats, sometimes they became disruptive to my sleep
reviews[14].comments: We stayed at Pinars place for about 6 months, and absolutely loved it! The apartment has the best location imaginable, close to the center and with a wonderful sunday market right outside the door.\r\n\r\nThe area is super charming and has some of the tastiest and cheapest food around. Highly recommended!!
reviews[15].comments:
Pinar was an excellent hostess. She was home from Kenya during our visit, and even took us around the city and out to a Turkish dinner. Wonderful!

The apartment is as listed - it is lovely, clean, bright, and big. It's on a quiet street, very comfortable, and has all amenities you might need. There is a wonderful street market outside on Sundays. 

Wifi is 3-8MBS, but that is common throughout Turkey. I would recommend getting a SIM card with 3G to tether if you need fast Internet. 

One issue to know before you book: This apartment is solidly in the ghetto. It is very close (3 blocks) to the nice, touristy part of town. But make no mistake - this is the ghetto. Example: A homeless guy slept in our doorway for 3 nights (Pinar's friend quickly took care of this), and there was presumably human feces left by this homeless man outside our door for a few days.

So while this place was fine for us, just be aware of the location - I would not recommend this spot for families with small children, or anyone who feels uncomfortable around overt poverty. It is not dangerous, however. I never felt unsafe - the area is just unclean, and there are a lot of squatters. 

So if you're ok with an area with "character" - this apartment will be perfect for you! Overall very nice and exactly what we expected.
reviews[16].comments: We stayed in Pinar’s apartment for 1 month in December and January. We found the apartment to be clean and bright and very much like the photos. Pinar was visiting from Kenya and we had the opportunity to meet her. She was very friendly and was quick to clear a couple of issues with the house when we moved in. The kitchen was adequate and we were able to prepare our meals in the house. There are stores nearby but selections are not great and visits to multiple stores might be necessary to find what you need. The washing machine on the lower level was a welcome addition. As others have done, I would have to mention that the neighborhood could be seen as rundown and difficult for some. The apartment is located a short distance from Istiklal Avenue, however the hill up to Istiklal is very steep and you have to walk in the busy road most of the way. It could be seen as dangerous to some. We also found public transportation difficult unless you first walk to either Taksim Square or Tunel Funicular which are both nearly 20 minutes away. There is a tram on Istiklal but it is not reliable. The neighborhood can be noisy, but we found it to be nice when we met people in shops in the neighborhood. The Sunday market outside the door would be a highlight for anyone visiting.
reviews[17].comments: This lovely house is in a unique and must seen historic neighborhood in Beyoglu. We really enjoyed being 4-5 minutes away from the mid point of the most famous avenue called Istiklal Street. The hosts  are kind and nice people. It's the right choice if you want to enjoy your visit in Istanbul.
reviews[18].comments: +Good location, confortable flat, kindness host family+  The flat located 5min from Omer Hayyam bus stop,10 min from Istiklal street,20min from Taksim or Sishane metro stations on foot. Many small supermarkets are around the apartment. Every sunday we can see big street market in front of the door.  Rooms are clean and pretty same as photos. I stayed in winter time, it was snowing it was so cold outside, but inside was warm by heating machine. Also there was a airconditioner in bed room, but I didn't have to use it. Enough speed wi-fi, foldable dining table(I used this as a big pc desk), enough kitchin stuffs were there. I really relaxed in this flat.  Thank you Pinar!!
reviews[19].comments: I stayed at Pinar's apartment three plus weeks for what amounted to a very comfortable stay. The apartment itself is excellent value -- spacious, cozy, & with everything you should need. I loved spending hours reading on the cushions in the bay windows overlooking the street. It's very well located less than a ten minute walk from Beyoglu and Taksim. The neighbourhood's somewhat rough character could be an issue for some people, but really, they shouldn't be put off -- everyone I came across was friendly and I never felt unsafe. Tarlabasi is a lively, fascinating area, with one of Istanbul's more interesting stories. One night I was invited to join in the dancing at a Kurdish wedding celebration just down the street. The shopkeeper with the food stall across the way was unfailingly helpful. And Sunday mornings are a nice surprise when the entire street is given over to a market, which is when I did most of my grocery shopping. (You step out the front door and there's a guy selling olives or cheese or spices for the day.) When I eventually return to Istanbul I would definitely consider staying here again.
reviews[20].comments: Konumu itibariyle hosnut olmasak da ev ile ilgili bir sıkıntı yaşamadık
reviews[21].comments: Pictures do reflect the place, clean and new, which is in a renovated house in a slowly gentrifying area. Pinar and relatives were quickly responsive and helpful with all issues.  Will rent it again for my next long term visit.
reviews[22].comments: warm and comfortable apartment in family style neighborhood ,you will feel like a local and  surprise yourself during on Sunday market, not  far from  the  touristic   area  by  walk  ,  leave  yourself    free   to  explore   around     the    unknown   part  of   historic    area  of   Beyoglu!
reviews[23].comments:
Pinar's flat was a disappointing experience. The main difference from the photos is the bathroom - it's really old and needs remodeling badly. I even wore flip-flops in the shower. There is no shower curtain or separation of the shower area, so water gets all over the bathroom floor. Despite what the listing said, there was no shampoo or hair dryer. The neighborhood is also rough - really poor and not somewhere I would want to walk at night alone.

We booked Pinar's flat very last-minute after another host cancelled, which was very flexible of her, but 45 minutes after booking she informed me the flat was being painted and we had to stay in another room for the first night. The "other room" turned out to be a room in her nephew's downstairs flat. We had no idea we would be sharing a flat for the first night, and the flat we booked wasn't ready until 7 pm the next evening because they hadn't cleaned it. She didn't offer us a discount or anything for staying in a shared flat instead of the one we booked, or for the very late check-in.

In summary - this place might be fine as a long-term choice for students on a budget, but if you're in Istanbul for a few days and are looking for a nice place, stay somewhere else.
reviews[24].comments: Everything was ok but the appartament  is rather dark not like on the pictures , if you switch on the light it’s dim particularly in the evening , it was very cold to take a shower so we couldn’t because it was too cold ! And as for the area that was very important ! It’s like Arab district and in the evening it was not pleasant and not safe for us to come back home ! Very dirty street and if you are two girls you will be scared to come back alone ! And it is very noisy because in the morning the cars come , people cry so we didn’t sleep ! \nP.s the new phew of piñar is a good pleasant person who showed us everything
reviews[25].comments: Great place to stay in Istanbul!
reviews[26].comments: Pinar and Baran were very communicative and helpful. Provided me with all I needed!
reviews[27].comments: Pinar's apartment is ideal for both short and long-term stays. If you enjoy walking, it is perfectly located to discover the city by foot. The place is spacious and quiet, as there is not much traffic. The market on Sundays is a particular highlight as it is literally outside the front door.\nBaran, Pinar's nephew, is there to ensure that you find everything you need and is a terrific help.\nI spent a month here and am happy to recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. What is more, both Pinar and Baran are extremely forthcoming and very quick to respond to any questions.
reviews[28].comments: Smooth check in & out! Pinar & Baran were very responsive and helpful!\nVery cosy apartment! Thanks a lot.
reviews[29].comments: Very nice, good value!
reviews[30].comments: Very nice flat in a popular area, close to buses from/to both airports. Baran was really nice and helpful. The flat was clean and looks like the pictures. We recommend it!
reviews[31].comments: Grand appartement ! Un cadre idéal pour des vacances ! Prêt d'une rue assez passante, la chambre est située du côté opposé donc parfait ! (pour les oreilles sensibles comme moi, je conseille tout de même les boules quies) (Website hidden by Airbnb) 10-15 minutes à pied de la grande rue menant à Taksim Square, où l'on trouve vraiment tout. L'appartement est située dans une rue descendante de la grande rue Tarlabasi, un ami m'a tout de même conseillé en tant que femme seule de ne pas trop y traîner la nuit, car on s'excentre un peu) (Website hidden by Airbnb) Le neveu de Pinar est très réactif aux questions et dispo pour aider, donc hôtes au to (Website hidden by Airbnb) Je recommande cet airbnb pour tous les couples (avec 1 enfant aussi je pense que ce serait parfait)!
reviews[32].comments: I’d recommend a couple looking for a central private flat in Istanbul to stay here! The location was excellent, very close to our favourite areas of the city with hip bars and independent shops! The flat met all our basic needs, although not to the standard of a hotel we were barely in the flat as there was so much to do nearby! Pinar and Baran were very helpful and always responded quickly to any questions we had, perfect hosts. Thanks so much to both of you for letting us stay, we loved exploring the city!
reviews[33].comments: Good for couples looking to for some privacy and good location to do some sightseeing and feel the Turkish way of living.
reviews[34].comments: the apartment of Pinar is located not far (approx. 5 minutes by foot) from the main shopping street and is beautifully and functionally furnished.
reviews[35].comments: We had a wonderful time here.
reviews[36].comments: Very nice stay. Our host was really welcoming and helpful. The Appartement was really clean and conform to the description and pictures. \nI wholeheartedly recommend them
reviews[37].comments: Adorable newly renovated, comfortable flat. Everything you need is provided, including a well-equipped kitchen. Pinar's nephew Baran helped us with check-in and questions, and since he lives in the building that was very easy, and he was very friendly and helpful. The immediate neighborhood feels rundown, but the flat is walking distance to restaurants, transportation, coffee shops. It's a good value for such a large place, but the tradeoff is being a little farther away from the action.
reviews[38].comments: Thanks to our host for having us. Istanbul is definitely worth a trip. Pinars appartment is lovely and clean. Communication with her and Baran was easy. He helped us with first steps when we arrived. The neighborhood is not that nice but we didn‘t mind.
reviews[39].comments: Pinar’s apartment is absolutely gorgeous. It is bright, clean and spacious. It is well appointed with everything you’d need for your stay. It’s located in a lively and colourful neighbourhood. There are grocery stores and restaurants nearby and a market in the street every Sunday, selling fresh produce. \nThis place is wonderful, I would highly recommend a stay here.
reviews[40].comments: We had a lovely stay at Pinar’s apartment during our week in Istanbul. We met her nephew, Baran, on arrival, who lives in the apartment below and was friendly, helpful and quick to respond to any queries we had during our stay. The apartment is well located, 5/10 minutes walk from the Nevizade restaurant area and bars to the South. The only thing I would recommend to other guests is to bring earplugs as the apartment is very close to a mosque. reviews[41].comments:
I stayed at Pinar's apartment in the Tarlabasi neighbourhood of Beyoglu for one month. The 1-bedroom apartment is spacious, clean and well maintained. The bed is firm, but comfortable and with radiators in every room it was sufficiently warm at night. (My stay was in the late fall, when the Istanbul weather is a little unpredictable.) The kitchen, though small, was perfect for cooking and Pinar provided nearly every kitchen item that one could need for meals small or large.

Contrary to what you might hear or read online, Tarlabasi is a safe and very interesting neighbourhood. It is very much a local area, where people live their lives, go to the local stores, drink tea for hours at the local shops, and go to the amazing and enormous Sunday market that is right on the same street as Pinar's building. It is very close to more touristy & fashionable areas (Istiklal Street, Galata, Taksim, Cihangir, Karakoy, etc.), but it is not a tourist area. So if you want a relatively quiet and relaxing place to stay, where you can see how "normal" people live in Istanbul, I'd highly recommend Pinar's apartment.

Pinar and Baran, her nephew who lives in the building, were extremely helpful and responsive to my queries. I would stay at Pinar's place again & recommend it for open-minded and thoughtful visitors to Istanbul.

Çok teşekkürler Pinar!
reviews[42].comments:
This apartment is one of the true treasures in Istanbul. Huge space, lots of light, perfectly decorated, comfortable bed + couch... everything was perfect. And the Sunday market is just about the most local experience you can have. When I come to Istanbul, this is the only place I will stay at. It's perfect. 

Per the comments on the neighborhood, this is the real Istanbul! None of the touristy fake stuff you'll get up on Istiklal. Families live here, chat here, hang up their colorful laundry together, so you truly do get an actual feel of the city. 

Book this place immediately, and for longer than you think.
reviews[43].comments: We had a fantastic stay at Pinar's place. It is well located and many of the attractions of the city are easy to reach.

reviews[101].comments:

reviews[107].comments:
Alexis' heritage suite is a wonderful home away from home! Alexis answered our emails promptly and was very detailed. The house is an absolute gem. It's been lovingly updated and is in a very convenient and neighbourly locale. It is spotlessly clean! 

The beds are super comfortable, the bedding is lovely. The bathroom is comfortable with a great shower! There is also a. dishwasher and washing machine. Wifi is excellent. Dishes etc are all new. 

We really liked the layout as there was a nice dining and working area and a separate and spacious lounge with comfortable seating. The decor is very relaxing and we felt very at home. We arrived when the temperature was cold at the beginning of January but the suite was lovely and warm with excellent heating and double paned windows. Alexis very thoughtfully provided books on Istanbul, maps and guides and also a variety of novels by Turkish authors. Nice touch.  

We enjoyed walking Istiklal Street, to the Sultanameht area, Galata Bridge, Besitkas, the list goes on.  We took a Bosphorus tour with Turyol which was very good. There are hundreds of tiny, delicious restaurants and bakeries within walking distance and some higher end venues as well. We like to walk and found we could reach most "must see" things within 15 minutes to an hour or the metro was nearby (5 mins) and there are taxis always at Taksim. 

Without question we would recommend staying at Alexis' heritage suite. We really felt like we could have stayed for weeks!

reviews[125].comments:

reviews[129].comments: Alexis的房子位置很好,步行去塔克西姆广场大约10分钟,周围有两个开到很晚的小超市｡ Alexis的公寓非常非常干净,居家的所有设备都有,非常的方便,希望Alexis可以准备一些城市地图,地铁线路图之类的小册子更方便游客｡谢谢Alexis的招待｡
reviews[130].comments: We enjoyed our stay in this apartment - it's well located on a quiet street, fairly close to major transport and to restaurants and shopping on Istiklal Street, in the New District of Istanbul.  The apartment was comfortable, with all basic amenities, plus air-conditioning and Wifi.  Alexis had sent us useful information beforehand on how to get to the apartment, and Alexis' father was waiting for us on our arrival and showed us the basic features of the apartment and reviewed the few rules (take off shoes on entry, keep windows closed, how to use keys).  There are a few things which could make things easier for visitors:  (i) a more accurate map showing the location of the apartment; the one Alexis sent us - which we appreciated - had some inaccuracies, and both my husband and I, arriving separately, had a little trouble finding the right street and the right block, although we did find the apartment eventually; (ii) the router for the Wifi needed to be restarted several times - Alexis had left a note to that effect, but without indicating where the router was located.  Once we found it, attached to the wall above the front door, we had to stand on a chair and reach up to get to it - only my daughter and my husband could do this; I was too short, so if it had been up to me to restart it, I would not have been able to do it.  What was a minor inconvenience for us could be a bigger inconvenience for shorter visitors.  (iii) we had some trouble figuring out how to use the washing machine, particularly how to get it opened when we thought the wash was done; my husband finally figured it out, but it wasn't obvious, and some instructions on how to use it correctly would be helpful; (iv) most important, I tried to contact Alexis while we were staying at the apartment, in connection with the washing machine, by email and by phone, trying both telephone numbers he gave, and was unsuccessful.  He never answered my email and I couldn't get through on either number.   Visitors need to be able to reach him with questions or problems.  Having said all this, we would recommend the apartment to others - it was really quite a good place to stay.
reviews[131].comments: Alexis is a caring host. The location is wonderful.

reviews[171].comments: A very clean apartment, close to taksim square, has nice food places close by. On a very steep road!
reviews[172].comments: Apartment is lovely. Everything was spotless. Coffee, tea, water, soap & laundry liquid were provided. The building is on a quiet street on a steap hill. Bedding was all clean & smelled lovely. \nBalcony looks over onto a quaint street with cute cats roaming around.
reviews[174].comments: Very nice and clean and the most important very near to taksim square. If there was a dryer and elevator it would be perfect.
reviews[175].comments: very nice place and very nice people...\r\n
reviews[176].comments: Alexis was a great host he was very attentive and communicated well. Nice apartment, good location and very clean.
reviews[177].comments:
The host was welcoming us very friendly and intoduced us to the details of the apartment. Before travelling to Istanbul the communication was perfect, the host provided us all the relevant and necessary information prior to our arrival (e.g. the different possibilities to get from the airport to the apartment, telephone numbers etc.).
The apartment was very clean and every single detail completely matched to the description on Airbnb.
The biggest advantage of the apartment was definetly its location. Taksim Square and the very famous shopping mile "Istiklal Caddesi" were just 5 minutes away to walk. If you want to discover the rest of this beautiful city, you can take the Metro or the busses at Taksim Square.
In general, we had a wonderful week in this apartment in Istanbul.
I can highly recommend this apartment to everyone, who wants to discover beautiful Istanbul.
reviews[178].comments: Excellent apartment. Comfortable and well equiped with everything you need. Location is also excellent as t is walking distance from Taksim square.
reviews[179].comments: the house clean and perfect and the location is very near to everything ....
reviews[181].comments:
I had a very pleasant stay in Alexis's place, and, on future trips to Istanbul, would be glad to stay here if he'll have me back.  :-)

Alexis's flat fulfilled many of the options I was seeking in an Airbnb space: walkable neighbourhood, easy access to public transit, residential but with great access to restaurants and nightlife; and Alexis's home fulfilled all these criteria. 
Additionally, the space is clean, private, excellent value for money, and very well-appointed...among the best Airbnbs I have so far stayed in. 

Alexis was helpful throughout my stay, and I especially appreciate the fact that his lovely parents stayed to welcome me even though the check-in hour was quite late.

I recommend Alexis, his place. and his lovely parents to you all. :-)
reviews[182].comments: Alexisov stan je smješten na oko 10 minuta šetnje do trga Taksim. Stan je čist, udoban i dovoljno veliki za tri ili četiri osobe. Sve pisane poruke koje sam razmijenila sa Alexisom prije dolaska u Istanbul, u potpunosti su bile ispoštovane i sve je bilo u najboljem redu.\nPreporučujem Alexisov stan svima koji imaju namjeru da odsjedaju u dijelu grada koji je blizu Taksimu.
reviews[183].comments: Alexis was a great host and his house is great as well. It's not too far from Taksim so a great location to stay at. However, if you've got luggage then it's difficult to get to on foot since the house is uphill and you have to climb a narrow stairway. Overall it was a great experience but I do think that Alexis could've provided us with some basic household items. Apart from that, great clean apartment at a great location.
reviews[184].comments: Отличная квартира недалеко от основной улицы. Второй этаж, тихо спокойно. Хороший ремонт, делали для себя. Все необходимое в квартире есть. Дополнительно просили только второй ключ от квартиры. Все очень чисто. Постель в спальне безумно удобная. Надеюсь в следующий раз получится остановиться тут же
reviews[185].comments: Really nice place, renovated to a high standard for Istanbul apartments, very large, equipped with everything (though had to go searching for towel - it's in a drawer in bathroom), highly recommended, only thing had problems with was communication, took long time to hear back from host about this booking and another booking, missed on one booking due to the response time, also never met any host as a friend arranged key, this is what led to problems finding towel (borrowed one for first few days), highly recommend apartment though, it's much larger than appears in photos and very comfortable
reviews[186].comments: Sehr empfehlenswert! Super Lage, sehr sauber, sehr komfortabel! Danke!
reviews[187].comments: Great Host, Great Location to discover the city. Clean and comfortable, recommended !
reviews[188].comments: Top Lage, die Wohnung hat alles, was man braucht. Die Kommunikation war unkompliziert und hat super funktioniert. Die Wohnung von Alexis würde ich auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.
reviews[189].comments: This place was very nice! The flat was clean and comfortable, and only a short walk to Taksim Square.
reviews[190].comments: Great stay at Alexis house, everything was accurate, I recommend ! :)
reviews[191].comments: Great place, close to everything but still quiet which is a big bonus in Istanbul
reviews[192].comments:
