reviews[193].comments: The flat is very beautiful, all perfect.
reviews[194].comments: Alexis is super nice and his guide is really helpful to find the apartment. it's located in the downtown, few steps to all the shops, very convenient to buy things, go to different places and to the airport. highly recommend!
reviews[195].comments: Very good place to stay. Near taxim square. The neighborhood is nice. Easy to find everything nearby. The place is very cozy
reviews[196].comments: The flat is located in a quiet neighborhood yet within a short walk to a major street with several cafes, restaurants, convenience stores, and banks. Alexis' brother was supposed to be waiting for us at the flat for check-in, but there was no answer after numerous rings. We did not have a local SIM, but luckily, a guy at the hotel nearby was nice enough to let us use his phone so we could call his brother; he ended up showing up within a few minutes. The flat itself is spacious, clean, and tastefully decorated. It was well equipped for our needs. Wifi didn't work that well, but all in all, it was a good stay.
reviews[198].comments: Appartement très propre, Proprietaire très sympa. Nous avions à disposition tous se qu'il fallait, même des serviettes  de salle de bain toute propre, les draps et les lits tout propre. Très satisfait. Le seul seul bémol, il y avais des clim que dans les chambre et non pas dans le salon. Au salon nous avions en ventilo sur pied. Mais sinon tout était perfecto :)
reviews[199].comments:
Another 5-Star stay at Alexis's.  :-)
I stayed here the first time a few months ago, and was pleased to see on this most recent visit that all the attributes (very clean, very cosy, and very well-appointed quarters) that made Alexis's apartment a great stay the first time were even better the second.
I also enthusiastically recommend Alexis as a host: he is proactive with communication, and detailed with logistics...essential qualities to ensuring a smooth experience.
Enjoy.
reviews[200].comments: We arrived late and Alexis brother could be there waiting for us. Very clean house and comfortable staying. Definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for Airbnb in Istabul.
reviews[201].comments:
提供给以后越来越多的中国游客们,房间非常好,全部实图无p,很干净,很舒适｡房东热情好客,在我们出发前给我发了详细的介绍,凭借此介绍,我们顺利的从萨比哈机场坐机场大巴到达塔克西姆广场,步行约10分钟到达房东的家｡设施齐备,冰箱,洗衣机,空调都有,还有洗碗机和咖啡机,厨房设施也很全,我们最后一晚做了火锅,棒棒哒｡
地理位置不错,附近有很多公交车,可方便到达蓝色清真寺,索非亚大教堂等,步行可到欧洲区最大的商场,以及箭头包的工作室和lv､gucci等奢侈品店｡
房东反应迅速,基本上邮件秒回｡第一天到的较晚,可能是房东父亲吧,一直在等我们,递交钥匙和告知注意事项及房内设施｡最后一天小伙伴晚走,房东也同意把退房时间改到下午两点,谢谢｡
最后,房子非常好,值得!
reviews[202].comments: We stayed two weeks in Alex's flat. It is a comfortable apartment with all the necessities you need, though it should be noted that the balcony is not really big enough for two people to sit on. It is very well located. It is a short walk from Taxim square (with its excellent transport links - metro bus and dolmus and airport shuttle)  and iconic Istiklal street. The flat is very quiet despite being in the heart of Beyoglu district.  The area also has many local shops, restaurants and banks. I definitely recommend it.
reviews[203].comments: Bonjour, logement bien équipé, très propre et très bien situé dans une rue au calme à 5 minutes à pied de la navette aéroport et à 10 minutes à pieds de la place Taksim. Idéal pour la vie nocturne et aussi pour les visites des monument qui sont accessible en transport en commun. Parfait pour les gens qui aime dormir au calme mais aussi rejoindre le mouvement de la vie en quelques minutes à pied. Je recommande fortement.
reviews[205].comments: Perfect location, good space, amazingly clean. We came really tiered late at night, but Alexis's parents still waited for us. The greeted us with smile and explained everything. Zero regrets in choosing this apartment. Highly recommended.
reviews[206].comments: 房间很好 房东妈妈帮忙办理的入住,不太会说英语但是很热情｡房间干净整洁｡就是运气不好,最后一晚赶上停水停电,没办法洗漱上厕所,很不方便｡
reviews[207].comments: so close to istiklal caddesi, nice flat with bunk beds, clean bathroom was important for us, pleasant host. we will use this flat again
reviews[208].comments: Alexis and his family rank among the most outstanding hosts I've enjoyed in my Airbnb travels around the world. This time, as with all others, it was a pleasure to stay here.\nI like the stylish space and the authentic neighbourhood vibe, I value the prompt communication and logistical consideration provided by this family, and I hope to return to this space on future visits.\n:-)
reviews[209].comments: The flat was extra clean and cozy
reviews[210].comments: The apartment is charming and has everything you need. Sometimes taxi drivers didn’t know the address but Alexis gave us very thoughtful and clear instructions how to get to the apartment and who to contact in case of anything. We would stay there again.\n\nThe only problem was that we could hear neighbors watching TV, sometimes till late, so don’t forget to bring earplugs.
reviews[211].comments: Its very clean and good location
reviews[212].comments: Charmant, douillet, extrêmement bien situé, spacieux, bien équipé.\nà deux pas de Taksim, de sa vitalité. \nL’appartement d’Alexis est un endroit où on a envie de revenir.
reviews[213].comments: 非常建议大家来这里住,真的是非常好的住宿体验,去哪里都很方便,机场大巴,地铁站,独立大街,都在附近,最重要的是,房间很舒适,又很有当地特色,房东回复邮件及时,他的爸爸过来接待我们,非常友善!总之,让我们在伊斯坦布尔的行程特别的满意,提供了很多便利,推荐!
reviews[214].comments: Great spot right next to Taksim square. Close to buses, taxis, restaurants, shops. The apartment is furnished beautifully, a lovely window seat sofa, another large sofa & two good sized bedrooms. Its very modern with authentic Turkish touches & spotlessly clean. Cheers for letting us stay
reviews[215].comments: Очень здорово пожить в таком аутентичном месте! Великолепная квартира с продуманным интерьером и всеми удобствами! От метро 10 минут быстрым шагом. Вокруг много магазинов и кафе, но в тоже время район очень тихий!
reviews[216].comments: Nice and clean house on a quiet street. We had a good time. We needed to arrange the check out time which they adapted. Very convenient!
reviews[217].comments: A great place for families and friends. Close to the metro, and lots of local shops and attractions. Well recommended.
reviews[218].comments: Квартира темная, мало света. Местоположение удобное в плане доступности достопримечательностей, но район не очень. Парковки нет, поблизости паркинги закрывают вечером в 8.00.\nНу и небезопасный район для семей
reviews[219].comments: This lovely flat is centrally located, an easy walk from the metro and Istanbul’s famous Taksim Square and İstiklal Street. It was clean and comfortable. The host was accomodating and super responsive. I would definitely book again the next time I am in Istanbul.
reviews[220].comments: 资深算不上,但是也住过很多家名宿,这家我还蛮生气的,因为飞机到伊斯坦布尔是凌晨,之前邮件房东说Check in只能在下午2点,然后我们坐在星巴克坐了一个上午,后面就和房东商量能不能先把行李放进去,房东说可以,但是后面因为那边的房子太多了,和房东说能不能到星巴克来接下我们,房东说这是我们自己的事,我就觉得怎么可以这样,后面想想毕竟住在人家家里比较麻烦,还是给了从中国带来的礼物,并且发了邮件给房东,但是几天房东连邮件都没回我,有点生气
reviews[221].comments: We had a wonderful time in Istanbul, the apartment was great. It was really clean and well taken care of. We can absolutely recommend the place for your stay in Istanbul.
reviews[222].comments: L’appartement est d’une propreté impeccable ! La rue est calme (pas un bruit pour dormir), la literie est très bonne (bon repos). La douche est spacieuse, très agréable. reviews[223].comments: 房间一尘不染,非常干净舒适,房东人非常好｡
reviews[224].comments: 位置挺方便的,出门两百多米就是公交站,离机场大巴出发到达地点五百米左右,在塔克西姆附近｡还有大超市,买水果早餐都很方便｡土国房间通病就是没有电梯,提行李很麻烦,没有人帮忙｡最后我们出门时候小伙伴没注意把地毯带出来半截,房东说门打不开,找了人开锁,收了近400,各位朋友注意｡
reviews[225].comments: Great apartment. Especially liked the window seat in the lounge. Suited our needs perfectly. Apartment clean and welcoming. Would recommend to everyone.
reviews[226].comments: Wonderful apartment, clean and complete furniture, close to the most vital places and a wonderful reception, thanks Arthur
reviews[227].comments: We had a lovely time staying at Alexis' place. The apartment was very comfortable, and located in a prime area to get to and from so many of Istanbul's diverse neighborhoods. We had some struggles meeting our car service at the airport and Alexis was available and so helpful in  helping us get from the airport to his apartment. We couldn't have asked for a more welcoming and enjoyable stay in Istanbul!
reviews[228].comments: Nice and very clean apartment. Safe and quiet neighborhood. Just 10 minutes walk to Taksim Square. Very friendly host.
reviews[229].comments: The flat is very clean and comfortable, it is spacious so there is enough room for everyone and it is in a very good location right near Taxim square - the road it is situated on is a steep hill, and although it is only on the first floor, there is no lift in the building, so bare in mind if this causes an issue for anyone - however this didn’t cause any problems for us. The owners are very friendly and communicate very well, they allowed us to keep our luggage in the flat past check out time on our final day which was a very big help for us and very kind of them. We would happily stay in this flat again. Thank you for having us!
reviews[230].comments: Great location and I recommend it for small family only (three Maximum).
reviews[231].comments: the apartment is beautiful and like in the photos, the location is very close to Taksim and public transport and quiet and secure area.\nI really liked the welcome and the quality of services and listening of the host.\nI highly recommend and if I go back to Istanbul one day I already know where I am staying
reviews[232].comments: Alexis’ place was clean, bright, in a great location. Recommended and thankful for the hospitality!
reviews[233].comments: 房子布置很用心,距离塔克西姆广场很近,机场巴士直达,交通便利,附近街区很漂亮,不过上下坡多,房子是楼梯房,提大行李会有点累,不过整个伊斯坦布尔也差不多TOT,推荐入住~
reviews[234].comments: Great place and location.  Would definately recommend.
reviews[235].comments: A very good place in Istanbul. The Alex’s flat is very confortable and nice. We spent a very  good time. Alex helped us for taxi. We hope to come back soon.
reviews[236].comments: Nice warm personal welcome.\nLovely open space and comfy sofas.\nGreat location, quiet yet close to the hustle and bustle of Taksim square.
reviews[237].comments: Very convenient, very clean. Fast and reliable internet.
reviews[238].comments:
This place is a little gem in the heart of Istanbul. It's quite close to Taksim, we never got tired walking to it even in the rain and cold, the space itself is very cozy and will make you feel like home. It's better than the pics!
The minor details are charming as well, from the daisies to the curtains and to the comfortable pillows, we never needed anything.
We didn't get to meet Alexis unfortunately, but his parents were very warm and welcoming and provided us with all the info we needed.
Alexis was very responsive and flexible, agreeing on delaying the check-out time and accommodating to all our needs.
Definitely booking again here.
reviews[239].comments: Very responsive and flexible host. Clean and cozy apartment, located in a quiet neighborhood close to Taksim Square. Definitely recommend.
reviews[240].comments: Good comunication. Apartment located on a more steep street so it would be very hard for someone with a wheel chair or a walking disability. I would stay there again.
reviews[241].comments: Really modern apartment, clean and has everything you would need (towels could do with up-dating).  I had a great stay.  The only thing worth noting is that late check in is not available.  Alexis does not live in Istanbul, his parents arrange check in and I was told my midnight arrival was too late, so I had to have keys dropped off with a friend.  Everything else is great, thanks for the stay, hope to come again.
reviews[242].comments: Super propre et bien situé. Je recommande vivement!
reviews[243].comments: Awesome place, I really recommned it.
reviews[244].comments: Tres bon emplacement et bon rapport qualité prix
reviews[245].comments: Overall experience is great, though there are few things that need to be addressed: a weak Wi-Fi signal / unreliable connection and a shower that needs repair.

reviews[1].comments: alper is an amazing host. during our stay, he checked on us through (Hidden by Airbnb) , and asked if we needed anything or if we were fine. his house is one of the most beautiful ones that i ever rented through airbnb. it was clean and had everything we needed. also, the house has a great balcony with an amazing view of the historical peninsula. additionally, the house's location is very central. i totally recommend alper and his house. i would defiantly hire it again.
reviews[2].comments: Всё было очень хорошо.Лофт отлично расположен и в хорошем состоянии.Альпер радушный хозяин,очень понятно объяснил как чем пользоваться.шикарная терраса с отличным видом.Рекомендую парам или небольшой компании.
reviews[3].comments: Alper is a very helpful host and a quick responder. His place was great. I really enjoyed staying there
reviews[4].comments: Staying in Alper flat was a great experience, the flat is amazing, the view unique and alper is a great host. We ve spent a wonderful week in Istambul, thank you Alper for all
reviews[5].comments: I doubt exist a most beautiful ans stylish flat in all Istanbul, moderm, comfy, great location, extremely well equipped,  just amazing, thanks Alper!!!!
reviews[6].comments: The location is perfect to explore the city. It's at the heart of Kadıköy. The flat is very stylish, warm and cozy. We have already started to talk about when we can arrange day-off and go back Alper's place ... and of course we recommend the place to everyone who needs to keep up with the city for sure ...
reviews[7].comments: Konum olarak çok iyi, etraf çok hareketli olmasına rağmen daireye çıktığınızda inanılmaz huzur dolu ve muhteşem bir manzara ile karşılaşıyorsunuz. Alper istanbulu iyi biliyor olmama rağmen herşeyle yakından ilgilendi ve çok hızlı geri dönüş sağladı. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum.
reviews[8].comments: Alper has a stylish flat at the center of Kadikoy with everything you might need. It was a very cozy, clean and comfortable place and it felt like a warm shelter in these cold winter days with a perfect view. We really enjoyed staying here for a short while and highly recommend to everyone. Cheers
reviews[9].comments: Bizi çok iyi ağırladı. Dostluğu ve yardımseverliği altında ezildik desem yeridir. Herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebileceğim bir ev sahibi.
reviews[10].comments: Very nice place in the most happening Instabul neighborhood.
reviews[11].comments: Квартира находится на последнем этаже коммерческого дома в самом центре района Мода. Вокруг в переулках разбросаны бары и многочисленные заведения. Сама квартира - вау. Рекомендуем.
reviews[12].comments: Alper's place is great, located right in the center of Moda. It's very close to many places to eat and buy fruits. He was also very flexible with the check-in given my very early flight. The place has a nice design and the place has everything you need for a pleasant stay in Istanbul.
reviews[13].comments: Alper is a perfect host who takes great care of his home. the apartment is beautiful and in a unique location in the heart of one of the most interesting areas of istanbul. Kadikoy is a perfect place for public transportation. Perfect for those arriving from Sabiha Airport and close to the underground  and ferries to Minonou and Karakoy. Alper and his sister advised me the best clubs in the neighborhood where I ate very well. They are all within a mile and the neighborhood is full of life and very quiet. The apartment is elegant, with a terrace offering a breathtaking view of Istanbul. There is a very comfortable sofa with a modern television. Alper supported me for every request and he always responded promptly.  There are a microwave oven, a coffee machine, a dishwasher and a washing machine. I recommend this district to those who want to know the real life of the city and in many trips I had never found such a perfect accommodation. I absolutely recommend it and will definitely come back
reviews[14].comments: Very nice place in the middle of a lively neighborhood. All you need is there. Especially the big balcony is a plus. Alper was a very friendly and helpful host.
reviews[15].comments: Alper's place is a gem in a wonderful neighborhood in Istanbul.  It is right in the thick of the nightlife scene of Kadikoy, but also not right above the most busy and noisy streets.  There is a Starbucks around 100 meters away, and a lovely man who makes fresh squeezed juices right below the apartment - both were musts every morning.  But, the really special thing about Alper's place is its extensive roof patio with breathtaking views of the Bosphorus.  I will check its availability everytime I go to Istanbul!
reviews[16].comments: Los ısıklardan hoslanıyorsanız ev fena degil...
reviews[17].comments: We’ve stayed in Alper’s place for two whole weeks. He was very responsive and flexible with our odd check-in and check-out times. The flat is tastefully decorated and the view from the terrace is more than what you’re looking for after a tiring day.
reviews[18].comments: I'm in love with Istanbul!) Stunning city. Apartments Alper in my opinion are located in the best part of the city. This I have never seen) I liked the collection of shoes in the apartment) I was interested in the shoe maker;) The host organized a full transfer from the airport and back) Everything is just super!)

Были на Новый год. 

Отличная стильная и уютная квартира для пары, находится в самом центре Кадыкёя — близко пешком до набережной и причала. Все самые злачные места возле дома или рядом. Рынок с божественными оливками и потрясающими огромными креветками тоже в минуте ходьбы. Лучшие коты тоже здесь :)
Сам Альбер был в отпуске, но нас встретила его сестра. Они заказали трансфер из аэропорта и все время были с водителем на связи, так что мы просто переходили из рук в руки)
Квартира на верхнем этаже, в доме ещё 3 квартиры, которые переделаны под музыкальные студии, так что часов до 11 вечера кто-то учится петь и играть на гитаре, но нам это не мешало. 
Есть огромная терраса с видом на Босфор — зимой она скорее для фоточек, чем для посиделок, поэтому придётся вернуться в более тёплое время, чтобы оценить. 
Очень мягкая кровать. ОЧЕНЬ. Лежишь в ней как в гнезде. 
Единственный минус — неудобный унитаз. Колени упираются в бортик ванной. И нет шторки в ванной, но это не беда. 
Зато в квартире тёплый пол, и это огромный плюс зимой, гораздо круче батарей. 
Нет яркого освещения, только точечные приглушённые светильники, и это создаёт очень романтичное настроение. 
В целом мы очень довольны, жена уже мечтает вернуться.

Can was very helpful and laid back. Our cab driver had problems locating the venue, Can helped to direct him and waited out (in the rain) for our cab. 

My friend and I "check-out" at different times. My friend was scheduled to leave in an airport shuttle that Can helped to book with a local tour company. As my flight was much later in the day, I scooted off to the Istanbul Modern (which is a really short 10/15 mins leisurely walk away) while she waited for the shuttle. But HORRORS! My friend left all her money with me and when her shuttle arrived, she had no money to pay for the service. Can graciously let her get onto the shuttle anyway with just a verbal promise that on my return to the apartment, I would be paying for my friend. He did not make any fuss about it at all nor was he anxiously reminding me to make the payment, so that's pretty cool.

The apartment was clean and spacious, pretty much exactly what you see in the photos. Noticed the aircon was dripping a little but that didn't affect our stay in any way. There were some stubborn stains on the white armchair but hey.. it is white, which is hard to maintain... so we weren't too fussy about that, we used it anyway, it wasn't disgusting.
 
The location is superb if you are visiting the Galata Tower and Istanbul Modern (which is awesome btw). It is also an easy walk to the Tophane Tram stop (max 5 mins) and the Galata Bridge (20 mins). 

There are many interesting eateries around and we had a nice breakfast at the eatery next door - the pancakes are freshly made and really awesome. I also had superb spinach + cheese pide at this no-nonsense place diagonally across the street. The pide are cooked in a traditional stove. When I visited, there were many locals enjoying their pide there. Yummy. I love to eat food prepared by people who take pride in making them. :)

name: Terraced Ottoman Villa - Room 1
space: The room I am renting out is in a renovated Ottoman villa with a terraced garden and a magnificent view on to the Bosphorous.  Within a 2 - minute walking distance to Büyükdere (a small Bosphorous village and shopping center) on the bus route connecting to the subway, which provides quick and easy access to Taksim - Kabatas and the historical Peninsula.  Stopping at interesting museums while taking a leisurely walk along the Bosphorous or going for a cup of Turkish coffee in the gardens of an Ottoman Sultan's hunting lodge or taking a ferry to Anadolu Kavagi (a picturesque fishing village) to climb up to its Ottoman Castle and have a look at the Black Sea ... are some of the attractions we can promise you.  There are quite a few other surprises if you're really up for Istanbul adventures ... Or you can just relax and read (or write) your book in a serene atmosphere just listening to the beautiful sounds of nature ...  Organic breakfast is also included.

This review is for our second reservation at the same hotel on our trip, after we returned to Istanbul after visiting other sites in Turkey. I have reproduced the same review from our first stay at the hotel:

Our stay at Sultan's Inn was a wonderful experience. I and my friends chose this place because of all the positive reviews it had received, and our experience corroborates everyone else's reviews! Sultan's Inn is an affordable and well-organised hotel. Our rooms were cleaned and tidied up everyday while we were out, dirty dishes were replaced and clean towels were provided. We never needed to request anything because it was all taken care of seamlessly.

The staff at Sultan Inn is very courteous, friendly and professional. They are well-informed about local sights and the ways to reach them. Sometimes their recommendations for guided tours and transport options are more expensive than the alternatives we found by ourselves, but their recommendations were still useful nevertheless. In particular, the hotel's airport pickup service is more expensive than local taxis. But this service was useful for first-time visitors to Turkey like us, since we'd have otherwise found it difficult to navigate our way to the hotel from the airport.

Also, the breakfast buffet is one of the best we've ever had, with a really sumptuous selection of foods for every taste! I'm not typically a morning person, but I woke up extra early just to make sure I got a crack at those amazing sausages, boiled eggs, baked potatoes, black olives, creamy yogurt with three different flavours of jams, chocolate brownies, and much more!

Finally, Sultan's Inn is very conveniently located at the heart of the Sultanahmet district in Istanbul. The area is fairly touristy, and Istanbul's local residents don't frequent it much. But for those of us visiting the city to take in all the famous sights like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, most hotels in Sultanahmet are a mere 7 to 10 minutes walking distance from all these places. In partcular, Sultan Inn is situated at an intersection with a taxi stand, so for residents in need of private transport, it is very easy to find one right outside the hotel.

My only point of dissatisfaction was that the rooms were smaller than we expected. The photographs posted on Airbnb appear slightly 'stretched', giving the appearance that the rooms are longer than they really are. This could be just a function of the camera that was used to take the photographs, but it is worth bearing in mind for visitors who plan to spend a lot of time in their hotel rooms. Sultanahmet is so beautiful that we were barely in the hotel except at night, so it didn't really affect us.

All in all it was a good experience, and I would recommend this hotel to anybody visiting Istanbul!

الشقة جميلة جداً، وهي مطابقة تماماً للصور المعروضة والوصف المكتوب عنها. وهي تقع في شارع هادئ جداً على الرغم من أنها تبعد دقيقتين فقط مشياً على الأقدام من جامع السلطان أحمد ومتحف حاجية صوفيا. يوجد بجانب الشقة بقالتين صغيرة، وصالون حلاقة، ومغسلة، وعدد من المطاعم والمقاهي.

أنا أنصح بشدة بالتعامل مع محمود والاستفادة من هذه الشقة لمن يحتاج لسعتها وقربها من المنطقة المركزية.

reviews[2].comments:
У меня была ночная пересадка в Стамбуле,  и мы с мужем остановились у Элиф. Комната чистая, красивая. Находится на 12 этаже без лифта (но этаж там на каждом лестнечном проходе, так что можно считать, что 6й этаж). 
Договорились, что Элиф встретит нас в аэропорту за дополнительную плату отвезёт домой и обратно в аэропорт. Элиф ждала нас около 2х часов и в 5 утра отвезла обратно. Очень благодарны ей за содействие! 
Кроме того, девочки приютили наших друзей, которые опаздал на рейс, покормили, погуляли с ними. Хорошие люди, рекомендую! 
-----
We stayed at Elif's room for 1 night, when we had a stop in Istanbul. The room is nice, and the whole apartment, too. The apartment is on the 12 floor, but it was OK.   
Elif met us in the airport (she waited for us about 2 hours) and really early in the morning drove us back.
We are really pleased having met Elif and her friend.  They are really good girls. 
Moreover, they met our friends who missed the flight, and helped them, too. :) 
Definitely recommend!
reviews[3].comments: It was very easy to go to Elif's home from Ataturk Airport. It took me less than 30 minutes and the route was very short by subway and bus. She has a nice flat in a sweet apartment, where you can feel relaxed and restful. There were many restaurants, coffee shops, markets, shopping malls and many buses stops to the almost all points of Istanbul. Her apartment is very close to the sea, too. So you can walk and have rest at the seaside, too.\nHer flat was very sweet, wide and clean. I felt as in my home. It is better than the photos she shared.\nElif was very nice to me during my stay. She was helping me to get some places and answers to any questions about Istanbul life. I was feeling fine and relaxed. We became friends during my stay there. We went to see many places, did shopping, had meals and coffee together in different parts of Istanbul. I had a great time with Elif and her friends during 4 days. Thank you for everything, dear Elif. Love you.
reviews[4].comments: Elif's place is especially great for girl travellers. I had a good talk with her roomate. Their house is cozy and clean. I love that :) Also, the host is quick responsive. Long before we arrived, she had asked us the check in time. She still waiting for us even we arrived at midnight. Thanks a lot!
reviews[5].comments: Elif’s home is very cute , tidy and clean. Elif is very helpful and friendly person. elif was very interested to me . I definitely suggest elif’s home
reviews[6].comments: what do you expect from a home? a peaceful enviroment,a clear and tidy house.there are more of these in Elif's house.the hose is in a peaceful building which is in a pretty quiet,calm neighbourhood,but the most important thing is that because  of Elif is such a caring owner she makes you feel you are at your own home.Elif is the best caring owner with her guests that I have never seen and met in my previous accomodations.I intensly suggest Elif's house.because of lasting my accomodation second time,I had a chance to write with details.our paths are separating for now.I hope we keep in touch.Goodbye. Mala min mala te (mi casa es su casa )

name: Beautiful Room in the City Centre!
space: Hello everyone!  Very rare opportunity, in beautiful old style apartment (70 sq mt plus balcony, high ceilings) 5 minutes by walking to Asmalı Mescit / Tunnel, Tepebasi area , two nice furnished rooms, one extra storage room/cellar, clean bathroom, separate kitchen, collective heating.  There are two rooms (each room has own double bed and a table, chairs etc..) and a cellar room includes one sofa and a washing machine which can be used as a storage space.  The flat has a great balcony (not that big) with a great view of Golden Horn that you can have open air breakfasts and a perfect place to get some booze as well.  It is very convenient, reliable and safe place and it's in the safe neighborhood. Also literally 5 minutes to Istiklal street / Taksim / Beyoglu, right across from the Pera Hotel. You'll be living in the room with a balcony! Hope you'll enjoy being in Istanbul! Jan

reviews[0].comments: Staying with Jan was a great experience. She helped out finding restaurants, shops, sights etc. She even fixed me a new place to live together with one of her friends when I wanted to stay longer than planed. The appartment is located on the other side of Tarlabasi Blv close to the stadium and only five minutes from Istiklal, the main street in Beyoglu. It has windows and lots of light and air from both sides, and a small terrace with a beautiful view up the Golden Horn. For those sensetive to noice, there is a minaret not far from the house, but then again, you're in Istanbul! There are two rooms, both furnished as bedroms, a small separat kitchen, a bathroom and a flexible room with no windows. I would definitely recommend staying at Jans, and its great value for the money.
reviews[1].comments: I stayed with my boyfriend for one week in Istanbul at Jan´s flat. It´s a place I highly recommend to everybody who likes to discover the heart of Istanbul. With its two rooms it´s was more than enough space for us and we loved to have breakfast on the balcony with its beautiful view including the Golden Horn. And Jan is a very friendly host, we could contact her any time to ask her something or to get insider tips (restaurants etc..).
reviews[2].comments: I had an excellent stay at Sinejan's flat! It is nice and clean, and it has everything you need. I didn't spend much time with Jan, as I was off sightseeing most of the time, but she was always available if I needed anything. Jan is very helpful and hospitable. Now I have a real friend in Istanbul! Highly recommend!\r\nAnd by the way Jan is one of the most beautiful girl I saw in Istanbul!
reviews[3].comments:
The flat is in nice, silent area 10 min walk from main pedestrian street. On the corner it has convenience store open till 23 or later with very friendly owner and we felt very safe every time we returned home late. 
The flat was artistic and gave an inspiration for all the stay. The unique thing is - balcony with wonderful view over city and Golden Horn. Just keep in mind - you will have a minaret just 20 meters from the balcony - so a nice cultural experience 5 times a day. :) But we more enjoyed it, then felt disturbed.

The hostess Jan - was very nice and caring. Thank You a lot. :) 
Definitely a place where to return for inspiration.
reviews[4].comments: Jan's place is very, very central to everywhere we needed to be in Istanbul. We were able to walk to all the major tourist sights, as well as tons of great restaurants, bars, etc. There's plenty of space in the flat, and Jan was generous with recommendations for both restaurants and galleries (which were also very close for any art people looking at this listing). Call to prayer is louder in the back room, so if you want to get some sleep, set up shop in the front room!
reviews[5].comments: We had a very nice stay in Istanbul! The flat is very well located, in walking distance to most of the important sites. The flat itself is also really nice and equipped with everything you might need. The balcony is great! Finally, Sinejan was a very nice host!
reviews[6].comments: A nice and cozy flat with an awesome view over the Golden Horn. Close to public transport and the very busy Istiklal street, nonetheless the flat is very quiet (obviously apart from the Muezzin from the nearby Mosque, but he's fortunately quite brief).\r\nSinejan was a great host and helped with some necessary phone calls due to missing luggage. We can recommend the flat (and her) wholeheartedly.

reviews[1].comments: After booking, I received a messaging saying that this room was actually booked for the weekend and offering me a different room. I ultimately accepted, but the room received was much smaller (no sitting room or terrace, nor was it on the rooftop). However, I still paid the rate listed for this room (minus a small cash refund received upon arrival). \r\n\r\nThat being said, the room I did receive was rather nice with a small balcony overlooking the street (minus the mildewy smell in the bathroom). reviews[2].comments: Yes he was really nice and welcoming and helpful. The room was clean and location is supper strategic.

Location is great and the service given by Evrim and Ilhaam is fantastic. 24/7 availability which is just fantastic. Always willing to help.

The apartment is on the 5th floor so some stairs to climb,  but if you're fit, you'll be able to do it.

It is also great being so close to Isitklal street where everything happens.

Only negative is that the bathroom could be maintained better. There's a constant sewerage smell coming from the drains which isn't pleasant.
reviews[10].comments: Lokasyonu çok iyi. Merkezi yerde olmasına rağmen sakin ve sessiz. Temiz. Herşey istediğimiz gibiydi, tekrar konaklamak isteriz, çok memnun kaldık.
reviews[11].comments: The location was great. Evrim was very helpfull and he helped us to make a beautiful place for our friends wedding night. :) thank you Evrim!

reviews[16].comments: Great service and quick response from Evrim.  1 min walk from Istiklal street. If you are looking for something in the hub of that area, this is a great option to stay at. Close but the hotel was in a quite street
reviews[17].comments: Это номер в прекрасно расположенном отеле на улице Истикляль, несколько минут до Галатском башни. Сам номер выполнен в стиле лофт, потрясающий интерьер
reviews[18].comments: The location is really perfect and the rooftop so nice. The room is spacious and people at the reception very helpful. I recommand!
reviews[19].comments: Lokasyon, teras ve manzarası gerçekten güzel, ayrıca kilise ve ışıklandırması güzel bir ambiyans oluşturuyor. Çevreden çokta rahatsız etmeyen bir müzik sesi duyuluyor. \n\nYaşadığımız tek sorun çarşaf ve yastıkların çok pis görünmesiydi. Yıkanmışlar ama heryerlerinde siyah ve sarı lekeler vardı. Ve bir kaç kıl vardı.  Havlular da aynı şekilde bir sürü siyah ve sarı  leke ve ayrıca pas lekesi vardı. Değiştirmelerini istedik ancak yeni getirdiklerinin onlardan bir farkı yoktu. Kısacası nevresimlerini ve havlularını değiştirmeleri gerekiyor. Belliki artık çok eskimişler. Bir de terastaki bank ve masa çok eskimiş, güneşten ve yağmurdan yıpranmış, her an kırılacakmış gibi. Açıkçası biz korkarak oturduk. Bunlar dışında Evrim beyi hiç göremedik ama en azından telefonla ilgilendi.
reviews[20].comments: Great location! A minute walk to Isliklal street and on the way there is great Shisha place right on the steps. We stayed in a terrace room on the 5th floor and it was great too, terrace is huge and has a decent view. Stuff on reception are super responsive, they were really helpful to answer every question we've got whether it's about the room service or nearest attractions. They spoke great english and even russian)\nOverall it is great place to stay in Istanbul, the best we've stayed in for sure.
reviews[21].comments: nice
reviews[22].comments: Perfect location, calm and a beautiful view !
reviews[23].comments: Well located apartment conform to the picture!
reviews[24].comments: Great location and price, helped us with our luggage. However beware of 5 floors of stairs to climb if you are not in good physical condition or travel with kids. Sewage smell from the bathroom needs to be fixed, kitchenette should have a few more essentials and place would be five stars.
reviews[25].comments: Konum ve manzara çok güzeldi. Her şey fotograflardaki gibi. Ev sahibiyle iletisimi kolay sagladik. Ev yeterince temiz degildi. Banyo ve tuvalet rutubet kokuyordu. Internette baglanti sorunu vardi interneti kullanamadik.
reviews[26].comments: Excellent location but could be cleaner. We needed to ask them to put on the heating as it was very cold at night and the plug sockets stopped working another time.

reviews[2].comments: We would be regretting if we had cancelled our trip do to recent suicide attacks in Turkey. The atmosphere was as good as we expected. Peaceful city and helpful people. That's why I love Istanbul more than anywhere else in the world. The hospitality, care, respect, food, sightseeing, transportation... all excellent. All went well. Electricity, hot/cold water, everything is as advertised. We have been given the keys and nobody disturbed us during our stay. The home had all necessities, including cutlery, dishes, bed sheets, toiletries etc.The place is around 2-3 minutes walking distance to "şişhane" Metro Station and around 3-5 minutes walking istiklal street..I would recommend it to everyone ...Thank you very much evrim
reviews[3].comments:
Oncelikle Evrim ev sahibi olarak cok sicakkanli ve icten birisi , Yer olarak cok merkezi bi yerde olmasi disinda metrodan sonra 3-5 dakika da ulasabiliyorsunuz . Balkonundan St.Antuan kilisesi gozukmekte ve hos bi hava veriyor . Yeme , icme eglence olarak zaten heryere yuruyus ile cok yakin bir mesafede  .
Oda da ocaktan ,mikrodalga firindan utu masasina ciftkisilik yataginakadar hersey mevcut ,Ayrica oda temizligi , buyuklugu ,dekorasyonu hersey resimlerde gozuktugu gibiyken fiyati bu beklentilere karsilik  uygun kaliyor

reviews[4].comments: Evrim is lovely and the room was perfect for us. The location could not be more central. We had a great experience in Istanbul. I highly recommend it.
reviews[5].comments: We really enjoyed staying at this very beautiful place! Evrim was very helpful and made everything to make us feel comfortable. We arrived in the middle of the night and he was waiting for us to open the doors. The apartment has everything you need and even provides towels, shampoo, shower gel, house shoes, fully equipped kitchen,…and the location is amazing. Very central, but still far enough from the huge tourist crowd. It's a very nice part of istanbul, full with very sweet cafes and shops! I would definitely stay here again when I come back to Istanbul. In fact, my boyfriend is coming back to Istanbul and going to stay there another couple of days!
reviews[6].comments: Our apartment was perfect! nothing fancy but has everything you need and in a great location with a 24/7 reception. I would highly recommend and would definitely stay there again.
reviews[7].comments: Evrim and staff were welcoming and helpful.  My room was upgraded to a lovely suite, which was a nice surprise.  The room was clean, although not quite as modern as te photos suggest.  It is centrally located and, as someone who likes to explore by foot, I was able to walk to all major sites.  If you are able to climb stairs, this may not be the place for you.  I would recommend Cirus Suites.  A wondeful place to rest after a lon few months of travel.
reviews[8].comments:
A mon arrivée, j'ai trouvé Ilham qui est tout simplement merveilleux!!!
je n'ai rencontré Evrim que durant mes derniers jours mais il a fait preuve d'une bonne hospitalité, un accueil chaleureux assistance aussi en cas de besoin il n’hésite pas à faire le nécessaire

A noter que la description de la chambre et de l'emplacement .... correspond exactement à la réalité
Voyage à refaire, la ville est splendide
reviews[9].comments: I have to say I absolutely liked this place. It's situated in the heart of Istanbul: 1 minute to Istiklal, 10 minutes to Galata bridge. There are a lot of cafes, restaurants, mini markets nearby. In my case it was an urgent booking request (3 days before the visit, so, Evrim, çok teşekkür ederim for approval). The man at reception, Ilham, was one of the most attentive, caring and hospitable man I've ever seen. It's absolutely the best value for money. Evrim, Ilham, Istanbul - I want to thank you all a lot for this chance to be there!
reviews[10].comments:
Hemos pasado un fin de semana estupendo en Estambul. 
Nuestra estancia ha sido agradable si bien, por las fotos, imaginaba que el lugar era de mayor calidad. 
Tuvimos problemas con el agua del baño y ruidos la primera noche pero enseguida nos ofrecieron otra habitación mejor y más grande. 
La zona donde está situado el alojamiento está genial. La calidad del mobiliario deja mucho que desear pero se suple con la amabilidad del anfitrión que se desvivió por hacernos sentir como en casa y nos ayudó en todo lo que le pedimos.

reviews[6].comments:
My experience with my temporary home in Istanbul is reminiscent of one fortuitous occasion on which I was accidentally allotted a first class seat on an international flight.  The accommodations were luxurious; the ambience a careful balance between stimulating and restful, the service superior in both attentiveness and cordiality; I had no trouble acclimating.  I like nice things.

I arrived on a Friday evening and after he gave directions in Turkish to my taxi driver over the phone, Jonas, the gracious host-turned-bellhop, pulled my generously portioned luggage out of my taxi, hauled it up the stairs for me, and showed me into a beautifully refinished apartment. . . with a plethora of snacks.  Regrettably, I ate all of them, and for that I do not thank him, but there was a degree of thoughtfulness in this welcoming which may or may not be demonstrated by one's own family upon homecoming so I believe it merits recognition.

The digs: significantly more spacious than expected (or needed, but I'm not one to complain about such things), brick covered walls, hardwood floors, brand new appliances, full length gold framed mirror in the ample bedroom evoking a Victorian-era level of refinement . . .  in summary, Jonas should be charging more.  But I will stop here.

I lied.  One more note.  The bathroom.  I grew up with three brothers who pounded on the door if I had the audacity to take more than 23 seconds in our small bathroom which they never cleaned.  So now, as previously mentioned, I like nice things, including a nice bathroom; I like to have coffee when doing my makeup in the mirror in the morning and red wine in front of said mirror when getting ready to go out at night, and this is the bathroom for such things.  It is a marble/glass/stainless steel oasis equipped with a well lit vanity mirror, removable shower head, and high powered hairdryer (#basic but these things do matter; hostel hair dryers do not cut it and even some nice hotel hair dryers will keep you drying for days.)

Now that we've covered the critical points and know my hair looked good for my entire trip, I should say a few words about Istanbul.  Hearing the call to prayer throughout the day and seeing the mosques dotting the skyline makes it quite the surreal city.  Though as exotic as it was, I actually felt quite at home rather quickly.  Everyone was respectful and friendly towards me, I was able to walk everywhere I wanted to go, and consequently I found it easy to slip into life here.  Jonas gallantly offered to escort me to and from the apartment at night should I ever feel uncomfortable, but I never needed to take him up on the offer.  I have traveled all over Europe and this was the safest I have ever felt in any neighborhood I've stayed in.

In case it was not clear, I will be back.

reviews[15].comments: The apartment is spacy and located in a convenient spot—close to a variety of public transportation such as the tram, metro and ferry. We stayed here for a month and were overall satisfied with our stay. We had to get a few things for the kitchen (like a pot to make pasta, a sieve, etc.) since we wanted to cook at least a few days a week. This wasn’t really a problem. The main issue was that the fan in the TV room wasn’t working when we arrived and the last 10 days of our stay it got pretty hot in Istanbul. I asked about fans/air conditioner before we booked the place specifically, because my husband has low tolerance for heat, so we were disappointed to find out that the fan was not working (all other fans and the air conditioner in the bedroom worked well). We were watching the World Cup, so we spent quite a bit of time in that room. Jonas was already aware of the problem when I brought it up with him and told us that there was an issue with its engine and that he bought the fans from France and couldn’t find a matching model in Turkey to replace the broken one. He offered to send one from France, but of course the chances of the fan making it to Turkey before we left was very low. We were expecting a more immediate solution—such as an inexpensive portable fan from a local store perhaps? Luckily, I have family living in Istanbul, so we borrowed a portable fan from my sister; otherwise we wouldn’t be able to use that room very much. Jonas was prompt in his replies when we had questions and he let us stay an extra night without charging us.

My name is Sena. I live in Kadıköy where all the cultures mixed up. I think my place is the heart of the city. Im an English teacher who loves her job so much. I studied in England, lived there for seven years( considering its a long time)  I sometimes confuse my nationalty :)  I love music both listening and making. I play violin and guitar and besides Im a dance teacher too. I am a nature person who runs away to the mountains and lakes and camp there in her tiny spare time. I work busy hours because ı only work with business people.

My place is very central which is in a walking distance to all puplic transports and easy to get to and find. We have three bedroom in my big flat and ı sometimes I invite my students in the living room for lessons but very rarely. If you see people laughing around dont be surprised :) The building is not pretty new as nearly all flats are the same in Kadikoy area.  My neighbourhood is very safe and everybody knows eachother here and all of them are lovely people. I used to have a dog in the last years as you read in the rewievs but my friend  took her from me to a lovely farm where she is free and happy. House will be very clean when you checked in and I dont do a deep cleaning until you leave so try to be nice and tidy :) There are no rules in this house!!! I love people who treats this area as their own place. 

I have been hosting people on Airbnb for three years and had lovely friends and unforgetable experiences. Some of them stayed for a day and some of them stayed for three months bu we still keep in touch with most of them. I love meeting new people, listening different stories, learn abour their culture. Maybe Ill ask you to go out together if we have or play a game or even a long chat if you want ofcourse.

reviews[1].comments: Recep (Zafer) is a wonderful host. I did not know a word of Turkish and he did not know a word of English and we seemed to still have no problem communicating. He came and found me when I arrived from the airport, which was great. He was always offering delicious coffees and he made several wonderful meals (he is a chef) On my second day, he walked me around and was eager to share his city with me. If you are on a budget, like I was, then this is an excellent option for you. The location can not be beat, especially for the price.
reviews[2].comments: This is the perfect location and host for budget travellers to Istanbul. On less popular side of Taxim Square you go up a not very well kept stairwell to find a surprisingly pleasant, super small but well organized apartment with a very accomodating host. Zafer doesnt speak English but he makes use of translator and is really helpful. Can't find a better place in a better location for such a deal.
reviews[3].comments: Recep was a great host, his home is in the best location and so easy and convient to go out and about from taksim square everyday, even tho he doesn't speak English and we didn't speak turkish we communicated through a translator on our phones and it was fine! He has an adorable kitten to keep you company also! Will Definatley reccomend recepa home!
reviews[4].comments: Zafer is one of the most welcome and sincere host i have ever seen. He picked me up earlier than the check in time and immediately I went in the house i liked it! The location is very near Taksim square, a little bit difficult to find but very convenient. There are several animals in the house and they are very cute. Zafer doesn't speak English but it was very fun talking to him using the mobile phone. I felt lucky to find this place with Zafer during my stay in Istanbul.
reviews[5].comments: Everything fine! Zafer is really kind and polite! The room  was really clean as the rest of the house. For that price you can't find nothing better.
reviews[6].comments: Recep is really a good man, he is so welcoming and kind
reviews[7].comments: Very friendly and helpful and he took care of all the details.\r\nThe location is perfect, I would highly recommend this place
reviews[8].comments:
We arrived in Istanbul at 2 p.m. and had asked Zafer beforehand if it was and he said it was. But when we arrived at his place, he was asleep and didn't hear us call. So the first night we were paniqued because we didn't know where to sleep. We eventually found another hotel at 4 p.m... 
Zafer did apologize the next morning...
The room is very very tiny (the bed too) and if you're allergic to cats then this isn't the place for you because the cats is very playful and jumps on your bed, pillow, shoes and stuff... 
The good thing was the location. At walking distance from Taksim. Very convenient. 
If you don't need luxury then you're good. We were never in the appartment as we were sightseeing the whole time and went out a lot.
reviews[9].comments: Recep and Zafer were terrific hosts. Our language barrier was overcome by the use of a great phone app. Recep carried our heavy bags up quite a few stairs then made us coffee and walked us into town to show us around. We really enjoyed their hospitality. We had to move on a couple of days earlier than we thought due to wifi connectivity (we were working), but other than that, we would recommend Zafer and Recep's flat as a cozy place to stay. Great location. Thank you!
reviews[10].comments: The place was nice and cozy (as described). Recep's cat is really cute. I did find it a bit difficult to communicate with translating via phone, I would ask him some stuff but it took to long to get the correct the right answer. Check out is strict, not flexible :) Other than that, he's a nice guy
reviews[11].comments: What can we say, we had a great stay at Recep's place. The location is great, really a few steps from Taksim square, and everything we wanted was therefore near. Though there is perhaps little privacy, since you do share the appartement with Recep, it is absolutely no problem as he is a very kind and easy-going person. And of course for that price one can only be happy. Mind you, as others had written, that Recep does not speak English so communication goes through (Hidden by Airbnb) translate, though for us that was not a problem whatsoever, at times it was even pleasant for it didn't force us to socialise. Also, Recep makes great Turkish coffee!\r\n\r\nIn sum, if you are looking for a nice, cheap place that is centrally located, we recommend a stay at Recep's place!
reviews[12].comments: apartment centrally located, very nice host. Thank you for all
reviews[13].comments: Good place for its price, the room is tiny and you seem to have very less privacy but Recep is very welcoming and friendly. we had a good time.
reviews[14].comments: The place is lovely and the host is kind. He goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable. Lovely stay, would definitely stay there again.
reviews[15].comments: Recep отличный человек! Поможет во всех вопросах, очень гостеприимный хозяин. Квартира не большая, но очень уютная и есть все необходимое. До Таксима 5 минут пешком.

reviews[0].comments: Absolutely loved this place! This was my first ever visit to Istanbul and I rented the place for the whole month. The decor of the room is very clean and modern. Soft and comfy bed.  Felt like a hotel room with a lot of great natural light. Bathroom was fantastic as well, especially the shower. Super fast wifi. Helpful staff: there was one time I needed to make a reservation at a restaurant that only spoke Turkish, and they helped me with that. Location was very central, close to Taksim and Nisantasi where there are some great restaurants. Highly recommend!
reviews[1].comments: My previous reservation with another host was cancelled the same day I was to check-in. Fortunately, Emrah responded quickly to my requests, answered all my questions and even allowed me a quick tour of the facility. His staff helped me with my luggage, laundry and all of my requests for the duration of my stay. The apartments are new, clean, modern, and avante-gardesque. Angular shaped space, concrete walls with clean white walls, tasteful furniture to match. So many things are in walking distance, metro is close by, centrally located to many of the sites to see in Istanbul. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a new, clean, hotel-serviced, apartment centrally located in Istanbul.
reviews[2].comments: Handsomely designed studio with a very nice bathroom and a separated eating/cooking area. Perfect for one or a couple. The location in Harbiye is very convenient, just one street from the main avenue. Emrah is a great host and the apartments are perfect for a short-term stay.
reviews[3].comments: Super Lage, Metro- und Bushaltestelle fußläufig erreichbar. Belebte Hauptstraße gleich nebenan trotzdem ruhige Unterkunft. Super Zimmerservice, sauber und ordentlich. reviews[1].comments: This apartment itself is very beautiful, very clean and with beautiful furnitured, friendly colour, lovely decorated and warm welcoming its guest when arrived after some steps to climb (not problem for me but might be important for people to know). It made our stay very comfortable. The kitchen is nice and well equiped and ready to use. The bathrooms are great as there is a toilet on the first floor and an additional toilet with shower on the second floor next to the master bedroom. Also this room is very nice, I was very surprised and happy when I saw that beautiful room. But above everything else I loved the terrace which really provides enough space. It was so wonderful to enjoy breakfast in the morning there. Nice and typical shops around the apartment made it easy to get everything for preparing meals and also many restaurants around make it easy if you didn't want to be far away from your apartment in the night after a bustling day in the city. Although the surrounding of Aksaray is not what everyone wishes as it is well known to be a conservative place and also a meltingpot for certain illegals. Although I want to mention that I always at every time of the day and in the night felt very safe in this area where I stayed with my 13 years old son, that the apartment is on a good location, that I felt like being a part of Istanbul and not just a tourist, getting a bit of the feeling of a real life in that wonderful city and I would love to stay there again.
reviews[2].comments: Great apartment within walking distance of all the main attractions. Its in a locals area so there's lots of great restaurants nearby which are really good value. There isn't a lift and the apartment is on the top floor. But you soon get used to it and my elderly mother coped ok. The outside terrace was a welcome place to decamp with a beer after a busy day in Istanbul.
reviews[3].comments: This is a very nice loft apartment near the city center. My girlfriend and I were very impressed by the apartment itself, and absolutely loved the roof terrace in the mornings and evenings. The only drawback is that places were a bit further to walk to than advertised, but everything was still close enough that we never needed to take public transport or a cab.
reviews[4].comments: The loft is quite nice and cozy place for our 5 girls staying for a night in Istanbul. it's easy to take 5min walk to the Airport Subway line and Tram station. We didn't meet Onur in person but made phone call with each other and his friend's father took care of us very well.\r\nThank you. We will visit again in future.
reviews[5].comments:
Симпатичная квартира в районе Аксарай. Удобная и просторная, места достаточно для двух человек. Тем не менее, можно разместить и три. 
Просторная терраса, уютная гостиная. Всегда горячая вода в душе - это очень важно. 
Проблем с заселением не было. Мы были хорошо приняты и нам все объяснили. 
Рядом красивая мечеть и видом на закат и город. 
   Из небольших минусов: нужна хорошая сковорода на кухне) для удобства приготовления пищи)) 
Хорошая, уютная квартира, рекомендую!
reviews[6].comments: Onur was very friendly and very easy to reach, via email or What's app. We didn't meet but he had someone else at the apartment who met us there and gave us the keys. The apartment itself was nice, pretty much as shown in the photos. All in all we had a nice staying, even though I wouldn't recommend Aksaray as the perfect neighborhood for tourists in Istanbul.
reviews[7].comments: we really liked it here: spacious, clean, well-decorated, right next to airport metro and main tram line 1, quiet at night, normal neighbourhood, good and responsive host, attractive price. Highly recommended. Just two small remarks: if you like your bedroom dark in the morning bring a sleeping mask as there are just sunshades/privacy screens. And the dinner table is on the terrace, wonderful in summer but maybe not in winter. Again, recommended. Best for 3 people, as there is a master bedroom for 2 and a small bedroom for 1. However there are extra beds.
reviews[8].comments: The apartment is large enough to accommodate we six people. Rooms are clean and equipment with everything you need. Hence we can cook ourselves during the days. However, if you don't want to cook yourself, there are lots of restaurants and small shops. In addition,the location is not bad ( 15 min walking to grand bazaar and 30 min to blue mosque).
reviews[9].comments:
Clean flat where we felt good during our 8-days stay. Made to rent, not "owner's place". Nice terrace which we did not use (we stayed in December). Kitchen well equipped. Correct wifi. Tram and Subway to Airport very near to the flat. The area is not the safest or cleanest we know in Istanbul, but we never felt bad (3 women). A small market is open 24hours and other small Turkish and Kurdish restaurants are all around. 

We did not meet Onur in person, but he has been very responsive when we had questions (such as how to operate a machine where everything is written in Turkish). 

Bear in mind that the flat is on the 4th floor with no lift (especially if you are traveling with heavy luggage) and that there is a steep, uneven-stepped interior staircase leading to shower, main bedroom and terrace. There is one tiny one-bed bedroom downstairs, and a master's bedroom upstairs where the shower+toilet+sink is also located. One additional toilet+ sink downstairs. Decoration was not our favorite but all is clean and probably quite new, so this only an opinion, a matter of taste.. As everywhere in Istanbul, tap water is not drinkable, so you also have to carry water bottles upstairs. 

Recommended flat.. to people with good legs!
reviews[10].comments: We were seven total persons (4 adults, 3 children [4, 6 & 9]) who stayed in the apartment. It was very roomy, and was very pleasant. All bedding and linens were clean and new. \r\n\r\nOnur and his friends were very helpful and very responsive. They helped arrange airport transport, and several of our local needs. I would definitely stay here again!
reviews[11].comments: The apartment was very nice. The district was a very muslim one, but we haven't got any problems. It is very easy to reach from Ataturk airport (line red, Aksaray stop), a little more difficult from SAW airport. It is well connected with all Istanbul zones, for example the T1 line (blue) is very close and it takes you to Sultanahmet and Topkapi within few minutes.We never met Onur, but we were welcomed by Mr. Ibrahim father, a nice man. There is wi-fi in the apartment. The little terrace is very confortable and the view is very nice. We found the apartment kind of clean at our arrival, we only had some problems with a few ants in the kitchen and in the two bathrooms.
reviews[12].comments:
Très bon accueil, logement confortable et bien équipé, bien situé dans un quartier populaire mais tranquille, la terrasse est très agréable.
Le logement est à deux pas du métro vers Ataturk et du Tramway vers Sultanahmet, Galata ... .
Pour ceux qui aiment marcher on peut aussi aller à Sultanahmet à pied, une grosse demi heure de marche sur une avenue commerçante, à mi chemin on passe devant le grand bazar.
Une bonne adresse !

Very welcoming, comfortable and well equipped accommodation, located in a popular but quiet area, the terrace is very nice. 
The accommodation is close to the metro to Ataturk and the tram to Sultanahmet, Galata .... 
For those who enjoy walking you can also go to Sultanahmet on foot, around half-hour walking on a shopping street, halfway you can visit the Grand Bazaar. 
A good place!
reviews[13].comments: merci à Ibrahim, Onur et son cousin pour l'accueil chaleureux dès notre arrivée. Appartement super sympa bien clean, et confortable. Dommage nous n'avons pas profité de la terrasse le début de notre séjour était vraiment très froid et pluvieux. Situation idéale métro, tram à côté, et surtout le quartier très populaire et peu touristique nous a emballées. nous avons mangé pour 3 fois rien dans une "petite cantine" c'était délicieux. Je recommande cet appartement, et j'ai déjà donné les coordonnées à 1 ami qui doit venir sur Istanbul. merci Ibrahim c'était super bien.\r\nA bientôt si je reviens...Nicole
reviews[14].comments: Ibranhim's place was clean, spacious and centrally located on top of a 5 story building.  It is in an ultra local neighborhood with lot of local restraurant, street food and fruit vendors and apprantly popular internet cafes. Truly local experience, though carrying lots of luggage all the way up was a bit work. Ibranhim himself is very communicative and went extra miles to order airport transportation for us, which saved us lots of hassle.
reviews[15].comments: Everything was perfect. Ibrahim gave us full instructions to get to his flat, he also called me back and met us at the metro station. Very kind and very good person! The stay was perfect. No questions, no problems.
reviews[16].comments: The apartment is amazing, it's super clean, beautiful, and spacious. The terrace is the best place to hang out when we are "home." The location is very convenient, less than 5 min walking distance to the red line subway, which is direct to Antarturk airport, 5 min walking distance to the tram, many buses around to Tuksim and other attractions. Many restaurants close by. The building is in safe area.  \r\nMr Ibrahim and his father are very friendly and helpful. I would love to go back to this apartment anytime I have chance to visit Istanbul.
reviews[17].comments: Nice apartment in a nice area! Vibrate atmosphere, close to shops, metro and tramway. The apartement was clean, and quiet. The terrace was great!  Perfect for our long week end! The landlord was available and responsive.
reviews[18].comments: Very nice flat, close to the centre of the city. The hosts are great and helpful.
reviews[19].comments: The area was easily reachable from the airport by the Red line metro, but was a little difficult to find upon arrival. Definitely have a map and walking directions with you, and be sure to search for the Askaray METRO stop - there is also a nearby Aksaray TRAM stop, which is not the same! We did not meet Ibrahim, but were met outside and let into the apartment by his father who was very kind and helpful. The apartment was beautiful and clean, exactly as pictured in the photos and provided more than enough space for our three person group. The apartment also included two air conditioners, which cooled the apartment quickly and were great to come home to after a long, hot Istanbul summer day. The highlight of this place was definitely the lovely terrace. It was a perfect place to relax and overlook the city. The only real drawback about the apartment was its location - while the main sights of the old city were reachable by foot (25 minutes to Sultanahmet square) and by tram (5-10 minutes to Sultanahmet), the tram does not run all night and this made returning to the apartment after a long night out somewhat difficult. But the walk is easy, and passes right by the Grand Bazaar! Would recommend this apartment for guests who do not mind a little exercise (it is on the top floor, and you will be doing a fair bit of walking if you would like to skip the tram) and for whom outdoor space is a priority - I will repeat, the terrace really was spectacular. reviews[20].comments: This is a perfect appartment for travelling with teenagers. reviews[2].comments:
The apartment is very central, just a minute from Taksim and İstiklal. I chose the apartment because of the location close to my school.
There were no problems in the apartment: bathroom, heating, refrigerator all worked as they should.
The layout of the apartment is not optimal: the living room seems added to the apartment, and the cold gets in through the windows. Sleeping on the couch in winter is a cold experience - in summer it is no problem.
Also the apartment doesn’t have a table or a desk. This was no problem the first month or two, as I did my writing and reading in cafes, but it would have been nice to have the opportunity to work from the apartment after a couple of months in cafes.

Right next to the apartment is a school and a schoolyard. The windows from the living room face the schoolyard, and the sound from the school is quite loud.

The neighbour upstairs has a cat that gets up early. From the adjacent apartments you  can hear everything from the neighbours, and they from me. The noise didn’t bother me, because I sleep well and am not bothered by noise, but take it into consideration if you are noise sensitive.

The laundry dryer had some problems, so for some weeks I had to find other solutions, but it was solved, and I could wash again.

I didn’t cook at home. Kitchen is small, but clean. There are not many kitchen tools in the kitchen, but as I didn’t cook, this was no problem.

reviews[2].comments: The place is very close to the main attractions of Istanbul. It is small but it's enough for a good stay.
reviews[3].comments: Farouq is the best host i have encountered so far. Messages were replied really quick although he wasnt in istanbul to meet me, he made sure his colleague was ready to receive me when I reached his apartment. The apartment is great with rooms with individual attached bathrooms. Space was fantastic as well. Location is nearby to places like the blue mosque, grand bazaar, spice market etc. Travelling to IST airport took only about 15 to 20mins. Kudos to Farouq for his excellent apartment and service!
reviews[4].comments: Farouq is very hospitable. He always answers very fast and and he gave us the ride from and to the airport. We were pretty happy for this price. Thank you
reviews[5].comments:
Farouq has a lovely place, which is located in the heeart of Istanbul's tourist area, with all of the city's sites to see conveniently located within a few minutes' walk.
The place is clean with modern bathrooms and other amneties.
Our host remained in touch from the time of booking to check out and even beyond. He arranged transport from and to the airport as well as accommodating our odd check-in and check-out timings.
This was my first trip to Istanbul as well as first Airbnb experience. Both went better than expected. I dare say I feel I have found a new friend!
reviews[6].comments: Приезжали в Стамбул и останавливались у Farouq на 8 ночей. Нас было 5 человек. Снимали 2-х комнатные аппартаменты на 3 этаже. Квартира очень чистая, приятно находится. В каждой комнате отдельный санузел. Единственное, что нам не хватило- это маленького стола, за которым можно выпить чая. Мини кухня содержит все самое необходимое. От остановки трамвая идти 10 минут, до Голубой мечети тоже 10 минут. Очень спокойный район. Рядом есть продуктовый магазин с хорошим выбором продуктов. Рядом набережная Мраморного моря. Отличная квартира. Когда приедем ещё раз в Стамбул, то обязательно остановимся здесь.
reviews[7].comments: About Farouq ....we could not meet but he took all the efforts to make our stay comfortable  through Murat who personally got my heavy bags throgh those rather acutely narrow staircases !!....and his very helpful  travel guide friend Fehmi who was  outstanding. I appreciate all that. Sufi place is small but  central ; convenient and adequate with good kitchen facilities. Hot water was always there... clean towels bedspreads too. Food and mosque closeby made my life easy...and yes UBER could come to pick up most of the time!!  Only issue is climbing up two stairs after big Kebap meals .. .. carrying suitcases needs planning...but we knew it.
reviews[8].comments: Очень удобное месторасположение, недалеко от исторического центра(5-7минут ходьбы)и общественного транспорта. Рядом много ресторанчиков и достаточно магазинчиков, но в тоже время не так много народу ходит по улице. Близко до набережной с прекрасной прогулочной дорожкой. Сложно найти за эти деньги лучше.
reviews[9].comments: Отличная квартира. Все ОК. Только надо что-то делать с wi-fi. Вообще не ловит.
reviews[10].comments: Farouk’s place is nice❤️ Away from the hustle, but close enough to quaint refreshment bars, small stores selling ceramics and silver jewelry. Theres a travel agency a street and a half away, where you can get your trip organized, in case you just came to Athens on a limb and unprepared. The streets are small, lovely, and safe. Its a 15 minute walk to Sultanahmet area which hosts Hahia Sofia, Top Kapi Palace and the Blue Mosque❤️
reviews[11].comments: Farouq was the perfect host.  He set up transportation for us to and from the airport.  Our arrival was very late but he still had someone onsite to greet us and check us in.  The same was true for our departure.  The residence is about a 15-25 minute walk to the Bazar or River so very accessible to all sites in Istanbul.  The residence is perfect for a family of 5.  Beds were great, residence was very clean, and plenty of hot water.  We had a very enjoyable stay.
reviews[12].comments: a good place to stay in Istanbul, very good location. rooms have appropriate amenities. very good for a group of 4-5 persons.
reviews[13].comments: Very very helpful host. Since the start of the booking until the end he was always there to help and advise. Place is very clean and quiet, away from traffic and under a minute from restaurants and shops. Some restaurants were we even open until one bit the morning. With good internet connection this was perfect for me and my family as we wanted to have a nice and relaxing stay and at the same time close to transportation so we can do sightseeing. We will stay here again.
reviews[14].comments: Farouq’s place was very clean and in a convenient location to all of the major tourist attractions. He was a welcoming host, who even stayed behind late to let us check in after our flight was diverted. Thank you for a wonderful stay.
reviews[15].comments: Farouq's place is central to the Sultanahmet area and close by some fantastic restaurants and parks. The place was well furnished and very very clean, and had two bathrooms which was a plus for us. Definitely consider booking this place for a nice, cheap stay in Istanbul!
reviews[16].comments: Yurt dışından misafirlerimi yönlendirmiştim. Çok yardımcı oldular. Teşekkürler.
reviews[17].comments: Farouq was great at organising transportation for us at great prices. He had an emergency maintenance issue which meant having to come to the place late one evening, but to apologise for the inconvenience, he gave the girls a gift which was lovely touch. Great communication and helpful tips about Istanbul.
reviews[18].comments: Super séjour de 4 jours dans un hôtel très calme, mais proche de tous lieux historiques d'Istanbul. A côté de la place sultanameth, 500m. Farouq au petit soin...
reviews[19].comments: Its a clean flat with comfy beds and small kitchenette (ok for making tea/coffee but not really for meal cooking). Check-in was smooth with someone waiting for us at the door to welcome. 10min walk to Sultanahmet!
reviews[20].comments: Good location walking distance to prime attractions, lots of eating options around, had a pleasant stay.
reviews[21].comments:
Communication with Farouq was easy and he always replies and help.
The apartment is a walking distance from touristic places..blue mosque..hagia sophia
Farouq was very cooperative and allowed us to have a late checkout.
Recommended!!!
reviews[22].comments: Great place to stay in Istanbul! Perfectly located to get to the Grand Bazaar and the Blue Mosque/ Eye of Sofia - all of which are less than 10 minutes away.\n\nBoth bedrooms are great sizes, and the bathrooms were good also. Thanks for a great stay!
reviews[23].comments: This was our first time in Istambul, and location was of paramount importance. We were lucky to stay at Farouq’s apartment, because it’s perfectly located in a quiet street in the old city. All the major attractions were just 5-10 minutes walk. The apartment itself was very nice, clean, and comfortable. We had a late flight back. Farouq proposed to leave our belongings at his office (which is in the same building). So we could enjoy our last day in Istambul without carrying bags.
reviews[24].comments: Clean and comfortable accommodation with everything you need in a base to explore and enjoy Istanbul sights and cuisine.  In a great location in Sultanahmet with many of the famous places of interest, such as the Topcapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, Haghia Sophia and the Grand Bazaar all within easy walking distance, and a bit further afield, across the Galata Bridge, Taksim Square and the Galata Tower are also walkable if you're feeling energetic.  After a day out, it was nice to think that we would return to the apartment and be able to relax.
reviews[25].comments: This apartment is very well located ten minutes walking to the most important places such as Blue Mosk, Santa Sophia, Topkapi Palace. Also near to Ataturk Airport.\nThere are a lot of supermarkets and restaurants around the corner that are open until very late.\nI really recomend this place if you don't want to spend time going to the most important tourist places.
reviews[26].comments: Farouq est très gentil et très disponible! Il nous a facilité notre séjour en nous aidant pour plusieurs services. C’est la deuxième fois qu’on s’héberge dans son appartement la literie est très confortable ! Juste un petit coup de propreté et de renouvellement et ça sera super!!
reviews[27].comments: The room is clean and tidy. The room is very close to the scenic spot. The landlord is very enthusiastic and recommends living in this house.
reviews[28].comments: Farouq siempre disponible y la casa justo lo que esperábamos y muy bien localizada
reviews[29].comments: Merci Farouk \nOn était content de notre séjour
reviews[30].comments: Super nice and cozy appartment! My family and i found everything we needed and were super comfortable. Everything was sparkling clean and the location is the best.
reviews[31].comments: El lugar es muy limpio, pero hay que tener en cuenta que qurda en un 3er piso sin ascensor, con escaleras angostas por lo que cuesta subir las maletas. La publicación es cercana a los principales lugares de interés, sin embargo, se requiere desplazarse por calles con pendientes fuertes para llegar a la estación más cercana.
reviews[32].comments: Nice apartment, very close to the main points in old Istanbul. Very good experience.
reviews[33].comments: Thanks for the hospitality!  \nClean, beautiful interior, good locatione!\nWe really liked everything ❤️
