host.host_about:
Hello, this is Güner, welcome to our Family-run business, BERRY LIFE APARTS & ISTANBERRY :)

We are owner of this whole property and also managing here with our family members. We are also working in the two offices left and right side of the apart building entrance door.

Our sensitivities:
1) Cleaning (The most important one. Confirmed with our awards and reviews)
2) Security (Secure with easy-remote alarm system)
3) Working Discipline (No overbooking. And the apartments will be ready in the check-in hour for sure)
4) Solving the Problems (We instantly take an action about your problems during your stay)
5) Enjoying our Work (You will see our energy and positive approach when you arrive)

Let me introduce ourselves :)

*** GÜNER (Me) ***

I was born in Istanbul and I lived in this beautiful city during my whole life. I am a totally local Istanbul citizen, so I hope I can answer all your questions about Istanbul easily :)

I graduated from Marmara University in 2005 and worked for Finansbank Project Finance Department more than 7 years. And then I started working in our own business and quit from bank.

I will be always replying your messages and emails instantly (If I am not sleeping). And also if you need anything or want to ask something or have any problem (Before & during & after your stay) you can contact me, I will be happy to help :)

My office is in the right side of Berry Life Aparts entrance door. You can see me here whenever you want (The blue door).

*** BERİVAN (My Wife) ***

She was born in Düsseldorf and come to Istanbul while she was a baby.

She graduated from Istanbul University in 2005 and she was working in Citibank Credits Department with her 8 years’ experience. And then she started working in our own business and quit from bank.

She is designer of our concepts. We won creativity award in 2012 thanks to her :) She chooses all the furniture and fixture, pictures on the wall, colors of the wall, carpets, curtains etc. If you have any suggestions about the visual issues, she will consider every single one :)

She is also managing real estate office with expertise on furnished rentals. If you are moving to Istanbul and will need long term rentals, she is the correct person to ask :)

Her office (Which is also our reception office) is in the left side of Berry Life Aparts entrance door and open 24 hours.



*** ERDAL (My Mother-In-Law) ***
Honorary Chief & Cleaning Inspector 

She was born in Kastamonu City, and lived there for many years. Then she came to Istanbul.

She was a carpet designer, but when she gave birth to her daughter (My wife), she quit, and only take care of her :) And now, with her great experience, she is taking care of everything and helping us running here :) She is inspector of the cleaning services and we thank her for our famous & awarded cleaning quality. But she can’t speak English very well.

She is also in our reception office during day.

We all will be glad to welcome you :)
Güner & Berivan & Erdal
reviews[0].comments: We enjoyed out stay in Erdal's Studio. It looks exactly like the photos, clean and cozy, but on the small side. Erdal and her niece were very helpful and always very quick at responding to any questions we had. \r\nThe location is good, it does involve a fair amount of waking to reach most destinations, approx 10-15minute walk to nearest tram. However Istiklal Ave is very close and convenient to get to locations if you enjoy walking around. The area is very safe and lively although the roads and sidewalks can be quite uneven. \r\nOverall we would suggest staying with Erdal and feel as though this is a good place for young travelers to explore the less touristy side of Istanbul.
reviews[1].comments: The flat was clean and comfortable-- just as it is shown in the photos.  Erdal was very quick to respond to all my inquiries, which was much appreciated and very reassuring.  The heating in the flat and all the appliances worked perfectly.  The only thing to be aware of is that (as per the picture) there is not a separate shower, just the shower head over the toilet.  Otherwise, a very happy stay!  The flat location is positioned ideally for nights out and it is feasible to walk to all the major tourist spots without wearing yourself out, which was a great bonus for us!
reviews[2].comments: Staying in Erdal's studio was a good experience! Good price for value, the property and the location of the studio, near to Istiklal Caddesi were appreciable for us. Erdal's nephew, spoke perfectly english so she will be able to respond to any demand.
reviews[3].comments: We really enjoyed staying at the Cute Studio Concept during our stay in Istanbul. Erdal and her family are very attentive and easy to communicate with. The flat is a great bargain and a nice option for a stay in Istanbul especially for a young couple or a couple of friends. I definitely recommend it!\r\n\r\nThe only comment is that the shower is a bit of an adventure because it's not partitioned. You basically shower in the middle of the bathroom floor in front of the toilet, but that's all part of the fun!
reviews[4].comments: Erdal and his niece were helpful and kind. Their responses to our emails have always been timely, and they met our every request. The position is strategic to reach anywhere in the city. I advice Erdal if someone will visit Istanbul.
reviews[5].comments: Erdal and her family were great.  They ran the bed and breakfast, and allowed us to check-in early since our flight came in very early in the morning.  For you, that would depend on if there were people in your room the night before.  The room was small, but was as advertised.   Room had clean sheets and towels.  Comfortable beds.  Shower was strange for american standards, but it was a good stay!  Would recommend if you're on a budget
reviews[6].comments: A clean, convenient and safe place, wıth everything you need. Although İ didn't have a chance to meet Erdal, her niece Seyma was extremely helpful and patient when İ had problems with my bank at home - thanks *so* much for all your assistance!!!
reviews[7].comments: We spent a week in Istanbul and during our stay we lived in this apart. We came there with our daughter (she’s 2y.o) and it was really helpful that Eldar gave us baby bath and stroller. The apart itself is tiny but there is everything you need during your vacation. In real life the apart is just the same as you can see on the pictures. It’s a perfect place to stay if you are going to see Istanbul. The only thing that I would recommend is to print presentation (especially map)in color and to use jalousie in the evening. Many thanks to Seima for her help)))))
reviews[8].comments: Owner: Very nice & helpful. Questions were lways fast responded.\r\nRoom: Small but clean\r\n
reviews[9].comments: We had a layover in Istanbul and unfortunately were very disappointed with our stay here in Istanbul.  Our apartment door was in an alley filled with trash and upon entering the apartment all you could smell was mold/mildew. I thought maybe I was overreacting, however, as the night went on I developed allergy symptoms and woke up with a headache and completely congested. We opened a window and turned on the de-humidifier that was in the room, but it did little to get rid of the smell. The shower is only a showerhead over the toilet, however, it provided plenty of hot water. We used Airbnb for our entire two week vaction and this was the only one we had a bad experience at. We left early the next morning and did not get a chance to explore the neighborhood, however, we can’t recommend this room to future renters. Erdal did keep in touch with us and responded quickly regarding our concerns about the protests in Taksim square, however, she will use your e-mail for communication and we were receiving multiple e-mails a day from her and that became somewhat overwhelming as well.
reviews[10].comments: The hosts are great with providing info before and during the stay.  :) The room itself (Cute Studio Concept) is clean but musty.  If mold/mildew bothers you, you probably don't want to stay here.  It probably has to do with the fact that the drain in the bathroom is not at the low point of the floor.  There's a squeegee type thing in the bathroom which would make it easy to push the water in the drain, except that there's a bumpy sticky mat right in the middle of the floor that holds all the water and makes it impossible to move water to the drain.  You can tell this bothered me a little bit.  But!  Aside from musty smell and permanently wet bathroom floor, the place was clean and the price was fairly good.  If those two downsides don't bother you, then it definitely could be worthwhile.  Although there's only one burner, the kitchen is wonderfully well stocked.
reviews[11].comments: During our 3 week tour of Eastern Europe using Airbnb for housing, my girlfriend and I were least impressed with our stay here. To be fair, the place did look as it did in the photos and the communication and check in were second to none in professionalism. The reasons we were left unimpressed was because of the alleyway where trash was scattered around, the musty interior, and the shower and squeegee situation other reviewers have described. In addition, my girlfriend and I kept waking up in the morning with insect bites and found a roach in the sheets. We spent three nights here and never quite felt comfortable. As I said before, there were definitely positives such as the communication and very detailed information and tips the host gave us before the trip. However, even with the budget price, I would have paid a bit more for a more comfortable place to stay.
reviews[12].comments:
This cute little studio apartment is exactly that, cute and little. It appears exactly as it does in the photos and is really all that I needed when staying in Istanbul for 2 nights. There is a funny mildew-y smell, but it really isn't that bad - particularly when you're out all day exploring the huge city. 
I really really appreciated Erdal's emails prior to my arrival, particularly due to the protests in Gezi Park. I was never really that worried, but if I was, Erdal's emails would have easily lessened any worries I may have had.
Erdal's niece was lovely, very friendly and spoke excellent english, Erdal's spoken English isn't as good however she was very friendly and welcoming on my first day. Kindness is a universal language and it was shown on this stay.
Thank you so much.
reviews[13].comments: Todo estuvo perfecto en el apartamento de Erdal. Gran seguridad y privacidad. Cerca de todo. Muy bueno.
reviews[14].comments: We stayed in the appartment in early July. The studio was well located and Erdal was really helpful, providing all the info we needed before our arrival. However, the smell was hard to bear (musty), and the door of the bathroom did not lock. It was ok for one night and adapted to our small budget but I would not recommend it for a long stay.
reviews[15].comments: The studio is in fact a room with a kitchen corner and a shower/toilet. There is indeed a smell of mold because it's rather damp (there's a dehumidifier in the room). If you don't mind this, then it's very good value for money, and the staff is friendly as well.
reviews[16].comments: Excellent location and value!! Erdal and her staff were fantastic and the place was awesome!!! I wish we had more time to spend in that 2bd rm studio but it was just a quick one night stay. Thanks Erdal!!!
reviews[17].comments: The pictures are all real, however, one thing that does not appear on them is the high humidity and the noise from the street. The studio feels more like a tiny underground cave due to high humidity. The noise coming from the cars and people in the streets make it difficult to sleep. I spent 2 nights there after a last minute reservation, and I would not have been able to stay more. Istanbul is an expensive city, but this place is to expensive for the standard.
reviews[18].comments: Very small studio, no big window to open, bed cracking, very stinky (most probably because of rotten wood or something like that), shower is above the toilet!\r\nSo very bad experience, it is easy to find much better at a reasonable price.\r\n
reviews[19].comments:
I would recommend to stay in this apartment if you are traveling on a budget :)
The apartment was clean, in a good location and Erdal and her work partners were very friendly and helpful :)
There was even some food and drinks left for us, which was very handy on our first night as we were very tired/hungry and didn't want to leave the apartment !
The apartment is fairly small but all you need for a short stay.
reviews[20].comments:
Great place if you have a low budget! In Fact tha apartament is a room with a Kitchen corner, e and toilet with a shower on it! But it's clean end the staff is friendly!! Was perfect for me and my friend!! 

It's highly recommended!
reviews[21].comments: My experience at "The Cute Studio" was great! It wasn't luxury, but for the price, the location, and the good service of Güner and Nazim it's perfect.\r\nAs I mentioned, Güner and Nazim were really helpful and responsive to our requests. They gave us tips to tour the city, helped us to communicate with cab drivers, and fixed the shower that I unintentionally broke.\r\nOverall, I am happy with this experience. If I had to go back to Istanbul, I'd stay there again.
reviews[22].comments: Квартира расположена в районе Таксим. Это центр развлекательной жизни в Стамбуле. В этой небольшой квартире есть всё что нужно для комфортной жизни: кондиционер, микроволновая печь, холодильник, душ. Фотографии и описание полностью соответствуют действительности, но возможно не будут соответствовать вашим ожиданиям. Не плохая цена для квартиры в центре. . Были с другом  в Стамбуле два раза. Хотели и во второй раз снять квартиру, но к сожалению было занято. Рекомендую эту квартиру для непритязательных путешественников.
reviews[23].comments:
Приятный персонал. 
Чистое помещение.
Недалеко от Таксима.

Приемлемая цена, но того не стоит.

Неподходящий район для одиноких путешествующих девушек.
Очень тесное помещение для троих.
Ужасно сыро.
Обратите внимание на душ на фотографиях.
reviews[24].comments: The owners were very kind and the apartment was central. For staying some days in Istanbul and you´re on budget it is a great oportunity but for staying longer -for me personally- it would be too small (as you can see in the description). \r\nMoreover the apartment gets a little smelly because there are no windows ;)
reviews[25].comments: i was in the flat for 6 nights.location of the flat is perfect! main street is just 3 min walking. place was really clean and you have everything you need. just one small problem was the bathroom. while taking a shower whater is not going out, so you cant sense the humidity for hours after. but all in all for that price you could not expect more!
reviews[26].comments:
Guner was a fantastic host. Himself and the staff were very helpful with everything  I needed and offered me detailed info about Istanbul and its charms.
The room presented itself exactly in the same way it was illustrated in the photographs, and most importantly - it was very clean and tidy. 
If I were to visit Istanbul ever again, I would most certainly book one of Guner's rooms once more.
The area is not too shabby either. Very close to Taksim Square which is a bubbly area with a spectacular nightlife. Walking distance to Galata Tower.
reviews[27].comments: We have been hosted in a different apartment by Guner and his family before. When this was not available I message the host's who kindly recommended this new apartment. This was an absolute treat and a steal for my colleague to stay in. Small but clean, tidy and very central. \r\nSuch a welcome. Thank you
reviews[28].comments: Güner was the perfect host and we enjoyed our stay. The apartment was in a great location and although a little small for longer stays, it was a charming place. We would stay there again.
reviews[29].comments: The correspondence with the hosts was quickly, helpful and nice. They are really professional hosts. They sent me a lot of useful information about Istanbul, it was really a great present, thank you! The apartment was incredible tiny, it's in fact a room with a kitchenette and a bathroom. It was a surprise but it wasn't a problem because we had everything we needed, the apartment was fully equipped. The bathroom is very new and nice. The bed is comfortable and we had an inusefully long blanket that was very comfortable. The house is in a good place but you need to walk a lot (it wasn't a problem for us) because the public transport is far and for the centre is better walking. There was good central heating in the flat. The apartment is clean and by night we could sleep well, there wasn't any loud noise in the neighbourhood. I recommend the flat only for sleeping but you will go to Istanbul to pass the hole day in the streets :). The description of how to reach the house and the map is a little bit misleading, it is better control the route for the house meticulously before starting off because there is another Burger King earlier in Istiklal street and we were confused. On Sundays there is a fantastic vegetable and cheese market in the next streets we found it by chance and it was really a plus.\r\n
reviews[30].comments: Aucun problème avec ce studio. Il est bien situé et il y a tout le nécessaire si on cherche un endroit où dormir à Istanbul. L'hôte est très sympa et parle bien anglais, il est toujours prêt a aider si on cherche des conseils.
reviews[31].comments: Host was great.  Easy to communicate with and readily available.  Street where the apartment was being worked on by construction and it was a little too dusty. Overall, good experience for a first timer on airbnb.
reviews[32].comments:
Guner and Berry are so welcoming and helpful. They tried all their best to give all info I needed during my stay. 
The accommodation is so clean and has basic requirements. It is located in a residential area, surrounded by some small local shops, cafes, and etc. a few mins walk to Istiklal. 
I should also mention that the flat a tiny studio but good for the price being.
Advice, be aware of taxis in Taksim. Ask for the British embassy and you can walk from there to the flat about 5 min.
Bottom line, I would recommend the host first and then the place.
reviews[33].comments: Guner was great host, always here to help. Flat have everything you need. Street is little dusty and not clean,but overall is good.
reviews[34].comments: We had a nice stay at the hotel-apartment type place. Guner was very nice to us. He tried to help us a lot, especially when we couldn't find the address :))) The room was not the big one, but very nice and clean, with a wonderful terrace on the roof. Also i liked the location. It is located near British Counsulate, very nice street with a lot of bars/restaurants, but still it was not so noisy and annoying. I can tell that the price really corresponds the quality. And if you could book this place you would be very lucky. Thank you Guner. Next time i will book your place in Istanbul for sure.

reviews[36].comments: Absolutly nice small Apartment. Very clean and there Is everything you need. Good located. Only the bed is horrible!
reviews[38].comments: Our guest wanted to book us with credit card, but she doesnt have airbnb account. So we used our second account for the reservation.

reviews[40].comments: i extended  my reservation here and still my opinion  is the same it was really great place to stay , thank you Guner for all the things that you helped me with , if i ever come back to İstanbul i will stay here again for sure .
reviews[41].comments: We liked this flat very much. Erdal was very friendly and he took a good care of us :) The location is very cool. We had a lot of fun in the time of our stay

reviews[44].comments: Nice place and quiet. \nI recommend it

reviews[46].comments: Küçük,tatlı ve ihtiyacınızın olabileceği her şeye sahip studio daire. İstiklal caddesine ve ulaşım araçlarına yakın. Ayrıca oldukça temizdi :)

reviews[48].comments: Çok temiz ve düzgün bir daire.

reviews[62].comments:
Perfect place for a short stay in Istanbul. The apartment is small, but it's more than enough for 2 people to have a rest and shower (you don't travel to stay in the room, right?). Good value for the price.
Great location, close to tourist attractions, public transport stations, restaurants and bars. Had no problem finding our way around.

Highly recommended

reviews[64].comments: Very good experience en general. The apartment its really little but has everything you need. It is really clean too, great service from the 24 hours reception. The only bad thing it's that can be a little noisy at night. But overall a very good experience, I think next time I will stay in other of their apartments that are not in the last floor. Everything in general was really good and I loved their security system, so you can have all your belongs in your rooms without worrying about anything.
reviews[65].comments: Все было супер! Хозяева очень гостеприимные, всегда готовы прийти к тебе на помощь. Комната очень скромная, но главное , что чистая. Удобное расположение, есть где побродить. В общем рекомендую.
reviews[66].comments:
Квартира отлично расположена, рядом улица Истикляль, огромное количество уютных кафе, есть 2 супермаркета рядом, мелкие магазины, небольшой овощной рынок. 15 минут ходьбы до станции метро и 3 минуты до автобусной остановки. 
Квартира расположена на цокольном этаже, очень маленькая и скромная, подойдет для одного человека или максимум двоих. Горячая вода идет хорошо, туалет, душ - все работает. Был предоставлен полный набор посуды, еда на первый день проживания. Быстрый WiFi без перебоев, работает телевизор с местными каналами. Бесплатная стирка вещей в прачечной. 
Очень отзывчивый и приветливый персонал.
В общем, все очень хорошо, и нам понравилось, единственный минус - в квартире была повышенная влажность, и никакие проветривания помещения не спасали, особенно, после пользования ванной комнатой двумя людьми)
reviews[67].comments: This place was great for my first time visiting Istanbul.
reviews[68].comments: Building was in a great location and it was easy to get around the city. Apartment was comfortable and very clean.
reviews[69].comments: Great spot that was close to some really nice places to visit on foot. Cozy little space for two that made us feel right at home. Not the biggest room but with a well equipped kitchen and gorgeous bathroom, we couldn’t ask for more. Cheers!
reviews[70].comments: We had a great stay in Istanbul! We extrnded our atay at Berrys, because we really felt like home and everything was perfect!\nThe appartment is well-located, very central. reviews[71].comments: Good enough but expensive without reason..
reviews[72].comments: Excellent customer service and value for money!
reviews[73].comments: Квартира идеально подойдет для одного- двух человек, небольшая но очень уютная и чистая! При заезде нас ждала питьевая вода, растворимый кофе,  кексики! В квартире есть все необходимое: постельное белье, полотенца, тапочки, фен ,кондиционер , набор посуды и даже сендвичница!) Душ, туалет- все работает отлично, перебоев с водой не было. Квартира находится на цокольном этаже(может быть немного влажно, когда мы приезжали на улице было холодно и дождливо),  вход изолированный- за калиткой, как на фото.Хорошо работает WiFi. reviews[74].comments: It is a very cosy and clean place, I would definitely recommend it to any solo traveller or a couple!

reviews[15].comments: Our stay at Ali's place was perfect. The house was very easy to reach, and the neighborhood was calm and had every kind of store you might need for everyday needs. reviews[16].comments: I was in Istanbul 3 times, and my last time I stayed in Ali's house. It was the best option ever I had in Istanbul. Very calm area, amazing balcony for breakfast, flat is a bit old (as a grandmother's one) but well orginized, big and really comfortable for 3 people. Flat is NOT in the center or any touristical place, so you you will spend time (around 30 minutes with walking) and money (3 turkish lira for each person for 1 ride) to get to another side. Last ferry is around 22 o'clock, so you will be always time limited to go by it back home. But there is also (more far!) metro, what is also reachable. Overall - good expirience and definietly recommended.
reviews[17].comments: I didn't get to meet Ali -- his relatives who live upstairs gave me the key for check in -- but he was very prompt in replying to all messages, and the place was great. A great value with a full kitchen (though I didn't really use it much), two bedrooms, and a nice back balcony with a partial view of the Bosporous. The neighborhood has cafes, grocery stores, and ATMs all conveniently located within a few blocks. It's a short walk to Uskudar or the ferries to the European side, and a quick dolmush (shared van) ride down to Kadikoy, which I was able to figure out with no problem despite speaking almost no Turkish.
reviews[18].comments: This apartment is one of the loveliest apartments I've ever been to ever in my life. The location, the view, the coziness, also Ali is a great host, he helped us a lot during our trip and gave us all the needed tips. Highly recommended, specially for couples.

name: Cozy Bedroom in Heart of Cihangir
summary: In Cihangir, the “Western-spirited” neighbourhood in Istanbul, home to fashion and arts community. One person bedroom with small balcony in big, bright and fully equipped apartment, with a big open kitchen, 1 bathroom and 1 toilet, and a dining room.
space: The room is about 10 square meters / 107 square feet. It is furnished with one single bed, a small hanger closet, a library unit and an office desk. It has a small balcony looking out to the closed but sunny apartment inner ward. Our living-room is spacious and bright. Half of it is my personal study area, but the common area is still very big, and furnished with armchairs, a couch and a dinner table for 4-5 people. We have a big open kitchen, fully equipped with all expectable facilities and utensils. Including a dishwasher, an oven, a garbage disposal unit for organic waste, all kinds of coffee machines, a big fridge inside which we can manage you some room, etc… There are 2 bathrooms : 1 toilet only, 1 with shower, toilet and a washing machine. The flat has hot water 24/7 (I know it sounds mundane, but it is not always the case in Istanbul), a central heating system, and unlimited 50 mbps wireless internet.

neighborhood_overview: The flat is located at the end of Sıraselviler Street, right in Cihangir “kahve” (a square that local people use as a meeting point). It is 10 mins walking distance to Istiklal Street and Taksim square, the heart of “modern” Istanbul, where you’ll find a shopping district and all the nightlife (restaurants, bars, clubs etc).  There is a big supermarket 2 mins from the apartment, and a “bakkal” (small shop open until the late hours of the night) just next to the entrance of our apartment building.
transit: You’ll find a metro station up the street in Taksim, a tramway station 5 mins walking down the street (this tramway will let you access the “old Istanbul” touristic areas, such as Big Bazaar, Hagia Sophia…). access: You are free to use any space and equipment (except personal items and personal groceries) in the flat except our private bedrooms, and my personal area in the living room.
interaction: We are two people sharing the flat. A French girl, and myself. We both know the surrounding area very well and will be happy to help you out with information and recommendations about where to hang out.
house_rules: We want you to feel at home, so please feel free to be yourself. We never felt the need to write down formal house code, we just naturally expect you to be respectful towards us and our neighbours in the building.

host.host_about:
I am an urban planner with architecture and computer science qualifications.
I love to travel and work and am interested in international business. My favorite travel destinations abroad are Greece, South and North America at the moment.   
I am married and a very happy father of two children. I try to travel with my family as long as my son is on holiday and not goes to the school. We all are interested especially in good food, new places and nature. 
This property you are viewing now is located very central in the historical Peninsula so called Sultanahmet and was my home for about 6 years. After I moved to another district I remodeled the house and have now 17 rooms with en-suite bathrooms to rent. Public areas like terrace, breakfast room and a lounge are also available for all my guests. Our location is just perfect in case of being so close to the major sights and security. The standard of the rooms are high and my colleagues working in this property will do their best 24/7  to make you feel homey and get information about the city.  I am sure you will love this property as your home in Istanbul.
My Motto is share everything you can and be thankful for all you have.

I have recently stayed in this apartment for 5 nights.

I have had family and friends popping in and out frequently who fell in love with Murat's cats. Location is amazing and as it has been mentioned in the previous reviews, the view from the living room and the terrace is spectacular. There is everything you could ask for in the area right by the door step; supermarket,  off-license open almost till morning, restaurants for all budget, souvenir shops , breakfast cafes open from 8am, bars. Trams and Busses are about 7/8mins walk as well as the boats to go to the Asian side of Istanbul. Galata Tower, Grand Bazaar, Taksim Square are some of the few walking distance places. If I have to consider one disadvantage , that would be the stairs in the apartment - perhaps if a family with a young child and a buggy would stay in the apartment or someone with an elderly, there are quite a few steps to keep your fit :) 

Best Wishes,
Cisel (London)

Overall a nice experience. Murat was very helpful and welcoming. The flat has all the necessities. And cats are adorable.

I stayed with a friend in Murat’s place for 5 days. The balcony with the view over the city is incredible, potentially the nicest we had in the entire trip. The neighbors from the other flats in the building come up to sit in the balcony, and are friendly, welcoming and charming. Bearing in mind that turkey is a fairly conservative country, I think it’s worth pointing out that this building is somewhat of a liberal stronghold - so this flat would be a really good choice for women travelling alone or LGBT people, etc. 

The flat itself is not exactly pristine, but it’s comfortable and very well located. All the basic things are in good working conditions. Although there’s no a/c, the flat is relatively cool at night and you’ll get a good night’s sleep.

reviews[31].comments:
We had a great time at Murat's apartment, which is wonderfully Bohemian, is in a great location in Galata (near the Tower), and has a fabulous view from the roof terrace.
 Of course, the view comes at a price - not money, as Murat's appt. is excellent value, but you need to be fairly fit as it's at the top of a hill and then four flights of stairs.
Murat is an excellent host, and is also smoker friendly - a breath of fresh air compared to smoker hostile Britain. Non-smokers should not be put off though, as the flat is well ventilated and doesn't smell of tobacco. 
The cooking facilities are fine, but you probably won't want to use them much as there are so many fabulous places to eat nearby at all price levels, which, generally, are much lower than anywhere else we've been in Europe. What's more, you can just pop over to Asia where the prices are even better.
Murat keeps a couple of cats, which I think are rescued street cats. They are very affectionate, seemingly flea free, and enhanced our stay. 
To sum up - Istanbul is amazing fun, great sightseeing, great shopping (bargain hard, but keep it friendly!), fabulous food, good local wines, very friendly, wonderfully  atmospheric and, by European standards, very good VFM, but tough for anyone who is disabled.
When you come to Istanbul, Murat's is the place to stay, just so long as you're ok with cats.
reviews[32].comments: 4 flights of stairs as advertised - spectacular location. Cats as advertised were very Friendly. 1 block to Galata Tower. supermarket nearby - easy downhill walk for local transportation. Worth the stay for a frugal traveler.

neighborhood_overview: You will have easy access to all splendid attractions such as Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and Beyoglu with unique shops, many restaurants, cafe's and bars and museums. You have to take the time to explore the streets filled with quirky shops, designer boutiques and excellent restaurants.  Especially Serdar-ı Ekrem! It may be just one street but it is home to a wide variety of funky, fancy, and down-right quirky shops and boutiques. I'm definitely not a shopping guy myself but there's no denying that it's got some quite interesting places. I'll be sure to give you a nice list of places to eat&drink at when you get here, compiled from places that I enjoy going to myself. They're all located nearby, but, I wouldn't type'em here since I consider it somewhat of a secret recipe : )
notes: There is NOT a dishwasher in the apartment : (  There isn't an elevator in the building so you'll need to climb three staircases. This is a renovated historical building so the windows are a bit heavy to lift up. I'm literally not allowed to install modern ones (not that I'd choose to do so anyway).
transit: The apartment is conveniently located just 250 meters from Şişhane metro station which goes directly to Taksim Square, the city centre.  The distance from apartment to Taksim square is around 1 km. A single metro stop, a pleasant 20 minute walk along the historical Istiklal Street or a short ride in the nostalgic tramway are different options to get to the city center. Getting to the Old City where the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace etc. are is quite easy as well - just a 10 minute walk to the Karaköy tram station and a 15 min tram ride from there. If you would like to go to the Asian side there are ferries to Kadıköy departing from Karaköy. That ferry ride is lovely by the way. All in all I can freely say that the location of this apt. (or any other in the Galata area really) can not be beaten. It's amazingly easy to get to any part of the city.

There's something lovely about making sure people get the most out of their trips, perhaps it's because what I would want to have happen to me when I'm traveling myself.

host.host_about:
Greetings! Despite how unnatural it feels to try and "describe" a human being, especially one's own self, let's give it a shot. I'm an independent game developer, which is a fancy term for "a human who's chosen not to earn as much money as he could be earning in order not to be told how to do things". Having lived in almost every part of Istanbul (and therefore having seen its lowest as well as its highest) I found myself unable to move away from the Galata area and eventually settled here.

As a host, I'm doing Airbnb for the sake of meeting with new people and having an excuse for drinking more beer. Being into this sort of a thing solely for the purpose of having an extra income is, tho I respect that choice as well, just not for me. I'm more of a "eh, let's be off with the fake pleasantries, fake smiles, fake impersonations and hit the damned pub!" person, being much more into conversations and interactions where all sides are genuine and not parts of self-made scripts. 

There's something lovely about knowing that I've helped someone enjoy their trip more. It's not always easy getting a taste of the local life in Istanbul since authentic cities such as this are also usually hyper-touristy. What's more is that the understanding of a "local life" will differ from one part of the city to another, it's as non homogeneous as it gets and that's why I love helping my guests around - so that they can experience how we "the Galata area people" live.

We spent 4 nights in Istanbul at Kerem's apartment, and wish we had stayed longer! We'll have to come back another time.

The location is perfect—maybe 3-4 minutes from Galata Tower and from the Shishane metro stop. Many interesting and unique shops around, lots of coffee shops and restaurant options, etc. Not nearly so touristy as across in Sultanhamet: the area has a 'real' feel, and there are very few buskers. I'd highly recommend this place (and area) for a first time in Istanbul, even though of course you'll have to head over to Sultanhamet to see Topkapi and Hagia Sophia, etc.

The apartment itself is recently-renovated, all fixtures work great, nice shower. Kitchen is small but serviceable—in any case there are so many good restaurants nearby that we only cooked breakfast here—and there's a washing machine and A/C unit and heaters if you need them. It's a little bit off Istiklal street, so there is not much noise at night or in the mornings ... except for whichever neighbor it is who thought a doorbell that played the first few notes of Für Elise at high volume would be an awesome idea. Somehow this particular sound goes right through the walls, despite it otherwise being adequately soundproofed. 

Bed is comfortable, Internet is fine, host is readily available, etc. I'd stay here again the next time I come to Istanbul, and if all the apartments are rented, I'd definitely still stay in this area.

My wife and I had a great stay in Istanbul, and much of it is thanks to Kerem's place. The place was clean and had all the amenities we needed. It is strategically located in the Beyoglu area, which is good for shopping and eating out. We particularly liked to just walk around Istiklal street. It is also not too difficult to get to the Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar.

Kerem himself was helpful with the questions we had. He did not personally meet us, but he gave us his contact number and we communicated using (Hidden by Airbnb) .

Be warned that the apartment is on the fourth floor and that the stairs is narrow and steep. While Kerem's apartment itself is good, the main entrance is in a small cul de sac which was not so presentable. We used Efendi Travel for the airport transfer to the apartment and the driver took a while to find the place.

I strongly advice that when it is time to leave for the airport, call the taxi or Uber at least three hours before your flight. For some reason, the driver of our first Uber request cancelled our request. Then, based on Kerem's advice, we downloaded the taxi app BiTaksi and requested for taxi to the airport. Twice, the taxis we requested ignored us. The app had a map and we could see the taxis were moving away instead of coming towards us. We suspect it is because the taxi rate was too cheap to the airport, and so they thought it was not worth it to take us. Finally we made another Uber request and this time the Uber car arrived and took us to the airport in time.

All in all, Kerem's place is very good value provided you are okay with going up the stairs.

She's a wonderful host, and an interesting person.  
Warm and very helpful. 
She kindly offered us an Istanbul travel card and had some great advice on what to do. 
Besiktas is also a cool area to stay in, and it's central enough to travel to and from all the other sights around Istanbul very easily. 

Thanks again Ulas! We'd love to stay with you again if we ever come back.
reviews[5].comments: Ulaş was a great host! She gave us good advices, was friendly and nice.\r\nHer apartment was lovely and we felt like home. We fell in love with her cats, they were adorable! The neighbourhood (Beşiktaş) is an awesome place for young people-shops and pubs everywhere. Also the location is perfect, close to the centre. We really enjoyed our stay in Istanbul. Thank you, Ulaş!:)
reviews[6].comments: Ulas was a great host for me and my girlfriend's visit to Istanbul. Her place is in a very good location, with great food places nearby and ferry and tram at walking distance. She gave us clear and detailed directions to reach her place. Her recommendation for restaurants became a defining part of our Istanbul experience. Her cats are very cute and friendly. We were moved to another bigger room on reaching. She was not with us during the whole stay but we didn't face any problems in her absence and she was always reachable. Will definitely recommend this place to stay because of the location, price and a nice host.
reviews[7].comments: The reservation was canceled 51 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[8].comments: You were a great host, Ulas. We can highly recommend your place. We liked you and the flat from the beginning and enjoyed talking to you. The cats are a funny bunch, sneaking around and watching us with big yes. It is amazing that though in the middle of busy Besiktas at night in the room one can only hear the muezzin and the occasional call of a rooster. Son Onni is still talking about you and carries the blue airpane around that you made him. And we enjoy listening to the vinyls you gave us.
reviews[9].comments: Stayed in one of two rooms (I think) available at this gritty-but-stylish retro apartment. Small kitchen, lived-in, authentic, Ulas was very generous sharing coffee and such; living area is spacious and lovely: Decorated with music posters and relics from Ulas's event-organizing days, as well as tons of books. It has an artist's pad vibe (which I loved, but might not be everyone's style). Ulas (and roommate, too) were very friendly and communication was excellent. The air circulation in the room was a little less than ideal (I stayed in the second room, with the wrought-iron bed frame) and it got quite hot and humid, but hey, it's Istanbul in the summer and overall it was fine. The cats are friendly but got a little lonely when Ulas was gone, but if you like to play with cats, you'll have a family of three to entertain. The bathroom and other aspects of the "facilities" are worn and gritty, but well-maintained and perfectly functional. If you're looking to live as a student or artist in Besiktas, this is a great place to stay. The best part is that it's right off the main drag, which is extremely crowded and busy, but the apartment is actually amazingly quiet for Istanbul and set back enough from the busy-ness that it feels residential and cozy without any sacrifice in convenience.
reviews[10].comments: The place was really nice and the neighborhood was absolutely amazing. It is very lively and safe and well connected to the rest of the city. I enjoyed my stay a lot and definitely recommend this place. Ulas is a lovely host and has been very helpful and responsive and was always happy to give some tips and recommendations! ❤️
reviews[11].comments: Ulas was a really great host! She was there for me when I had any questions and looked for all my needs. The flat is very cozy, so you can feel comfortable like home. It is very central and you can reach all stations by foot. \nRecommended! :)
reviews[12].comments: Ulas's place is in a stunning local area called Besiktas. I really enjoyed the energy of the students and the trendiness of the coffeeshops. Even though it looks rundown, it's very safe to stay there.\nDuring my stay it was quite noisy outside, as the bedroom overlooks the front section of the apartment. The lounge area was lovely and very bohemian.
reviews[13].comments: I didn’t stay at ulas’s place because of a time schedule conflict.
reviews[14].comments: It was very cozy and comfortable to live here. Ulas is very caring and friendly. It was a really good time and unforgettable journey! Thank you so much!
reviews[15].comments: Ulas’s house was in a perfect location: silence but at a minute walking from the center of Besiktas.\nThe room was comfortable and familiar.\nUlas’s was a really good host and very helpful for advice on Istanbul! I absolutely recommend this place and can’t wait to go back!
reviews[16].comments: It was a good stay. I really enjoyed the hospitality.
reviews[17].comments: We had a lovely time at Ulas' place. The area, Besiktas, is really cool, with lots of nice restaurants and cafés nearby. It was also easy to travel to the sights on the European side that we wanted to see. Ulas was very accommodating and helpful - she gave us great suggestions for where to eat, drink etc. We would definitely recommend the place to others!

reviews[6].comments: Great host!
reviews[7].comments: We stayed at Metins apartment for a week , the location is pretty good, not even 5 minutes to Taksim square, the communication with Metin was pretty easy, he answers really quickly and is always helpful. It could have been a little cleaner but apart of that we were pretty happy with our decision.
reviews[8].comments: Nice location next to Taksim square. The apartment is big with two double beds, kitchen and bathroom. Don't know if it's because it was raining but the bathroom always smelled pretty bad, like sewer.\nMy biggest complain was the wifi and lack of communication. We spent 11 days in the apartment and the wifi only worked for 2 days. I messaged the host several times to see if it culd be fixed but he never even answered my texts. And in a city where public wifi is not the best, we needed to conect to the internet at home... it's nearly 2019!
reviews[9].comments: Metin is a very welcoming and responsive host. There is no problem with late check-in or check-out times. \nThe place itself is as I expected and a teal value for the money. Its location is just perfect. \nRecommended.
